Method: 提出Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM)：在黎曼流形(M,g)的Wasserstein空间P2(M)上构建生成模型。训练时将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度，以McCann位移插值作为条件路径；理论上证明该构造在P2(M)上是有效的流匹配方法；并引入Riemannian Entropic Map作为流形上最优传输映射的GPU高效近似。仅需测地距离和投影算子。

Result: 实验表明，通过尊重数据的本质几何，RWEFM能在超球潜空间中生成完整单细胞样本，并能在环面上生成蛋白质构象集合；此外还在一般三角网格上生成分布，证明其不局限于具有闭式几何的流形。

Conclusion: RWEFM是首个在黎曼流形Wasserstein空间上进行流匹配的生成框架，通过黎曼最优传输和熵映射近似，在保持计算效率的同时捕捉非欧氏数据的元分布结构，且仅依赖测地距离与投影算子，几何通用性强。

Abstract: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. Our experiments show that by respecting the intrinsic geometry of the data, RWEFM can generate whole single-cell samples in hyperspherical latent spaces and protein conformational ensembles on the torus. As RWEFM requires only a geodesic distance and a projection operator, it is not restricted to manifolds with closed-form geometry, which we demonstrate by generating distributions on a general triangulated mesh.

</details>


### [229] [Marginal Log-Likelihood Increments under Dirichlet-Smoothed Markov Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25675)
*Levin David Schwab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Dirichlet平滑转移模型中新增一条工作流轨迹的似然变化,刻画为参考条件分布与模型之间KL散度的加权缩减,并据此推导采集增益上界、协方差恒等式与批次目标的非子模/非超模判别准则;在BPI Challenge 2012案例中给出反直觉结论:个体增量预测更准的回归器反而获得更小的可达增益份额。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动学习/过程挖掘中的采集(acquisition)通常依赖对单条轨迹或单批候选的增益排序,但缺乏对"新增一条轨迹究竟改变多少参考加权对数似然"的精确刻画,也不清楚个体排序准确性与批量采集质量之间的关系。作者希望从Dirichlet平滑转移模型出发,给出增益变化的解析形式,从而为批次采集的目标性质(可优化性、候选交互)与评估指标提供理论依据。

Method: 以Dirichlet平滑的转移模型为对象,推导在训练档案中加入一条工作流轨迹所引起的参考加权对数似然的精确变化;将其改写为参考条件分布与模型条件分布间KL散度的加权缩减形式;由此导出:(1)任一采集可得增益的上界(把毫纳特级差异表示为可达增益的份额);(2)参考加权效应的精确协方差恒等式;(3)两候选交互项的符号判据,用以证明批量目标既非子模也非超模。最后在BPI Challenge 2012贷款申请日志上开展案例研究,在参考加权与预算单位的四种组合中测量上述三项,并比较两个基于相同描述符与相同标签的回归器的个体增量预测精度(中位数R² 0.87 vs 0.62)与其实际可达增益份额(61% vs 69%)。

Result: 理论上得到增益上界、参考加权的协方差恒等式以及候选交互的符号准则,并证明批量目标不具备子模性或超模性。案例研究在四种参考加权×预算单位组合中仅一种出现正向选择结果;在该情形下,个体增量预测更准确的回归器(中位数R² 0.87)实现的可达增益份额反而更小(61%),而精度较低的回归器(中位数R² 0.62)取得69%。

Conclusion: 对单条轨迹的排序准确性既非批量采集质量的必要条件,也非充分条件;以个体增量预测精度作为采集代理指标是不可靠的。批量主动采集的评估与设计应直接面向"可达增益份额"这一度量,而非个体排序精度。

Abstract: For a Dirichlet-smoothed transition model, the effect of adding one workflow trace to the training archive is an exact change in reference-weighted log likelihood. We derive that change and show that it is a weighted reduction of Kullback--Leibler divergence between the reference conditionals and the model. From this form we obtain an upper bound on the gain available to any acquisition, which expresses a millinat difference as a share of what is attainable, an exact covariance identity for the effect of the reference weighting, and a sign criterion for the interaction between two candidates, from which the batch objective is neither submodular nor supermodular. A case study on the BPI Challenge 2012 loan-application log measures all three and finds a positive selection result in one of the four combinations of reference weighting and budget unit. There, of two regressors fitted to identical descriptors and identical labels, the one that predicts individual increments far more accurately, median $R^2$ 0.87 against 0.62, realizes the smaller share of the attainable gain, 61 against 69 per cent, so ranking accuracy for individual traces is neither necessary nor sufficient for batch quality.

</details>


### [230] [Graph Domain Adaptation Does Not End with Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25692)
*Ziqian Liu,Yongxue Xu,Enze Zhang,Jiaqi Zhang,Hao Wang,Maolin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EviGDA，通过在图域自适应中引入一个无图传播的局部专家，以任务级固定概率混合两个独立优化的专家，在推理时融合互补预测证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图域自适应方法虽通过传播重设计、分布对齐或源到目标迁移建模来适配图表示，但仍依赖单一路径进行目标预测。在拓扑偏移下，图感知专家与无图局部专家的失效模式可能不同，单一图表示未必穷尽目标域中的预测证据。

Method: 框架包含两个独立优化的专家：图感知专家进行消息传递并施加熵感知的边缘对齐；无图局部专家仅从源节点特征和标签学习，不做图传播与目标对齐。二者不联合训练、不使用学习式路由或目标伪标签，仅在推理阶段通过任务级固定概率混合进行组合。

Result: 在十个数据集、16个迁移任务上的大量实验表明，EviGDA优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 以无图局部专家补充图表示适配，可在不引入联合训练/伪标签等复杂机制的情况下提供互补预测证据，从而提升图域自适应的目标域预测性能。

Abstract: Graph domain adaptation (GDA) transfers knowledge from a labeled source graph to an unlabeled target graph under shifts in both node attributes and graph structure. Existing methods primarily adapt graph representations through propagation redesign, distribution alignment, or source-to-target transition modeling, but still rely on a single graph-propagating path for target prediction. This leaves open whether an adapted graph representation exhausts the predictive evidence available in the target domain, since the graph-aware expert and graph-free local expert may exhibit different failure modes under topological shifts. To address this limitation, we propose EviGDA, an Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert. The graph-aware expert performs message passing and entropy-aware marginal alignment, while the graph-free local expert learns solely from source node features and labels without graph propagation or target alignment. The two experts are optimized independently and combined only at inference through a task-level constant probability mixture, preserving complementary evidence without joint training, learned routing, or target pseudo-labels. Extensive experiments on ten datasets and 16 transfer tasks show that EviGDA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [231] [Fully Byzantine-Resilient Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25701)
*Haejoon Lee,Dimitra Panagou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出完全鲁棒的多智能体强化学习方法FRAC-MARL，利用两跳消息冗余识别可靠消息，在拜占庭边缘攻击下参数几乎必然收敛至无攻击极限点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式拜占庭鲁棒AC-MARL方法仅能保证参数收敛至无攻击极限点的邻域，性能下降，无法完全抵御攻击。

Method: 每个智能体利用两跳消息的冗余性识别可靠消息；在线性参数化价值函数与团队奖励函数、拜占庭边缘攻击（限于通信层）假设下，针对时变通信图进行收敛性分析，并提出新的拓扑收敛条件及多项式时间可验证的网络构造方法。

Result: 证明智能体参数几乎必然收敛到与无攻击情形相同的极限点，给出可多项式时间验证的拓扑条件及系统化网络构造方法，并在协作多机器人编队控制任务上验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: FRAC-MARL实现了完全鲁棒的分布式AC-MARL，克服了现有方法仅收敛到邻域的局限，为拜占庭攻击下的多智能体学习提供了理论保证与实用框架。

Abstract: We study distributed Byzantine-resilient actor-critic multi-agent reinforcement learning (AC-MARL), where agents collectively learn policies through local interactions. Existing methods guarantee convergence of the agents' parameters only to a neighborhood of the attack-free limit points, resulting in degraded performance. We propose Fully Resilient AC-MARL (FRAC-MARL), a decentralized method in which each agent leverages redundancy in two-hop messages to identify reliable messages. Under linear parameterizations of the value and team-reward functions and Byzantine edge attacks, where adversarial behavior is confined to the communication layer, we prove that agents' parameters converge almost surely to the same limit points as in the attack-free case over time-varying communication graphs. We introduce a novel topological condition for the convergence of our method, present a systematic method to construct such networks, and prove that this condition can be verified in polynomial time. Finally, we demonstrate our method on cooperative multi-robot formation control tasks.

</details>


### [232] [Slow Decay and Silenced Expression: Iterated Subliminal Trait Transfer in Language-Model Lineages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25721)
*Ryan Vo,Duc-Vu Nguyen,Matt Kretchmar,Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究模型谱系中潜意识特质的传递深度。将特质植入Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct三个副本并迭代训练至第十代，发现特质可跨十代持续存在；且特质可在内部激活层面存在而行为层面缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前关于潜意识学习（subliminal learning）的研究仅覆盖单次训练步骤，即教师特质可通过不含该特质内容的过滤数据传递给学生，但尚不清楚这种特质在模型谱系（lineages）中能否延续或逐渐消退。

Method: 向三个Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct副本注入特质，并从每个副本迭代训练步骤至深度十。对每一代用两种方式在同一留出提示上读取：一是关键词筛选（检测输出中特质的表达），二是激活探针（将模型相对基座的位移投影到由其他谱系教师构建的方向上）。此外还进行移除默认系统提示的评估，以及用第十代学生的位移对未处理基座进行引导（steering）的实验。

Result: 第一，特质在三个谱系的十代中持续存在。注入模型在每次补全中都表达该特质；关键词筛选率在第一步后降至55.6%，到第十代降至21.1%；基座在全部300次补全中均未匹配筛选。第二，特质可内部存在而行为缺失：评估时移除默认系统提示后，第十代学生的关键词筛选率在每个提示上均为零，而探针分数在每个提示上仍为正。用第十代学生的位移引导未处理基座，可在移除系统提示时诱导出被筛选到的特质表达，而该学生自身在移除系统提示时却不表达该特质。

Conclusion: 潜意识特质可跨模型谱系多代持续存在，且存在内部表征与行为表达的解耦（internal presence without behavioral expression），说明仅凭行为层面的关键词筛选会低估特质的实际保留程度，激活探针能揭示更深层的特质延续。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly trained on the outputs of other models, forming chains that we call lineages, in which a trait present in one generation can pass to the next. Prior work on subliminal learning has shown that a teacher's trait can transmit to a student through filtered data carrying none of the trait's content. However, the evidence covers only a single training step. We study whether such a trait holds or fades across lineages. We instill the trait into three copies of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and iterate the training step to depth ten from each, reading every generation two ways on the same held-out prompts: a keyword screen that looks for expressions of the trait in the model's output, and an activation probe that projects each model's displacement from the base onto a direction built from the other lineages' teachers. We report two findings. First, the trait persists through ten generations across three lineages. The instilled models express it on every completion; the keyword-screen rate falls to 55.6% after the first step and to 21.1% by generation ten. The base itself matches the screen on none of its 300 completions. Second, the trait can be present internally while absent behaviorally. When the model's default system prompt is removed at evaluation, the generation-ten students' keyword-screen rate is zero on every prompt while the probe score stays positive on every prompt. Steering the untreated base with the displacement of a generation-ten student, which is trained and measured under the default system prompt, induces screened expression of the trait even with the system prompt removed, while that same student shows no expression of the trait with the system prompt removed.

</details>


### [233] [Signed Graph Pre-Training and Prompt Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25722)
*Zihan Mei,Rong Pan,Yuzhou Chen,Yixuan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoSIGN，一个面向符号图的拓扑引导图预训练与提示学习框架，将磁符号拉普拉斯结构编码器与基于 Dowker 复形持久同调的拓扑分支融合，再迁移至提示学习函数，在合成与真实数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号图（边含正负且可有向）广泛存在于信任-不信任网络、金融相关系统、生物交互图等场景。尽管符号图神经网络提升了特定任务的表现，但符号图上的图迁移学习仍发展不足，缺乏通用的预训练与提示学习框架。

Method: TopoSIGN 包含两部分：一是基于磁符号拉普拉斯（magnetic signed Laplacian）构建的结构编码器；二是新颖的持久同调分支，通过 Dowker 复形持久性图像（persistence images）刻画符号拓扑。两者得到的嵌入进行融合，并迁移至提示学习（prompt learning）函数。

Result: 在合成数据集与真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TopoSIGN 能有效提取符号图中的有用结构信息，并验证了该通用框架的适应性与灵活性。

Conclusion: TopoSIGN 是面向符号图的拓扑引导预训练与提示学习框架的先驱工作，通过结构编码与拓扑特征的融合实现了有效的迁移学习，为符号图迁移学习提供了通用、可扩展的方案。

Abstract: Signed graphs arise in trust--distrust networks, financial correlation systems, biological interaction graphs, and many other domains in which edges can be positive or negative and may also be directed. While signed graph neural networks have improved task-specific learning, graph transfer learning on signed graphs remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce TopoSIGN, a pioneer topology-guided graph pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs. TopoSIGN combines a structural encoder built on the magnetic signed Laplacian with a novel persistent-homology branch that summarizes signed topology through Dowker-complex persistence images. The fused embeddings are then transferred to a prompt learning function. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the efficacy of TopoSIGN in extracting useful structural information in signed graphs, as well as the adaptability and flexibility of the proposed general framework.

</details>


### [234] [Self-Supervised Combinatorial Optimization with Constraints via Frank-Wolfe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25728)
*Akbar Rafiey,Yifei Xu,Nikolaos Karalias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用自监督框架，允许神经网络输出任意连续向量，并通过基于Frank-Wolfe的几何分解将其近似为可行解的稀疏凸组合，从而在无需投影和问题特定构造的情况下处理硬组合约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续、基于梯度的训练难以处理离散优化中的硬组合约束。现有将组合目标连续凸化扩展的方法通常需要投影步骤把网络输出限制在可行多面体内，并依赖特定问题的临时构造，缺乏通用性。

Method: 允许神经网络预测可能位于可行多面体之外的任意连续向量；利用基于Frank-Wolfe方法和近似Carathéodory结果的几何分解算法，将这些预测近似为可行解的稀疏凸组合；该分解诱导出一个几乎处处可微、定义为离散目标期望值的自监督损失，并在推理时提供自动舍入保证。

Result: 在多个组合问题上取得较强实证表现，包括二次分配问题（QAP）、最大覆盖问题（Maximum Coverage）和旅行商问题（TSP）。

Conclusion: 该框架无需投影和问题特定构造即可通用地处理硬组合约束，兼具可微损失与推理时舍入保证，并在多种组合优化任务上表现良好。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning for combinatorial optimization has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving discrete optimization problems with neural networks, but a central challenge remains: handling hard combinatorial constraints within continuous, gradient-based training. Continuously extending combinatorial objectives to convex domains is a powerful technique, yet existing approaches often require projection steps that constrain neural network outputs to lie inside the feasible polytope and rely on ad-hoc and problem-specific constructions. We propose a general framework in which the neural network is allowed to predict arbitrary continuous vectors that could potentially lie outside of the feasible polytope. These predictions are then approximated by sparse convex combinations of feasible solutions using a geometric decomposition algorithm based on Frank--Wolfe methods and approximate Caratheodory results. This decomposition induces an a.e.-differentiable, self-supervised loss defined as the expected value of the discrete objective. The same procedure provides an automatic rounding guarantee at inference time. We demonstrate strong empirical performance across multiple combinatorial problems, including the Quadratic Assignment Problem, Maximum Coverage, and the Traveling Salesperson Problem.

</details>


### [235] [Beyond Class Marginals: Bounding Rehearsal Gaps without Freezing Class Co-occurrence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25735)
*Congren Dai,Nat Roongjirarat,Fei Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将"排练间隔"(rehearsal gap)从类别边际与类别共现中分离出来进行研究，提出随机遍次排练(RPR)，使每个常驻类在每个打乱遍次中恰好被访问一次，在保持均衡时间平均类别边际的同时将间隔上界限制为2*ceil(C/b)-1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类别均衡的排练只控制类别频率，却不能决定同一类别连续两次被排练之间的间隔长度；作者希望单独研究这一"排练间隔"效应，将其与类别边际、类别共现等时间统计量区分开来。

Method: 提出随机遍次排练(RPR)：在固定C个常驻类、回放批大小b≤C时，每个常驻类在每次打乱遍次中恰好被访问一次；调度器不使用未来类别信息，不增加回放样本或前向计算，并对常驻集变化时给出随churn变化的条件界。另用线性头ER-ACE诊断分析来/回放批次联合缺失所产生的单边分类偏置梯度。

Result: RPR保持均衡的时间平均类别边际并将每个间隔上界限制为2*ceil(C/b)-1；更长的缺席期对应更大的负向偏置位移，移除来批损失掩码会削弱该调度效应；在ER-ACE主实验中，相对储层存储下的独立类别均衡检索，最终平均准确率提升0.72–1.67个百分点，均衡存储下亦有正向效果；预训练ViT在测试的LT10流与小回放批下呈正向效果，但匹配的更大批对照无实质影响。

Conclusion: RPR在不增加样本与计算的前提下通过控制排练间隔改善了持续学习性能，但固定周期与复用遍次等对照同时改变了多个时间统计量，因此实验未能将排练间隔长度与其他时间依赖形式完全隔离；准确率收益依赖于学习器与运行机制。

Abstract: Class-balanced replay controls class frequency but does not determine the interval between successive replay appearances of a class. We study this interval, the rehearsal gap, separately from the class marginal and class co-occurrence, and introduce randomised-pass replay (RPR), which visits each resident class once per shuffled pass. For a fixed set of C resident classes and replay batch size b less than or equal to C, RPR preserves the balanced time-averaged class marginal and bounds every gap by 2*ceil(C/b)-1; a churn-conditional bound applies while the resident set changes. The scheduler uses no future class information and adds no replay examples or forward passes. In a linear-head ER-ACE diagnostic, joint absence from the incoming and replay batches produces a one-sided classifier-bias gradient. Longer absence episodes are associated with larger negative bias displacement, and removing the incoming-loss mask attenuates the scheduling effect. In the primary ER-ACE experiments, RPR improves final average accuracy by 0.72-1.67 percentage points relative to independent class-balanced retrieval under reservoir storage, with positive effects also observed under balanced storage. Pretrained ViTs show positive effects on the tested LT10 streams with small replay batches, while matched larger-batch controls show no material effect. Fixed-cycle and reused-pass controls change more than one temporal statistic, so the experiments do not isolate rehearsal-gap length from all other forms of temporal dependence. The accuracy effects depend on the learner and operating regime.

</details>


### [236] [Modular Norm RandOpt: Population-Efficient Ensembling through Architecture-Aware Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25745)
*Kirato Yoshihara,Hiroaki Hamade*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出模块化范数RandOpt（Modular Norm RandOpt），通过按模块自然范数与校准尺度进行架构感知采样，在保持选择与投票机制不变的前提下以更少候选超越原RandOpt，实现更高准确率与墙钟时间节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始RandOpt使用全局扰动尺度，忽略了不同模块在几何尺度上的异质性，导致扰动几何不匹配、采样效率低。作者希望以架构感知的方式改进扰动尺度设计，从而提升无梯度搜索的候选效率与集成效果。

Method: 提出Modular Norm RandOpt：一种架构感知的采样方法，采用逐模块的自然范数（module-wise natural norms）与校准尺度（calibrated scales），同时保留原有候选选择与多数投票流程；在七个任务、三个Qwen规模（0.5B–3B）上评估，并扩展至Llama 3.2 3B与Gemma 3 4B。

Result: Countdown上与RandOpt相比使用3倍更少候选即超越，GSM8K上至少12倍更少候选即超越，并带来墙钟时间节省；在七个任务、三个Qwen规模下，Countdown、GSM8K、MATH-500的每个规模上平均准确率均更高；增益延伸至Llama 3.2 3B与Gemma 3 4B；在Qwen2.5-1.5B上，与迭代基线在可比主运行评估预算下取得更高平均准确率；GSM8K上尾部密度诊断表明仅1.2–1.8倍候选缩减，多数集成提升与更有利的正确专家支持相关。

Conclusion: 扰动几何是预训练模型周围种群高效、无梯度搜索的关键设计选择，模块化范数与校准尺度能显著提升候选效率与集成准确率。

Abstract: RandOpt samples weight-perturbed language models and ensembles top-ranked candidates through plurality voting, but its global perturbation scale ignores heterogeneous module geometry. We propose \mbox{\textbf{\emph{Modular Norm RandOpt}}}, an architecture-aware sampling method using module-wise natural norms and calibrated scales while preserving selection and voting. It outperforms RandOpt using $3\times$ fewer candidates on Countdown and at least $12\times$ fewer on GSM8K, with corresponding wall-clock savings. Evaluations across seven tasks and three Qwen scales ($0.5$B--$3$B) show higher mean accuracy than RandOpt on Countdown, GSM8K, and MATH-500 at every scale. The gains extend to Llama 3.2 $3$B and Gemma 3 $4$B on Countdown and GSM8K. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, our ensembles also achieve higher mean accuracy than iterative baselines on both tasks at comparable main-run evaluation budgets. On GSM8K, a tail-density diagnostic implies only a $1.2$--$1.8\times$ candidate reduction, while most ensemble improvement is associated with more favorable correct-expert support. These results highlight perturbation geometry as a key design choice for population-efficient, gradient-free search around pretrained models.

</details>


### [237] [Minimal Recurrent Behavioral Memory for Imitation under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25757)
*Xianyao Li,Fang Xu,Rui Min,Ruitong Tian,Jing Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了部分可观测条件下复现专家行为所需的最小循环记忆，通过相容关系给出最小熵表征与精确证书，并提出单载体测量协议分离行为充分性、超额码率与观测信息，实验验证其在操控任务中的零至低比特需求及监督学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注一个基础问题：在部分可观测环境中，要复现某专家策略，最少需要多少循环（recurrent）记忆。即时需求可刻画为专家行为商的条件熵，但循环记忆还必须在使用前保留未来观测无法恢复的区分信息，因此需要给出更精确的最小循环行为记忆理论刻画，并区分行为充分性、码率冗余以及由观测或其他记忆路径携带的信息。

Method: 方法上引入相容关系（compatibility relation）：在传递性情形下其等价类达到精确最小值；一般情形则转化为对封闭相容状态分配的熵最小化问题，并在有限实例上给出精确证书。提出单载体测量协议（sole-carrier measurement protocol），用于分离行为充分性、超额码率以及由观测或其他记忆路径携带的信息。实验中以诱导出的符号行为模型和给定占用分布衡量比特需求，并结合事件无关的未来行为监督训练该表示。

Result: 在多种操控任务中，随着隐藏模式增长到512，学习到的码率仍接近0比特和2比特需求；预期记忆（anticipatory memory）呈现2→1→0的需求变化，尽管等待期间即时需求为零。学习该表示仍然困难：事件无关的未来行为监督在单一冻结配置下产生36/40个充分种子，并将最长视野的像素设置从0/8提升到6/8充分留出种子（闭环成功率从0.08提升到0.57）。在未修改的社区基准上，协议证明了与延迟无关的需求，充分码在中延迟处与之匹配。

Conclusion: 该监督有助于形成承诺（commitment），但可能引入预测性冗余；对其进行退火可使模仿与码率训练降低该冗余，从而将信息论目标与学习该目标的能力区分开来。整体上，论文给出了部分可观测下最小循环行为记忆的理论刻画与可测量协议，并揭示了理论最优需求与实际可学习性之间的差距。

Abstract: What is the least recurrent memory needed to reproduce a specified expert under partial observability? The instantaneous requirement is the conditional entropy of the expert's behavioral quotient, but recurrence must also preserve distinctions that future observations will not restore before use. We characterize this minimal recurrent behavioral memory by a compatibility relation: under transitivity its classes attain the exact minimum, while the general case is an entropy minimization over closed compatible state assignments, with exact certificates on finite instances. A sole-carrier measurement protocol separates behavioral sufficiency, excess code rate, and information carried by observations or other memory paths; experimental bit requirements refer to the induced symbolic behavioral model under the stated occupancy. Across manipulation tasks, learned code rates remain near zero- and two-bit requirements as hidden modes grow to $512$, and anticipatory memory follows a $2\to1\to0$ requirement despite zero instantaneous demand during waiting. Learning this representation remains difficult: event-agnostic future-behavior supervision yields $36/40$ sufficient seeds with one frozen configuration and improves the longest-horizon pixel setting from $0/8$ to $6/8$ sufficient held-out seeds (closed-loop success from $0.08$ to $0.57$). On unmodified community benchmarks, the protocol certifies delay-independent requirements, which sufficient codes match at mid-delay. The supervision aids commitment but can induce predictive surplus; annealing it lets imitation and rate training reduce that surplus, separating the information-theoretic target from the ability to learn it.

</details>


### [238] [Disentangling Heterogeneous Traffic Dynamics for Multi-Step Traffic Forecasting via Adaptive Spectral Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25777)
*Zijun Huang,Chenrui Fu,Wenhao Wang,Xiaochuan Gou,Chih-Chieh Hung,Guanyao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应分解网络ADNet，通过可学习的互补频谱分解机制将交通动态分解为主导与残差成分并分别建模，在多步交通预测中取得优于基线的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步交通预测困难在于观测信号包含特征与可预测性各异的异质时间动态；现有方法通常在统一表示中建模或依赖预定义分解规则，难以灵活分离持久模式与快速波动。

Method: ADNet采用成分特定的预测框架，引入可学习的互补频谱分解机制，确定每个频率bin对主导和残差两个成分的贡献比例；不同于硬性频率划分，每个频率bin都能以不同学习比例同时贡献于两个成分，使分解与预测目标联合优化；重构后的成分由两个专用的时空预测分支建模，并融合其预测生成最终多步预测。

Result: 在TraffiDent数据集的Alameda和Orange区域上，ADNet在24项区域-预测步长-指标对比中的20项取得最佳性能，且长预测步长下增益尤为明显；容量控制消融实验显示，可学习分解显著优于固定分解，并在双分支架构之外带来额外提升。

Conclusion: 结果验证了自适应分解与成分特定建模对多步交通预测的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate multi-step traffic forecasting remains challenging because observed traffic signals contain heterogeneous temporal dynamics with different characteristics and levels of predictability. Existing approaches typically model these dynamics within a unified representation or rely on predefined decomposition rules, which may limit their ability to flexibly separate persistent patterns from rapidly varying fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose the Adaptive Decomposition Network (ADNet), a component-specific forecasting framework that adaptively disentangles traffic dynamics into dominant and residual components. ADNet introduces a learnable complementary spectral decomposition mechanism that determines the contribution of each frequency bin to the two components. Unlike hard frequency partitioning, every frequency bin can contribute to both components with different learned proportions, allowing the decomposition to be optimized jointly with the forecasting objective. The reconstructed components are then modeled by two dedicated spatiotemporal forecasting branches, and their predictions are integrated to generate the final multi-step forecast. Experiments on the Alameda and Orange regions of the TraffiDent dataset show that ADNet achieves the best performance in 20 of the 24 reported region-horizon-metric comparisons, with particularly clear gains at longer forecasting horizons. Capacity-controlled ablation experiments further show that the learnable decomposition substantially outperforms a fixed decomposition and provides additional improvements beyond the dual-branch architecture alone. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of adaptive decomposition and component-specific modeling for multi-step traffic forecasting.

</details>


### [239] [A Lightweight Plastic-Memory Framework for Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25781)
*Zihan Mei,Zhili Qin,Tongze Zhang,Hongyuan Liu,Junming Shao,Qinli Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向图少样本增量学习的轻量可塑记忆框架，通过演化微聚类结构与元学习策略，兼顾新旧知识的稳定与适应，在四个基准数据集上表现优越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图增量学习需缓解灾难性遗忘，传统基于重放或蒸馏的方法计算开销大、效率低；在真实场景中新类别标注数据稀缺，问题更严重，因此需要一种轻量且适用于少样本图增量学习的方案。

Method: 核心是构建随时间演化的可塑记忆模块，持续更新与扩展记忆以容纳新类并保留旧知识；模块轻量高效，采用创新的演化微聚类结构，动态更新类原型、子原型及其交互权重。在此基础上提出记忆驱动的元学习框架：内循环增强对新任务的适应，外循环维持对早期任务的稳定性。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架在平衡旧知识稳定性与新知识适应性方面表现优越。

Conclusion: 轻量可塑记忆结合演化微聚类与记忆驱动元学习，可有效应对图少样本增量学习中的灾难性遗忘与计算低效问题，实现稳定与适应的良好平衡。

Abstract: Graph Incremental Learning has garnered increasing attention as dynamic graph data continues to emerge across diverse fields. Conventional approaches primarily address catastrophic forgetting by preserving node-related knowledge through replay or distillation techniques; however, they often incur high computational costs and inefficiency. This issue is further exacerbated in real-world scenarios where labeled data for new classes is scarce. In this paper, we propose a novel lightweight plastic-memory framework specifically designed for few-shot incremental learning on graphs. The core idea of our framework is the construction of a plastic-memory module that evolves over time, continuously updating and expanding its memory to accommodate new classes while retaining previously learned knowledge. In contrast to existing techniques, our memory module is both lightweight and effective, featuring an innovative evolving micro-clustering structure that dynamically updates representations of class prototypes, sub-prototypes, and their interaction weights. Building on this memory module, we introduce a memory-driven meta-learning framework that enhances adaptability to new tasks in its inner loop while maintaining stability for earlier tasks in the outer loop. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the framework's superior performance in balancing stability for old knowledge and adaptability to new knowledge.

</details>


### [240] [Evaluating Accuracy and Probabilistic Reliability of Zero-Shot Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25788)
*Panagiotis Michael,Moysis Symeonides,Demetris Trihinas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对六种时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在能源、交通、金融数据集上进行基准评测，发现其虽优于统计基线与监督深度模型，但存在点预测精度与概率可靠性之间的根本性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSFM研究多以零样本预测的精度为目标，忽视了预测精度与概率校准之间的权衡，缺乏对实际部署中泛化能力与不确定性量化平衡的实证指导。

Method: 构建基准评测：选取六种TSFM，在能源、交通、金融三类数据集上评估，并与统计基线及一个监督深度学习模型进行对比，考察点预测精度与概率校准表现。

Result: TSFM整体优于统计方法与监督模型；但精度与概率可靠性不可兼得：xLSTM类架构在各预测步长下概率校准稳健；patch-based transformer精度具竞争力但长步长下校准恶化；transformer类模型存在使零样本推理最优的上下文饱和点。

Conclusion: TSFM存在精度—校准权衡，需按架构特性与预测步长选择模型，为实际部署中兼顾泛化与不确定性量化提供实证依据。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) promise a paradigm shift toward zero-shot forecasting by eliminating task-specific training. However, existing works often overlook trade-offs between predictive accuracy and probabilistic calibration. This paper presents a benchmark study of six TSFMs evaluated on energy, traffic, and financial datasets. We contrast their performance against statistical baselines and a supervised DL model. The study reveals that while TSFMs outperform statistical methods and supervised models, they are subject to a fundamental trade-off between point accuracy and probabilistic reliability. Specifically, xLSTM architectures provide robust probabilistic calibration across horizons. In contrast, patch-based transformers offer competitive accuracy but face calibration issues at long horizons, while transformer-based models exhibit context saturation points for optimal zero-shot reasoning. These findings offer evidence-based guidance for balancing generalization and uncertainty quantification in real-world deployments.

</details>


### [241] [Latest Exact Match Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25802)
*Moritz Brösamle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LEMA 注意力变体：查询与键二值化，每个查询仅关注最近的完全匹配键，理论证明其与 word-RAM 相互可模拟，并给出可行训练方法与推理实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 hard attention（如最右 hard attention）表达能力受限且缺乏高效的反向模拟；需要一种既能保持 word-RAM 等价表达力、又能在计算与内存上高效对应的注意力机制。

Method: 将 query/key 二值化，查询只 attend 最近完全匹配的 key；用 straight-through estimator 处理二值化、并用向 LEMA 退火的 soft attention 替代不可微操作进行训练；推理时采用基于字典的实现，字典存于主存。

Result: 证明带 CoT 的 LEMA transformer 可模拟 word-RAM，且 word-RAM 可反向模拟 LEMA，每 token 代价与上下文长度无关；合成联想召回任务上优于固定状态规模的 GDN；最大 834M 参数模型损失约匹配一半大小的 softmax transformer，在长距离召回上超过同规模 GDN；生成速度恒定、与 GDN 相当。

Conclusion: LEMA 在理论与实践中建立了注意力与 word-RAM 的紧密对应，实现了随状态增长的高效存储与长距离召回，并保持常数级生成速度，为高效长上下文建模提供了新方向。

Abstract: We introduce latest exact match attention (LEMA), an attention variant for transformers where queries and keys are binarized and each query attends only to the latest exactly matching key. We prove that LEMA transformers with chain of thought can simulate word-RAMs, as was recently shown for the less restrictive rightmost hard attention. In contrast to prior hard attention variants, the restriction to exact matches enables an efficient converse direction: word-RAMs can simulate LEMA transformers at a cost per token independent of the context length. Together, these results yield a close correspondence between the two computational models in terms of both compute and memory. Beyond the theory, we propose a training method for LEMA transformers that handles their non-differentiable operations with a straight-through estimator for the binarization and a soft attention surrogate annealed towards LEMA. On a synthetic associative recall task, LEMA models trained this way use their growing state to store and recall a large number of associations, outperforming gated DeltaNet (GDN) with its fixed state size. As a first scaling test, we train LEMA language models with up to 834 million parameters. They match softmax transformers of around half their size in loss and, on repeated rare phrases and a needle-retrieval task, remain behind softmax transformers but recall across longer distances than GDN models of comparable size. Finally, we implement dictionary-based inference for LEMA transformers and show constant generation speed comparable to GDN despite their growing state, with the dictionaries residing in main memory rather than VRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention.

</details>


### [242] [Auditing Proxy-Based Validation Across Text Spans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25808)
*Daein Weon,Dong Ho Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，当评估分数与其廉价代理标签（proxy label）取自同一文本片段时，二者的一致性可能来自共享的表面证据，而非代理本应代表的语义构念。作者提出将"分数、分数片段、代理、目标构念"显式声明为"验证契约（validation contract）"，并在评分片段之外重新读取代理以做严格复评。在 HotpotQA 正确性实验中，仅改变共享文本边界，50 字符前缀处分数与代理一致性远高于与正确性的一致性（差距 +0.184），120 字符后该差距降至 ≤+0.045；短前缀下分数仍能预测答案串是否后出现（AUC 0.634），但与正确性一致性等价于随机。OR-Bench 上抑制模型固定开头模板可消除分数与拒绝代理的大部分关联，而等量删除则几乎无影响，构念一致性仍为随机水平。11 个外部契约仅 3 个支持片段外控制，路由研究均未公开所需生成文本。作者呼吁：声明每个标签的读取片段、同时报告构念一致性与代理一致性、并公开生成文本以支持片段外复读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估分数的效度常通过与廉价代理标签的一致性来验证，但若分数与代理从同一文本片段（span）计算，二者的一致性可能源于共享的表面证据（如词汇重叠、格式模板），而非代理所要代表的语义构念。这种"测在同一片段上"的做法会产生虚假效度：现有的代理验证实践由此可能高估评估分数的真实构念效度，且无法区分"分数确实排名目标构念"与"分数只是捕捉了与代理共有的表面线索"。论文旨在揭示并量化这一问题，并给出可操作的补救规范。

Method: 1）形式化：将分数（score）、其读取片段（span）、代理（proxy）与目标构念（target construct）声明为一个"验证契约（validation contract）"，要求代理在评分片段之外被重新读取，形成"片段外控制（off-span control）"。2）HotpotQA 正确性实验：仅改变共享文本边界（共享前缀长度），在受控条件下比较分数-代理一致性与分数-正确性一致性，并测量与正确性一致性的等价性检验及对答案串后续出现的预测能力（AUC）。3）OR-Bench 实验：对比两种干预——抑制每个模型反复出现的开头模板（template suppression）与等量删除（matched-volume deletion），观察分数与拒绝代理关联的变化，并检查构念一致性。4）契约审查：审计 11 个外部验证契约是否支持片段外控制，并检查被抽样的路由研究是否公开用于重读代理的生成文本。

Result: HotpotQA 受控实验中，50 字符前缀处分数与代理的一致性显著优于与正确性的一致性，差距为 +0.184；从 120 字符起该差距坍缩至至多 +0.045。在短前缀下，分数仍能预测答案串是否在后续文本中出现（AUC 0.634），但等价检验显示其与正确性的一致性处于随机水平，说明所报告的代理一致性并不能证明分数对正确性具有排名能力。OR-Bench 上，抑制各模型固定开头模板后，分数与拒绝代理的大部分关联消失，而等量删除几乎不改变该关联，且与构念的一致性仍为随机水平。外部审查发现，11 个契约中仅 3 个支持片段外控制，且抽样的路由研究没有一个公开其所需的生成文本。

Conclusion: 基于代理的效度验证在分数与代理共享文本片段时会产生误导性的一致性，其来源往往是表面证据而非目标构念。论文提出三项规范性要求：其一，任何基于代理的验证主张必须声明每个标签所读取的片段；其二，需在报告代理一致性的同时报告构念一致性；其三，需公开生成文本，使代理能够在评分片段之外被重新读取。作者由此呼吁将"片段外控制"确立为代理验证的标准实践，以避免评估分数效度被系统性高估。

Abstract: Evaluation scores are often validated by their agreement with inexpensive proxy labels. When the score and the proxy are computed from the same text span, however, that agreement can arise from surface evidence the two share rather than from the semantic construct the proxy is meant to represent. We make the distinction explicit by declaring the score, its span, the proxy and the target construct as a validation contract, then re-evaluating that proxy rule strictly outside the scored span. In a controlled HotpotQA correctness experiment varying only the shared text boundary, the score agrees with its proxy far better than with correctness at a 50-character prefix: the gap is +0.184, collapsing to at most +0.045 from 120 characters onward. At that short prefix the score still predicts whether the answer string appears later (AUC 0.634) while an equivalence test places its agreement with correctness at chance, so the reported proxy agreement does not establish that the score ranks correctness. On OR-Bench, suppressing each model's recurring opening templates removes most of the score's association with the refusal proxy, while matched-volume deletion removes almost none and construct agreement stays at chance. Only three of eleven external contracts support the off-span control, and none of the routing studies we sampled released the generations it needs. We therefore ask that a proxy-based validation claim declare the span each label is read from, report the construct agreement beside the proxy agreement, and release the generations that let the proxy be re-read off the scored span.

</details>


### [243] [You Only Need 2/3 of the Chosen Experts: An Empirical Study of Dynamic Expert Pruning in Fine-Grained MoE LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25809)
*Yuanteng Chen,Qiwei Lai,Chen Tianqi,Peisong Wang,Yuantian Shao,Nanxin Zeng,Zhilei Liu,Chuangyi Li,Jing Liu,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对12个细粒度MoE检查点（9个架构家族）进行系统实证研究，发现专家选择冗余度远高于预期：均匀保留约2/3的已选专家即可平均保持98.8%性能，并带来1.2–1.7倍速度提升；现有动态剪枝方法在保守预算下优势微弱（<1%），仅在激进剪枝下最多领先均匀截断3.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度MoE（数百专家、每token选择更多）已成开放权重LLM主流，动态专家剪枝被视为降低推理成本的途径。但现有证据多来自较粗粒度架构和基于似然打分的多项选择基准，未回答细粒度场景下三个核心问题：每token专家选择的冗余程度、现有剪枝方法对该冗余的利用效率、以及何种因素决定模型对剪枝的敏感度。

Method: 构建系统实证研究：覆盖9个架构家族的12个细粒度MoE检查点，核心评测套件包含11个基准，涵盖知识问答、数学、代码生成与通用推理；对比均匀保留（uniform truncation）基线与已发表动态分配规则；在两个服务后端测量实际加速；并分析模型属性（规模、思考型、多模态）对剪枝敏感度的影响。

Result: 专家选择冗余度远超领域现用操作点假设：均匀保留约三分之二的已选专家，平均保留98.8%的未剪枝性能，仅需改动一个整数字段，在两个服务后端实现1.2–1.7倍实测加速。该简单基线在保守预算下压缩了动态分配空间——即便最优已发表规则在匹配专家预算下与其差距不足1%。其价值在激进剪枝下显现：最优规则较均匀截断最多恢复3.0%，收益集中于退化最严重的生成式任务。剪枝敏感度因模型而异：更大模型与思考型模型更鲁棒，多模态模型更脆弱。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了细粒度MoE可舍弃的专家计算量，并界定动态分配何时才值得其复杂度，为实际部署与未来剪枝方法提供指导。总体而言，均匀截断是强基线；动态分配主要在激进预算与生成式任务上具备价值。

Abstract: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures have become a mainstream design for open-weight LLMs, with hundreds of experts and increasingly many selected per token. This shift makes dynamic expert pruning an attractive route to cheaper inference. Yet existing evidence comes largely from coarser architectures and likelihood-scored multiple-choice benchmarks, leaving three central questions open in the fine-grained regime: how redundant per-token expert selection is, how effectively existing pruning methods exploit that redundancy, and what governs a model's sensitivity to pruning. We fill this gap with a systematic empirical study of twelve fine-grained MoE checkpoints spanning nine architecture families, with a core suite of eleven benchmarks covering knowledge QA, mathematics, code generation, and general reasoning. We find that expert selection is far more redundant than the field's operating points assume: uniformly retaining about two thirds of the selected experts preserves 98.8% of unpruned performance on average, requiring only a one-integer change and delivering 1.2-1.7x measured speedup across two serving backends. This simple baseline leaves little room for dynamic allocation at conservative budgets: even the best published rules differ from it by under 1% at matched expert budgets. Their value emerges under aggressive pruning, where the best rules recover up to 3.0% over uniform truncation, with gains concentrated in the generative tasks that suffer the sharpest degradation. Sensitivity to aggressive pruning also depends on the model: larger and thinking models are more resilient, whereas multimodal models are more vulnerable. Together, these findings reveal how much expert computation fine-grained MoEs can dispense with, and establish when dynamic allocation earns its complexity, informing both practical deployment and future pruning methods.

</details>


### [244] [Multi-View Fair Clustering Guided by Cross-View Sensitive Information Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25811)
*Mudi Jiang,Jiahui Zhou,Xinying Liu,Zengyou He,Zhikui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种由跨视图敏感信息差异引导的多视图公平聚类框架。方法通过估计各视图的敏感依赖程度，设计"偏差排序的非对称对齐"机制，使敏感依赖高的视图向敏感依赖低的视图学习，并用跨视图差异自适应调节对齐过程，同时对共识软分配施加公平正则化。在基准数据集上取得了聚类质量与群体公平性的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图公平聚类方法对各个视图采用基本统一的公平机制，未显式区分它们在敏感依赖程度上的差异。实际上，不同视图编码的敏感信息量差别很大；若忽略这种跨视图差异，高敏感依赖视图会在跨视图学习中影响低敏感依赖视图，从而同时损害聚类性能与公平性。

Method: 1）估计每个视图的敏感依赖程度；2）提出偏差排序的非对称对齐机制，鼓励高敏感依赖视图向低敏感依赖视图学习；3）利用跨视图差异自适应调节对齐过程；4）在共识软分配上施加公平正则化，促进群体公平。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在聚类质量与群体公平性之间实现了良好的平衡。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模并结合跨视图敏感信息差异，可有效缓解统一公平机制带来的性能与公平性双重下降问题，为多视图公平聚类提供了新思路。

Abstract: Multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to uncover latent cluster structures by exploiting complementary information from multiple views. Despite substantial progress in clustering performance, fairness remains an important concern when MVC is applied to socially sensitive scenarios. Recent fair multi-view clustering methods have introduced fairness constraints into representation learning or clustering assignments. However, these methods generally treat different views under a largely uniform fairness mechanism, without explicitly distinguishing their varying levels of sensitive dependence during cross-view learning. In practice, different views may encode substantially different levels of sensitive information. Ignoring such cross-view discrepancy can allow highly sensitive-dependent views to influence less sensitive-dependent ones during cross-view learning, potentially degrading both clustering performance and fairness. To address this issue, we propose a novel multi-view fair clustering framework guided by cross-view sensitive information discrepancy. Specifically, we estimate the sensitive dependence of each view and develop a bias-ranked asymmetric alignment mechanism that encourages views with higher sensitive dependence to learn from those with lower sensitive dependence, while cross-view discrepancies are further exploited to adaptively regulate the alignment process. Moreover, fairness regularization is imposed on the consensus soft assignments to further promote group fairness. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a favorable balance between clustering quality and group fairness.

</details>


### [245] [CacheDyG: Decoupling Temporal Propagation for Efficient Dynamic Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25814)
*PinHeng Zong,Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CacheDyG框架，通过时间依赖缓存将时序传播与参数更新解耦，仅训练轻量refiner、残差门与预测器，选择性刷新缓存，实现更少参数、更低耗时且更具竞争力的动态图预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态图神经网络在每次优化迭代中都耦合时序传播，并为每个节点-时间对维护大量可训练表示，导致对基本未变的历史结构反复重算，带来显著的训练与参数开销。

Method: 将时序传播与常规参数更新解耦：构建按时间排序的时序依赖缓存，以不可训练缓冲区存储图感知的节点-时间表示；标准训练轮次中仅读取缓存并更新轻量缓存refiner、自适应残差门及链接预测器；并通过选择性缓存刷新保持缓存表示与监督目标一致，避免逐轮稀疏传播。

Result: 在五个动态图基准上，CacheDyG以显著更少的可训练参数和更低运行时间，取得优于基线的预测性能。

Conclusion: 基于缓存的解耦为可扩展动态图学习提供了一条有效原则。

Abstract: Dynamic graphs are widely used to model time-evolving relational systems in real-world applications. Dynamic graph neural networks provide an effective framework for capturing both structural dependencies and temporal dynamics in such data. However, they typically intertwine temporal graph propagation with every optimization epoch and often maintain large trainable representations for each node-time pair. This design repeatedly recomputes largely unchanged historical structures, leading to substantial training and parameter overhead. To address this critical issue, we propose CacheDyG, a Cache-refine framework for efficient Dynamic Graph learning. Specifically, it decouples temporal propagation from routine parameter updates by constructing a time-ordered temporal dependency cache that stores graph-aware node-time representations in non-trainable buffers. During standard training epochs, CacheDyG reads from the cache and updates only a lightweight cache refiner, an adaptive residual gate, and the link predictor. Selective cache refresh further keeps cached representations aligned with the supervised objective while avoiding epoch-wise sparse propagation. Experiments on five dynamic graph benchmarks show that CacheDyG adopts substantially fewer trainable parameters and lower runtime to obtain more competitive predictive performance than baselines. These results demonstrate that cache-based decoupling provides an effective principle for scalable dynamic graph learning.

</details>


### [246] [Protocol before progress: leakage-aware evaluation of AIS trajectory prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25827)
*Zobeir Raisi,Vali Mohammad Nazarzehi Had*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出AIS船舶轨迹预测中"架构创新带来性能提升"的结论在很大程度上受评测协议影响；作者构建了防泄漏评测协议（按船舶、时间、区域划分），在丹麦与美湾两套AIS语料上审计TrAISformer、GATransformer及受AISFormer启发的受控重构模型，发现协议效应（oracle解码、船舶共享划分、区域不相交划分）比架构机制影响更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIS轨迹预测文献常把误差下降归因于新架构，但很少把评测协议本身当作误差来源来衡量。划分方式若有泄漏（如训练与测试共享船舶、时间或区域），会虚高模型性能，导致架构贡献被高估、结论不可复现。因此需要一个明确、可审计的防泄漏评测协议，并系统量化协议带来的误差变化。

Method: 构建leakage-aware评测协议，采用船舶不相交、时间不相交、区域不相交三种划分；在两类交通特征不同的语料上实验：丹麦全国AIS 31天、美国墨西哥湾休斯敦与加尔维斯顿近海30天。审计对象包括TrAISformer、GATransformer，以及受AISFormer启发的受控重构模型（含一个仅0.43 M参数的小型编码器，基于局部偏移量）。

Result: 两套语料上均出现三类协议效应：1) TrAISformer的best-of-16 oracle解码相对贪心解码误差降低2.1–3.2倍；2) 共享船舶的划分使一小时误差下降23–25%，而0.43 M参数编码器仅≤2%；3) 区域不相交划分使美湾语料上TrAISformer一小时误差从2.2 km升至24.6 km，因99.9%测试上下文落在训练未见经度区间，而基于局部偏移的编码器不受影响。架构机制影响较小：GATransformer图注意力在两套语料上无明显收益，其水道特征贡献12–22%；时间不相交划分的效果跨语料不稳定（13% vs 2%）。

Conclusion: AIS轨迹预测报告的增益需区分架构贡献与评测协议贡献；防泄漏的船舶/时间/区域不相交划分是必要基准，否则性能提升可能主要由泄漏或解码策略造成。作者公开划分与代码，推动可复现、可比对的评测。

Abstract: Reported gains in vessel-trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data are credited to new architectures, but the evaluation protocol is rarely measured as a source of error reduction. We build a leakage-aware protocol with vessel-, time- and region-disjoint splits and apply it to two corpora with different traffic: 31 days of Danish national AIS traffic and 30 days of US Gulf coast traffic off Houston and Galveston. On both, we audit TrAISformer, GATransformer, and controlled AISFormer-inspired reconstructions. Three protocol effects appear in both corpora. First, TrAISformer's best-of-16 oracle decoder lowers error by a factor of 2.1-3.2 relative to greedy decoding. Second, a split that shares vessels lowers its greedy error by 23-25% at one hour, against 2% or less for a compact 0.43 M-parameter encoder. Third, a region-disjoint split raises TrAISformer's one-hour error from 2.2 to 24.6 km on the US corpus, because 99.9% of the test contexts fall in longitude bins never seen in training; the encoder built on local offsets is unaffected by this. Architectural mechanisms matter less: GATransformer's graph attention gives no measurable benefit on either corpus, while its waterway feature is worth 12-22%. The effect of a time-disjoint split is not stable across corpora (13% versus 2%). We release the splits and code.

</details>


### [247] [In-Context Guidance: Learning Inter-Task Synergies via Numerical Foundational Models for Few-Shot Multitask Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25836)
*Tingyang Wei,Haofeng Wu,Jiao Liu,Zhao Wei,Puay Siew Tan,Yew-Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ICG-MTO框架，利用冻结的数值基础模型通过上下文学习为少样本多任务优化提供任务间耦合估计的辅助引导，并在多任务贝叶斯优化与MFEA-II中实例化验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务优化（MTO）同时求解多个任务，但在评估预算有限时，任务间关系估计不准确，易导致负迁移。传统方法仅依赖稀缺的已观测数据，难以在少样本场景下准确刻画任务耦合。

Method: ICG-MTO采用冻结的基础模型进行上下文学习以推断辅助引导信号，包含三阶段：1）由已评估解构造算法特定的上下文查询；2）用基础模型推断刻画任务间预测关系的引导信号；3）将信号转化为算法特定的引导，用于最大后验耦合估计。该引导在早期数据稀缺阶段起正则化作用，并随任务观测累积逐步退出。作者将其实例化为ICG-MTBO（用方向性适应度类别查询引导任务间耦合估计）和MFEA-II实例（用决策空间重叠查询引导随机交配概率估计）。

Result: 在合成基准与真实机械臂控制问题上，以及在不同采集函数和进化多任务设置下的评估中，ICG-MTO均展现出有效性，验证了其面向少样本多任务优化的通用性与有效性。

Conclusion: ICG-MTO通过引入数值基础模型的上下文引导，缓解了少样本多任务优化中的负迁移问题，具备跨算法、跨采集函数和跨进化多任务的通用性。

Abstract: Multi-task optimization (MTO) addresses a set of optimization tasks simultaneously, often suffering from inaccurate inter-task relationship estimation under limited evaluation budgets, leading to negative transfer. This paper introduces In-Context Guidance Multitask Optimization (ICG-MTO), a novel framework that leverages numerical foundational models to improve inter-task coupling estimation in few-shot scenarios. Unlike conventional methods that rely solely on scarce observed data, ICG-MTO employs a frozen foundational model to infer auxiliary guidance through in-context learning. The framework operates through three stages: constructing an algorithm-specific in-context query from evaluated solutions, using the foundational model to infer a guidance signal characterizing predictive relationships among tasks, and translating this signal into algorithm-specific guidance for maximum-a-posteriori coupling estimation. This approach provides regularization during the early, data-scarce stages of optimization and gradually relinquishes control as task-specific observations accumulate. We instantiate the framework in multitask Bayesian optimization as ICG-MTBO, using directional fitness-class queries to guide inter-task coupling estimation, and further instantiate it in MFEA-II using decision-space-overlap queries to guide random mating probability estimation. Experiments across synthetic benchmarks and a real-world robot arm control problem, together with evaluations under different acquisition functions and evolutionary multitasking, demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of ICG-MTO for few-shot multitask optimization.

</details>


### [248] [Gaussian Flow-Matching Schedules: Implications for Sampling and Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25839)
*Arsène Claustre,Hugo Negrel,Claire Boyer,Kimia Nadjahi,Eric Vanden-Eijnden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究流匹配（flow-matching）调度策略，揭示方向相关调度可分解为方差路径与因子分解两个独立设计维度，分别控制采样动力学与回归方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配的调度（schedule）会同时影响采样动力学与回归目标的方差。作者希望厘清这两类效应是否可以被解耦，从而为调度设计提供清晰的理论指导。

Method: 针对中心化且可交换（commuting）的高斯分布，将方向相关调度分解为：(1) 方差路径，完全决定中间分布律与概率流；(2) 因子分解，在保持该流不变的前提下控制不可约回归方差。采样侧分析有限步欧拉法的精度，推导精确 N 步采样所需的漂移下界；训练侧对任意固定路径推导闭式因子分解。

Result: 证明了方差路径与因子分解的独立可分解性；给出有限步欧拉精度的分析，并导出精确 N 步采样所需漂移上界，将测地路径与对数路径联系起来；对于任意固定路径，得到使时间平均回归方差最小或使其沿路径保持恒定的闭式因子分解。

Conclusion: 流匹配调度设计可拆解为方差路径与因子分解两个正交维度，分别对应采样效率与训练方差；论文为路径选择与因子分解提供了理论刻画与闭式解，并为测地路径与对数路径建立了联系。

Abstract: Flow-matching schedules affect both sampling dynamics and the variance of the regression target. For centered commuting Gaussians, we show that a direction-dependent schedule decomposes into two independent design choices: a variance path, which fully determines the intermediate laws and probability flow, and a factorization, which leaves this flow unchanged while controlling irreducible regression variance. On the sampling side, we analyze finite-step Euler accuracy and derive a necessary drift bound for exact N -step sampling, connecting the geodesic and the logarithmic path. On the training side, for any fixed path, we derive closed-form factorizations that either minimize time-averaged regression variance or make it constant along the path.

</details>


### [249] [Neural Approximation by Function Composition: Rigidity and Doubly Exponential Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25874)
*Wentao Huang,Haizhang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究一类"单一标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和"机制，该机制是深度神经网络逼近力来源的经典构造（如帐篷映射构造 \(x-x^2\)、Yarotsky 与 W. E 等人的递归表示）的基础。作者先证明刚性定理：分段线性生成元只能表示至多二次的 \(C^3\) 函数；随后构造光滑生成元，实现平方逼近与多项式逼近的双指数误差衰减，并对可和幂级数给出 \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) 的一致误差率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络通过仿射映射与非线性激活的复合获得逼近能力，但"复合"本身如何产生逼近力尚不完全清楚。作者希望剖析这一复合机制的一个基本构件——单一标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和，以理解深度网络逼近率的来源与限度。

Method: 1) 形式化"单一标量生成元迭代的几何加权和"表示机制，统一刻画帐篷映射构造与既有递归多项式构造；2) 对有限段连续分段线性生成元证明刚性定理，通过分段结构与 \(C^3\) 光滑性约束推导表示能力上限；3) 以精确余项恒等式为指导，构造光滑生成元，使迭代在总深度上产生双指数误差衰减；4) 借助乘法模块将该结论推广到每个固定多项式；5) 对 \([-1,1]^d\) 上绝对可和幂级数，按单项式次数分配深度。

Result: (1) 刚性定理：有限段连续分段线性生成元只能表示至多二次的 \(C^3\) 函数；对非仿射二次函数，其几何因子至少为 \(1/4\)。这既揭示了帐篷映射方法的局限，也补充了基于层次基与递归多项式构造的既有方法。(2) 构造出光滑生成元，其迭代在总深度上实现平方逼近的双指数误差衰减，并通过乘法模块覆盖每个固定多项式。(3) 对 \([-1,1]^d\) 上绝对可和幂级数，按单项式次数分配深度，在每个内部立方体上获得 \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) 的一致逼近误差。

Conclusion: 生成元动力学与余项估计共同支配深度神经网络的深度分配与逼近率；经典帐篷映射类构造存在刚性上限，而光滑生成元可突破该限制并实现更优的深度-精度权衡。

Abstract: Deep neural networks approximate functions by composing affine maps with nonlinear activations, but how composition itself creates approximation power is not yet fully understood. We investigate a fundamental mechanism: geometrically weighted sums of iterates of a single scalar generator function. This mechanism underpins the classical tent-map construction of the function \(x - x^2\) and related recursive representations used by Yarotsky, W. E, et al., to analyze the approximation powers of deep neural networks.
  First, we establish a rigidity theorem: for continuous piecewise linear generators with a finite number of segments, any \(C^3\) function that can be represented in this way is at most quadratic. For non-affine quadratic functions, the geometric factor is at least $1/4$. This result both reveals limitations of the tent-map approach and complements existing methods based on hierarchical bases and recursive polynomial constructions. Second, using an exact remainder identity as guidance, we construct a smooth generator whose iterates yield doubly exponential error decay in total depth for square approximation and, through multiplication modules, for each fixed polynomial. For power series with absolutely summable coefficients on \([-1,1]^d\), distributing depth according to monomial degree yields a uniform approximation error of order \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) on each interior cube. These findings demonstrate how generator dynamics and remainder estimates govern depth allocation and approximation rates of deep neural networks.

</details>


### [250] [Evaluating the Effectiveness of SechKAN on 1D Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25876)
*Hoang-Thang Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于双曲正割（sech）函数作为基函数、并采用一维投影降低参数量的KAN变体 SechKAN，在三个一维分类数据集上验证其有效性与影响因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KART 与神经网络设计的结合催生了 KANs，但其参数量与适用性仍是关注点。作者希望探索以 sech 为基函数、通过一维投影将参数量降至与 MLP 相当的 KAN 变体是否有效。

Method: 提出 SechKAN：以双曲正割函数作为基函数，并采用 1D 投影压缩参数规模。在 UCI HAR、ElectricDevices、Crop 三个一维分类数据集上，与 EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D 在参数量大致相当的预算下进行对比，并开展网格大小与归一化的消融实验。

Result: SechKAN 在三个数据集上取得有竞争力的性能，在 Crop 上表现尤为突出；消融实验表明网格大小与归一化会影响性能。

Conclusion: SechKAN 的有效性依赖数据集与架构选择，说明该 KAN 变体的优势并非普适，需结合具体任务与设计进行权衡。代码已开源。

Abstract: The connection between the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem (KART) and neural network design has led to the development of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), with applications ranging from STEM problems to AI tasks. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of a KAN variant, SechKAN, which relies on hyperbolic secant (sech) functions as basis functions, with a 1D projection to reduce the number of parameters to a level comparable to MLPs. We evaluate SechKAN on three 1D classification datasets: UCI Human Activity Recognition (UCI HAR), ElectricDevices, and Crop, and compare it with several effective networks, including EfficientKAN, MLP, CNN1D, ResNet1D, and DSCNN1D, using approximately comparable parameter budgets. The results indicate that SechKAN achieves competitive performance across the three datasets, with particularly strong performance on Crop. Ablation studies further show that grid size and normalization affect performance, suggesting that SechKAN's effectiveness depends on the dataset and architectural choices. Our source code and experimental implementation are publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/SechKAN_1D.

</details>


### [251] [AURA: Angular Update Rate Adaptation for training complex-valued neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25914)
*Enrico Ballini,Allan Peter Engsig-Karup,Tito Andriollo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AURA（角更新率自适应），一种可插拔的逐参数步长自适应方法，用于复数神经网络的一阶优化器，通过度量相邻更新的长度、对齐与旋转方向一致性来调节步长，无需额外梯度计算，实验表明在多数场景下加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复数神经网络（CVNNs）处理复值数据日益普遍，但其训练多沿用实数域的一阶优化器，这些方法的效率高度依赖步长，且步长规则忽略了复平面中可用的角度信息。因此需要针对复数域设计步长自适应机制。

Method: 提出AURA（Angular Update Rate Adaptation）：一种逐参数步长自适应方法，可叠加于任意一阶优化器之上，也可移除，且不改变原优化器的更新方向。AURA度量每个复数参数相邻更新的"一致性"，包括长度、对齐程度与旋转方向；当更新一致时增大步长，不一致时减小步长。该方法无需额外梯度评估，每步仅需廉价的向量运算。作者将其与Adam和Muon结合，在四个复杂度递增的测试案例（从标量复函数逼近到物理信息训练）上，与知名一阶优化器比较，全部使用全连接网络，除步长外的超参数跨测试案例固定；其中一个案例还在相同预算下对各优化器超参数进行调优。

Result: 实证测试显示，AURA在多数情况下以其较小的单步开销提升了基础优化器的收敛性，同时作者也识别出了AURA未能提升收敛性能的条件。

Conclusion: AURA是一种通用、低开销的复数域步长自适应策略，能够增强现有实数继承型一阶优化器在复数神经网络中的表现；其有效性依赖具体条件，作者明确了失效情形，为后续研究提供了边界说明。

Abstract: Complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) are increasingly adopted for complex-valued data; however, they are often trained with first-order optimizers inherited from the real-valued case. The efficiency of these methods depends largely on the step size, and their step-size rules ignore the angular information available in the complex plane. We address step-size adaptation in the complex domain by introducing AURA (Angular Update Rate Adaptation), a per-parameter step-size adaptation that can be added on top of any first-order optimizer, and removed from it, without altering its update direction. AURA measures the agreement between consecutive updates of each complex parameter, in length, alignment, and sense of rotation, and enlarges the step when they are consistent and reduces it when they are not. It requires no additional gradient evaluations and only inexpensive vector operations per step. We combine AURA with Adam and Muon and compare the resulting methods with well-known first-order optimizers on four test cases of increasing complexity, ranging from the approximation of scalar complex functions to physics-informed training. Fully connected neural networks are used throughout this work. All hyperparameters other than the step size are held fixed across test cases; for one case, we also tune the hyperparameters of each optimizer under the same budget. Our empirical tests show that AURA improves the convergence of its base optimizer in most cases with a small per-step overhead, and we identify the conditions under which it fails to do so.

</details>


### [252] [Beyond Scalar Sensitivity: Activation-Aware Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization with Cross-Layer Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25916)
*Akihiro Yoshida,Yuma Ichikawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将混合精度权重量化建模为MCKP，证明标量敏感度代理存在最高√(κ(A)κ(B))的乘性失真，提出两阶段方法CASA（Kronecker激活感知度量+跨层局部搜索），在多LLM上取得更低困惑度，尤其在超低位宽下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合精度量化求解器依赖标量敏感度代理，将每个权重矩阵的Hessian压缩为单个数并独立处理各模块，忽略模块间耦合，导致跨模块敏感度排序不可靠。作者证明即使最优标量代理也存在相对完整激活感知二次型的乘性失真上界√(κ(A)κ(B))，对典型LLM模块该界从10^1到10^13不等。

Method: 提出CASA两阶段方法：第一阶段用基于Kronecker分解Hessian的激活感知度量替代标量代理，将MCKP化简为连续松弛可闭式求解的形式；第二阶段采用跨层感知的局部搜索，以端到端模型损失评估位宽更新。

Result: 在多个LLM和不同比特预算下，CASA相比最新标量代理基线获得更低困惑度，在超低比特（每权重<3比特）时优势尤为明显；零样本精度提升与逐模型模块平均条件数相关，验证失真界可作为标量代理失效的实用指标。

Conclusion: 标量敏感度代理在跨模块敏感度排序上不可靠，其失真由条件数决定；CASA通过激活感知度量与跨层局部搜索有效缓解该问题，并在低位宽量化中验证了失真界作为实用指标的预测能力。

Abstract: Mixed-precision weight quantization is commonly formulated as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), yet existing solvers rely on scalar sensitivity proxies that collapse each weight matrix's Hessian into a single number and treat every module independently. We prove that even the optimal scalar proxy incurs multiplicative distortion up to $\sqrt{κ(\mathbf{A})κ(\mathbf{B})}$ relative to the full activation-aware quadratic, where $κ(\mathbf{A})$ and $κ(\mathbf{B})$ denote the condition numbers of the input- and output-side Hessian factors. This bound varies from $10^1$ to $10^{13}$ for typical LLM modules, making inter-module sensitivity ranking unreliable. To address these limitations, we propose Cross-layer Activation-aware Sensitivity Allocation (CASA), a two-phase method. In Stage 1, the scalar proxy is replaced by an activation-aware metric derived from the Kronecker-factored Hessian, reducing the MCKP to a form whose continuous relaxation admits a closed-form solution. In Stage 2, a cross-layer-aware local search evaluates bit-width updates using the end-to-end model loss. Experiments on multiple LLMs across different bit budgets show that CASA achieves lower perplexity than the latest scalar-proxy baselines, especially at ultra-low bit-widths ($<3$ bits per weight). Moreover, the performance gain in zero-shot accuracy tracks the per-model average condition-number over modules, confirming the distortion bound as a practical indicator of scalar-proxy failure.

</details>


### [253] [Certified Against Which Oracle? Execution Labels Set the Reported Risk of Conformal Abstention for Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25938)
*Jiamiao Liu,Dewen Qiao,Yu Zhang,Xuetao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过对Spider-Realistic的预注册干预实验，揭示text-to-SQL一致性弃权证书的风险校准结果严重依赖于所采用的oracle（单一数据库 vs 多实例测试套件），并主张证书应同时报告两种oracle且一致性分数应在非构建其聚类的oracle下评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: text-to-SQL的共形弃权证书（conformal abstention certificate）依赖正确性标签进行校准，而现有不确定性流水线从基准自带的单一数据库读取标签，该oracle被公认为宽松。作者质疑：若换用更严格的多实例测试套件作为oracle，证书的真实风险与一致性分数的评估是否会显著改变。

Method: 在Spider-Realistic上进行预注册干预，将单一数据库oracle替换为基准蒸馏的多实例测试套件；比较四个SQL专用检查点、两种数据划分方案下证书的held-out风险；引入两位SQL专家的盲标注验证；用AI对拒绝样本进行语义错误普查，并进行预注册的盲专家审计；比较不同oracle（shipped-database聚类 vs suite聚类）下执行一致性分数的AUROC。

Result: 1) 替换oracle后，证书held-out风险比其自身标签报告的风险高2.73–10.23个百分点；2) 两个oracle均未报告专家评定的风险，名义0.10的证书在盲专家标签下实际风险达20.0和17.2个百分点；3) 更严格的oracle双向出错——多数被拒答案并非错误，部分被接受的答案却错误；4) AI普查发现被拒样本中1/4至1/3存在语义错误，其余多归因于问题表述不清、合成实例或疑似参考查询缺陷，并获盲专家审计支持；5) 16/16组合中，执行一致性分数在其聚类构建oracle的标签下表现更好；6) 专家标签下，用suite聚类替代shipped-database聚类使AUROC在一个检查点提升6.96个百分点、另一个提升1.53个百分点，且在后者的专家区间排除了suite标签报告的8.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 证书应同时报告两种oracle；oracle间的风险差异只有在基准经过审计后才能解读为语义风险；一致性分数应在非构建其聚类的oracle下评估。

Abstract: A conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL is only as truthful as the correctness labels it is calibrated on. The uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency take those labels from the single database a benchmark ships, an oracle known to be lenient. We run a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic, swapping that database for the benchmark's distilled multi-instance test suite. Across four SQL-specialist checkpoints and two split schemes, the swap raises the certificate's held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report. Neither oracle reports the risk experts assign. Under blinded labels from two SQL experts, a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints. The stricter oracle errs in both directions: most of the answers it rejects are not judged wrong, and some of those it accepts are. An AI-assigned census of what it rejects finds a semantic error in a quarter to a third of them, depending on the population. It attributes most of the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances or suspected reference-query defects, a flag supported by a preregistered blinded expert audit. The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Every execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations. Under expert labels, building such a score on suite clusters instead of shipped-database clusters raises its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) by 6.96 points on one checkpoint and 1.53 on the other. On the second, the expert interval excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. A certificate should be reported with both oracles, and an oracle-relative difference read as semantic risk only after the benchmark is audited. A consistency score should be evaluated under an oracle that did not build it.

</details>


### [254] [Exploring Solver-Level Warmstarting for Neural Network Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25962)
*Annelot Bosman,Minghao Liu,Marta Kwiatkowska,Holger Hoos,Jan van Rijn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探索在神经网络验证中引入求解器级热启动，以复用历史求解信息，从而加速验证并提升可解实例数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络验证在最坏情况下计算不可解，即使常见对抗鲁棒性规格验证也是NP完全的，因此需要新方法来降低求解开销。

Method: 采用求解器级热启动，将先前求解结果作为初始信息，并设计可推广、可适配先进验证器的流水线；研究扰动半径、输入数据和网络本身变化时的影响。

Result: 热启动在多数情况下显著减少验证时间，并能成功验证从零开始无法在给定时限内求解的实例。

Conclusion: 求解器级热启动是提升神经网络验证效率的有效手段，具备推广到先进验证器的潜力。

Abstract: Neural network verification has become a key tool for providing formal guarantees on the behaviour of neural networks. However, many verification problems remain computationally intractable in the worst case: even for common adversarial robustness specifications, verification is NP-complete. Here, we explore the application of solver-level warmstarting for neural network verification to exploit information from previous solutions. We study the effect on running time as several properties are modified, including perturbation radii, input data and the networks themselves, using a pipeline that is generalisable and potentially adaptable to state-of-the-art verifiers. Our results show that warmstarting can significantly reduce verification time in most cases. Moreover, warmstarting enables the successful verification of instances that could not be solved from scratch within the given time limit.

</details>


### [255] [GeoPair: Geometry-Preserving Cross-Layer Factorization for Training-Free Transformer Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25963)
*Baher Mohammad,Ammar Ali,Stamatios Lefkimmiatis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的跨层权重配对与共享字典分解框架，结合结构化稀疏实现高效Transformer压缩，在多种架构、规模与模态上达到最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练压缩流程通常对层独立优化，或依赖忽视各层激活几何特性的启发式分组策略，未能充分利用Transformer的跨层冗余，导致压缩效率与功能保真度受限。

Method: 一个无需训练、基于优化的框架：顺序优化跨层权重配对与共享字典分解。不强制相邻层共享基，也不启发式合并激活统计，而是识别结构兼容的投影，学习能保留各层校准几何的共享表示；并与结构化稀疏结合。

Result: 在多种架构、规模和模态上取得最优（state-of-the-art）结果，持续优于独立的逐层结构化权重分解及采用启发式分组的其他成对权重分解方法。

Conclusion: 以收敛的、优化驱动的流程替代启发式工程策略，为跨模态可扩展Transformer压缩提供了具有理论基础的方案。

Abstract: Transformer architectures exhibit cross-layer redundancies, yet post-training compression pipelines typically optimize layers in isolation or rely on heuristic grouping strategies that disregard layer-specific activation geometries. We introduce a principled, training-free framework that sequentially optimizes cross-layer weight pairings and shared-dictionary factorizations. Rather than forcing weights of adjacent layers to share a basis or heuristically merging activation statistics, our approach identifies structurally compatible projections and learns a shared representation that better preserves each layer's distinct calibration geometry. Coupled with structured sparsity, this yields highly efficient weight decompositions without sacrificing functional fidelity. Across diverse architectures, scales, and modalities, our method achieves state-of-the-art results, consistently outperforming independent structured weight decompositions and alternative pairwise weight factorizations, which operate under heuristic grouping strategies. By replacing heuristic engineering strategies with a convergent, optimization-driven pipeline, we establish a theoretically grounded foundation for scalable, transformer compression across different modalities.

</details>


### [256] [Interweaving Marginals into Multivariate Sample Paths: Training-Free Dependence Construction for Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25980)
*Jinmyeong Choi,Jinkwan Jang,Seul Lee,Taesup Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何将冻结的概率时序基础模型（TSFM）所输出的逐坐标边缘分布，通过免训练耦合方法重构为多元未来轨迹的联合分布，并将依赖关系重构视为一个独立的后处理问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率时序基础模型只提供逐坐标的预测边际分布，而这些边际分布无法唯一确定多元未来轨迹的联合分布。因此，如何从边缘分布中恢复跨时间与跨通道的依赖结构，成为一个尚未被充分研究的问题。

Method: 论文研究对冻结TSFM边缘分布进行免训练耦合以生成多元预测样本路径。主要评估设定在每个通道—预测步坐标上固定经验边缘样本多重集，从而隔离耦合本身的影响；并进一步测试移除固定边缘约束、直接采样以及原生态多元骨干推理的情形。

Result: 历史的时序关系与通道关系能显著改善对应的依赖诊断指标。该规律在移除固定边缘约束直接采样时依然成立，并在原生多元骨干推理下同样存在。

Conclusion: 依赖重构应被视为概率TSFM的一个独立后处理问题，而非仅由边缘分布自然决定。

Abstract: Probabilistic time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide coordinate-wise predictive distributions, but these marginals do not determine a joint distribution over multivariate future trajectories. We study training-free coupling of frozen TSFM marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths. Our primary evaluation fixes the empirical marginal sample multiset at every channel--horizon coordinate across methods, isolating the effect of coupling alone. Historical temporal and channel relations substantially improve their corresponding dependence diagnostics. The same pattern persists when the fixed-marginal constraint is removed and paths are sampled directly, and remains present under native multivariate backbone inference. These results support treating dependence reconstruction as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.

</details>


### [257] [Theory for groupoid equivariant neural networks: an approach for steerable CNNs on bounded domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25987)
*Alberto Ibort,Maria Jimenez-Vazquez,Juan M. Perez-Pardo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出群胚等变神经网络理论：用群胚+局部双截断伪群+测度+表示丛刻画对称性，证明双截断等变核定理，并在有界平面域上以稀疏算子实现，数值上精度提升至少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统等变卷积网络假设一个群全局作用于信号空间，这在有界域与分层域上不成立：环境刚体运动可能仅局部可行，且边界引入了几何类型，这些类型无法被传递群作用捕获。

Method: 构建群胚等变神经网络理论：对称性数据由群胚、选定的局部双截断伪群、测度以及输入/输出表示丛组成。针对对象空间上的积分通道，证明双截断等变核定理——等变性等价于两点核上的传输约束，其解由每对点轨道上的一个联合稳定化子交织算子分类；并以有界平面域为案例。实现上采用离线零空间基与稀疏gather–transform–scatter操作。

Result: 数值结果表明：所提架构在对称性无法由群作用全局实现时具有显著优势，相对所测试模型精度提升至少一个数量级。此外，Poisson–Dirichlet核研究用于评估边界感知归纳偏置，其精确逆保持矩形的全局对称性，但不保持一般固有局部双截断。

Conclusion: 群胚等变框架将等变性从全局群作用推广到局部双截断，适用于有界/分层域，可有效处理边界诱导的几何类型，并在实验中验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Equivariant convolutional neural networks are usually built from a group acting globally on the space of signals. This hypothesis is inappropriate for many bounded or stratified domains: an ambient rigid motion may be admissible only on part of the domain, and the boundary introduces geometric types that are invisible to a transitive group action. We develop a theory of groupoid-equivariant neural networks in which the symmetry datum consists of a groupoid, a selected pseudogroup of local bisections, a measure, and input and output representation bundles. For integral channels on the object space, we prove a bisection-equivariant kernel theorem: equivariance is equivalent to a transport constraint on the two-point kernel, and its solutions are classified by one joint-stabilizer intertwiner on each orbit of pairs. As a case study we apply the theory to bounded planar domains.
  The resulting architecture is implemented through offline nullspace bases and sparse gather--transform--scatter operations. A Poisson--Dirichlet kernel study is used separately to assess boundary-aware inductive bias; the exact inverse is shown to preserve the global symmetries of the rectangle but not general proper local bisections. The numerical results show that the proposed architectures provide significant advantages when symmetries cannot be globally implemented by group actions and provide an accuracy improvement of at least one order of magnitude with respect to the models tested.

</details>


### [258] [The Dynamics of Quasiregular Neural Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26018)
*Matthia Sabatelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文在可控的拟正则（quasiregular）回归任务中研究神经网络如何学习"主导规律+系统性例外"，观察到类似语言习得中的U形学习：先部分习得例外，随后回退到主导规律，最终重新恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多学习问题同时包含主导规律与系统性例外，语言习得中的U形学习（先正确、后过度正则化、再恢复）是典型表现。作者希望用已知正则解与例外解的受控回归任务，隔离并刻画这种规律与例外之间的竞争机制。

Method: 构建拟正则回归问题，其中"正则解"与"例外解"均被显式定义；训练神经网络并在训练过程中追踪其对规律与例外的拟合情况，通过改变例外的稀有程度以及所考察的正则类型进行对照实验。

Result: 网络能够部分习得例外，但随后会回退到主导规律（过度正则化），最终又能恢复。当例外较稀有，即使其早期已被习得，过度正则化仍显著增强；但这种效应在不同正则类型之间并不一致地出现。

Conclusion: 结果在神经网络学习中隔离出一种"规律与例外竞争"的简单形式，为解释U形学习提供了受控证据。

Abstract: Many learning problems combine a dominant regularity with systematic exceptions. Motivated by U-shaped learning in language acquisition, we study this interaction in controlled quasiregular regression problems where regular and exceptional solutions are explicitly known. Neural networks can partially acquire exceptions, subsequently regress toward the dominant regularity, and finally recover. This overregularization becomes substantially stronger when exceptions are rare, despite their early acquisition, but does not emerge equally across all regularities considered. Our results isolate a simple form of competition between regularities and exceptions during neural learning.

</details>


### [259] [BOBA: Dynamic Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26021)
*Merlin Angel Kelly,Rishan Patel,Alexander Thomas,Ziyue Zhu,Zikun Quan,Tom Carlson,Youngjun Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BOBA采集函数，基于主动推断的自由能原理，显式最小化对未来状态变化的预测不确定性，用于动态黑箱优化，在查询受限下显著降低遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态黑箱优化中目标函数随时间演化、最优位置持续漂移，而现有动态贝叶斯优化（DBO）方法使用UCB等标准采集函数，未能显式考虑时间变化，导致样本分配次优、对移动最优点的跟踪能力差。

Method: 提出BOBA（Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference），受主动推断中自由能原理启发的新型采集函数：在传统采集函数基础上引入前瞻性不确定性量化，估计函数变化中的不确定性，从而在非平稳环境中实现更合理的探索-利用权衡；并在合成动态基准上与最先进DBO方法对比，并分析不同探索策略的BOBA变体。

Result: 在合成动态基准实验中，BOBA在查询受限设置下显著改善遗憾（regret），在时间受限设置下保持竞争力；通过不同探索策略的变体分析，表明探索-利用平衡可针对不同类型动态函数进行调节。

Conclusion: 该工作贡献了面向DBO的基于自由能的采集函数，并揭示了主动推断原理如何增强非平稳环境中的优化，对需要持续自适应的实时应用具有启示意义。

Abstract: Dynamic black-box optimization presents significant challenges for Bayesian Optimization (BO), as the objective function evolves over time, causing optimal locations to shift continuously. Existing dynamic BO (DBO) methods using standard acquisition functions such as Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) fail to explicitly account for temporal variations, leading to suboptimal sample allocation and poor tracking of moving optima. Here, we propose BOBA (Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference), a novel acquisition function inspired by free energy principles from active inference that explicitly minimizes predictive uncertainty about future states in dynamic environments. BOBA extends traditional acquisition functions by incorporating a forward-looking uncertainty quantification that estimates uncertainty in function changes, enabling more informed exploration-exploitation trade-offs in non-stationary settings. We evaluate BOBA on synthetic dynamic benchmarks, comparing against state-of-the-art DBO methods. Our experiments demonstrate that BOBA significantly improves regret in query-restricted settings, while remaining competitive in time-limited settings. We further analyze variants of BOBA with different exploration strategies, showing how the exploration-exploitation balance can be tuned for different types of dynamic functions. This work contributes both a free energy-based acquisition function for DBO and insights into how active inference principles can enhance optimization in non-stationary environments, with implications for real-time applications requiring continuous adaptation.

</details>


### [260] [MICRO: Multi-Fidelity Active Search for Severe Error Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26025)
*Orlando Leone,Niclas Pokel,Pehuén Moure,Yingqiang Gao,Roman Boehringer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 MICRO 主动搜索框架，通过联合建模质量评分与标注损失并采用聚类与 rollout 估计，在共享预算下最大化严重错误发现数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类反馈在成本与信息量上存在差异：强反馈能揭示严重错误但代价高，而廉价的质量评分可辅助决定哪些样本需要标注。现有方法未能在共享预算下有效权衡不同保真度反馈以最大化严重错误发现。

Method: MICRO（Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout）将共享预算分配给评分与标注两类反馈。它以样本特征为条件，联合建模评分与标注损失以引导采样；依据对严重性概率的预测影响对采集样本聚类以选取多样化候选；再用 rollout 估计其发现价值。

Result: 在 WMT20 英德任务上，评分提升了损失重建与严重性预测性能。MICRO 在四种预算与评分成本设置中平均发现数最高：其一同适配版 MF-ENS 表现相当，其余三设置中显著优于全部六种对比策略（含两种 rollout 对照，p<.001）。

Conclusion: 多保真度反馈的联合建模与基于影响聚类、rollout 估值的采集策略，可在预算约束下显著提高严重错误发现效率。

Abstract: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO (Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to select diverse candidates, then uses rollout to estimate their discovery value. Experiments on WMT20 English-German show that ratings improve both loss reconstruction and severity prediction. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across four budget and rating cost settings, with similar performance to adapted MF-ENS in one and significant gains over all six comparison policies, including two rollout controls, in the other three $(p<.001)$.

</details>


### [261] [xWhyL: Causal Interactive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26037)
*Nicholas Tagliapietra,Florian Peter Busch,Moritz Willig,Matej Zečević,Lavdim Halilaj,Juergen Luettin,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出xWhyL框架，将解释作为溯因学习信号来学习因果模型，并实例化为CIL方法，证明其可超越观测因果发现的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知科学早已确认"解释"是人类学习因果的机制，但AI领域基本忽视了从溯因信号中学习。XAI虽常借助因果模型生成解释，但反向问题——解释能为因果做什么——仍未被探索。

Method: 提出xWhyL形式化框架，将因果性与XAI连接；构建数学理论，把解释转化为与观测数据互补的学习信号；并实例化为Causal Interactive Learning (CIL)。

Result: 证明该框架可在何种条件下拒绝而非吸收错误指定的解释，即所谓"Causal Tug-of-War"张力下的处理机制；CIL展示专家解释能高效支持因果发现并区分正确与错误解释。

Conclusion: 解释可作为独立于观测数据的因果学习信号，突破观测因果发现的限制；xWhyL与CIL为融合因果与XAI提供了理论与实用路径。

Abstract: Explanations are central to causal reasoning, and cognitive science has long established that the human drive to explain is itself a mechanism for learning about causality. Despite this, learning from those abductive signals is largely ignored in artificial intelligence. While explainable AI (XAI) increasingly draws on causal models to generate explanations, the converse direction about what explanations can do for causality remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we propose xWhyL, a formal framework connecting causality and XAI by learning causal models from explanations. We develop a mathematical theory that translates explanations into a learning signal complementary to observational data, and demonstrate how it enables overcoming the limits of observational causal discovery. As explanations can be derived from incorrect beliefs and clash with data, a tension we call the Causal Tug-of-War, we prove conditions under which our framework rejects misspecified explanations rather than absorbing them. Our practical instantiation, Causal Interactive Learning (CIL), shows how expert explanations can efficiently support causal discovery and distinguish correct from incorrect explanations.

</details>


### [262] [Towards Adaptive Federated Graph Clustering: A Global Community-aware Contrastive Learning-based Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26063)
*Yinlin Zhu,Di Wu,Wang Luo,Guocong Quan,Miao Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaFGC，一个基于全局社区感知对比学习的自适应联邦图聚类框架，通过过完备全局社区锚点与跨客户端锚点细化自适应估计聚类数目，并用社区级对比原型强化社区间吸引与排斥，在八个基准数据集上超越现有联邦图学习基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦图学习多聚焦监督任务，而现实图数据往往大规模且无标签，联邦图聚类因此重要但尚不成熟。该任务的核心难点在于客户端间子图异质性导致各客户端社区结构不同。现有联邦图聚类方法存在两个关键局限：(1) 不切实际的预定义聚类数目假设；(2) 社区间分离不充分。

Method: 提出AdaFGC框架：引入过完备的全局社区锚点集合来建模全局社区结构，并通过跨客户端锚点细化自适应估计聚类基数；设计全局社区感知对比学习方案，以共享锚点作为对比原型，显式地在跨客户端间施加社区级吸引与排斥，并辅以节点级和拓扑级目标以稳定本地表示。

Result: 在八个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaFGC在多个聚类指标上持续优于现有的监督式与无监督式联邦图学习基线。

Conclusion: AdaFGC通过全局社区锚点与社区感知对比学习，有效解决了联邦图聚类中聚类数目难以预先设定和社区间分离不足的问题，验证了自适应聚类基数估计与社区级对比约束在联邦无监督图学习中的有效性。

Abstract: Federated graph learning (FGL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train graph models without sharing their private graph data, providing a promising paradigm for mining knowledge from distributed graph repositories. While most existing FGL methods focus on supervised tasks, real-world graphs are often massive and unlabeled, making federated graph clustering an important yet still immature research direction. Notably, this task is particularly challenging due to the inherent subgraph heterogeneity across clients, which leads to client-specific community structures. In this work, we identify two critical limitations in existing federated graph clustering methods: (1) unrealistic pre-defined cluster cardinality assumptions and (2) incomplete inter-community separation. To address these challenges, we propose AdaFGC, an Adaptive Federated graph clustering framework based on Global community-aware Contrastive learning. AdaFGC introduces an over-complete set of global community anchors to model the global community structure and adaptively estimate clustering cardinality via cross-client anchor refinement. In addition, it employs a global community-aware contrastive learning scheme that uses the shared anchors as contrastive prototypes to explicitly enforce community-level attraction and repulsion across clients, complemented by node-level and topology-level objectives that stabilize local representations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaFGC consistently outperforms existing supervised and unsupervised FGL baselines across multiple clustering metrics.

</details>


### [263] [FuncCode: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Function Space with Hardware-Aware Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26067)
*Kazi Ahmed Asif Fuad,Lizhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FuncCode，一种与基函数无关的KAN压缩方法，通过对采样后的边响应构建共享码本并分别压缩基分支与base分支，实现高倍率压缩且精度损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN用可学习的单变量函数替代标量边权重，提升了灵活性，但每条边需存储多个系数（常伴随独立的base分支），导致参数内存显著增大，亟需高效压缩方案。

Method: FuncCode从采样后的边响应构建共享码本，对基函数分支与base分支独立编码，最终以量化、位打包格式导出码本与逐边索引；方法为基函数无关（basis-agnostic）。

Result: 在样条与多项式KAN中，采样边响应的有效秩比系数表示低13%–35%；函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类统计上持平，增益来自保留两分支的差异化共享结构。十种子MNIST上，样条KAN与GRAM KAN分别压缩31.6×和17.6×，精度仅降0.31和0.34 pp；6.1M边卷积KAGN压缩19.9×，CIFAR-10/100精度差在0.54/1.89 pp内。压缩后逐边索引占存储权重比特高达99.4%，呈索引受限。九种bit-exact FPGA加速器上，相对dense INT4将SplineKAN布线后权重内存降3.87×，且不增加周期数或延迟。

Conclusion: FuncCode验证了函数空间表示可压缩性优于系数空间，能在保持精度的同时大幅降低KAN内存，并可直接映射到硬件实现。
