Importantly, the block-triangular architecture preserves the current-state marginal while making its second component a direct sampler of the conditional distribution of possible next states. The resulting surrogate generates stochastic trajectories with one model evaluation per time step, without auxiliary generative steps between time steps. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate marginal and trajectory-dependent statistics and favorable accuracy-cost tradeoffs compared with deterministic, diffusion-, flow-, and distillation-based generative surrogate models.

</details>


### [296] [Can We Predict Anomaly Detection Performance from Embedding-Space Geometry?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26460)
*Kevin Wilkinghoff,Zheng-Hua Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在无异常数据的条件下预测异常检测性能，针对kNN检测器推导AUC下界，并提出伪异常探针实现无异常模型选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异常检测系统通常仅用正常数据训练，但模型选择与评估却依赖标注异常，这一矛盾在实际中构成限制。本文旨在探究能否在没有异常数据的情况下预测检测性能。

Method: 对kNN检测器推导AUC下界，将其与内点/外点分数的分离度及各自方差相关联；在局部缩放模型下刻画密度变化、本征维度异质性与跨域失配对分数变异的影响；并提出伪异常探针，为估计相对分数分离度提供参考。

Result: 在DCASE 2022-2025基准上，涵盖4种嵌入模型与208个候选系统，基于伪异常的估计器显著提升了无异常模型选择效果；尤其在域偏移下，多样化伪异常使无异常模型选择优于传统开发集选择。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间几何包含关于异常检测性能的预测信息，但仅基于内点的性能估计具有表征依赖性，需借助伪异常探针来稳健估计分数分离度。

Abstract: Anomaly detection systems are often trained using normal data alone, while model selection and evaluation typically require labeled anomalies. We study whether anomaly detection performance can be predicted without access to anomalous data. For kNN-based detectors, we derive a lower bound on the area under the ROC curve (AUC) that relates detection performance to the separation between inlier and outlier scores and to their respective variances. Under a local scaling model, we use this bound to characterize how density variation, intrinsic-dimensional heterogeneity, and cross-domain mismatch contribute to score variability. We then investigate anomaly-free model selection and show that inlier score variance alone does not reliably predict performance across different representations. To address this limitation, we introduce simple pseudo-anomaly probes that provide a reference for estimating relative score separation. Experiments on the DCASE 2022-2025 benchmarks, spanning four embedding models and 208 candidate systems, show that pseudo-anomaly-based estimators substantially improve anomaly-free model selection. In particular, diverse pseudo-anomalies enable anomaly-free model selection to outperform conventional development-set selection under domain shift. These results show that embedding-space geometry contains predictive information about anomaly detection performance while also highlighting the representation-dependent nature of inlier-only performance estimates.

</details>


### [297] [When Recursive Models Finish Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26487)
*Hare Krishna,Shubham Singh,Stephen Ebert,Hao-Yu Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 递归模型在名义推理预算外仍可继续更新隐状态。本文将注意力型与MLP型Tiny Recursive Models（TRM）的递归步数从16步扩展到512步，在1000道困难数独上考察"完成"的动力学特征：准确率显著提升，且首次精确解后隐状态运动骤减，轨迹方向呈局部收缩（但同一雅可比仍保留强扩张方向），即"轨迹条件性各向异性稳定"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归模型可在名义推理预算之外持续更新隐状态，因此预算内输出错误时，无法判断究竟是计算尚未完成，还是已进入持续失败的机制状态。作者希望区分这两种情形，并寻找跨架构的"完成"动力学标志。

Method: 在两个架构（注意力型与MLP型）的Tiny Recursive Models上，于1000道困难数独任务中把递归步数由名义16步扩展至512步，统计累积精确求解准确率；分析隐状态运动幅度随求解前后的变化；沿轨迹方向计算局部雅可比，考察收缩/扩张特性；进行扰动实验与最长扩张方向的多步命运分析；并在第二个注意力检查点上验证模式的可复现性。

Result: 递归步数从16增至512后，累积精确求解准确率由59.2%升至87.5%（注意力模型）、由74.4%升至91.9%（MLP模型），解决了名义预算下未解题目中的三分之二以上。两种架构中，首次精确解之后隐状态运动均急剧下降。完成态通常沿轨迹方向局部收缩，尽管同一局部雅可比仍保留强扩张方向。扰动实验证实了这种方向性稳定。最大扩张方向的多步命运存在差异：注意力模型中在16步内被吸收，而MLP模型中持续更久。该各向异性稳定模式在第二个注意力检查点上同样成立。

Conclusion: 上述结果为区分名义预算下的失败与已完成的计算提供了依据，并揭示了两种递归架构中共有的"完成"动力学特征：完成态表现为沿轨迹方向的局部收缩（轨迹条件性各向异性稳定），而整体雅可比仍具扩张方向。

Abstract: Recursive models can continue updating their latent states beyond their nominal inference budget, so an incorrect output at that budget does not show whether computation is unfinished or has entered a persistently unsuccessful regime. We study the dynamics of completion in attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles. Extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps increases cumulative exact-solve accuracy from 59.2% to 87.5% for the attention model and from 74.4% to 91.9% for the MLP model, solving more than two-thirds of the puzzles unsolved in the nominal budget. Across both architectures, latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution. Completed states are typically locally contractive along the trajectory direction, even though the same local Jacobian retains strongly expanding directions. We characterize this phenomenon as trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability. Perturbation experiments confirm this directional stability across both models. The multi-step fate of the maximally expanding direction differs: it is absorbed within 16 steps in the attention model but persists longer in the MLP model. The anisotropic-stability pattern also holds for a second attention checkpoint. Together, these results distinguish nominal-budget failure from completed computation and identify a common dynamical signature of completion across two recurrent architectures.

</details>


### [298] [Gap-Free Streaming PCA Beyond Rank-One Updates: Near-Optimal Rates and Applications to Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26508)
*Anming Gu,Syamantak Kumar,Kevin Tian,Chutong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对无间隙（gap-free）流式PCA给出Oja算法的新分析，仅依赖单步随机更新的二阶矩界，得到近最优速率并配近乎匹配的下界，同时扩展到Rayleigh商近似PCA及差分隐私PCA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式PCA旨在单遍扫描数据流恢复主谱子空间。已有近最优速率的结果要么需要特征间隙（eigengap）假设，要么局限于秩一更新，无法覆盖最一般的无间隙情形，因此需要新的分析工具来突破这些限制。

Method: 对广泛使用的Oja算法在最一般的无间隙变体下重新分析，证明中仅使用单步随机更新的二阶矩界（second moment bound），避免了以往近最优分析所需的几乎必然（almost sure）界及离线矩阵Bernstein界的类比；并构造近乎匹配的下界，同时将结果推广至Rayleigh商定义的近似PCA。

Result: 在无特征间隙假设下获得近最优的收敛速率，并给出与之近乎匹配的下界；解决了[JJK+16]关于Rayleigh商近似PCA的公开问题；作为主要应用，对次高斯数据给出无间隙的差分隐私PCA保证，在至多对数因子意义下解决了[Bro26]的猜想1.1。

Conclusion: Oja算法在无间隙流式PCA中即可达到近最优速率，且仅需较弱的二阶矩假设，说明先前分析中的强假设并非必要；该框架进一步统一了近似PCA与差分隐私PCA的理论保证。

Abstract: Streaming principal component analysis (PCA) seeks to recover a leading spectral subspace in a single pass over a data stream. We give a new analysis of the ubiquitous Oja's algorithm [Oja82] for the most general, gap-free variant of this problem, where no eigengap assumptions are made on the underlying mean matrix, complemented by a nearly-matching lower bound. Prior works achieving near-optimal rates for streaming PCA either required gap assumptions [JJK+16, HNWW21], or were limited to rank-one updates [AZL17, Lia23]. Our proof only uses a second moment bound on the individual stochastic updates, bypassing the almost sure bounds needed by prior near-optimal analyses, and the analogous offline matrix Bernstein bound. We also extend our result to a Rayleigh quotient notion of approximate PCA, addressing an open question of [JJK+16]. As our main application, we give gap-free differentially private PCA guarantees for sub-Gaussian data, settling Conjecture 1.1 of [Bro26] up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [299] [Notes on Fourier-Bessel wavelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26537)
*Marcel Venturotti,Georgios Exarchakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了一套受 Shaqfa 等人圆盘谐波启发的 Fourier-Bessel 小波族的数学基础与构造方法，包括 Bessel 函数性质、Neumann 边界下单位圆盘 Helmholtz 方程解、Gaussian 包络与零均值修正、归一化常数及闭式频域表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于径向特征值之间近似线性间隔（收敛于 π），作者希望探索更均匀的径向频率分配是否适用于需要宽而均衡频率覆盖的应用，而非取代传统二进小波组织方式。

Method: 方法上先回顾 Bessel 与修正 Bessel 函数的相关性质并引入构造所需的小波属性；随后在单位圆盘上以 Neumann 边界条件求解 Helmholtz 方程，得到 Fourier-Bessel 圆盘谐波；在此基础上施加 Gaussian 空间包络并为第零角阶引入零均值修正；进而推导 L2 应用所需的归一化常数，讨论 L1 频率域峰值一致性归一化；最后推导小波的闭式 Fourier 域表示。

Result: 结果给出了 Fourier-Bessel 圆盘谐波的 Helmholtz 方程解、Gaussian 包络小波族、第零角阶零均值修正、L2 与 L1 两套归一化方案，以及小波的闭式频域表达式。

Conclusion: 结论是这套构造为探索更均匀的径向频率分配奠定了基础，可用于需要宽而均衡频率覆盖的应用，同时保留传统二进小波组织方式作为对照。

Abstract: These notes develop the mathematical foundations and construction of a Fourier-Bessel wavelet family inspired by the disk harmonics of Shaqfa et al.[9]. We begin with the relevant properties of Bessel and modified Bessel functions and introduce the wavelet properties required for the construction. We then derive the Fourier-Bessel disk harmonics as solutions to the Helmholtz equation on the unit disk subject to a Neumann boundary condition.
  Building on this basis, we construct a wavelet family by applying a Gaussian spatial envelope and introducing a zero-mean correction for the zeroth angular order. We derive the corresponding normalisation constants for $L^2$-based applications and discuss $L^1$-based normalisation for frequency-domain peak consistency. Finally, we derive a closed-form Fourier-domain representation of the resulting wavelets.
  The main motivation is the approximately linear spacing, which converges to $π$ between consecutive radial eigenvalues. Rather than replacing the conventional dyadic organisation of wavelet families, this construction lays out the foundation to explore whether a more uniform radial frequency allocation can be useful for applications in which broad and balanced frequency coverage is desirable.

</details>


### [300] [Towards Hierarchical GNNs for multi-grid power flow: generalization across operating scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26603)
*Carmine Delle Femine,Leire Garin Atxaga,Asier Diaz-Iglesias,Juan Pablo Maroto Herrera,Ane Miren Florez-Tapia,Marco Quartulli. Izaro Goienetxea Urziku*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该预印本提出一种分层潜变量通信模块，通过GENCO校正网络中的两个约简图交换信息，以提升多电网潮流模型对新运行场景的泛化能力。在三种拓扑上（每模型3个初始化种子、200轮训练）对比Kron导出传输、同锚点商构造与扁平骨干；Kron将宏族平衡电压误差从5.660±0.899降至0.851±0.110，但跨拓扑泛化尚未实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统中电网运行场景多变，而多电网潮流学习模型通常只在特定运行条件下表现良好，跨新运行场景的泛化能力不足。作者希望验证分层潜变量通信能否作为多电网潮流学习的有效组件，提升模型对新运行场景的泛化性，并明确其与跨拓扑泛化的边界。

Method: 在基于GENCO的校正网络内，通过两个约简图进行分层信息交换。比较三类结构：Kron导出传输、同锚点Quotient构造以及扁平骨干（Flat GENCO）。在三种电网拓扑上进行200轮预训练，每个模型使用3个初始化种子；每个电网采用200个新生成且预先筛选的场景进行评估，误差指标为宏族平衡电压误差。所有电网共享一组学习参数。

Result: 在训练拓扑上，Kron将宏族平衡电压误差从5.660±0.899降至0.851±0.110，相对Flat GENCO降低85.0%，相对Quotient（1.235±0.225）降低31.0%。两种分层模型在所有训练拓扑、全部三个种子上均优于基于训练解的逐母线均值拟合参照。但在两个额外拓扑的校准迁移评估中，当前模型尚未超过该拟合参照，即跨拓扑泛化仍未达成。

Conclusion: 结果证明在所学拓扑内部、跨运行场景具备泛化能力，且一组参数可跨电网共享；但这一能力不等同于跨拓扑泛化，校准迁移场景下模型仍逊于逐母线均值参照。该预印本给出架构与初步证据，将分层通信视为多电网潮流学习的一个组件，下一步目标是泛化到未见拓扑。

Abstract: Hierarchical latent communication improves the generalization of a multi-grid power-flow model to new operating scenarios. The module exchanges information through two reduced graphs within a GENCO-based corrective network. We compare Kron-derived transports, a same-anchor Quotient construction and a flat backbone in preliminary trainings of 200 epochs on three grid topologies, with three initialization seeds per model. Evaluation uses 200 newly generated, preselected scenarios per grid. On the training topologies, Kron reduces the macro family-balanced voltage error from 5.660 +- 0.899 to 0.851 +- 0.110: an 85.0% reduction relative to Flat GENCO and 31.0% relative to Quotient, which reaches 1.235 +- 0.225. Both hierarchical models outperform a per-bus mean fitted on training solutions on every training topology in all three seeds. These results demonstrate generalization across operating scenarios within the studied topologies, with one set of learned parameters shared across grids. Evaluation on two additional topologies distinguishes this achievement from cross-topology generalization: the current models do not yet outperform the fitted reference in that calibrated- transfer setting. This preprint presents the architecture and preliminary evidence for hierarchical communication as a component of multi-grid power-flow learning, with generalization to unseen topologies as the next development objective.

</details>


### [301] [Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26621)
*Gaoyuan Du,Anam Nawaz Khan,Rex Zhou,Xiaoyang Liu,Deepayan Chakrabarti,Fnu Suya,Xueping Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 贪心解码并非精度不变：同一模型、提示与算法在BF16与FP16下会产生不同输出，多数提示发生分歧。作者通过误差传播分析揭示了翻转机制，并提出一种低开销的FP32 LM head选择性重算干预，在低延迟代价下显著提升输出一致性，但该方法只是部分缓解而非通用的确定性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的贪心解码通常被视为确定性过程。作者旨在验证这一假设是否在数值精度变化下成立，即相同模型、提示与解码算法在不同浮点精度（BF16与FP16）下是否会产生不同输出，并探究其内在机制与可行的缓解方案。

Method: 作者在相同硬件上对比BF16与FP16解码结果，评估了六个模型（1.1B-7B参数，四个家族，并在12B上额外刻画分歧）与三个基准。通过实证误差传播分析，考察22层累积的body error对翻转的影响，重点分析LM head处top-two logit margin与top-two候选之间的方向性扰动之间的关系。据此提出五项可测试的干预结果预测并进行验证。最佳干预为选择性FP32 LM head重算，仅在margin低于阈值时触发。

Result: 在六个模型与三个基准中，49-100%的提示发生分歧，单个token翻转常级联为轨迹级分歧。22层累积body error无法区分翻转与非翻转步骤，结果主要取决于LM head处top-two logit margin相对于候选间方向性扰动的比值。五项预测全部得到实验验证，包括更广范围的FP32计算反而使一致性变差。选择性FP32 LM head重算在A10G上提升+22-36 pp精确一致性（L4与A100提升+12-21 pp），低批次（batch size<=4）单流推理下延迟开销低于4%。

Conclusion: 该方法是部分缓解措施，而非通用确定性保证。其收益在body来源误差占主导时消失，包括batch size>=8以及测试中的端到端FP8情形。作者刻画了六个模型与四种批次下的适用边界，并假设训练时精度稳定性是决定因素。

Abstract: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match all five predictions. The best-performing low-overhead intervention we evaluate, selective FP32 LM head recomputation, triggered only when the margin falls below a threshold, delivers +22-36 pp exact agreement on A10G (+12-21 pp on L4 and A100) at less than 4\% latency overhead in low-batch (batch size <=4) single-stream inference. We map the applicability boundary across six models and four batch sizes, and hypothesise that training-time precision stability is a determining factor. The method is a partial mitigation rather than a universal determinism guarantee: its benefit vanishes when body-originated error dominates, including at batch size >=8 and under end-to-end FP8 in our tests.

</details>


### [302] [Label-Efficient Learning for Ground-Based Sky-Image Classification: A Benchmark of Transfer Learning, Active Learning, and Pseudo-Labeling on GCD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26631)
*Esther Bou Dagher,Viktoriya Bu-Dager,Boguslaw Zegarlinski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD)上系统评测了迁移学习、主动学习与高置信伪标签三种策略的标签效率，发现ImageNet预训练ResNet50的监督迁移学习已高度节省标注，主动学习与伪标签仅带来有限且不稳定的额外增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地基云分类对大气监测、光伏功率预测、航空气象评估与气候观测具有重要意义，但天空图像标注耗时，且云类视觉相似或混合时尤为困难。作者因此关注深度模型在有限标注预算下的标签效率问题，而非设计新网络结构。

Method: 以ImageNet预训练ResNet50作为统一冻结骨干网络，在标注预算为训练标签的1%至100%区间内，用5个随机种子重复三类策略：监督迁移学习、基于不确定性的主动学习、高置信度伪标签。并开展诊断分析，考察被接受伪标签的准确率与类别偏向，以及不确定性采样所查询样本的类别分布。

Result: 监督迁移学习已具备很高标签效率：1%标签时测试准确率为0.635±0.018，40%标签时升至0.730±0.002，接近全标签的0.735±0.003。主动学习与伪标签相较监督采样具有竞争力，在部分指标与预算下有小幅提升，但缺乏显著且一致的总体增益。诊断显示被接受伪标签准确率高达0.946至0.977，但偏向较易的高置信云型组；不确定性采样则优先查询视觉困难组，包括Mixed及易混淆的Stratocumulus与Cumulonimbus，但这些定向获取仅带来有限提升。

Conclusion: 迁移学习显著降低了GCD的标注需求，而简单的主动学习与半监督策略相较强监督基线仅提供有限附加收益。

Abstract: Accurate ground-based cloud classification is important for atmospheric monitoring, solar-energy forecasting, aviation weather assessment, and climate observation systems. However, reliable sky-image annotation is time-consuming, especially when cloud types are visually similar or mixed. We study the label efficiency of deep learning for ground-based cloud classification using the Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD). Rather than proposing a new architecture, we benchmark three practical strategies under limited annotation budgets: supervised transfer learning, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling. An ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 is used as a common frozen backbone, with experiments repeated over five random seeds for label budgets from $1\%$ to $100\%$ of the training labels. Supervised transfer learning is already highly label-efficient: test accuracy increases from $0.635 \pm 0.018$ with $1\%$ labels to $0.730 \pm 0.002$ with $40\%$ labels, approaching the full-label result of $0.735 \pm 0.003$. Active learning and pseudo-labeling are competitive with supervised sampling and provide small improvements for some metrics and budgets, but neither gives a large or consistent aggregate gain. Diagnostic analyses show that accepted pseudo-labels are reliable, with accuracy from $0.946$ to $0.977$, but biased toward easier high-confidence sky-type groups. In contrast, uncertainty sampling preferentially queries visually challenging groups, including Mixed and the confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups, but these targeted acquisitions yield only modest gains. Overall, transfer learning substantially reduces annotation requirements for GCD, while simple active and semi-supervised strategies provide limited additional benefit over a strong supervised baseline.

</details>


### [303] [MAGIC: Mixed-Granularity Agent Graphs via Incremental Construction with Dense-Reward Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26667)
*Kairui Yang,Ziheng Yi,Xunkai Li,Minghao An,Zhanke Liu,Zekai Chen,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAGIC：一种稠密奖励强化学习框架，用于混合粒度多智能体协作图生成，在每个功能角色上局部选择细粒度（单智能体或可复用群组）并顺序连接，在八个基准上超越SOTA并具备较高推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统中，协作拓扑同时决定性能与执行成本。任务在复杂度与所需能力上差异较大，因此出现了生成任务特定协作图的方法。但代表性拓扑生成器在全组织范围内统一使用个体智能体或预定义群组，忽略了不同子任务间协作需求的差异。

Method: 核心洞见是按功能角色局部选择粒度，将细粒度控制与组织内可复用协作模式结合。学习此类组织需在组合式构造空间中探索，且仅有最终答案奖励带来的有限中间反馈。为此提出MAGIC：通过顺序选择功能角色、将其实例化为单智能体或可复用群组、并连接到已有单元来构造混合粒度智能体图；直接用当前策略采样轨迹的回报优化构造策略，并用基于势能的奖励塑形（potential-based reward shaping），从探针式效用与结构信号提供中间反馈，同时保持累积任务奖励不变。

Result: MAGIC在八个基准上优于当前最优基线，并在效率研究中展现出较强的推理效率。

Conclusion: 按功能角色局部选择协作粒度、并以稠密奖励的强化学习学习组织构造策略，是兼顾多智能体系统性能与执行成本的有效途径。

Abstract: Collaboration topology shapes both the performance and execution cost of LLM-based multi-agent systems. Because tasks differ in complexity and required capabilities, recent approaches generate task-specific collaboration graphs that specify agent participation and information flow. However, representative topology generators use either individual agents or predefined groups throughout an organization, overlooking differing collaboration needs across subtasks. Our key insight is to select granularity locally for each functional role, combining fine-grained control with reusable collaboration patterns within one organization. Learning such organizations requires exploring a combinatorial construction space with limited intermediate feedback from final-answer rewards. Therefore, we propose MAGIC, a dense-reward reinforcement learning framework for mixed-granularity graph generation. Specifically, MAGIC constructs a mixed-granularity agent graph by sequentially selecting a functional role, instantiating it as a single agent or reusable group, and connecting it to existing units. We directly optimize the construction policy using returns from trajectories sampled under the current policy and use potential-based reward shaping to provide intermediate feedback from probe-based utility and structural signals while preserving the cumulative task reward. MAGIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across eight benchmarks and demonstrates strong inference efficiency in our efficiency study.

</details>


### [304] [A Spectral Theory of Grokking: Weight Decay induces Feature Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26679)
*Lenz Pracher,Pascal de Jong,Oskar Lieshaus,Alan Jeffares,Steffen Rulands*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个定量理论，解释同质网络中从"懒惰学习"NTK机制向"丰富学习"的转变如何导致grokking式延迟泛化，并在模加法任务上验证了预测的学习率-权重衰减相图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: grokking现象中，训练集上的早期拟合与泛化能力的显著提升之间存在明显延迟。理解这一延迟期间训练如何从固定的NTK机制转变为任务相关核特征方向持续演化的机制，并把记忆后残差与泛化起始联系起来，是该问题的核心动机。

Method: 针对使用平方损失和L2权重衰减训练的同质网络，作者量化了记忆后有限的残差，发现目标分量中残差比例与NTK特征值成反比。这些残差反馈到NTK动力学中；将动力学投影到任务相关的谱方向上，得到一个约化系统，其中残差驱动的核增长与权重衰减相互竞争。作者在模加法任务上用同质MLP进行了84×90学习率-权重衰减网格实验，并在一个单块Transformer上进行了42×45网格实验。

Result: 约化系统预测grokking时间尺度由学习率与权重衰减的乘积控制；特征学习在临界衰减附近对数式减慢，超过该临界值任务对齐的NTK结构无法支持泛化，且更强的衰减会完全阻止拟合。模加法实验中，同质MLP在训练精度饱和后任务对齐的傅里叶结构仍在NTK中继续涌现，网格实验再现了预测的相几何与泛化时间随学习率×权重衰减的逆乘积标度；单块Transformer展现出类似的宏观相结构与相同的转变时间标度，尽管其不满足严格的同质性。

Conclusion: 该工作从机制上推导了拟合后特征学习与泛化起始及其在学习率-权重衰减平面上的相结构之间的联系，解释了grokking的延迟泛化本质。

Abstract: In grokking an early fit to the training data separates from a much later improvement in generalization. During this delay, training can move from a fixed neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime to one in which task-relevant kernel eigendirections continue to evolve. We provide a quantitative theory for how this transition from lazy to rich learning can produce delayed generalization. For homogeneous networks trained with squared loss and $L_2$ weight decay, we show that a finite residual remains after memorization, with larger residual fractions in target components associated with smaller NTK eigenvalues. These residuals feed back into the dynamics of the NTK itself, and projecting the resulting dynamics onto task-relevant spectral directions yields a reduced system in which residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay. This system predicts that the grokking timescale is controlled by the product of learning rate and weight decay, that feature learning slows logarithmically near a critical decay above which task-aligned NTK structure can no longer support generalization, and that stronger decay can prevent fitting altogether. We test these predictions in modular addition. In a homogeneous MLP, task-aligned Fourier structure continues to emerge in the NTK after training accuracy has saturated, and an 84$\times$90-grid of trained networks across varying learning rate and weight decay recovers the predicted phase geometry and inverse-product scaling of the generalization time with learning rate and weight decay. A one-block Transformer shows similar macroscopic phase structure in a 42$\times$45-grid, as well as the same transition-time scaling despite violating exact homogeneity. Together, these results provide a mechanistic derivation connecting post-fit feature learning to both the onset of generalization and its phase structure in the learning rate and weight decay plane.

</details>


### [305] [Train Where the Quantized Model Goes: On-Policy Distillation for Low-Bit Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26708)
*Yuanteng Chen,Zhilei Liu,Peisong Wang,Yuantian Shao,Chuangyi Li,Weining Wang,Shuang Qiu,Gang Li,Jing Liu,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在QAD检查点上增加on-policy蒸馏（OPD）阶段，让学生模型在量化前向路径上自回归生成并由冻结全精度教师在自己的前缀上监督，从而恢复亚3比特量化的长文本数学与代码推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）能恢复亚3比特量化损失的大部分短文本问答性能，但数学与代码推理仍严重受损，长文本生成常陷入重复循环并耗尽解码预算。作者将此归因于量化放大的暴露偏差：QAD在固定的语料前缀上训练，而量化带来的偏差会沿模型自身的自回归轨迹累积，训练与推理分布不匹配。

Method: 提出on-policy蒸馏（OPD）阶段，将教师监督置于量化模型实际到达的状态上。从QAD检查点出发，学生通过部署时使用的量化前向路径生成，并在自身前缀上接受冻结全精度教师的反馈，结合稠密的token级指导与任务验证器奖励。

Result: 在四个模型、2.79和1.88有效比特下，OPD将平均BF16性能保留率在MATH-500上从35%提升至70%，在HumanEval上从66%提升至91%，同时保持短文本性能；在同等预算比较中，其推理增益显著超过继续使用教师强制QAD的方案。

Conclusion: 将QAD稳定的低比特初始化与OPD的on-policy推理恢复相结合，该框架提供了一个全面的亚3比特方案，在保留广泛能力的同时恢复长文本推理。

Abstract: Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) restores much of the short-form question-answering performance lost to sub-3-bit quantization, yet leaves mathematical and code reasoning substantially impaired. Long generations often degenerate into repetitive loops, exhausting the decoding budget without completing a solution. We trace this gap to quantization-amplified exposure bias: QAD trains on fixed corpus prefixes, while quantization-induced deviations compound along the model's own autoregressive trajectories. To address this mismatch, we introduce an on-policy distillation (OPD) stage that places teacher supervision where the quantized model actually goes. Starting from a QAD checkpoint, the student generates through the quantized forward path used at deployment and receives feedback from a frozen full-precision teacher on its own prefixes, combining dense token-level guidance with task-verifier rewards. Across four models at 2.79 and 1.88 effective bits, OPD raises average BF16 performance retention from 35% to 70% on MATH-500 and from 66% to 91% on HumanEval while preserving short-form performance, with reasoning gains substantially exceeding those of continued teacher-forced QAD in matched-budget comparisons. By coupling QAD's stable low-bit initialization with OPD's on-policy reasoning recovery, our framework provides a comprehensive sub-3-bit solution that preserves broad capabilities while restoring long-form reasoning.

</details>


### [306] [The Sirens' Song: When Proximal Background Context Overshadows Distant Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26718)
*Xiaoyu Yang,Jie Lu,Wei Duan,En Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文识别出长上下文LLM的"近端陷阱"现象（远距离证据利用不足更多源于无关近端背景的累积竞争而非距离本身），提出LYRA机制并构建ProxBench基准，在多个长上下文任务上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文研究主要致力于克服"距离"单一因素，作者认为远处证据被忽视的真正原因在于大量任务无关的近端背景与远处证据形成的累积竞争，即"近端陷阱"（Proximity Trap）。

Method: 提出LYRA（Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment），一种t分布方向匹配机制，重塑上下文检索分布，使更多注意力质量导向任务相关证据，同时保留已编码的相对位置信息；并构建ProxBench多层级细粒度基准，评估在近端背景干扰不断增强情形下的远距离证据利用能力。

Result: 在LongBench-v2、RULER和LongBench上，跨上下文长度与任务类别均取得一致性改进；ProxBench提供了近端干扰递增下的细粒度评测。

Conclusion: 长上下文建模的关键瓶颈不只是距离，而是近端无关背景的累积竞争；通过重分布注意力的机制设计（LYRA）可有效缓解该问题，为后续长上下文研究提供了新视角与评测工具。

Abstract: Long-context LLMs focus on retrieving distant evidence from extensive context, yet existing work has largely focused on overcoming distance alone. In this work, we identify the Proximity Trap, insufficient attention to distant evidence often arises less from distance itself than from cumulative competition with abundant, task-irrelevant proximal background. To address the Proximity Trap, we introduce LYRA (Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment), a t-distributed directional matching mechanism that reshapes the context retrieval distribution, directing more attention mass toward task-relevant evidence, while preserving the relative positional information encoded. Extensive experiments on LongBench-v2, RULER, and LongBench demonstrate consistent improvements across context lengths and task categories. We further introduce ProxBench, a multi-level fine-grained benchmark for evaluating distant evidence utilization under increasing proximal background interference. Project page: https://xiaoyuyoung.github.io/LYRA/

</details>


### [307] [EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26751)
*FNU Aditi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EquivSVA，一个以行为族为核心、经形式化验证的数据集，用于研究LLM生成的SystemVerilog断言是否刻画外部可观察行为，还是依赖某个RTL实现的偶然细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集和基准主要支持大规模训练、形式化评估、规范到断言生成以及变异测试等目标，但缺乏一种互补能力：判断生成的断言捕获的是外部可观察行为，还是某个RTL实现的偶然细节。为此需要一个围绕"行为族"组织、可支持受控稳健性研究的数据集。

Method: 构建EquivSVA数据集，以行为族为单位组织：每个族包含同一外部可观察行为的4个结构上不同的RTL实现、共享的接口级gold properties、3个受控变异体以及形式化验证证据。数据集共含12个类别、120个行为族、480个参考RTL实现、914条gold properties和360个变异体。每个最终族需通过固定的17项验证套件，覆盖RTL等价性、gold property证明、性质可达性、变异体可区分性以及变异体上的gold property检查；并提供族安全（family-safe）的固定训练/开发/测试划分。

Result: 在留出测试集上评估公开的Apache-2.0许可Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct模型：生成的293条仅基于接口的性质中有93条形式化可靠；在24个测试族中有14个族，其可靠性质数量在不同等价实现间存在变化。

Conclusion: 结果说明，行为族组织方式能够在不改变预期功能的前提下，支持对断言生成稳健性的受控研究。数据集、生成器、验证脚本及案例研究工件均已公开。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to generate SystemVerilog Assertions from natural-language specifica- tions and register-transfer-level designs. Existing datasets and benchmarks support important goals such as large- scale training, formal evaluation, specification-to-assertion generation, and mutation-based testing. A complemen- tary need is to study whether a generated assertion cap- tures externally observable behavior or depends on inci- dental details of one RTL implementation. We present EquivSVA, a formally verified dataset organized around behavior families. Each family contains four structurally distinct RTL implementations of the same externally ob- servable behavior, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence. EquivSVA contains 120 behavior families across 12 cat- egories, 480 reference RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants. Every final family passes a fixed 17-job validation suite covering RTL equivalence, gold-property proofs, property reachability, mutant dis- tinguishability, and gold-property checks on mutants. We also provide fixed family-safe train, development, and test splits. As a small demonstration of the analyses en- abled by the dataset, we evaluate the publicly released, Apache-2.0-licensed Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model on the held-out test split. Of 293 interface-only generated properties, 93 are formally sound, and the number of sound properties varies across equivalent implementations for 14 of 24 test families. These results illustrate how behavior-family organization can support controlled stud- ies of assertion-generation robustness without requiring changes in intended functionality. The dataset, generators, validation scripts, and case-study artifacts are publicly released at https://github.com/aditigupta96/EquivSVA.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [308] [NPLSD: Accelerating Line-Segment Detection on NPU Microcontrollers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25022)
*Parsa Hassani Shariat Panahi,Amir Hossein Jalilvand,M. Hassan Najafi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 针对STM32N6的Neural-ART NPU不支持注意力、网格采样和归一化算子的问题，提出NPU兼容的线段检测器NPLSD-H与NPLSD-M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线段检测对机器人、自主导航和工业检测至关重要。基于Transformer的检测器精度最高，但受资源限制难以部署在微控制器上。STM32N6及其Neural-ART NPU有望在极端边缘实现深度视觉，然而现有检测器依赖的注意力、网格采样和归一化算子不被该面向卷积的NPU支持，存在架构不匹配问题。

Method: 逐算子分析架构不匹配：注意力和网格采样、归一化缺乏加速器原语，解码器自注意力单独就产生39MB分数张量，超出片上内存。据此提出统一设计方法学下的两个NPU兼容检测器：NPLSD-H保留LINEA的卷积HGNetv2主干，用全卷积特征金字塔和F-Clip稠密头替换Transformer头；NPLSD-M将M-LSD-tiny主干适配到受支持的算子集。二者在ImageNet上热启动并在ShanghaiTech Wireframe上训练。

Result: 2.63M参数的NPLSD-H达到sAP^10=37.9（int8下35.9）；0.62M参数的NPLSD-M达到41.9（int8下41.1）。受控消融实验将主干确定为唯一变量，仅初始化一项就贡献4.6个点。

Conclusion: 通过面向NPU算子集的重新设计，可在极端边缘设备上实现高精度线段检测，主干选择与初始化对性能影响显著。

Abstract: Line-segment detection is fundamental to robotics, autonomous navigation, and industrial inspection. While transformer-based detectors achieve the highest accuracy, their deployment on microcontrollers remains impractical due to resource constraints. The STM32N6, with its Neural-ART NPU, promises to enable deep vision at the extreme edge. However, existing detectors rely on attention, grid-sampling, and normalization, operators that are unsupported by the convolution-oriented NPU. This architectural mismatch is characterized operator by operator: attention, grid-sampling, and normalization lack accelerator primitives, and the decoder's self-attention alone materializes a 39 MB score tensor that exceeds on-chip memory. To address this limitation, NPLSD is introduced as a pair of NPU-compatible line-segment detectors built from one design methodology. NPLSD-H retains the convolutional HGNetv2 backbone of LINEA and replaces the transformer head with a fully-convolutional feature pyramid and an F-Clip dense head. NPLSD-M adapts the M-LSD-tiny trunk to the supported operator set. Warm-started from ImageNet and trained on ShanghaiTech Wireframe, the 2.63M-parameter NPLSD-H reaches sAP^10=37.9 (35.9 int8); the 0.62M-parameter NPLSD-M reaches 41.9 (41.1 int8). A controlled ablation isolates the trunk as the only variable, and initialization alone accounts for 4.6 points.

</details>


### [309] [GRADE-RTL: Evaluating LLM-Generated RTL Beyond Compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25335)
*Hepziba Susan,Shivaranjani G. R.,Malik Imran,Muhammad Rashid,Sumathi Gokulanathan,Zain Ul Abideen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出GRADE-RTL框架，通过五项检查（端口签名、编译、细化、模块完整性、功能等价）与紧凑指标，在固定提示与验证设置下评估LLM生成的RTL，区分结构有效性、行为正确性与实现质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可依据自然语言规格生成RTL代码，但仅通过编译无法证明结构完整性、功能正确性或实现效率，缺乏能够超越"可编译"层面的系统化评估手段，难以定位失败环节并区分端到端成功与可进入下游综合的资格。

Method: GRADE-RTL采用固定提示与验证设置，对候选RTL执行五项检查：端口签名、编译、细化（elaboration）、模块完整性与对可信参考RTL的功能等价性验证；并设计紧凑指标定位失败点。评测对象为9个通用与RTL专用LLM，任务为10个边缘相关IP设计，预算为3次生成尝试并配合失败导向反馈，另补充FPGA实现与65 nm ASIC综合，以及PID控制器布局布线案例研究。

Result: 端到端成功率在0%至70%之间波动；失败不仅限于编译，还延伸至层次解析、逻辑不完整与行为不匹配。FPGA实现与65 nm ASIC综合显示，功能等价的RTL在资源占用、时序、面积和功耗上可能存在显著差异；PID控制器布局布线案例进一步揭示了不同RTL实现带来的物理设计后果。

Conclusion: GRADE-RTL为比较LLM生成的硬件描述提供了实用基础，通过将结构有效性、行为正确性与实现质量三者分离，支持更细致、可复现的评估与模型间对比。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) code from natural-language specifications, but compilation alone does not establish structural completeness, functional correctness, or implementation efficiency. This paper presents a framework for evaluating LLM-generated RTL beyond compilation, which we named GRADE-RTL. Using fixed prompts and validation settings, GRADE-RTL applies five checks, such as Port Signature, Compilation, Elaboration, Module Completeness, and Functional Equivalence against trusted reference RTL. With the help of compact metrics, we identify where candidates fail and distinguish end-to-end success from eligibility for downstream synthesis. We evaluate nine general-purpose and RTL-specialized LLMs on ten edge-relevant intellectual property designs under a budget of three generation attempts with failure-directed feedback. End-to-end success ranges from 0% to 70% across the evaluated models, with failures extending beyond compilation to hierarchy resolution, incomplete logic, and behavioral mismatch. FPGA implementation and 65 nm ASIC synthesis results further show that functionally equivalent RTL can differ substantially in resource use, timing, area, and power. A PID-controller place-and-route case study illustrates the physical-design consequences of different RTL implementations. GRADE-RTL provides a practical basis for comparing LLM-generated hardware descriptions by separating structural validity, behavioral correctness, and implementation quality.

</details>


### [310] [Accelerating the Mitigation of LLM Inference Nondeterminism Across GPU Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25624)
*Liam Cooper,Shinnung Jeong,Hyeran Jeon,Jeffrey Young,Hyesoon Kim*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出固定配置的融合上采样GEMM内核，将归约顺序固定为问题形状的纯函数，实现跨GPU架构的逐位可复现推理，同时性能优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在贪婪解码下本应可复现，但由于浮点非结合性与硬件相关内核选择（不同架构选用不同矩阵乘法内核、并行归约顺序与张量核算术未规定），相同模型、提示与软件栈在不同GPU上会产生不同输出，甚至翻转token。现有方案跨架构可复现性不完美且性能损失显著。

Method: 采用一组固定配置的融合上采样（fused-upcast）GEMM内核：从内存加载16位权重，在寄存器中上采样至FP32，并以IEEE-754算术累加；其归约顺序仅是问题形状的纯函数，与设备、SM数量及内核调度无关。这样每块GPU执行相同的运算序列。

Result: 线性层输出在NVIDIA Ampere、Ada、Hopper GPU上逐位一致；端到端速度比SOTA方案快1.17–3.1倍，并将权重内存流量减半。

Conclusion: 将浮点归约顺序固定为问题形状的函数后，跨架构可复现性归结为正确的IEEE-754算术，而不再依赖舍入差异低于平局翻转阈值，从而同时实现逐位可复现与性能提升。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) outputs are expected to be reproducible under greedy decoding, yet in practice the same model, prompt, and software stack produce different outputs on different GPUs. The root cause is floating-point non-associativity combined with hardware-dependent kernel selection. Inference frameworks select different matrix-multiplication kernels on each architecture, with different parallel reduction orders and unspecified tensor-core arithmetic, and the resulting rounding differences can flip output tokens. Existing solutions have imperfect cross-architecture reproducibility and incur a significant performance penalty. We present a solution employing a set of fixed-configuration fused-upcast GEMM kernels that load 16-bit weights from memory, upcast them to FP32 in registers, and accumulate with IEEE-754 arithmetic in a reduction order that is a pure function of the problem shape and is therefore independent of the device, its SM count, or kernel scheduling. By fixing the floating-point reduction order as a function of problem shape alone, every GPU runs the same operation sequence, so cross-architecture reproducibility of the linear layers reduces to correct IEEE-754 arithmetic rather than to rounding differences staying below a tie-flip threshold. We confirm our solution's linear-layer outputs are bitwise identical across NVIDIA Ampere, Ada, and Hopper GPUs, while running $1.17$ to $3.1\times$ faster end-to-end than the state-of-the-art solution and cutting weight-memory traffic in half.

</details>


### [311] [Hot-Cold Tiering of HBM and High Bandwidth Flash for Agentic LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25782)
*Jongjin Baek,Won Ji,Seungjae Yoo,Joo-Young Kim*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出冷热KV分层方案：将热KV集放HBM、冷KV池放HBF，在智能体负载下实现14ms TBT、约0.1ms恢复延迟，单GPU并发会话数提升24倍，每8-GPU节点读功耗降低7.6kW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务日益智能体化，多轮会话在动作间闲置却需保留完整上下文。GPU显存容量有限，非活跃KV状态被迫驱逐，恢复会话时需高代价重算或缓慢互连传输。HBF容量远大于HBM且读带宽相当，但读能耗高、写寿命有限，无法承载全部KV流量，因此需要更精细的分层策略。

Method: 通过分析发现智能体KV状态具有冷热分明的访问模式：小热集每步解码均被读取，大冷池仅在暂停会话恢复时读取。据此在GPU显存层级内构建冷热KV层次结构，将热集置于HBM、冷池置于HBF，实现HBM与HBF的协同分工。

Result: 在Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B的智能体负载上，方案实现14ms的token间时间（TBT），在预填充之上仅增加约0.1ms恢复延迟，单GPU可承载的并发会话数提升24倍；相比全部KV由flash服务，每8-GPU节点读功耗降低7.6kW。

Conclusion: 将HBM限定于热KV集，使HBF成为HBM的冷层补充而非替代品，兼顾容量、延迟与能效，为智能体LLM服务提供可行的显存分层方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly agentic, with multi-turn sessions that idle between actions yet must retain their full context. Limited GPU memory capacity forces inactive KV states to be evicted, so resuming a session incurs either costly recomputation or slow interconnect transfers. To address this, high bandwidth flash (HBF)-an on-package 3D-NAND memory offering orders-of-magnitude greater capacity than high bandwidth memory (HBM) at comparable read bandwidth-has emerged as a strong candidate. However, its high read energy and limited write endurance make it impractical to serve all KV traffic. Fortunately, our analysis shows that agentic KV states exhibit distinct access patterns: a small hot set is read for every decoding step, while a large cold pool is read only when a paused session resumes. Exploiting this, we place the hot set in HBM and the cold pool in HBF, forming a hot-cold KV hierarchy within the GPU memory tier. On agentic workloads with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, our design delivers 14 ms time-between-tokens (TBT) and adds only $\approx$0.1 ms of resume latency on top of prefill, while hosting $24\times$ more concurrent sessions per GPU. By confining HBM to the hot set, our design also cuts read power by 7.6 kW per 8-GPU node relative to serving all KV from flash-establishing HBF as a cold-tier complement to HBM rather than its replacement.

</details>


### [312] [Decoupling Logical Masks from GPU Execution for Dynamic Block-Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25869)
*Shanghao Liu,Xiaoyun Yu,Wanting Li,Wenqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Tessera 是一种面向动态块稀疏注意力（BSA）的专用运行时，通过解耦逻辑掩码与 GPU 执行、物理映射与任务组织，并结合 profile 引导的执行方案选择，在视频扩散模型中实现最高 6.79 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer（vDiT）需迭代去噪生成视频，注意力计算导致推理开销高昂。块稀疏注意力（BSA）通过逻辑掩码仅计算被选中的块以降低成本，但将逻辑块几何与执行选择耦合，限制了其对不同掩码和 GPU 的适应性；而运行时内核特化又会带来准备开销，可能抵消执行时间的节省。

Method: Tessera 将逻辑掩码与 GPU 执行解耦，同时保持指定的注意力交互。其物理映射层将逻辑注意力块保留、合并或细分为物理 tile，以适配不同注意力掩码形状与 GPU 架构；任务组织层在 GPU 任务内分组并调度 tile，以复用数据、暴露并行性并重叠数据搬运与计算；profile 引导的 regime 选择通过离线 profiling 构建查找表，实现低开销的执行计划选择。使用支持四代 NVIDIA GPU 的专用 CUDA kernel 实现。

Result: 在 2,315 个真实注意力掩码及工业视频扩散模型上评估，Tessera 在所评估的视频扩散模型中相对基线系统实现最高 6.79 倍的 BSA 请求加速。

Conclusion: Tessera 通过解耦逻辑掩码与 GPU 执行、物理映射与任务组织优化，以及 profile 引导的执行方案选择，有效降低了 vDiT 中动态 BSA 的推理开销，并在真实掩码与工业模型上取得了显著加速。

Abstract: Attention computation makes inference expensive in video diffusion transformers (vDiTs), which generate videos through iterative denoising. Block-sparse attention (BSA) reduces
  this cost by computing only blocks selected by a logical mask, which specifies attention interactions to compute. However, coupling logical block geometry to execution choices
  limits adaptation to varying masks and graphics processing units (GPUs), while runtime kernel specialization can incur preparation overhead that outweighs execution time savings.
  We present Tessera, a specialized runtime for dynamic BSA that decouples logical masks from GPU execution while preserving specified attention interactions. Its physical mapping
  layer retains, combines, or subdivides logical attention blocks into physical tiles suited to different attention mask shapes and GPU architectures. Its task organization layer
  groups and schedules tiles within GPU tasks to reuse data, expose parallelism, and overlap data movement with computation. Finally, profile-guided regime selection enables low-
  overhead execution plan selection through a lookup table constructed from offline profiling. We implement Tessera with specialized CUDA kernels supporting four NVIDIA GPU
  generations. Evaluated on 2,315 real attention masks and industrial video diffusion models, Tessera achieves up to 6.79x BSA request speedup over baseline systems in the evaluated
  video diffusion models.

</details>


### [313] [ESupNNet: An Error Supervising Neural Network architecture for error detection against soft errors in parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26374)
*Jorge Cano-Paez,Luis Entrena,Almudena Lindoso*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种低资源开销、无需修改CNN的架构，利用CNN内部的类间关系检测由参数软错误引起的误分类错误，并在多种数据集-模型组合上验证了超过90%的单错误检测准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN参数中的软错误会导致误分类，而现有方案往往需要修改CNN或带来较大资源开销，缺乏可与其它错误保护技术兼容的通用检测方案。

Method: 提出一种基于被保护CNN所诱导的类间关系的检测架构；该架构资源开销极小、无需修改CNN，可与其它错误保护技术协同使用。验证采用五个现代数据集-模型组合：ImageNet-1K配ResNet-50与EfficientNetV2-Small；CIFAR-10配MobileNetV3、ShuffleNetV2-Small（2.0x输出通道）与MNASNet（深度乘子1.3）。验证过程从数据集构建到实验结果获取均严格遵循统计显著性。

Result: 在检测单一错误时准确率超过90%，在多种误码率（Bit Error Rate）条件下均表现出良好的错误检测性能，并可通过超参数调优进一步提升。

Conclusion: 该架构是一种高效、低开销且具兼容性的CNN软错误误分类检测方案，性能优异且具备通过超参数调优继续提升的潜力。

Abstract: This work presents a novel approach to detect misclassification errors in CNNs caused by soft errors in their parameters. We propose an architecture that uses inter-class relations induced by the CNN that needs protection. The architecture has minimal resources overhead and does not require modifying the CNN, which makes it a competent solution that can be used with other error protection techniques. We have validated the architecture with five different combinations of modern dataset-model pairs: ImageNet-1K for ResNet-50 and EfficientNetV2-Small; CIFAR-10 for MobileNetV3, ShuffleNetV2-Small with 2.0x output channels and MNASNet with depth multiplier of 1.3. The validation process was done rigorously with statistical significance, from the creation of the datasets used by the architecture to the acquisition of experimental results. Results show great performance with over 90% accuracy in detecting single errors and great error detection over multiple Bit Error Rates, which can be potentially increased with hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [314] [Toki: Profiling HBM Performance on FPGA Systems with RISC-V Soft Cores and PCIe Host DMA Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26551)
*Andrea Galimberti,Andrea Motta,Gianni Antichi,Davide Zoni*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Toki是首个开源软硬件框架，可在FPGA加速卡上联合RISC-V软核执行与主机DMA流量，对HBM性能进行真实负载剖析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心场景中RISC-V可编程软核日益普及，如何基于FPGA与HBM高效部署成为关键问题；仅依赖合成流量发生器无法获得真实负载下的HBM性能洞察。

Method: 提出开源框架Toki，同时考虑(i)FPGA上实例化的RISC-V软核上的负载执行与(ii)主机通过PCIe经DMA注入内存流量；在AMD Alveo U55C卡上部署最多60个RISC-V计算核，通过真实应用与自定义访问模式的微基准对HBM2施压。

Result: 实验表明Toki能够有效剖析计算核组织方式、负载内存访问模式、数据局部性、内存控制器争用以及主机流量对HBM性能的影响。

Conclusion: Toki为FPGA+HBM的RISC-V软核系统提供了可编程、贴近真实场景的性能剖析能力，弥补了纯合成流量方法的不足。

Abstract: Programmable RISC-V soft cores are becoming more widespread in data-center scenarios, making it crucial to design efficient systems that deploy them on FPGA chips with HBM memory. Toki, released as open source, is the first hardware-software framework that enables profiling the performance of HBM on FPGA accelerator cards by jointly considering (i) the execution of workloads on RISC-V soft cores instantiated on the FPGA and (ii) the injection of memory traffic from the host system via DMA over PCIe, providing insights that cannot be obtained with synthetic traffic generators alone. Extensive experiments target an AMD Alveo U55C card, deploying up to 60 RISC-V compute cores and stressing its HBM2 memory through real-world applications and microbenchmarks with user-defined access patterns. Results showcase how Toki can effectively profile the impact on HBM performance of the compute cores' organization, the workload's memory access patterns, data locality, contention over the memory controllers, and host traffic.

</details>


### [315] [Dynamic Slack-Aware Clocking for Near-Threshold Tensor Processing Units (TPUs)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26644)
*Muhammad Usman Nadeem,Sanghamitra Roy,Koushik Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出DSAC框架，通过操作级时序预测与本地时钟调节，在近阈值TPU上实现能效与鲁棒性的平衡，能效最高提升1.55倍，面积开销低至13%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在近阈值计算（NTC）区域运行TPU可显著降低能耗，但会使电路对工艺偏差和数据活动高度敏感，时序延迟波动大。传统设计依赖保守的固定全局时钟以保证安全，导致大量时序余量被浪费——多数操作远早于时钟边沿即完成。

Method: 提出动态松弛感知时钟（DSAC）框架，用操作级时序调整替代最坏情况设计。采用轻量级的汉明距离（HD）、最高有效位（MSB）与混合（Hybrid）预测器，估计单个乘累加（MAC）操作的延迟敏感性，并将其分为三个时序层级；在固定全局参考时钟下，通过本地dummy-hold周期强制执行分层，实现细粒度时序自适应，无需全局时钟重调或频率缩放；并引入闭环反馈控制器监控时序违规，运行时更新层级阈值以维持鲁棒性。

Result: 在量化DNN基准测试中，MSB预测器保持高推理精度，即使在激进性能点下平均精度损失仅1%；相比基线TPU，DSAC在2.15倍频率缩放时能效提升最高达1.55倍，面积开销低至13%。

Conclusion: DSAC通过操作级时序预测与本地时钟调节，在不牺牲精度的前提下有效挖掘NTC区域TPU的时序余量，实现了能效、性能与面积开销的良好折衷。

Abstract: Operating Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) in the near-threshold computing (NTC) region significantly reduces energy consumption but introduces high delay sensitivity to process variation and data activity. Conventional designs typically rely on a conservative, fixed global clock to ensure safety, which leaves large portions of timing margin unexploited as most operations finish well before the clock edge. We propose Dynamic Slack-Aware Clocking (DSAC), a proactive framework that replaces worst-case timing with operation-specific adjustments. DSAC employs lightweight Hamming-Distance, Most-Significant-Bit, and Hybrid predictors to estimate the delay sensitivity of individual multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations and classify them into three timing tiers. These tiers are enforced locally via dummy-hold cycles under a fixed global reference clock, enabling fine-grained timing adaptation without global clock retuning or frequency scaling. A closed-loop feedback controller monitors timing violations and updates tier thresholds at runtime to maintain resilience. Experiments on quantized DNN benchmarks demonstrate that the MSB predictor maintains high inference accuracy, with an average loss of only 1% even at aggressive performance points. Furthermore, DSAC achieves up to 1.55X better energy efficiency at 2.15X frequency scaling compared to a baseline TPU, while incurring an area overhead as low as 13%.

</details>

### [316] [In Vivo Length Distributions as Mechanistic Fingerprints of Pathological Protein Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25998)
*Matthew W. Cotton,David Klenerman,Georg Meisl*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 本文建立一套数学框架，用于从单时间点的聚集体长度分布中定量推断活体系统中聚集生长与清除过程的竞争关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代成像技术可在尸检人体样本中分辨单个病理蛋白聚集体并获得长度分布，但这类分布是微观生成过程的机制"指纹"，需要定量理论框架才能从中提取机制信息，而传统整体测量方法无法获得该信息。

Method: 发展解读活体系统中聚集体长度分布的数学工具，其中聚集生长与主动清除相互竞争；证明在一类模型中足够大聚集体的长度分布趋近几何衰减，并分析额外聚集与清除过程对分布的影响。

Result: 证明足够大聚集体的长度分布趋近几何衰减，其衰减率由聚集延伸与清除之间的平衡决定，可提供竞争过程的直接定量读取，仅需单时间点测量即可实现健康与患病样本的机制比较。

Conclusion: 本研究奠定了利用聚集体长度分布作为从人体组织直接推断微观聚集动力学的实验可及途径的数学基础与工具。

Abstract: Modern imaging techniques can resolve individual pathological protein aggregates in postmortem human samples, providing detailed measurements of aggregate size distributions that are inaccessible with conventional bulk approaches. These distributions represent mechanistic fingerprints of the microscopic processes that generated the observed pathology, but extracting this mechanistic information requires a quantitative theoretical framework. Here, we develop the mathematical tools needed to interpret aggregate length distributions in living systems, where aggregate growth competes with active removal. We show that, across a class of models, the length distribution of sufficiently large aggregates approaches a geometric decay. Crucially, the decay rate is determined by the balance between aggregate elongation and removal, providing a direct quantitative readout of these competing processes from a single time point measurement. This enables mechanistic comparisons between healthy and diseased human samples without requiring longitudinal measurements of aggregate dynamics. We further analyse how additional aggregation and removal processes modify the observed length distributions. Together, these results establish the mathematical foundations and tools to use aggregate length distributions as an experimentally accessible route for inferring microscopic aggregation dynamics directly from human tissue.

</details>

### [317] [Do Synthetic Personas Predict Real Audience Response? A Sim-to-Real Study Where a No-Persona Baseline Beats Persona-Based Copy Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25010)
*Alexandre Cristovão Maiorano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Marketers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as "synthetic personas" to predict how an audience will react to a piece of copy before it ships, encouraged by evidence that profile-conditioned LLMs mimic human samples. But is that prediction actually valid against real behaviour - and does the persona machinery help? We present a sim-to-real validity study using the Upworthy Research Archive - thousands of headline A/B tests on shared real traffic, with measured click-through - as held-out ground truth. We compare a ten-persona panel, grounded in the real audience's demographics, against a no-persona zero-shot baseline that simply asks the model how likely a typical reader is to click. Two findings stand out. First, ground-truth reliability is the binding constraint: most A/B tests have no statistically distinguishable winner, so validity can only be measured on the reliable subset (n = 399). Second, and counter to the persona-simulation premise, persona conditioning degrades predictive validity: the no-persona baseline ranks variants markedly better (Kendall τ = 0.361, a medium effect; top-1 accuracy 49.2%) than the persona panel (τ = 0.084; top-1 34.6%), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Asking the model directly taps an accurate population-level prior; forcing it to role-play specific personas injects bias and noise. The result replicates across three independent Upworthy splits, holds in direction on a different-domain news dataset, and is robust to seed, prompt phrasing, and model choice - across three Gemini tiers and a different model family (OpenAI gpt-4.1, significant paired gap). The takeaway: for predicting aggregate engagement, a plain LLM ranker beats persona simulation - synthetic personas are not merely a weak predictor, they are worse than not using them. All numbers regenerate from a public, artifact-first replication package.

</details>


### [318] [Do Existing Preconditioners Improve Biomedical Tabular Foundation Learning? An Empirical Study on TabPFN Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25013)
*M. Sajid,Pinki Khatun,M. Tanveer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对TabPFN v2.5在59个生物医学表格数据集上的5种AdamW预条件策略进行实证研究，发现原始AdamW综合性能与统计排名最佳，现有曲率感知预条件器无法带来可靠提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（如TabPFN）在低数据表格分类中表现良好，但优化与预条件策略对生物医学微调的影响尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 在涵盖阿尔茨海默病、乳腺癌、精神分裂症、SMC、KEEL及UCI等59个生物医学数据集上，对TabPFN v2.5微调的5种基于AdamW的预条件策略开展对比实验，评估预测性能、计算效率与统计显著性。

Result: 原始AdamW在整体性能与统计排名上持续最优；现有曲率感知预条件器在多样化生物医学场景中未能提供可靠改进。

Conclusion: 通用预条件方法难以充分刻画生物医学表格学习的优化特性，需针对医疗导向的表格基础模型开发领域感知的预条件器。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models have recently shown strong potential for structured biomedical data analysis. Among them, TabPFN has emerged as an effective approach for low-data tabular classification tasks. However, the impact of optimization and preconditioning strategies on biomedical fine-tuning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical investigation of five AdamW-based preconditioning strategies for fine-tuning TabPFN v2.5 on 59 biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease, breast cancer, schizophrenia, significant memory concern (SMC), KEEL biomedical datasets, and UCI biomedical benchmarks. The evaluation considers predictive performance, computational efficiency, and statistical significance analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that the original AdamW optimizer consistently achieves the best overall performance and statistical ranking, while existing curvature-aware preconditioners fail to provide reliable improvements across diverse biomedical learning scenarios. The findings suggest that generic preconditioning approaches may not adequately capture the optimization characteristics of biomedical tabular learning, motivating the development of biomedical-aware preconditioners specifically tailored for healthcare-oriented tabular foundation models.

</details>


### [319] [4DGS-JEPA: Temporally Compositional Joint-Embedding Prediction for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25036)
*Yongchao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 4DGS-JEPA，一种面向动态高斯场景的「高斯原生」联合嵌入预测架构，通过时序组合原则实现因果式多步预测，并在三项受控实验中验证其机制有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法主要面向重建、未来状态生成或渲染，而非学习可复用的预测动力学。作者希望构建一个显式表示演化三维场景、且能进行因果多步预测的架构，使预测状态具有可复用性与时序一致性。

Method: 1) 采用层级表示：场景级—运动组级—高斯基元级；2) 引入以预测时域为条件的转移算子，支持直接预测与递归 rollout；3) 核心原则为时序组合：到达同一未来端点的不同时间transition路径应产生兼容的预测状态；4) 监督信号包括端点监督与多时域路径监督，锚定未来目标嵌入；5) 选择性几何解码器与几何级组合将动力学约束到一致的组运动与高斯几何，无需完整未来外观重建；6) 混合对应机制：持久规范身份 + 残差最优传输匹配，应对重排序与拓扑变化。

Result: 理论上刻画了零损失路径一致性与有限误差下的 rollout 误差累积。三项受控实验给出机制级证据：时序组合降低潜空间路径依赖性同时保持预测精度；几何级组合提升解码运动的一致性；混合对应在保持可靠身份的同时，在对应模糊时仍具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 4DGS-JEPA 为动态高斯世界提供了一种预测性、时序可组合的建模范式，将重点从重建/渲染转向可复用的预测动力学学习。

Abstract: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation of evolving 3D scenes, but existing approaches are primarily optimized for reconstruction, future-state generation, or rendering rather than for learning reusable predictive dynamics. We propose 4DGS-JEPA, a Gaussian-native joint-embedding predictive architecture for causal multi-horizon prediction over dynamic Gaussian scenes. The model uses a hierarchical scene-, motion-group-, and Gaussian-level representation together with a horizon-conditioned transition operator that supports both direct prediction and recursive rollout. Its central principle is temporal composition: different chronological transition paths reaching the same future endpoint should produce compatible predictive states. Endpoint and multi-horizon path supervision anchor these predictions to future target embeddings, while a selective geometry decoder and geometry-level composition ground the learned dynamics in consistent group motion and Gaussian geometry without requiring complete future appearance reconstruction. We further introduce a hybrid correspondence mechanism that combines persistent canonical identity with residual optimal-transport matching under reordering and topology change. We characterize zero-loss path agreement and finite-error rollout accumulation theoretically. Three controlled experiments provide mechanism-level evidence that temporal composition reduces latent path dependence while retaining predictive accuracy, geometry-level composition improves consistency of decoded motion, and hybrid correspondence preserves reliable identity while remaining robust when correspondence becomes ambiguous. Together, 4DGS-JEPA provides a predictive, temporally compositional formulation of dynamic Gaussian worlds.

</details>


### [320] [An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25088)
*Mushahid Intesum*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出融合层束超图卷积、概念瓶颈层与充分性检验正则的多模态框架，在GBM生存预测中兼顾精度与可解释性，UPenn-GBM上C-index达0.643且方差最小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GBM生存预测中精度与可解释性常被视为相互竞争的目标：高性能模型牺牲透明度，可解释模型则损失预测能力。同时现有方法多依赖单一影像模态，未充分利用多模态MRI与临床元数据的互补信息。作者主张该权衡并非必然。

Method: 多模态框架含三部分：(1) 层束超图神经网络，通过有向、非对称消息传递捕获组织patch间高阶关系；(2) 概念瓶颈层，将学习到的表示压缩为临床可解释概念，实现事前（ante-hoc）可解释性；(3) 扩展充分性检验（EST）正则项，训练中惩罚不忠实解释，确保解释真实反映内部决策过程。临床与基因组特征通过门控融合引入，兼顾分子标志物的主导预后信号与概念级可追溯性。

Result: 在UPenn-GBM数据集593例患者上，采用5折交叉验证，C-index为0.643，折间方差在全部对比模型中最低（std=0.015）。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个统一层束超图卷积、概念瓶颈监督与EST正则用于脑MRI可解释生存预测的工作，表明精度与可解释性可同时实现。

Abstract: Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI

</details>


### [321] [Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25165)
*Ovis-Embedding Team*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Ovis-Embedding，一个基于原生多模态骨干网络的统一嵌入模型家族，实现文本、图像、视频、音频的任意模态检索，并在多个基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入模型通常采用分离的模态塔（modality towers）架构，导致模态碎片化，难以在统一表示空间中进行跨模态（any-to-any）检索。作者希望用统一的多模态训练克服这种割裂。

Method: 采用共享多模态骨干（以预训练Qwen-omni为嵌入骨干）而非独立模态塔，包含三项关键设计：(1) 原生全模态初始化——通过低秩初始化的对比训练适配骨干；(2) 数据中心化的全模态训练——构建覆盖文本/图像/视频/音频及交错数据的语料，并引入同源采样（homogeneous-source sampling）构造任务一致批次以获得有信息量的批内负样本；(3) 嵌入专用训练与推理优化——使用focal loss强调困难样本，并通过基于相似度的Embedding Distillation从互补专家迁移细粒度相似性结构；推理时用低秩特征分解实现可灵活调整维度且性能损失极小的紧凑嵌入。

Result: Ovis-Embedding系列在MMEB-v3、MMEB-v2、MVEB、MAEB和RTEB上均达到state-of-the-art性能，验证其在文本、图像、视频、音频各模态上的有效性。

Conclusion: 结果表

Abstract: In this report, we introduce \textbf{Ovis-Embedding}, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make \textbf{three key advances}: (1) \textbf{native omni-modal initialization}: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive training with low-rank initialization; (2) \textbf{data-centric omni-modal training}: we construct a broad, high-quality corpus spanning text, images, video, audio, and interleaved multimodal data. To improve data efficiency, we introduce homogeneous-source sampling to form task-consistent batches with informative in-batch negatives; and (3) \textbf{embedding-specific training and inference optimization}: we use focal loss to emphasize hard examples and similarity-based Embedding Distillation to transfer fine-grained similarity structure from complementary experts. At inference time, low-rank feature decomposition enables compact embeddings with flexible dimensionality and minimal performance loss. Empirical evaluations show that the \textbf{Ovis-Embedding} family achieves state-of-the-art performance on \textbf{MMEB-v3}, \textbf{MMEB-v2}, \textbf{MVEB}, \textbf{MAEB}, and \textbf{RTEB}, demonstrating its effectiveness across text, image, video, and audio modalities. These results highlight the potential of unified omni-modal training to overcome modality fragmentation and advance universal embedding models for any-to-any retrieval.

</details>


### [322] [X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25187)
*Howard Lu,Shalfun Li,Porter Pan,Cris,Lumen,Cyril,Eric Hu,Lily Li,Maeve Zhang,Robert Wang,KZ Zheng,Viggo Chen,Tim Ding,Regsis Cheng,YJ Xiao,Kian,Hai Lin,Alan Song,Elise Ma,Gody Li,Victor Yao,Yohann Tang,Ingrid Yu,Jason He,James Wang,Ryan Yu,Ping Yang,Chris Pan,Vincent Chen,Roy Gan,Hao Wang,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: X-Planner 是一个面向具身长程操作的规划前端，通过分层异构数据监督与事件结构化双接口（离散事件状态 + 瀑布式解码的连续隐式 CoT），兼顾可解释性与推理效率，离线与真机实验均取得有竞争力的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 VLA 系统将任务规划这一中间结构隐式化，缺乏显式规划表示；现有 CoT 规划器依赖粗粒度任务级标注，并逐 token 序列化长推理链，导致监督信号不足与推理效率低。论文希望同时解决具身推理的监督问题与表示问题。

Method: 数据侧：融合 Ego、UMI 与遥操作数据，采用层级粒度与依赖数据源的标注深度；以接管时刻标注和人工设计的失败案例监督进行中的错误识别。模型侧：共享 VLM 主干输出两种事件结构化规划形式——输出可解释事件状态的离散接口，以及通过 Staircase Decoding 在交错 Transformer 深度间传递连续 CoT 状态的隐式接口；并以冻结的隐式到文本重建目标为隐式表示提供语义锚点。

Result: 离线两步规划评测中，在 BERTScore-F1 与基于评判模型的 Overall 分数上，X-Planner 在四个被评估模型中位列第二；真机实验中分别优于所评估的基线。结果同时刻画了规划文本质量与下游执行表现。

Conclusion: 将显式事件结构化规划作为 VLA 前端，并统一离散与隐式两种表示，可有效提升具身长程操作的规划质量与执行效果。

Abstract: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. A frozen latent-to-text reconstruction objective provides a semantic anchor for the latent representation. Offline two-step planning evaluation places X-Planner second among four evaluated models on both BERTScore-F1 and a judge-based Overall score. In real-robot experiments, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baselines. These results characterize planning-text quality and downstream execution.

</details>


### [323] [Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25199)
*Vasily Ilin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lean Pool 是一个由 AI 智能体驱动生长、维护与优化的形式化数学仓库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在构建一个可持续扩展的形式化数学库，借助 AI 智能体降低人工维护成本，实现仓库的自动化生长与优化。

Method: 以 Lean 形式化语言为载体建立数学仓库，由多个 AI 智能体承担形式化内容的添加、维护与优化工作。

Result: 形成由 AI 智能体持续贡献并迭代优化的形式化数学资源库。

Conclusion: Lean Pool 展示了一种以 AI 智能体为核心维护者的形式化数学库构建范式，为数学形式化的规模化与自动化提供新思路。

Abstract: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.

</details>


### [324] [The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25254)
*Aakash Patel,Panos Ketonis,Shreya Saxena,Smita Krishnaswamy,David van Dijk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AI Neuroscientist——一个集成大语言模型与神经影像工具集的语言智能体，用于交互式数据探索，并以 fNIRS 数据验证其能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经影像数据分析需要专业编程与统计技能，对缺乏计算背景的研究者构成门槛，限制了数据的可及性。

Method: 将大语言模型与神经影像工具集结合，构建可执行质量控制、建模与可视化的语言智能体，使研究者能用自然语言查询数据质量并指定分析参数；以功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）数据演示其功能，并在自建 fNIRS 基准测试集上，与配备代码沙箱的通用 LLM 智能体进行对比评估。

Result: 该智能体在 fNIRS 数据上实现了质量控制、建模与可视化的自然语言交互分析，并在自建基准测试中完成了与通用 LLM 智能体的对比评估。

Conclusion: AI Neuroscientist 为小规模数据探索提供了一种透明、可交互的替代方案；未来工作将把架构推广至 fMRI 等其他模态，并扩展基准测试任务。

Abstract: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to conventional scripted pipelines for small-scale data exploration. We demonstrate these capabilities using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, and evaluate the agent on a custom fNIRS benchmarking suite against general-purpose LLM agents with code sandboxes. Future extensions will generalize the architecture to additional modalities, including functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, and expand the benchmarking suite to additional fNIRS tasks.

</details>


### [325] [MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25272)
*Hemn Khdr,Mohammad Noaeen,Karim Keshavjee,Aziz Guergachi,Zahra Shakeri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多模态门控架构MedGate-Fusion，将首诊叙事文本的Transformer嵌入与10项常规风险标志物融合，用于基层医疗5年卒中风险分层，并采用词典化脱敏降低标签泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基层医疗中卒中前瞻性风险分层困难：早期风险信号分散于常规生物标志物与非结构化临床叙事文本中，单一模态难以捕捉完整风险信息。

Method: 基于加拿大基层医疗哨点监测网络（CPCSSN）电子病历数据，从808,921条就诊级观测构建首诊队列，保留102,736份叙事非空且数据充足的唯一患者记录以评估5年卒中结局；对叙事中卒中相关术语进行基于词典的脱敏处理后再做语义编码，以减少诊断提及带来的显式标签泄漏；随后以门控机制融合Transformer叙事嵌入与10项常规记录风险标志物。

Result: 摘要未报告具体性能指标，仅给出数据规模与建模流程（808,921条就诊记录筛选至102,736例患者队列）。

Conclusion: MedGate-Fusion表明融合结构化风险标志物与非结构化首诊叙事可支撑基层卒中前瞻性风险分层，且基于词典的文本脱敏是控制标签泄漏的必要预处理步骤。

Abstract: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.

</details>


### [326] [AgenticSizing: A Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Framework for Analog Circuit Sizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25873)
*Yijia Hao,Pratibha Verma,Dongxu Guo,Cristian Sestito,Michael O'Boyle,Christos-Savvas Bouganis,Themis Prodromakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体LLM框架用于复杂模拟电路尺寸设计，先解析拓扑并分解网表、提取轻量设计知识，再由规划器协调角色专业化智能体更新设计变量。在8个电路（最大55个晶体管、60个尺寸变量）上验证，LDO基准达60%成功率、平均83次迭代，而经典优化器未能找到可行解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路尺寸设计因设计空间大、性能折衷强、先进工艺下电路复杂度上升而耗时困难。现有基于大语言模型的方法虽在样本效率与可解释性上有潜力，但缺乏对电路拓扑的显式理解，且多在较简单的模拟模块上评估。

Method: 构建基于多智能体LLM的复杂模拟电路尺寸设计框架：首先分析电路拓扑，将网表分解为功能块与子结构，并提取可复用的轻量设计知识；在此基础上由规划器协调多个角色专业化的尺寸设计智能体，更新设计变量以满足全局性能指标。该流程模拟专家模拟设计团队的协作过程，形成结构化、可解释、仿真驱动的优化流程。

Result: 在8个电路上验证，最大设计含55个晶体管与60个尺寸变量。LDO基准上达到60%成功率、平均83次迭代，而经典优化器未能找到可行解。消融实验表明拓扑理解、设计知识注入与智能体专业化带来互补收益。源代码已开放以支持可复现性。

Conclusion: 该多智能体LLM框架通过拓扑理解、知识注入与角色专业化协同，可有效求解复杂模拟电路尺寸设计问题，并在经典优化器失效的基准上取得可行解，同时保持结构化与可解释性。

Abstract: Analog circuit sizing remains a challenging and time-consuming task due to the large design space, strong performance trade-offs, and increasing circuit complexity in scaled technologies. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods show promise in improving sample efficiency and interpretability, existing approaches often lack explicit circuit-topology understanding and are mainly evaluated on relatively simple analog building blocks. This paper presents a multi-agent LLM-based framework for complex analog circuit sizing. The proposed framework first analyzes the circuit topology and decomposes the netlist into functional blocks and substructures. It also extracts lightweight design knowledge for reuse. Based on the extracted topology and knowledge, a planner coordinates multiple role-specialized sizing agents to update design variables and achieve global performance specifications. This workflow mimics the collaborative process of an expert analog design team and provides a structured, interpretable, and simulation-driven optimization procedure. The framework was validated on eight circuits, with the largest design containing up to 55 transistors and 60 sizing variables. Notably, for the LDO benchmark, the proposed method achieved a 60\% success rate with an average of 83 iterations, where classical optimizers failed to find feasible solutions. Further, ablation studies demonstrate that topology understanding, design-knowledge infusion, and agent specialization provide complementary benefits. The source code is available to support reproducibility.

</details>


### [327] [When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25284)
*Jianzhe Lin,Xiaolin Li,Yunda Liu,Fei Wang,Jubin Chheda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出LLM智能体的社交决策本质上是关系推理问题，提出关系推理基准（500个合成社交世界、1000条查询）以及ReAdapt方法，用显式结构化社交状态z=(G,B,R,N,D)增强ReAct循环，在反应选择与引荐任务上分别提升8和14个百分点准确率，并降低oracle regret。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交智能体的基本决策（如是否回应某帖、该联系谁）并非纯内容问题，其正确动作往往取决于人与人之间的潜在关系（关系强度、互惠性、共同连接），而非最显著的内容。标准LLM智能体循环没有显式表示新关系证据应如何修正当前社交假设，当关系线索与内容线索冲突时容易做出表面显然的选择。

Method: 1) 形式化该失败模式：构建关系推理基准，含500个合成社交世界（友谊、关注、互动历史、信息流），生成两个任务共1000条查询——反应选择与引荐（为目标人寻找最佳桥梁）；其中约53%查询的表面显然候选与关系依据的oracle不同，构成需修正初始选择的overturn子集。2) 提出ReAdapt（Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate）：在ReAct循环中加入显式结构化社交状态z=(G,B,R,N,D)，分别表示目标、信念、关系、规范、披露；每次工具观测后执行类型化Adapt步骤更新该状态并输出策略操作（continue/switch/abandon/clarify），再选择下一动作。

Result: 在Gemini-3-Flash上，对每任务n=150的分层查询子集：引荐任务准确率从37%提升至51%（+14点），反应选择从69%提升至77%（+8点）；oracle regret分别从0.260降至0.152、从0.095降至0.053。

Conclusion: 在固定模型、工具与环境的前提下，结果表明显式的关系状态自适应能帮助LLM智能体将检索到的社交证据转化为修正后的决策，验证了关系推理建模的有效性。

Abstract: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems. The right action often hinges on the latent relationship between people -- tie strength, reciprocity, mutual connections -- rather than on which content is most salient. Standard LLM agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's current social hypothesis, leaving them prone to surface-obvious choices when relational and content cues diverge. We formalize this failure mode with a relationship-reasoning benchmark: 500 synthetic social worlds with friendships, follows, reaction histories, and feeds, yielding 1,000 queries over two tasks, reaction selection and warm introduction (finding the best bridge to a target person). By construction, the surface-obvious candidate differs from the relationship-grounded oracle in about 53% of queries, forming an overturn subset where the agent must use relational evidence to revise an initially plausible choice. We propose ReAdapt (Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate), which augments the ReAct loop with an explicit structured social state z = (G, B, R, N, D) capturing goal, belief, relationship, norm, and disclosure. After each tool observation, ReAdapt runs a typed Adapt step that updates this state and emits a policy operation (continue, switch, abandon, or clarify) before choosing the next action. With Gemini-3-Flash on a stratified subset of n = 150 queries per task, ReAdapt improves warm-introduction accuracy from 37% to 51% (+14 points) and reaction-selection accuracy from 69% to 77% (+8 points). Oracle regret drops from 0.260 to 0.152 and from 0.095 to 0.053, respectively. Holding the model, tools, and environments fixed, these results suggest that explicit relational-state adaptation helps LLM agents turn retrieved social evidence into revised decisions.

</details>


### [328] [Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25285)
*Ash Manvi,Samreena Tajreen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种低成本方法，将注意力视为单次前向传播得到的路由图，提取少量指向答案的路由，并验证其对模型行为的因果重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语言模型电路发现通常依赖大量精细干预，成本高；作者希望探索一种更简单、更便宜的替代方案，用单次前向传播提取可能重要的注意力路由。

Method: 将注意力解释为路由图，在单次前向传播中提取一小组指向答案的路由/边；随后通过消融这些边来检验其因果作用，并与同规模随机边消融对比。评估使用配对差距检验和自助法置信区间，在GPT-2 Small、GPT-2 Medium和Pythia-410M上进行，每个单元格n=100个提示。

Result: 在归纳头和IOI等已知电路任务上，消融提取出的边对模型的损害显著大于消融同规模随机边；提取步骤仅需一次前向传播，而逐头补丁扫描的成本约高出两个数量级。

Conclusion: 该方法并非完整电路图谱，而是一种廉价草图，在已知任务上携带真实因果信号，并存在明确失败模式；代码与评估材料已公开。

Abstract: Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter.
  They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired gap tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. The extract step costs one forward; a head-by-head patch sweep costs about two orders of magnitude more.
  We are not claiming a complete circuit atlas. We are claiming a cheap sketch that carries real causal signal on known tasks, with clear failure modes when it does not. Code and evaluation artifacts are at https://github.com/Aquinf03/live-circuit-routing.

</details>


### [329] [Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25286)
*Ethan Torres,Eric Mills*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"潜在等价学习"框架，将持久任务身份与其数据集相关实现分离，通过支持/反对证据塑造的高斯原型、软隶属剖面与查询原型-兼容函数路由，实现身份因子化的查询条件化证据组织，在Data Agent Benchmark上取得94.67%数据集宏分层Pass@1与258/270成功尝试，显著优于55.51%的参考智能体，位列榜首。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业场景下的结构化数据智能体需在跨模式、关系、策略与固定业务角色的复杂环境中推理，证据分散。现有基于可复用markdown式记忆或技能文件的做法虽能减少结构重复发现，却掩盖了更自然的分工：智能体擅于语义推理，而学习系统擅于预测与组织重复性结构。为此需要一种机制来弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出潜在等价学习框架，将持久的任务相关身份与其数据集相对实现分离。实现中，支持与反对证据塑造"支持实现的"高斯原型，学习身份在特定数据环境中的表达方式，并用软隶属剖面保留硬分配所丢失的区分；另设学习式查询原型系统表示重复出现的证据需求，经学习的兼容函数映射到同一持久身份结构，形成身份因子化、查询条件化的路由，为下游推理物化出数据集特定证据。

Result: 在Data Agent Benchmark（覆盖12个异构数据集共54条查询）上，完整实现在5次完整试验中取得94.67%的数据集宏分层Pass@1，258/270次原始查询尝试成功，对比基准中Claude Opus 4.6参考智能体的55.51%，并在提交时于40个榜单条目中排名第一。

Conclusion: 通过在持久身份与数据集相对实现之间建立潜在等价关系，并以查询条件化路由组织证据，智能体可在已结构化的证据状态上运行，而无需在每次查询时重建跨模式结构，从而显著提升异构企业数据环境下的推理表现。

Abstract: Structured-data agents in enterprise settings must reason over complex data environments whose relevant evidence is distributed across schemas, relationships, policies, and recurring business roles. Modern agentic systems often address this burden through reusable markdown-style memory or skill files that preserve previously discovered information for later queries, reducing the need to rediscover the same structure repeatedly. This is useful, but it obscures a natural division of labor: agents are well suited to semantic reasoning, while learned systems are well suited to predicting and organizing recurring structure. We introduce latent equivalence learning to bridge this gap. The framework separates persistent task-relevant identities from their dataset-relative realizations. In our realization, supporting and opposing evidence shape support-realized Gaussian prototypes that learn how those identities are expressed in a particular data environment, while soft-membership profiles retain distinctions lost under a hard assignment. A separate learned query-prototype system represents recurring evidential requirements and maps them through a learned compatibility function into the same persistent identity structure. This identity-factorized, query-conditioned routing materializes the relevant dataset-specific evidence for downstream reasoning, allowing the agent to operate over an already organized evidential state rather than reconstructing cross-schema structure at every query. On the Data Agent Benchmark, spanning 54 queries across 12 heterogeneous datasets, our full implementation achieves 94.67% dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 over five complete trials and 258/270 successful raw query attempts, compared with 55.51% for the benchmark's Claude Opus 4.6 reference agent, ranking first among 40 leaderboard entries at submission.

</details>


### [330] [Agentic Algorithm Engineering: Improving Shared-Memory Exact Minimum Cuts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07204)
*David A. Bader,Adil Chhabra,Ernestine Großmann,Monika Henzinger,Alexander Noe,Christian Schulz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理式算法工程（AAE）"方法，让自主大语言模型代理在既有代码库上运行算法工程循环（形成假设、实现、基准测试、保留或丢弃），并据此改进了最小割问题的快速精确算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无向边权图最小割问题已有快速算法（如VieCut），且团队此前已 extensively 手工调优，但仍希望进一步压缩运行时间；同时探索一种可自动化算法工程流程的新方法论。

Method: AAE（agentic algorithm engineering）：由自主LLM代理在现成代码基上迭代执行算法工程循环——提出关于运行时间损失的假设、实现改动、在固定实例集上基准测试、决定保留或回退。对原有精确最小割算法（含非精确算法求界、依赖界的归约、改进数据结构与并行收缩例程）进行自动优化。

Result: 即使此前已大量手工调优，代理仍找到显著优化：真实世界k-core上顺序加速1.28倍、32线程加速1.63倍；DIMACS core实例上分别加速6.26倍与127倍。此前最快版本相比其他求解器已在真实实例上顺序快至2.5倍、并行快至12.9倍。

Conclusion: AAE能被自主LLM代理有效用于已有高性能算法代码库的持续优化，并在困难实例（尤其DIMACS core）上带来数量级级别的运行时间改进，展示了自动化算法工程循环的可行性。

Abstract: The minimum cut problem for an undirected edge-weighted graph asks us to divide its set of nodes into two blocks while minimizing the weighted sum of the cut edges. Over the last years, we engineered a range of fast algorithms for this problem. Our fastest exact algorithm uses an inexact algorithm to obtain a better bound for the problem, reductions that depend on this bound, improved data structures and parallel contraction routines.
