### [420] [BananaVLM: A Domain-Adapted Vision Language Model for Banana Crop Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25040)
*Sangam Kumar Jena,Pandarasamy Arjunan*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 提出基于LLaVA-v1.5-7B与LoRA微调的领域适配视觉语言模型BananaVLM，配合自动化指令数据生成流水线BananaInstruct，实现香蕉病害诊断，在九分类基准上大幅超越开源与闭源模型，并由专家与LLM评测验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 香蕉作物病害威胁全球粮食安全，但田间诊断困难：一方面缺乏专家资源，另一方面不同病害类别在视觉上高度相似，难以区分。

Method: 以LLaVA-v1.5-7B为基座，采用LoRA进行参数高效微调构建BananaVLM；提出BananaInstruct自动化流水线，无需人工标注，将原始病害图像转换为约8万条问答对（用LLaVA-1.5-13B生成症状描述，用Mistral-7B生成农业问答与标签对齐）；在九类基准上与14个开源、5个闭源VLM对比，并开展LoRA与DoRA的对照实验，以及9个LLM裁判的G-Eval和5位领域专家的盲测配对比较。

Result: BananaVLM取得域内92.21%、域外83.28%的分类准确率，分别超最佳闭源基线Gemini 2.5 Pro达49.8与63.3个百分点；健康/患病二分类域外准确率98.38%，召回率1.00；LoRA–DoRA对照显示DoRA随训练轮次性能退化，LoRA在细粒度分类上更有效；G-Eval胜率0.81–0.96，专家在990次盲测配对中98.48%偏好BananaVLM。

Conclusion: 轻量级领域适配结合自动化指令微调，是构建专用农业AI的一种有效且可扩展的路径；代码、数据集与模型权重均已开源。

Abstract: Banana crop diseases threaten food security across the world, yet field diagnosis remains difficult because of limited expert access and visual similarity among disease classes. We present BananaVLM, a domain-adapted vision-language model for banana disease diagnosis built on LLaVA-v1.5-7B and fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). To address the lack of multimodal agricultural instruction data, we introduce BananaInstruct, an automated pipeline that converts raw disease images into $\approx$80,000 question--answer pairs without manual annotation, using LLaVA-1.5-13B for symptom descriptions and Mistral-7B for agricultural Q&A generation and label grounding. Evaluated against 14 open-source and 5 closed-source VLMs on a nine-class benchmark, BananaVLM achieves 92.21% in-domain and 83.28% out-of-domain (OOD) classification accuracy, outperforming the best closed-source baseline, Gemini~2.5~Pro, by 49.8 and 63.3 percentage points, respectively. Binary healthy/diseased identification reaches 98.38% OOD accuracy with 1.00 recall. A controlled LoRA--DoRA comparison shows that DoRA performance degrades across epochs, while LoRA remains more effective for fine-grained classification. Qualitative evaluation using nine LLM judges yields G-Eval win rates of 0.81--0.96, while five domain experts prefer BananaVLM in 98.48% of 990 blind pairwise comparisons. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation with automated instruction tuning is an effective and scalable approach for specialized agricultural AI. Code, datasets, and model weights are available at https://github.com/samy101/banana-vlm

</details>


### [421] [Reactive molecular dynamics simulations of atenolol first steps degradation by 9CL6 ammonia monooxygenase](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25076)
*Pascal Brault,Matthieu Wolf,Yana Gouzi,Claire Albasi,Jeanne Trognon*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 采用ReaxFF反应分子动力学模拟，研究氨单加氧酶9CL6在300 K与350 K水环境中对阿替洛尔的初始酶促降解过程，揭示降解速率、饱和降解量、碎片种类及温度效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: β受体阻滞剂（如阿替洛尔）在水环境中持久存在，需要高效修复策略，酶促生物降解是潜在途径，但分子尺度上的初始降解机理与速率尚不明确，亟需原子级认识以指导预测。

Method: 使用ReaxFF反应力场，在模拟水环境中构建阿替洛尔与氧化还原酶9CL6氨单加氧酶体系，于300 K和350 K下进行6.5 ns反应分子动力学（rMD）模拟，并通过质谱分析识别降解碎片。

Result: 初始降解率300 K为24%、350 K为18%；每个酶分子约降解20个阿替洛尔分子后达到饱和。两种温度下主要生成C8和C6碎片；300 K时额外出现C1、C3、C11、C13中间碎片，而在350 K下这些中间体被完全绕过。升温至350 K使初始降解阶段由2 ns缩短至0.5 ns，但总体降解率略降。

Conclusion: 该工作从原子尺度阐明了阿替洛尔酶促降解的初始路径与温度依赖性，为在分子尺度预测药物污染物的生物降解速率与途径提供了基础性计算方法。

Abstract: The persistence of beta-blockers like atenolol in aquatic environments necessitates efficient remediation strategies, such as enzymatic biodegradation. This study employs reactive molecular dynamics (rMD) simulations to investigate the initial degradation steps of atenolol by the oxidoreductase 9CL6 ammonia monooxygenase. Using the ReaxFF reactive forcefield within a simulated aqueous environment, the degradation processes were modeled at 300 K and 350 K over 6.5 nanoseconds. Results indicate initial degradation rates of 24% at 300 K and 18% at 350 K, with each enzyme molecule degrading approximately 20 atenolol molecules before reaching a saturation point. Mass spectrum analysis reveals the primary formation of C8 and C6 fragments at both temperatures. However, at 300 K, additional intermediate fragments (C1, C3, C11, C13) are observed, which are completely bypassed at the higher temperature of 350 K. Furthermore, increasing the temperature to 350 K accelerates the initial degradation phase from 2 ns to 0.5 ns, despite yielding a slightly lower overall degradation rate. Ultimately, these atomistic insights provide a foundational computational methodology for predicting biodegradation rates and pathways of pharmaceutical contaminants at the molecular scale.

</details>


### [422] [WILSON - a pathology foundation model framework for patient-level analysis and diagnostic text generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25123)
*Saghir Alfasly,Wataru Uegami,Sobhan Hemati,Wenchao Han,Xiaojia Tang,Kevin Thompson,Daniel Stone,Ghazal Alabtah,Saba Yasir,Michael R. Lucas,Eric W. Klee,Cheryl L. Willman,Judy C. Boughey,Matthew P. Goetz,Krishna R. Kalari,H. R. Tizhoosh*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: WILSON是一个视觉-语言基础模型，将全切片图像和多切片病例表示为单张多放大倍数合成图像，基于Mayo Clinic约189k张切片训练，无需任务特定训练即超越专用病例级模型，并提供高效检索与报告生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理学家整合跨放大倍数、跨切片的形态学信息进行诊断，而现有病理基础模型仅编码单张切片中的成千上万个图块并聚合其特征，缺乏与临床工作流对齐的病例级计算单元。

Method: 提出WILSON视觉-语言基础模型，以多放大倍数合成图像作为紧凑表示单元，同时表示全切片图像与多切片病例；使用病理报告作为监督信号，在Mayo Clinic约189k张切片（涵盖42个器官、829个诊断实体）上训练。

Result: 无需任务特定训练下，WILSON在所有内部队列上超过专用病例级模型（macro-F1 0.52 vs 0.38），并以低272–2155倍计算量匹配大至9.4倍的切片级模型；在508例三阴性乳腺癌端到端微调中，组织学亚型与间质肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞分级分别提升0.16和0.11 macro-F1；诊断文本检索recall@1达75.6%（PRISM为58.1%），生成描述在内部队列及多数外部比较中更接近报告参考。

Conclusion: 合成图像为病理学提供了一种紧凑、临床对齐的计算单元，验证了多放大倍数、多切片联合建模在病理基础模型中的有效性。

Abstract: Pathologists integrate morphology across magnifications and across the slides of a patient case, whereas pathology foundation models encode thousands of tiles from single slides and aggregate their features. Here we present WILSON, a vision--language foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as single multi-magnification composite images, trained on approximately 189k slides from Mayo Clinic spanning 42 organs and 829 diagnostic entities using pathology reports as supervision. Without task-specific training, WILSON exceeded a dedicated case-level model on all internal cohorts (macro-F1 0.52 versus 0.38) and matched slide-level models up to 9.4 times larger at 272- to 2,155-fold lower compute. End-to-end fine-tuning on 508 triple-negative breast cancer cases improved histologic subtyping and stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte grading by 0.16 and 0.11 macro-F1. WILSON retrieved matching diagnostic text at 75.6% recall@1 (PRISM, 58.1%) and generated captions closer to report-derived references than PRISM and PRISM2 on the internal cohort and on most external comparisons. Composite images thus offer a compact, clinically aligned computational unit for pathology.

</details>


### [423] [Uncertainty Quantification-Incorporated Ensemble Model for Personalized Prediction of Severe Radiotherapy-Induced Immunosuppression Among Esophageal Cancer Patients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25139)
*Baode Gao,Yan Chu,Zongsheng Hu,Madison E. Grayson,Peter S. N. van Rossum,Clemens Grassberger,Heiko Enderling,Harald Paganetti,Ibrahim Chamseddine,Steven H. Lin,Brian P. Hobbs,Radhe Mohan,Yiqing Chen*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 该研究构建了融合不确定性的集成机器学习模型预测食管癌放化疗患者的绝对淋巴细胞计数（ALC）最低值，并开发交叉残差共形预测（CRCP）量化个体预测不确定性，以辅助质子治疗选择及剂量优化决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重度放射性淋巴细胞减少（尤其4级，G4RIL）是食管癌同步放化疗患者常见的免疫毒性，且强烈预示生存不良。临床亟需可在治疗决策前预测ALC最低值、并量化个体预测不确定性的工具，以支持质子治疗选择与剂量分布优化。

Method: 纳入2001年7月至2022年4月接受光子或质子治疗的1,491例食管癌患者。基于基线临床特征与剂量学变量（含由剂量分布推导的复合剂量评分CDS）构建加权集成模型；开发交叉残差共形预测（CRCP）量化个体预测不确定性，并与标准共形预测方法对比评估。

Result: 质子治疗患者平均ALC最低值显著高于光子患者（0.33 vs 0.25 K/μL）。集成模型预测ALC最低值的平均绝对误差为0.0926 K/μL，G4RIL分类的ROC-AUC为0.78。基线ALC、计划靶体积（PTV）和CDS为最具影响力的预测因子。CRCP在保证数学覆盖率的条件下取得有竞争力的预测区间宽度，在区间宽度与覆盖准确性之间实现良好平衡。

Conclusion: 该框架支持放疗肿瘤学中风险感知的个体化临床决策，可为质子治疗选择与剂量优化提供量化依据。

Abstract: Severe radiation-induced lymphopenia (RIL), specifically Grade 4 RIL (G4RIL), is a frequent immune toxicity and a strong predictor of poor survival for esophageal cancer patients undergoing concurrent chemoradiation therapy. This study developed an uncertainty-incorporated ensemble machine learning model to predict Absolute Lymphocyte Count (ALC) nadir using baseline clinical and dosimetric variables, supporting treatment decisions such as proton therapy selection and dose distribution optimization. A cohort of 1,491 esophageal cancer patients treated with photon or proton therapy between July 2001 and April 2022 was analyzed. A weighted ensemble model was constructed using clinical features and dosimetric variables, including the composite dosimetric score (CDS) derived from radiation dose distributions. To quantify individual-level predictive uncertainty, Cross-Residual Conformal Prediction (CRCP) was developed and evaluated against standard conformal prediction methods. Proton therapy patients maintained a significantly higher mean ALC nadir than photon patients (0.33 vs. 0.25 K/uL). The ensemble model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.0926 K/uL for ALC nadir prediction and an ROC-AUC of 0.78 for G4RIL classification. Baseline ALC, Planning Target Volume, and CDS were the most influential predictors. CRCP achieved competitive prediction interval widths with mathematically guaranteed coverage, offering a favorable balance between interval width and coverage accuracy. This framework enables risk-aware, personalized clinical decision-making in radiation oncology.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [424] [Cloud, Edge, or Split? Profiling Onboard and Split Vision-Language Model Deployment for Drone AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25415)
*Zoha Azimi,Reza Farahani,Schahram Dustdar,Christian Timmerer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文以SmolVLM-256M为代表性轻量级VLM，对无人机上完全机载推理、云端推理与分割计算三种部署范式进行基准测试，量化其推理延迟、计算资源利用率、通信开销与能耗，发现在不同图像分辨率与网络条件下不存在普遍最优的部署策略，最优选择取决于网络条件与输入图像分辨率的交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM使无人机等边缘设备能借助自然语言指令理解视觉观测并推理复杂环境，但实际部署受限：机载推理受算力、内存与能耗约束，云端推理则带来通信延迟、带宽开销及对网络连接的依赖。分割计算虽被视为有前景的替代方案，但针对轻量级VLM，完全机载、云端与分割计算三种架构之间的性能权衡尚未被系统性地刻画。

Method: 以SmolVLM-256M为代表性轻量级VLM，对完全机载、云端及分割计算三种部署范式进行基准测试，在不同图像分辨率和网络条件下量化推理延迟、计算资源利用率、通信开销与能耗。

Result: 实验结果表明，不存在普遍最优的部署策略；最优策略取决于网络条件与输入图像分辨率之间的相互作用。

Conclusion: 面向无人机轻量级VLM部署，应根据网络条件与图像分辨率的组合动态选择机载、云端或分割计算策略，而非固定采用单一范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable edge devices like unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to interpret visual observations and reason about complex environments using natural-language instructions. However, their practical deployment remains challenging as onboard inference is constrained by limited computational, memory, and energy resources, whereas cloud-based inference introduces communication latency, bandwidth overhead, and dependence on network connectivity. To address these limitations, split computing offers a promising alternative by partitioning VLM inference between the resource-constrained UAVs and more capable remote servers. However, the performance trade-offs among fully onboard, cloud-based, and split-computing architectures for lightweight VLMs have not yet been systematically profiled. This paper benchmarks these three deployment paradigms using SmolVLM-256M as a representative lightweight VLM. We quantify their inference latency, computational resource utilization, communication overhead, and energy consumption across varying image resolutions and network conditions. Our results show that no deployment strategy is universally optimal; instead, the preferred strategy depends on the interaction between network conditions and input image resolution.

</details>


### [425] [WeightBridge: An Efficient Weight Transfer Library for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25442)
*Xuanlin Jiang,Samuel Hsia,Michael Kuchnik,Zachary DeVito,Minlan Yu,Carole-Jean Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 WeightBridge，一个面向 LLM 强化学习系统的灵活高效权重传输库，通过自动提取训练端与生成端的权重布局对应关系，规划并执行无冗余、负载均衡的权重传输，在多种配置下显著降低 GPU 停顿时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 LLM 强化学习系统中，权重传输（将更新后的参数从训练器传播到 rollout 生成器）正成为关键性能瓶颈。核心挑战在于：需在不牺牲效率的前提下，支持现代 RL 工作负载中多样化的训练端与生成端布局以及同步需求。现有方案仅在部分配置下高效，在其他配置下性能差或缺乏支持。

Method: WeightBridge 首先自动提取训练端与生成端权重布局之间的对应关系，随后规划并执行无冗余且负载均衡的权重传输。它对外暴露一个小而通用的 API，同时能够跨多种同步模式协调各 worker。

Result: 在涵盖不同模型、并行化布局与同步模式的多种配置下，WeightBridge 相较当前最先进的开源 RL 框架，将平均 GPU 停顿时间最多降低 42 倍，并在所有设置中均取得高性能。此外，一个编程智能体在无人工指导的情况下成功将 WeightBridge 集成到两个不同的 RL 框架中，验证了其 API 的通用性与易用性。

Conclusion: WeightBridge 通过自动化布局提取与无冗余、负载均衡的传输规划，解决了多样 RL 配置下权重传输的效率与通用性难题，并提供简洁通用 API，具备良好的通用性与易用性。

Abstract: Weight transfer - the propagation of updated parameters from trainers to rollout generators - is becoming an important performance bottleneck in reinforcement learning (RL) systems for LLMs. The central challenge is supporting the diverse trainer and rollout layouts and synchronization requirements of modern RL workloads without sacrificing efficiency. Existing solutions are efficient under some configurations but perform poorly or lack support under others. We present WeightBridge, a flexible, efficient weight-transfer library designed to deliver high performance across diverse RL configurations. WeightBridge first automatically extracts the correspondence between trainer and rollout weight layouts, then plans and executes redundancy-free and load-balanced weight transfer. It exposes a small, general API while coordinating workers across diverse synchronization modes. Across configurations spanning different models, parallelization layouts, and synchronization modes, WeightBridge reduces average GPU stall time by up to 42$\times$ over the state-of-the-art open-source RL framework and achieves high performance in all settings. A coding agent was able to integrate WeightBridge into two different RL frameworks without manual guidance, demonstrating the generality and ease of use of its APIs.

</details>


### [426] [Fast Recovery for LLM Serving via Decoupled Device Memory Lifetime in Dynamo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25451)
*Schwinn Saereesitthipitak,Mohammed Abdulwahhab,Hannah Zhang,Dan Feigin,Neelay Shah,Maksim Khadkevich,Itay Neeman,Vikram Sharma Mailthody,Wen-mei W. Hwu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向Dynamo的快速恢复机制：失败时不再重建引擎，而是通过快照与GPU内存共享直接恢复已初始化状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理副本需在紧密耦合GPU上连续运行数周，硬件/软件故障不可避免，且单worker故障会中断整个副本。传统恢复需重新初始化引擎，即使权重与编译产物已缓存也需数分钟，生产部署因此需过度配置服务容量来掩盖恢复窗口。作者认为主要成本是就绪服务容量的丧失而非请求进度，恢复应保留已初始化引擎状态。

Method: 基于对Dynamo集群18周故障的分析，发现多数故障是设备保留型（engine进程失败但GPU及其驻留分配仍完好）。据此提出GMS（GPU Memory Service），将设备内存所有权与引擎进程解耦，使独立引擎进程可复用同一GPU驻留状态并保持可变执行状态私有，从而在不拷贝的情况下共享与重连存活分配。GMS保留模型权重，并在替换引擎与Shadow Engine间只读共享，避免权重重载；同一GPU上第二个已初始化运行时将恢复简化为提升（promotion）。

Result: 在vLLM与SGLang上的四个模型中，上述机制可在7秒内恢复失败副本，比热重启快13-29倍，且每GPU仅用固定4-8 GiB设备内存，与模型大小无关。重放生产trace估计可挽回79%因恢复损失的GPU-hours。

Conclusion: 以保留而非重建已初始化引擎状态为原则的快速恢复，通过GMS共享GPU驻留状态，显著缩短恢复时间并可大幅减少容量损失。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference replicas run across tightly coupled GPUs and serve traffic continuously for weeks. Hardware and software failures are therefore inevitable, and one worker failure can disrupt an entire replica. Recovery requires reinitializing the engine, taking minutes even when weights and compilation artifacts are cached. Production deployments overprovision serving capacity to mask this window. We argue that the dominant cost is loss of ready serving capacity, not request progress, so recovery should preserve initialized engine state rather than reconstruct it. We present fast recovery for Dynamo based on this principle. Snapshots capture an initialized engine once and restore it instead of reinitializing it. Analysis of 18 weeks of failures from the Dynamo cluster shows that most failures are device-preserving: the engine process fails while the GPU and its resident allocations remain intact. Our key insight is that independent engine processes can reuse the same GPU-resident state while keeping mutable execution state private. The GPU Memory Service (GMS) decouples device-memory ownership from engine processes, enabling engines to share and reattach surviving allocations without copying them. GMS preserves model weights and shares them read-only between replacement and Shadow Engines, avoiding weight reloads. A second initialized runtime on the same GPUs reduces recovery to promotion. Across four models on vLLM and SGLang, these mechanisms recover a failed replica in under 7 seconds, 13-29 times faster than a warm restart, using a fixed 4-8 GiB of device memory per GPU independent of model size. Replaying the production trace, we estimate they would reclaim 79% of GPU-hours lost to recovery.

</details>


### [427] [Adaptive and Cost-Efficient Joint Scheduling of UAV Routes and Analytics with Transit-Borne Fog](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25479)
*Suman Raj,Arindam Khanda,Gagana M D,Yogesh Simmhan,Sajal K. Das*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出以按时刻表运行的公共巴士作为"移动雾节点"（mobile fog），为在农村大范围执行时限受限分析的无人机提供任务卸载通道：无人机在巴士停靠时移交数据，由巴士携带至其路线进入蜂窝覆盖区时再上传。作者将该问题建模为任务调度问题（Mission Scheduling Problem），联合优化无人机路径与每个分析任务在无人机边缘、固定雾节点或巴士上的放置，并提出"Divide and Assign (DA)"启发式算法选择仍满足任务截止时间的最廉价停靠点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在农村大范围场景中，无人机执行有截止时间约束的分析任务时，蜂窝基站稀疏导致无法可靠卸载负载，因此需要借助既有的公共交通基础设施来弥补通信覆盖缺口。

Method: 利用按固定路线与时刻表运行的公共巴士作为移动雾节点，实现无人机到巴士的交接并由巴士运送数据至蜂窝覆盖区。由于巴士遵循固定路线与时刻表，交接可行性取决于巴士下一次到达蜂窝区域的"地点"与"时间"，而非停靠点的距离。作者将问题形式化为 Mission Scheduling Problem，联合调度无人机路径与任务放置（无人机边缘、固定雾节点或巴士），满足截止时间、能耗与成本约束，并提出 Divide and Assign (DA) 启发式，选择仍能满足任务截止时间的最廉价停靠点。

Result: 在基于真实蜂窝与公交数据构建的农村地区36种负载配置下，DA相比最强启发式算法效用提升最高20%，相比最强适配的既有调度器提升最高41%，同时总成本最低。公交层可承担最多71%的卸载任务，将任务完成率提升至100%，并将充电周期减少最多31%。在存在交通波动时，自适应变体可挽回延迟所造成的93%效用损失，并保持97%以上的完成率。

Conclusion: 将公共巴士作为移动雾节点可有效弥补农村蜂窝覆盖稀疏的缺陷，在截止时间、能耗与成本约束下显著提升任务效用、完成率并降低充电开销，且对交通波动具有较强鲁棒性。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) performing deadline-bound analytics over large rural areas cannot reliably offload workloads to sparse cellular base stations. We propose an approach that uses scheduled public buses as \textit{mobile fogs}: a UAV hands off data to a bus during a halt, and the bus carries it until its route enters cellular coverage. Because a public bus follows a fixed route and timetable, a handover depends on \textit{where} and \textit{when} the bus next reaches a cellular zone, rather than how near the stop is. We formulate a Mission Scheduling Problem over this model, co-scheduling UAV routes with the placement of each analytics task on the UAV edge, a stationary fog, or a bus, under deadline, energy, and cost constraints. Our \textit{Divide and Assign} (DA) heuristic selects the cheapest halt that still meets a task's deadline. Across 36 workload configurations in a rural region, derived from real cellular and transit data, DA achieves up to 20\% higher utility than the strongest heuristic and up to 41\% higher utility than the strongest adapted-prior scheduler, while incurring the lowest aggregate cost. The transit tier handles up to 71\% of drop-offs, raises task completion to 100\%, and reduces recharging cycles by up to 31\%. Finally, in the presence of traffic variability, the adaptive variant recovers 93\% of the utility the delays cost and maintains completion rates above 97\%.

</details>


### [428] [Co-Fabric: Breaking Host-Domain Boundaries for Unified xPU Interconnection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25560)
*Zhen Peng,Jiaming Huang,Chaofan Chen,Zhao Zhang,An Wu,Baoyang Liu,Xinglong Wang,Tanlong Ci,Jinfeng Li,Xueke Duan,Hao Wang,Xi Chen,Shunshun Zhang,Zhiyuan Su,Zhu Cao,Zhichong Dou,Shaohua Wu,Lu Jing,Yue Yuan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-Fabric，一种突破主机域边界的总线式互联架构，面向大规模 xPU 扩展（scale-up）超级节点，实现统一寻址、纳秒级协议处理与跨域 P2P，在 64-xPU 3D-Mesh 系统上较 RoCE 显著降低延迟、提升带宽并加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型参数规模已超出单一 xPU 容量，需跨多个主机域的 xPU 协同，xPU 间通信成为系统效率瓶颈。现有 scale-up 互联不足：基于以太网的 RoCE 方案存在特定消息语义与协议栈开销，且依赖分散的逐主机寻址；传统基于主机的总线/互联则局限于单一主机域，缺乏跨主机统一寻址能力。

Method: Co-Fabric 采用总线式互联并打破主机域边界，包含三项设计：一是精简四层协议栈，实现纳秒级处理延迟并具备原生可靠性；二是跨域扩展与 P2P 机制，利用包头中嵌入的端口标识进行路由；三是基于影子设备自动枚举构建的统一地址空间。

Result: 在 64-xPU 3D-Mesh 系统上，Co-Fabric 相比 RoCE 将节点间通信延迟降低 50% 以上，带宽提升 2–5 倍，并使 DeepSeek R1 推理加速 30%–80%。此外，其精简四层协议栈与更高数据通信效率降低了协议与处理开销，使互联本身成本最多降低 80%、功耗最多降低 5%。

Conclusion: Co-Fabric 通过跨域统一寻址与精简协议栈，在延迟、带宽、推理性能以及成本功耗上均优于基于以太网的 RoCE，体现出面向 AI 计算中心的可扩展互联优势。

Abstract: Large-model parameters have grown beyond the capacity of a single xPU, dispersing across multiple xPUs spanning distinct host domains, where xPU-to-xPU communication dominates overall system efficiency. Existing scale-up interconnect remains inadequate: network-based solutions built on Ethernet--such as RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet)--introduce specific message-semantics and protocol-stack characteristics, and rely on fragmented per-host addressing, while conventional host-based fabrics are confined to a single host domain and lack cross-host unified addressing. This paper presents Co-Fabric, a bus-based interconnect that, unlike conventional bus designs, breaks host-domain boundaries to deliver unified xPU interconnection for scale-up superpods. Co-Fabric makes three contributions: a streamlined four-layer protocol stack achieving nanosecond-scale processing latency with native reliability; a cross-domain scaling and P2P mechanism that routes using port identifiers embedded in the packet header; and a unified address space built on shadow-device auto-enumeration. On a 64-xPU 3D-Mesh system, Co-Fabric cuts inter-node communication latency by over 50% and improves bandwidth by 2-5x over RoCE, accelerating DeepSeek R1 inference by 30%-80%. Moreover, since its streamlined four-layer protocol stack and higher data-communication efficiency reduce protocol and processing overhead relative to the Ethernet-based RoCE stack, Co-Fabric cuts the cost and power of the interconnect itself by up to 80% and 5%, respectively. These results demonstrate Co-Fabric's advantage for AI computing centers.

</details>


### [429] [Hydrozoan: Latency-Adaptive DAG Consensus under Mixed Byzantine and Crash Faults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25918)
*Qianyu Yu,Lefteris Kokoris-Kogias,Alberto Sonnino*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Hydrozoan 是首个在混合故障模型（f 个拜占庭 + c 个崩溃，n=3f+c+2p+1）下具备双提交路径的 DAG 共识协议，在至多 p 个故障时可两消息延迟提交，否则三消息延迟提交，且不增加消息、无需视图切换，支持多领导者；其变体 Optimal-Hydrozoan 首次达到已知下界，两协议安全性已在 Lean 4 中机器验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DAG 共识可实现高吞吐与 n=3f+1 下的三消息延迟最优极限；已有的两延迟协议要么牺牲韧性（如需要 5f+1 规模的委员会），要么依赖回退机制而丧失 DAG 的高吞吐。因此需要一种既保持 DAG 高吞吐、又能灵活实现两消息延迟且不牺牲韧性的协议。

Method: 提出 Hydrozoan：在 n=3f+c+2p+1 个验证者的混合故障模型下设计双提交路径 DAG 协议，每轮多领导者，两条路径在同一 DAG 上评估，并采用新颖的分级间接规则（graded indirect rule）协调两路径以保证所有诚实验证者达成一致决策；(f, c, p) 参数可将快速法定人数配置到部署所需的区域；若配置不当或超过 p 个故障，仍可在三消息延迟下提交，取先触发路径。另提出 Optimal-Hydrozoan，容忍快速路径多一个故障。安全性在 Lean 4 中机器验证。

Result: 在地理分布式条件下，哪条路径更快取决于地理而非协议本身，因为到达远程区域的轮次代价远高于不涉及远程的轮次。地理分布式评估显示：Hydrozoan 吞吐量与 Mysticeti 相当；当快速法定人数位于快速区域时提交快约 25%；当不满足或超过 p 个故障时回退到三消息延迟，而已有两延迟协议在此情况下会停滞。Optimal-Hydrozoan 首次匹配已知下界。

Conclusion: Hydrozoan 通过双提交路径与 (f, c, p) 可调参数，在不牺牲 DAG 高吞吐的前提下实现两消息延迟提交并保持回退能力，优于已有两延迟协议；Optimal-Hydrozoan 达到已知下界；两者安全性经 Lean 4 机器验证。

Abstract: DAG-based consensus protocols can achieve great throughput and the optimal three-message-delay limit for n = 3f+1 consensus. While two-delay protocols exist, they pay with reduced resilience (requiring 5f+1-style committees) or rely on fallbacks that sacrifice the DAG's high throughput. This paper introduces Hydrozoan, the first DAG protocol with a dual commit path under a hybrid fault model of f Byzantine and c crashed validators, on n = 3f+c+2p+1 validators. Leaders commit in two message delays whenever at most p validators are faulty, and in three otherwise, with no extra messages, no view changes, and multiple leaders per round. Both paths are evaluated on the same DAG, using a novel graded indirect rule to reconcile them so that every honest validator reaches the same decision. We show that under geo-distributed conditions, which path is faster is a property of geography rather than the protocol, as rounds reaching a remote region cost far more than those that do not. The (f, c, p) knobs place the fast quorum where the deployment requires it, allowing a commit in two message delays. If misconfigured, Hydrozoan can still commit in three message delays: Hydrozoan commits on whichever path fires first. We also present Optimal-Hydrozoan, a variant that tolerates one more fault on the fast path, the first construction to match the known lower bound. The safety and liveness of both protocols are machine-checked in Lean 4. Our geo-distributed evaluation shows that Hydrozoan matches Mysticeti's throughput, commits ~25% faster when the fast quorum fits fast regions, and falls back to three message delays when it does not or past p faults, where existing two-delay protocols stall.

</details>


### [430] [Distributed Near-Equitable Coloring in the LOCAL Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26190)
*Amit Nir,David Peleg*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究LOCAL模型下的近均衡染色：精确均衡（含加性失衡g）在环C_n上需Ω(n/g)轮（确定算法），而粗略均衡（乘性(1±η)）可在与直径无关的轮数内实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知均衡(Δ+1)染色算法沿生成结构聚合，代价随直径D增长。作者旨在区分"精确均衡"与"粗略均衡"的局部可解性，揭示精确平衡本质上需要全局信息。

Method: 在LOCAL模型下对环C_n进行确定性下界分析（identifier-universe阈值N=n+1、ruling-set锚点下界），构造twisted fiber products显式图族，并设计匹配的确定性算法。

Result: 环上精确自由3染色需Ω(n)轮，加性失衡g需Ω(n/g)轮（与O((n/g)log* n)算法匹配，差log* n因子）；实现稠密中间复杂度族Θ̃(n^α)。twisted fiber products上精确均衡(Δ+1)染色需Θ(D)轮，即对数直径有界度图上精确性即需直径时间。粗略均衡：环上常数乘性均衡为Θ(log* n)；一般图调色板Δ+1（Δ≤2^{√log n}/C）或(1+η)(Δ+1)（Δ≤n^{1-o(1)}）时，O(log n(loglog n)^2)轮内使各类大小在(1±η)平均内。

Conclusion: 精确均衡染色在确定LOCAL模型中本质上是全局问题，需Ω(n/g)或Θ(D)轮；而粗略乘性均衡可实现直径无关的局部算法，两者复杂度存在本质分野。

Abstract: For an $n$-vertex graph of maximum degree $Δ$, an equitable $(Δ+1)$-coloring is a proper coloring all of whose color classes have size $σ= n/(Δ+1)$ up to rounding. Known algorithms for relaxations of this target aggregate along a spanning structure, at cost scaling with the diameter $D$. We study near-equitable coloring in the LOCAL model and prove that, for deterministic algorithms, exact balance is inherently global: already on the cycle $C_n$, exact balanced free $3$-coloring requires $Ω(n)$ rounds. More generally, additive imbalance $g$ requires $Ω(n/g)$ rounds, matching a deterministic $O((n/g)\log^* n)$-round algorithm up to the $\log^* n$ factor, and these problems realize a dense family of intermediate deterministic LOCAL complexities $\tildeΘ(n^α)$, $α\in (0,1)$, on cycles. The exact bound is sharp in two further senses: the identifier-universe threshold is exactly $N=n+1$, and the $\log^* n$ gap cannot be closed via faster ruling-set anchors. The bound then extends to twisted fiber products, an explicit family realizing, for every $Δ\ge 3$, every diameter scale from the Moore bound $Θ(\log n/\logΔ)$ up to $Θ(n/Δ)$. Exact equitable $(Δ+1)$-coloring requires $Θ(D)$ rounds deterministically on this family, so exactness costs diameter time already on bounded-degree graphs of logarithmic diameter.
  In contrast, coarse balance admits local algorithms. On cycles, constant multiplicative equity costs $Θ(\log^* n)$ rounds. On general graphs with large color classes, all class sizes can be kept within $(1\pmη)$ times the average in time independent of the diameter: with palette exactly $Δ+1$ for $Δ\le 2^{\sqrt{\log n}/C}$, and with palette $(1+η)(Δ+1)$ for every $Δ\le n^{1-o(1)}$, the latter in $O(\log n\,(\log\log n)^2)$ rounds.

</details>


### [431] [PatchKV: Efficient KV Cache Recovery for Dynamically Edited LLM Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26219)
*Guotao Yang,Rui Guo,Siwei He,Sheng Chen,Yitao Hu,Keqiu Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 PatchKV，一种面向后缀保留式上下文修订的 KV 缓存恢复系统，通过预测脏区域并块级修复，减少后缀重算与陈旧状态传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时运行的 LLM 智能体常修改中间上下文而保留长后缀。后缀 token 虽未变，但因果历史与 RoPE 位置改变使其卸载的 KV 状态无法精确复用：全量重算浪费 prefill，随意复用会传播陈旧状态，全精度恢复又增加数据搬运。

Method: 将相邻上下文版本分解为精确前缀、更新片段与对齐后缀；用离线长度条件漂移模型预测编辑局部脏区域，并结合从存储注意力中选取的稀疏非局部块，将两者块对齐合并为固定修复集；其余后缀块经 CPU 内存恢复，采用冻结的逐块精度标签及融合的去量化、RoPE 校正与 KV 页放置路径。

Result: 在三种模型与三个长上下文问答任务上，平均恢复首 token 时间较全后缀重算加速 2.51–3.85 倍，较 CacheBlend 加速 1.26–2.06 倍；F1 在九个设置中的六个持平或超过 CacheBlend，其余相差不超过 1.36 分。

Conclusion: PatchKV 以后缀保留式修订为切入，结合脏区域预测与块级精度恢复，在保持或提升 QA 质量的同时显著降低长上下文 resume 的 TTFT，验证了"局部修复 + 稀疏非局部补偿"路径的有效性。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agent workflows often revise interior context spans while retaining long suffixes. Although suffix tokens remain unchanged, altered causal histories and rotary positions prevent exact reuse of their offloaded key-value (KV) states. Full suffix recomputation wastes prefill work, while indiscriminate reuse propagates stale states and full-precision restoration adds data movement. We present PatchKV, a profile-guided recovery system for suffix-preserving revisions. PatchKV decomposes adjacent context versions into an exact prefix, an updated span, and an aligned suffix. It predicts an edit-local dirty region using an offline length-conditioned drift model, augments this region with sparse nonlocal blocks selected from stored attention, and block-rounds their union into a fixed repair set. The remaining suffix blocks are restored from CPU memory using frozen per-block precision tags and a fused path for dequantization, RoPE correction, and KV-page placement. Across three models and three long-context question-answering workloads, PatchKV achieves a $2.51$-$3.85\times$ speedup in mean resume time-to-first-token over full suffix recomputation and a $1.26$-$2.06\times$ speedup over CacheBlend, while matching or exceeding CacheBlend's F1 score in six of nine settings and remaining within 1.36 points in the others.

</details>


### [432] [DHSched: Stateless Control for Stateful Real-Time Avatar Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26363)
*Xin Wang,Haitong Zhang,Xianghong Li,Shumin Lin,Xianzheng Song,Lin Wang,Zhenyu Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DHSched：一种无状态对等调度控制平面，通过(WorkerID, epoch)世代外部化会话所有权，在生产数字人服务中实现9,927次会话迁移零双主冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时数字人服务运行长生命周期的GPU会话，将连续文本流转换为语音、面部运动、渲染视频与RTC媒体。弹性伸缩需在Worker间反复重分配会话，但重分配更新共享放置状态时，旧GPU运行时与RTC连接仍然存活，导致控制平面分配与执行权威之间出现空隙；有状态控制器通过保留每会话权威来串行化所有权，却把该状态置于控制器的扩缩容与故障转移路径上，成为瓶颈与风险点。

Method: DHSched以无状态对等Dispatch副本管理长生命周期有状态会话：将会话所有权外部化为由(WorkerID, epoch)标识的世代；Dispatch按条件提交每个世代；Infer-Controller在释放推进状态的输入前先声明并重新校验同一世代，使陈旧运行时即使仍存活也失去执行权威。候选排序基于周期性刷新的负载视图，容量准入保持权威；恢复过程通过源epoch守卫与源无关重建推进同一世代路径。

Result: 在生产数字人服务栈中实现49,987并发在线会话；2026年6月10日完成9,927次会话迁移，未观察到双主冲突或容量超配。生产峰值下CreateLive延迟P99为98.3 ms，PushText延迟P99为16.5 ms。在100,000次随机化所有权运行中，分配时刻协议、仅声明协议与仅WorkerID协议均允许陈旧执行，而DHSched未记录到双主或陈旧世代释放。

Conclusion: 通过将所有权外部化为条件提交的世代并由执行侧重新校验，可在无状态控制平面上安全实现有状态长会话的弹性重分配，消除陈旧执行与双主冲突，同时避免把会话权威放入控制器的扩缩容与故障转移路径。

Abstract: Real-time avatar services run long-lived, GPU-backed sessions that transform a continuous text stream into speech, facial motion, rendered video, and RTC media. Elastic operation repeatedly reassigns these sessions across Workers. A reassignment updates shared placement state while the previous GPU runtime and RTC connection remain alive, opening a gap between control-plane assignment and execution authority. A stateful controller serializes ownership by retaining per-session authority, placing that state on the controller's scaling and failover path.
  We present DHSched, a control plane that manages long-lived stateful sessions through stateless peer Dispatch replicas. DHSched externalizes session ownership as a generation identified by (WorkerID, epoch). Dispatch conditionally commits each generation. Infer-Controller claims and revalidates the same generation before releasing state-advancing input. A stale runtime loses execution authority even if it remains alive. DHSched ranks candidates from periodically refreshed load views while keeping capacity admission authoritative. Recovery advances the same generation path via source-epoch guards and source-independent reconstruction.
  DHSched runs in our production avatar-serving stack, which reached 49,987 concurrent live sessions. On 10 June 2026, it completed 9,927 session migrations with no observed dual-owner conflicts or capacity overshoots. At the production peak, CreateLive latency was 98.3 ms at P99 and PushText latency was 16.5 ms at P99. Across 100,000 randomized ownership runs, assignment-time, claim-only, and WorkerID-only protocols permit stale execution, while DHSched records no dual-owner or stale-generation release.

</details>


### [433] [Don't let your Memory defy you: Fragmentation-Aware Serverless Allocation with Elastic Memory Locality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26476)
*Achilleas Tzenetopoulos,Dimosthenis Masouros,Sotirios Xydis,Francky Catthoor,Dimitrios Soudris*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 Memoryless，一个碎片感知的无服务器资源管理器，将内存局部性作为控制面原语，通过联合选择与放置不同计算分配和内存局部性比例的实例变体来匹配碎片化节点容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无服务器平台通常采用内存为中心的绑定配置，CPU 随内存等比分配，导致资源浪费；资源解耦虽减少浪费，却因 CPU-内存形态多样而产生外部碎片，使残余容量分散困置于各节点。内存解聚与分层可将这些资源空洞转化为可用容量，但需要能够弹性调节内存局部性的调度机制。

Method: Memoryless 联合选择与放置函数变体，各变体在计算分配与内存局部性比例（本地/远程内存混合）上不同，从而将实例形态与碎片化节点容量相匹配，同时维持 SLO。系统在 Knative 之上实现，并采用 trace 驱动的工作负载进行评估。

Result: 相比最先进的无服务器放置框架，Memoryless 在稳态下将节点使用量降低最多 40%，峰值下降低 46%，SLO 违规保持在 3% 以内；同时将 CPU 困置减少 44%。

Conclusion: 弹性内存局部性可将碎片化节点容量转化为可用资源，Memoryless 证明了在无服务器控制面中暴露内存局部性并联合优化选择与放置，能有效缓解外部碎片并提升资源效率。

Abstract: Serverless platforms commonly rely on bundled, memory-centric configurations, where CPU capacity follows the specified memory size. Resource decoupling reduces this waste, but can create external fragmentation by producing diverse CPU-memory shapes that leave residual capacity stranded across nodes. Memory disaggregation and tiering can turn these resource holes into usable capacity by enabling elastic memory locality, where instances use different mixes of local and remote memory. In this paper, we present Memoryless, a fragmentation-aware resource manager that exposes memory locality as a serverless control-plane primitive. Memoryless jointly selects and places function variants that differ in their compute allocation and memory-locality ratio. This allows the scheduler to match instance shapes to fragmented node capacity while preserving SLOs. We implement Memoryless on top of Knative and evaluate it with trace-driven workloads. Compared to state-of-the-art serverless placement frameworks, Memoryless reduces node usage by up to 40% in steady state and 46% at peak, while keeping SLO violations within 3%. It also reduces CPU stranding by 44%, showing that elastic memory locality can convert fragmented node capacity into usable resources.

</details>


### [434] [A Configurable Heuristic for the MLCS Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26602)
*Farhana Akter Tumpa,Rebin Silva Valan Arasu,Rajiv Gupta*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ARP启发式算法求解NP-hard的多序列最长公共子序列(MLCS)问题，通过Adding-Δs、Replacing-Subsequences和字符优先化三种操作，在合成与生物序列上实现质量-运行时间可调，兼顾速度与解质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLCS问题是序列分析中的NP-hard问题。现有基于动态规划或MLCS-DAG剪枝的精确算法随序列长度和集合规模增长而内存迅速耗尽；启发式方法牺牲解质量，超启发式方法则需大量参数调优。

Method: 提出ARP启发式算法：针对给定主序列执行三类操作——(i) Adding-Δs，通过逐步添加主序列的子序列Δ增量构建解；(ii) Replacing-Subsequences，通过有针对性地替换所有解共有的子序列以增强解集多样性；(iii) 对主序列中可能共同出现在更长公共子序列中的字符组进行优先化。用户可配置替换与优先化操作的程度以实现质量-运行时间权衡。

Result: 在合成和生物序列集上的实证评估表明，ARP最快的配置AOnly找到的公共子序列显著长于经典启发式BNMAS；其激进配置的解质量可与最先进的超启发式UB-HH相媲美，同时运行速度快1.1×-1.7×。

Conclusion: ARP通过可配置的启发式操作在MLCS问题上实现了优于经典启发式、接近最先进超启发式的解质量，并具备更快的运行速度，提供了灵活的质量-运行时间权衡。

Abstract: Motivation: The Multiple Longest Common Subsequence (MLCS) problem for an arbitrary number of sequences is an NP-hard problem in sequence analysis. Existing exact algorithms based on dynamic programming or MLCS-DAG pruning rapidly exhaust memory as sequence lengths and set sizes grow, while heuristic and hyper-heuristic approaches compromise solution quality and require heavy parameter tuning, respectively. Results: This paper presents the ARP heuristic that, for a given primary sequence, performs three key actions: (i) Adding-$Δ$s, which incrementally builds a solution by adding subsequences, called $Δ$s, of the primary sequence to an initial solution; (ii) Replacing-Subsequences, which enhances the diversity of the solution set via targeted replacement of subsequences common to all solutions; and (iii) Prioritizing groups of characters from the primary sequence that are likely to appear together in longer common subsequences. ARP allows the user to configure the degree of Replacements and Prioritization actions for carrying out quality-runtime tradeoff. Empirical evaluations on both synthetic and biological sequence sets demonstrate that ARP's fastest configuration AOnly finds significantly longer common subsequences than the BNMAS classical heuristic and its aggressive configuration attains solution quality comparable to state-of-the-art hyper-heuristic (UB-HH) while running 1.1$\times$-1.7$\times$ faster.

</details>


### [435] [Seeking Cost-Optimal Infrastructure Size for Distributed Filesystems: A Ceph Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26616)
*Niccolo Tosato,Isac Pasianotto,Ruggero Lot,Stefano Cozzini*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Linux热插拔接口和Cgroups的实证方法，通过可控地调整CPU核数、内存容量和磁盘带宽，定量评估硬件配置对Ceph分布式文件系统I/O性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式文件系统（DFS）是现代计算环境的关键组件，其性能至关重要，但仅凭存储系统硬件难以预测DFS的I/O性能，缺乏对硬件配置选择如何影响性能的定量认识。

Method: 以Ceph为案例，考察三类硬件参数：CPU核数、内存容量和磁盘带宽；利用Linux热插拔接口与Cgroups控制这些变量，避免引入额外软件开销，从而在可控条件下测量硬件配置对DFS性能的影响。

Result: 结果表明，在所分析的工作负载下，硬件资源的减少并不总是带来成比例的性能损失。

Conclusion: 该方法为设计高性价比的分布式存储系统提供了实用见解，且具有足够的通用性，可推广应用于其他文件系统。

Abstract: Distributed Filesystems (DFS) are a crucial component of modern computing environments, and their performance is critical to the success of all the facilities that rely on them. However, predicting the DFS I/O performance solely based on the storage system hardware is not trivial. In this paper, we address this challenge by presenting an empirical method that tries to quantitatively assess how hardware configuration choices influence the performance of a DFS using Ceph as a case study. We investigate the influence of three hardware parameters-number of CPU cores, amount of RAM, and disk bandwidth. To control these variables, we relied on the Linux hotplug interface and Cgroups, avoiding additional software overhead. Our results reveal that for the analyzed workloads, decreasing hardware resources does not always yield proportional performance losses. This method offers practical insights for designing cost-effective distributed storage systems, remaining general enough to be applied to other filesystems.

</details>

### [436] [A theory of plasticity: capacity for change as inverse configurational constraint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25312)
*Igor Branchi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出"可塑性"应被理解为一种前瞻性属性，即"反向构型约束"：系统当前构型对向替代状态位移的约束越弱，可塑性越强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学文献普遍用系统发生的变化来推断可塑性，但这一推理存在循环：有多个替代状态却未实现者仍可能具备可塑性，而位移幅度大也不能确立可塑性。真正决定可塑性的是当前构型对替代状态的约束强度，而非位移距离，因此需要一个前瞻性的操作性定义。

Method: 将可塑性定义为"反向构型约束"，即在给定的表征框架内，系统现时构型对向替代状态位移的约束程度的倒数。分析限定于共享功能划分、结构表征与归一化架构的系统；在固定可达性判据下考察可达状态集合的变化；在**结构表征**中，将聚合耦合识别为构型约束，其倒数即为可塑性。

Result: 对于共享功能划分、结构表征与归一化架构的系统，提高可塑性会降低当前状态与替代状态之间所有正的有限**结构壁垒**；在固定可达性判据下，可达状态库（repertoire）只能扩张而不能收缩。壁垒降低与状态库嵌套是可塑性定义的结果而非组成部分。

Conclusion: 该定义将两大研究传统衔接起来：一是量化连接性但不将其解释为可塑性，二是将可塑性视为变化能力却缺乏前瞻性操作测度。可塑性由此获得可测量、可比较的表述，并使其结构后果（壁垒降低、状态库嵌套）从定义中自然导出。

Abstract: Plasticity is invoked across the sciences to explain how systems can change, yet it is inferred from the very change it is meant to explain. A system may have many alternatives, realize none and still be plastic. Another may be driven far toward its only alternative, but the magnitude of that change does not establish its plasticity. What matters for plasticity is not how far the system moves but how strongly its present configuration constrains alternatives. Here I propose that plasticity, understood as a prospective property, is inverse configurational constraint: a system is plastic to the extent that its present configuration weakly constrains displacement toward alternatives within a declared representation. For systems sharing a functional partition, structural representation, and normalized architecture, increasing plasticity lowers every positive finite structural barrier separating the current state from its alternatives. With a fixed accessibility criterion, the accessible repertoire can expand but cannot shrink. In network representations, aggregate coupling is identified as configurational constraint, whose inverse defines plasticity. Barrier reduction and repertoire nesting are consequences, not components, of the definition. This connects two research traditions: quantifying connectivity without interpreting it as plasticity, and treating plasticity as a capacity for change without a prospective operational measure.

</details>


### [437] [Physics-constrained inference of somatic dynamics from dendritic recordings with sparse somatic supervision in weakly coupled two-compartment neuron model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25436)
*Abdeltif Oujbara,Benjamin Ambrosio,M. A. Aziz-Alaoui*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该文提出一种受两房室Hodgkin-Huxley模型约束的物理信息神经网络(PINN)，利用密集树突电压记录、已知注入电流及少量(<5%)胞体电压样本，重建胞体膜电位轨迹并同时校正部分胞体最大电导，并将其与无迹卡尔曼滤波进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胞体膜电位是神经元输出的主要决定因素，但在许多实验设置中难以直接测量，只能获取树突记录。当胞体与树突耦合较弱时，树突信号是胞体活动的滤波与衰减版本，从远端测量重建胞体动力学是一个具有挑战性的逆问题。

Method: 采用受两房室 Hodgkin-Huxley 模型约束的物理信息神经网络(PINN)。训练数据为密集树突电压记录、已知注入电流以及至多占时间点 5% 的少量胞体电压样本；网络在重建完整胞体轨迹的同时调整一组选定的胞体最大电导。在四种刺激方案的合成数据上评估重建效果，并与使用同一模型和相同观测的无迹卡尔曼滤波(UKF)进行比较，同时考察对测量噪声和随机初始化的鲁棒性。

Result: 不使用胞体样本时，该公式给出的轨迹平滑、动作电位缺失且阈下水平有偏，RMSE 为 10–14 mV；仅用 1% 的胞体时间点即可恢复全部脉冲；5% 时 RMSE 降至约 2 mV(含脉冲)，钠电导与延迟整流电导的相对误差低于 0.1%。

Conclusion: 重建依赖树突记录之外的稀疏胞体锚定。结果界定了在合成、弱监督的两房室设定下可推断的信息范围，并明确了本公式所需的胞体信息量。

Abstract: Somatic membrane potential is the primary determinant of neuronal output, yet it remains inaccessible in many experimental setups where only dendritic recordings are available. Reconstructing somatic dynamics from distal measurements is a challenging inverse problem, particularly when the soma and dendrites are weakly coupled, as dendritic signals represent a filtered and attenuated version of somatic activity. To address this, we use a physics-informed neural network (PINN) constrained by a two-compartment Hodgkin--Huxley model. The network is trained on dense dendritic voltage recordings and the known injected current, complemented by a small number of somatic voltage samples (at most 5\% of the time points), and it reconstructs the full somatic trajectory while adjusting a selected set of somatic maximal conductances. On synthetic data from four stimulation protocols, we quantify how the reconstruction depends on the amount of somatic supervision. Without somatic samples, the present formulation returns a smooth trajectory in which the action potentials are absent and the subthreshold level is biased, with a root-mean-square error of 10--14~mV; 1\% of the somatic time points is enough to recover every spike; and 5\% brings the root-mean-square error to about 2~mV, spikes included, with relative errors below 0.1\% on the sodium and delayed-rectifier conductances. We also compare the PINN with an unscented Kalman filter constrained by the same model and assimilating the same observations, and we assess robustness to measurement noise and to random initialization. The reconstructions reported here therefore rely on sparse somatic anchoring in addition to the dendritic recordings. The results delimit what can be inferred in this synthetic, weakly supervised two-compartment setting and identify the amount of somatic information required by the present formulation.

</details>


### [438] [Deep Learning in Infant Functional Neuroimaging: Challenges, Advances, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26688)
*Dan Hu,Jiale Cheng,Weiran Xia,Kangfu Han,Matthew Wu,Li Wang,Weili Lin,Gang Li*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了深度学习在婴儿功能磁共振成像中的应用进展，涵盖输入表征、群体与个体脑图谱、纵向轨迹预测、稳健可解释评估及生物学转化，标志着该领域从描述性群体分析转向可靠、个体化、具发育基础的计算模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿期是脑功能网络快速重组与个体化连接组特征形成的关键窗口，早期偏差可能影响长期认知与临床结局。fMRI 为在体研究提供了机会，但受扫描时长较短、结构化运动伪影、扫描状态多变及脑快速成熟等因素制约，如何从中提取具发育意义的信息仍是难点。深度学习的表征学习能力为应对高维噪声数据、融合时空信息、刻画非线性快速演变的大脑组织提供了新途径，因此有必要系统综述其最新进展。

Method: 这是一篇方法学综述，未提出新模型或开展实验。作者按方法学维度进行归纳与综合，具体包括：输入表征的构造与格式化、群体水平与个体化脑映射、纵向发育轨迹预测、稳健且可解释的模型评估，以及向生物学机制与临床意义的转化。

Result: 综述指出，深度学习已扩展了计算神经影像的能力，可从噪声大、维度高的婴儿 fMRI 数据中学习稳健表征，整合复杂的空间与时间信息，并刻画发育中大脑的非线性、快速演变的组织模式；上述方法学进展共同推动了领域的范式转变。

Conclusion: 该领域正由描述性、群体水平的分析转向可靠、个体化且具发育基础的计算模型。未来取决于更大规模、更多样化的纵向数据集，符合发育特点的模型设计，严格且标准化的评估，以及将计算预测与生物学机制整合以服务于具有临床意义的结果，从而支持对神经发育风险的更早期、更精准评估。

Abstract: Infancy is a critical developmental window characterized by rapid functional brain reorganization, during which large-scale networks emerge, individualized connectome signatures continue to form, and early deviations may shape long-term cognitive and clinical outcomes. Functional MRI (fMRI) offers an opportunity to study these processes in vivo, yet extracting developmentally meaningful information from it remains challenging due to comparatively short scan duration, structured motion artifacts, variable scan states, and rapid brain maturation. Amid these challenges, deep learning has expanded the capacity of computational neuroimaging by learning robust representations from noisy, high-dimensional data, integrating complex spatial and temporal information, and capturing the nonlinear and rapidly evolving organization of the developing brain. Here, we review recent advances in deep learning for infant functional neuroimaging, synthesizing progress across input representation formatting, population and individualized brain mapping, longitudinal trajectory forecasting, robust and explainable model evaluation, and biological translation. Collectively, these methodological advances mark a paradigm shift in infant functional neuroimaging from descriptive, group-level analyses toward reliable, individualized, and developmentally grounded models. Future progress will depend on larger and more diverse longitudinal datasets, developmentally appropriate model designs, rigorous and standardized evaluation, and integration of computational predictions with biological mechanisms towards clinically meaningful outcomes. Addressing these priorities will help establish deep learning as a robust framework for understanding early functional brain development, identifying developmental variation at the individual level, and ultimately supporting earlier and precise assessment of neurodevelopmental risk.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [439] [Towards Adaptive Interaction Strategies for Human Companion Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25031)
*Cong-Thanh Vu,Yen-Chen Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于深度强化学习(DRL)的人机伴随策略,使移动机器人能根据环境与人类状态动态调整跟踪位置,不受固定方位约束。结合MPPI控制与控制障碍函数(CBF)构建伴随控制器,保证位置与朝向跟踪、避障及安全性。真实室内外实验中成功率与跟踪精度分别提升至少24%和47%,可在1.7 m/s行走速度下柔性伴随并尊重人类亲密空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机交互中,机器人在真实环境下灵活伴随人类具有广泛潜力但挑战显著。传统方法将机器人限制在相对人的固定位置(后随、前导或并排),难以适应动态工作空间,限制了机器人的灵活性与适应性。

Method: 1) 采用深度强化学习(DRL)构建人机伴随策略,使机器人动态调整跟踪位置;2) 定义"交互空间"刻画人与机器人及环境的关系,并作为DRL状态空间的基础,以支持环境适应;3) 集成模型预测路径积分(MPPI)控制与控制障碍函数(CBF),构建人机伴随控制器,在位置与朝向上精确跟随目标,同时实现避障并提升社会接受度与安全性。

Result: 在真实室内外场景中进行评估并与已有研究对比:所提方法将成功率与跟踪精度分别提升至少24%和47%,并改善了人类舒适度;实验显示机器人可在人行走速度达1.7 m/s时灵活伴随,动态调整策略而不局限于固定位置,且能尊重人的亲密空间,兼顾安全、舒适与有效避障。

Conclusion: 将DRL与MPPI-CBF控制相结合、并以交互空间作为状态表示的伴随策略,能够突破固定方位限制,在真实动态环境中实现灵活、安全、社会可接受的人机伴随,性能优于现有方法。

Abstract: In the field of Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), achieving flexibility in human-accompanying within real-world environments holds great potential for various applications but also poses significant challenges. Traditional methods typically restrict robots to fixed positions relative to humans, such as tracking from behind, in front, or side-by-side, which limits robot adaptability in dynamic workspaces. This study introduces a novel human-companioning strategy that uses Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to enable mobile robots to dynamically adjust their tracking positions according to varying conditions. An interaction space is defined to capture the relationship between the human and the robot while considering the environment, which serves as the basis for state spaces in DRL to assist the robot in adapting to environmental changes. A human-robot companion controller is developed by integrating Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with Control Barrier Functions (CBF), ensuring that the robot accurately follows the target's movement in both position and orientation while avoiding obstacles and enhancing social acceptance and safety. The proposed approach is evaluated in real-world scenarios, both indoors and outdoors, and compared with other studies. The results show that the proposed method improves the success rate and tracking accuracy by at least 24% and 47%, respectively, while enhancing human comfort. Experiments demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly accompany a person walking at speeds of up to 1.7 m/s, dynamically adjusting its strategy without being confined to a fixed position. Additionally, the robot respects the human's intimate space to ensure safety, comfort, and effective obstacle avoidance.

</details>


### [440] [Cosserat Modeling of Trimmed Helicoid Soft Arms with a Separated-Section Constitutive Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25264)
*Zhihang Qin,Linxin Hou,Zeyu Zhong,Yuchen Sun,Wenci Xin,Yueheng Zhang,Ji Qi,Jie Wang,Muhammad Sunny Nazeer,Yu Jun Tan,Federico Renda,Cecilia Laschi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对修剪螺旋臂中螺旋域分离、仅通过稀疏融合交叉点连接的特点，提出分离截面本构律与稀疏融合力学，构建强各向异性有效截面刚度，并嵌入几何精确动态Cosserat模型，实现高精度、快速求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Cosserat杆模型假设截面刚度可由同一截面上材料属性叠加得到，但对于修剪螺旋臂，承载螺旋域彼此分离、仅通过稀疏融合交叉点连接，该假设不再准确，需要新的本构描述来刻画其真实力学行为。

Method: 提出分离截面本构律：在每个螺旋域的局部坐标系中求其本构响应，再回拉到主干，得到有效主干刚度；用稀疏融合力学刻画相邻域相对运动带来的附加柔度，确定弯曲、扭转、拉伸的通道缩减曲线η_c(s/L)。将所得有效截面刚度嵌入几何精确动态Cosserat模型，采用GVS离散与布管肌腱驱动。

Result: 有效截面刚度呈强各向异性：弯曲与拉伸下降约一个数量级，扭转接近有效主干刚度。在103组实测构型上，三个数据集的归一化位置误差分别为7.7%、6.7%、7.8%；单次全臂求解在单CPU核心（Intel Xeon, Cascade Lake, 2.8 GHz）上约需0.3 s。

Conclusion: 该截面本构律与Cosserat建模框架能准确、高效地预测修剪螺旋软体臂的力学与运动，支持基于模型的快速规划、状态与载荷估计，以及面向结构化软体机器人的形态—控制协同设计。

Abstract: Cosserat rod models for soft robots usually construct sectional stiffness by summing material properties over a common cross-section. This assumption becomes inaccurate for trimmed helicoid arms, where load-bearing helix domains are separated and connected only through sparse fused crossings. This paper formulates a separated-section constitutive law that evaluates each helix domain in its local frame and pulls its constitutive response back to the backbone, yielding an effective backbone stiffness. Sparse-fusion mechanics captures the additional compliance caused by relative motion between neighboring domains and determines channel-wise reduction profiles $η_c(s/L)$ for bending, torsion, and extension. The resulting effective sectional stiffness is strongly anisotropic: bending and extension are reduced by about one order of magnitude, whereas torsion remains close to the effective backbone stiffness. The resulting sectional law is embedded in a geometrically exact dynamic Cosserat model with GVS discretization and routed-tendon actuation. Across 103 measured configurations, the three datasets give pooled normalized position errors of \SI{7.7}{\percent}, \SI{6.7}{\percent}, and \SI{7.8}{\percent}, while each full-arm solve requires approximately \SI{0.3}{s} on one CPU core (Intel Xeon, Cascade Lake, \SI{2.8}{GHz}), enabling rapid model-based planning, state and load estimation, and morphology--control co-design for architected soft robots.

</details>


### [441] [Beyond the Flat Seafloor: A Closed-Form Two-View Constraint to Aid Sidescan Sonar Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25271)
*Kalin Norman,Joshua G. Mangelson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将多视图几何引入侧扫声呐，形式化了两视图几何约束，证明共享特征被约束于球面与平面交线（圆）上，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真刻画歧义轨迹长度的影响因素，给出测量规划建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 侧扫声呐仅提供一维斜距测量，现有方法多依赖平坦海底等粗略假设，很少利用或构建传感器的几何投影模型，导致定位与匹配精度受限。

Method: 基于多视图几何的方法，推导并形式化两视图几何约束，证明共享特征位于球面与平面相交的轨迹上；结合真实孔径与安装几何（水面船与水下航行器），以蒙特卡洛仿真分析歧义轨迹长度的决定因素，并仿真两类平台的相对运动轨迹。

Result: 歧义轨迹长度主要由高程失配决定，在约20°的中等斜交角处达到峰值；在近于平行与反平行的航迹下轨迹长度最小。

Conclusion: 该几何约束框架和轨迹仿真为侧扫声呐的测量规划提供了具体指导，可通过选择航迹几何与高程配置来抑制特征定位歧义。

Abstract: Sidescan sonar is a common sensor for both manned and autonomous marine exploration and mapping, yet very few methods build upon or exploit the geometric projection model of the sensor. As sidescan sonar is limited to a 1D range measurement, many approximations are frequently used, including the long-standing assumption of a flat seafloor. Rather than make similar approximations, this paper focuses on a multi-view geometry based approach and formalizes a two-view geometric constraint and proves that a shared feature is constrained to a locus within the intersection of a sphere and a plane. In addition, we characterize what governs the size of the ambiguity locus through Monte Carlo simulation that is grounded in real aperture and mounting geometry for both a surface vessel and an underwater vehicle. We translate additional simulations of relative trajectories for both vehicle platforms into concrete survey-planning guidance. Our results show that locus length is strongly governed by elevation misalignment, and peaks at a moderate oblique crossing angle of approximately 20 degrees, with minimal locus lengths obtained at near parallel and anti-parallel passes.

</details>


### [442] [Learning to Plan in Human-Robot Collaboration: Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25274)
*Afagh Mehri Shervedani,Siyu Li,Natawut Monaikul,Bahareh Abbasi,Barbara Di Eugenio,Miloš Žefran*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的机器人多模态交互策略自动生成方法，用于辅助老年人与残障人士完成家庭环境中的物体定位任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向老年人和残障人士的机器人助手需要与用户有效协作，其核心是交互管理器，负责观察评估任务、推断人类状态与意图以选择最佳动作。由于该领域数据稀疏，多模态系统策略通常依赖人工设计，而随着交互复杂度提升，手工设计难以扩展。

Method: 提出基于强化学习（RL）的方法自动生成机器人多模态策略。系统聚焦于机器人在家庭环境中辅助用户定位物体的真实场景，管理语言与物理动作等多模态信号以选择最优动作。与传统对话系统不同，该智能体使用包含人类数据的模拟器训练，可处理多种模态。采用简单的高层奖励函数，无需微调，并设置若干前置条件以加速训练。

Result: 在真实环境中的用户研究显示，系统取得了有前景的结果，表现出较高的可用性和有效的任务完成度。

Conclusion: 该基于RL的方法为多模态人机协作中的交互管理器设计提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

Abstract: Robot assistants for older adults and people with disabilities need to perform collaborative tasks with users effectively. The core component of these systems is an interaction manager whose job is to observe and assess the task and infer the state of the human and their intent for the robot to choose the best course of action. Due to the sparseness of the data in this domain, the policy for such multimodal systems is often crafted by hand; as the complexity of interactions grows, this process is not scalable. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to automatically generate the multimodal policy of the robot. Our system focuses on a realistic scenario where a robot assists a user in locating objects within a home environment, managing multimodal signals, including language and physical actions, to select the best action. In contrast to traditional dialog systems, our agent is trained with a simulator that uses human data and can deal with multiple modalities. We use a simple high-level reward function that needs no fine-tuning and enforce some preconditions to speed up the training process. A human study evaluating the system in a real-world setting demonstrates promising results, indicating high usability and effective task completion. This RL-based approach offers a scalable and interpretable alternative for designing interaction managers in multimodal human-robot collaborations.

</details>


### [443] [JAMB: Joint Action-Motion Diffusion for Bimanual Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25322)
*Chuyang Xiao,Peilin Meng,David Held*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 JAMB，一种将双臂动作与未来 3D 点轨迹联合去噪的扩散策略，在同一 Transformer 内让动作与轨迹假设相互迭代精化，并在共享时空坐标系中对齐多模态表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂协调操作中任一手臂的运动都会改变共享 3D 场景并影响另一手臂，但多数扩散策略生成动作时未显式建模这种未来几何后果，而带预测的变体仅把未来状态当作辅助监督或固定条件，无法在去噪过程中实现动作与场景演化的双向交互。

Method: 1) 联合去噪：以扩散策略同时去噪双臂动作与未来 3D 点轨迹，两类假设在共享 Transformer 中协同演化、相互修正；2) 表征对齐：将多模态表示统一落地到共享时空坐标系，实现几何感知的交互；3) 对比设计：与仅动作策略及不同状态表示与学习目标下的未来预测方法进行对照，并在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真与真实机器人上评测。

Result: 16 个仿真任务平均成功率达 83.4%，较最强基线提升 23.9 个百分点；三项真实任务中分别较仅动作方法与辅助几何预测方法提升 50.0 与 21.2 个百分点；对杂乱场景与分布外背景的泛化能力更强。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合动作—运动建模框架对协调双臂操作有效，验证了在去噪过程中同步建模动作与未来几何演化的必要性。

Abstract: Coordinated bimanual manipulation is challenging because the motion of either arm can alter the shared 3D scene and thereby affect the other arm. Yet most diffusion policies generate actions without explicitly modeling these future geometric consequences, while predictive variants typically use future state only as auxiliary supervision or fixed conditioning. We address this limitation by proposing JAMB, a diffusion policy that jointly denoises bimanual actions and future 3D point tracks. By allowing action and track hypotheses to evolve together within a shared Transformer, each can inform and refine the other throughout denoising. We further ground multimodal representations in a shared spatiotemporal coordinate system to facilitate geometry-aware interaction during joint denoising. We evaluate JAMB on diverse bimanual manipulation tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 and on a real-world robot, comparing it with action-only policies and alternative future-prediction approaches spanning different state representations and learning objectives. Across 16 simulation tasks, JAMB achieves an average success rate of 83.4%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 23.9 percentage points. On three real-world tasks, it outperforms the action-only and auxiliary geometry prediction methods by 50.0 and 21.2 percentage points, respectively. Beyond these performance gains, JAMB shows stronger generalization to cluttered scenes and out-of-distribution backgrounds than the evaluated baselines. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our joint action-motion modeling framework for coordinated bimanual manipulation. Our project website is available at https://jam-bimanual.github.io/

</details>


### [444] [GINIO: A Geometric SO(3)-Equivariant Interface for Neural Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25338)
*Chankyo Kim,Minghan Zhu,Tzu-Yuan Lin,Avantika Rattan,Maani Ghaffari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GINIO——一种SO(3)等变的神经惯性里程计接口，使网络预测的观测量与协方差在任意IMU坐标系旋转下满足张量变换规律，并在多个数据集上显著提升精度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经惯性里程计常把网络作为滤波管线中的"学习观测"，但这些观测在IMU安装坐标系发生任意旋转时缺乏一致变换性：均值应如向量变换，协方差应如二阶张量协变变换。现有方法无法保证这种几何一致性，导致跨安装/重装场景性能退化。

Method: 提出GINIO：基于SO(3)等变的几何接口，在给定标定IMU窗口下预测满足张量律的运动观测与不确定性；引入Last-Frame Alignment（LFA）确定性预处理，可证与SO(3)等变预测器的世界坐标系训练等价；连接估计器跟踪传感器局部状态（如IMU偏置），分离干扰估计与几何律；该接口可实例化于滤波连接NIO、AirIO式循环空中预测、EqNIO式全SO(3)规范化及ResNet式时序骨干。不确定性采用谱协方差头。

Result: TLIO上GINIO达2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE，EqNIO退化至76.389 m，且FLOPs少11.6倍；NanoBench上AirIO式实例无需外部姿态输入将ATE从5.579 m降至1.430 m，ResNet式达0.581 m（对比ResNet1D的0.645 m）；Fetch上无需重训将未见物理重装ATE从8.15 m降至0.50 m；谱协方差相比对角头将协方差等变误差降低三个数量级以上。

Conclusion: GINIO通过SO(3)等变接口保证观测与不确定性在任意IMU坐标系下的几何一致性，兼顾精度、效率与跨安装鲁棒性，且谱协方差显著提升不确定性等变性，具有超越精确坐标变换保证的泛化能力。

Abstract: Neural inertial odometry increasingly uses networks as learned measurements inside filtering pipelines. Such measurements should transform consistently under arbitrary IMU mounting conventions: their mean must transform as a vector, and their covariance must transform congruently as a second-order tensor. We present GINIO, a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry under arbitrary rotations of the IMU measurement frame. Given calibrated IMU windows, our framework predicts a motion measurement and uncertainty obeying these tensorial laws. To support efficient sensor-frame learning, we introduce Last-Frame Alignment (LFA), a deterministic preprocessing step that is provably equivalent to world-frame training for SO(3)-equivariant predictors. The connected estimator tracks sensor-local states such as IMU bias, separating nuisance estimation from the geometric law enforced by the learned measurement. We instantiate the same interface in filter-connected NIO, AirIO-style recurrent aerial prediction, EqNIO-style full-SO(3) canonicalization, and ResNet-style temporal backbones. On TLIO, GINIO achieves 2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE while EqNIO degrades to 76.389 m, using 11.6x fewer FLOPs. On NanoBench, our AirIO-style instantiation improves ATE from 5.579 m to 1.430 m without external attitude input, and our ResNet-style instantiation reaches 0.581 m ATE versus 0.645 m for ResNet1D. On Fetch, GINIO empirically reduces unseen physical-remount ATE from 8.15 m to 0.50 m without retraining, demonstrating robustness beyond the exact coordinate-frame guarantee. For uncertainty, spectral covariance reduces covariance-equivariance error by over three orders of magnitude compared with a diagonal head.

</details>


### [445] [Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25351)
*Elvin Yang,Christoforos Mavrogiannis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PROACT框架，将人类协作行为预测融入柔顺全身控制，实现高效且顺应的人机协同搬运。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协同搬运中，机器人需在高效移动物体的同时顺应人类输入；既有工作往往将二者分离，导致机器人要么高效但抗拒用户输入，要么顺应用户却依赖持续引导。

Method: 核心洞察是障碍约束下的协同搬运需整合人类协作行为预测与柔顺机器人控制。PROACT通过大规模真实双人搬运示教数据集训练Transformer架构，学习人类协作行为并将其蒸馏为对未来物体运动的预测，进而将前瞻性融入柔顺全身控制。

Result: 在9自由度移动机械臂上开展108次真实世界试验，相比纯柔顺基线和MPC基线，平均交互功分别降低59.2%和20.4%，平均完成时间分别缩短12.9%和6.9%。

Conclusion: 将人类协作行为预测与柔顺全身控制相结合，可同时提升人机协同搬运的效率与物理顺应性。

Abstract: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative behavior. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset of dyadic human transport demonstrations, our transformer architecture distills collaborative behavior into predictions of future object motion. Across 108 real-world trials with a 9-DoF mobile manipulator, PROACT reduces mean interaction work by 59.2\% and 20.4\%, and mean completion time by 12.9\% and 6.9\%, relative to compliance-only and MPC baselines, respectively. Footage from our experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/qAGvQfVPjbk.

</details>


### [446] [HOTICE: Whole-Body Humanoid Object Transportation in Cluttered Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25363)
*Toan Nguyen,Weiduo Yuan,Siheng Zhao,Yue Wang,Daniel Seita*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 HOTICE，一个面向人形机器人在杂乱环境中搬运物体的全身学习框架，通过人-物解耦势场、双智能体强化学习与专家到通才蒸馏，实现仿真与真机 Unitree G1 上的鲁棒搬运。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实人类环境中的物体搬运是人形机器人的基础能力，但现有方法在机器人本体与所携带物体周围自由空间均受杂乱环境限制时表现不佳，难以同时处理本体与物体的避障及全身协调控制。

Method: 方法包含三部分：1）Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields，联合编码机器人与所携物体的避障引导，实现协同的障碍感知运动；2）面向全身移动操作的巨大动作空间，设计双智能体强化学习架构，解耦上身与下身控制，并通过共享状态观测与奖励保持全身协调；3）采用专家到通才的蒸馏策略，将带特权信息的教师策略蒸馏为单一可部署的学生策略，以泛化到多样杂乱场景。

Result: 在 MuJoCo 仿真与真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上评估，HOTICE 对多种形状物体在杂乱场景中实现了有效且鲁棒的搬运，能够可靠协调全身运动与物体感知避障，并有效泛化到未见过的杂乱环境，在 sim2real 部署中取得良好性能。

Conclusion: HOTICE 验证了将本体-物体联合势场、双智能体全身强化学习与特权蒸馏相结合，可有效解决杂乱环境下人形机器人全身物体搬运问题，并具备良好的仿真到现实迁移与泛化能力。

Abstract: Object transportation is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots operating in real-world, human-centric environments, yet existing methods struggle when clutter constrains free space around both the robot and its carried payload. We present HOTICE, a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects through such cluttered environments. First, we introduce Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields, which jointly encode collision-avoidance guidance for the robot and the carried object, enabling coordinated, obstacle-aware motion for both. Second, to address the large action space inherent to whole-body loco-manipulation, we design a dual-agent reinforcement learning architecture that decouples upper- and lower-body control while preserving whole-body coordination via shared state observations and rewards. To train a policy that generalizes across diverse cluttered scenes, we further employ a specialist-to-generalist distillation strategy, in which privileged teacher policies are distilled into a single deployable student policy. We evaluate HOTICE in MuJoCo simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating effective and robust object transportation across cluttered scenarios for objects of varying shapes. Our results show that HOTICE reliably coordinates whole-body motion and object-aware collision avoidance, generalizing effectively to previously unseen cluttered environments while achieving strong performance in sim2real deployment.

</details>


### [447] [Capability-Aware Arbitration for Semantic Intent-Based Shared Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25369)
*Zhaoda Du,Michael Bowman,Xiaoli Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出能力感知共享控制框架：VLM推断人类意图与语义置信度，VLA策略生成动作并在线估计能力置信度，通过sigmoid非线性仲裁自适应分配机器人权限，成功率达92%，优于遥操作、仅意图仲裁与固定权重融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共享控制多基于"人类意图置信度"分配机器人权限，隐含假设自主执行可靠；当该假设不成立时，高意图置信度会导致"过度帮助"（over-helping），损害控制性能与用户体验。

Method: 1) 用VLM推断人类意图，并输出语义意图置信度；2) 用VLA策略生成自主动作，基于随机动作轨迹的离散度与局部不稳定性在线估计VLA能力置信度；3) 设计非线性仲裁策略，将贝叶斯滤波后的语义意图置信度与VLA能力置信度经sigmoid映射融合，动态调节机器人权限。评估结合VLM/VLA置信度评估与12名被试实验，任务为抓放与双向堆叠，覆盖分布内与分布外条件。

Result: 任务成功率达92%，高于手动遥操作（83%）、仅意图仲裁（44%）与固定等权融合（10%）；控制友好度更高，权限加权分歧更低，均优于两种共享控制基线。

Conclusion: 将VLA能力置信度纳入权限分配可有效缓解过度帮助问题，提升共享控制的任务成功率与交互体验，说明仅依赖意图置信度的仲裁范式存在局限。

Abstract: Shared control often allocates robot authority based on confidence in inferred human intent, assuming reliable autonomous execution. When this assumption fails, high intent confidence can cause over-helping. We present a capability-aware shared-control framework in which a vision-language model (VLM) infers human intent and provides semantic-intent confidence, while a vision-language-action (VLA) policy generates autonomous actions. VLA capability confidence is estimated online from the dispersion and local instability of stochastic action trajectories. We design a nonlinear arbitration policy that combines Bayesian-filtered semantic-intent confidence with VLA capability confidence through a sigmoid mapping to adapt robot authority. Our evaluation combined VLM/VLA confidence assessment with a study involving 12 participants performing pick-and-place and bidirectional stacking under in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions. The proposed method achieved the highest task success rate (92%), compared with manual teleoperation (83%), intent-only arbitration (44%), and fixed equal-weight blending (10%). It also achieved higher control friendliness and lower authority-weighted disagreement than both shared-control baselines. These results demonstrate the benefit of incorporating VLA capability into authority allocation to mitigate over-helping and improve shared-control performance.

</details>


### [448] [Angular momentum analysis on Karate roundhouse kicks: a longitudinal case study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25374)
*Jan C. L. Lau,Christian Mele,Jonathan Feng-Shun Lin,Katja Mombaur*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文引入两种基于角动量(AM)的新指标,通过一年纵向研究分析空手道回旋踢中角动量的管理机制,探讨稳定与不稳定踢腿的差异及其随技术进步的演变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类步态不仅限于直线行走,还涉及剧烈的往复旋转,其机制尚不明确。空手道回旋踢是动态往复旋转的极端案例,研究其角动量管理可为动态人体运动的稳定性分析以及机器人和外骨骼的流畅步态提供参考。

Method: 采用以第一作者为空手道学员的为期一年的纵向研究,并招募一名空手道教练作为专家进行单次测试以作对比。引入两种基于角动量(AM)的新指标,并分析角动量相关变量,研究无目标的回缩式后腿回旋踢。

Result: 结果表明,不稳定踢腿在击打前具有更高的峰值总角动量,击打后的制动峰值较小。所提出的基于角动量的指标能够识别部分不稳定踢腿的成因;但由于踢腿不稳定可能源于不同原因,无法在稳定与不稳定踢腿之间做出明确区分。

Conclusion: 所提出的指标可作为性能度量用于分析其他类型的动态运动;但若要将其作为稳定性判据,建议同时考虑其与时间、运动学及压力中心的协调关系。

Abstract: Human gait in reality extends beyond straight-line walking, with some situations even requiring drastic back-and-forth rotations. A smooth and stable execution may seem intuitive, but the underlying mechanics remains unknown. The Karate roundhouse kick may be an extreme case of exhibiting dynamic back-and-forth rotations, but investigating the angular momentum (AM) management can potentially inform stability analysis in dynamic human motions and smoother gait in robots and exoskeletons. This paper introduces two new AM-based measures and analyzes AM-related variables to study the target-less retractable back-leg Karate roundhouse kick. The purpose is to understand the underlying AM management, analyze the differences between stable and unstable kicks, and investigate how these variables and measures change over time with improvement. A one-year longitudinal study was conducted with the first author as a Karate student, and a Karate instructor was also recruited for one session as an expert, whose data is used for comparison. Results show that unstable kicks have higher peak total AM before Strike and smaller braking peak after Strike. The proposed AM-based measures are able to identify the cause of some unstable kicks, though no clear distinction could be made between stable and unstable kicks since kicks can be unstable for different reasons. Nonetheless, the proposed measures can be applied as performance measures to analyze other types of dynamic motions. To incorporate them as stability criteria, however, it is recommended to also consider their coordination with time, kinematics, and center of pressure.

</details>


### [449] [PARTE: Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation for Point Cloud Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25375)
*Abolfazl Babanazari,Carson Cramer,Tyler Summers,Carlos Nieto,Kaveh Fathian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PARTE是一种全局点云配准方法，将平面结构视为补充配准证据，通过平面上下文直方图（PCH）描述子和两级匹配获得可靠平面对应，并与点对应在置信度加权兼容图中联合剔除离群点以估计刚体变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局点云配准在重叠有限、几何重复和传感器噪声导致对应集被离群点主导时仍然困难；平面区域对传统点描述子尤其不友好，通常在匹配前被抑制或丢弃。

Method: PARTE提取平面块，用平面上下文直方图（PCH）描述每个平面块周围的几何；采用两级匹配识别可靠平面对应；将候选点对应与平面对应结合到置信度加权的兼容图中进行联合离群点剔除，随后估计刚体变换；当没有可用平面对应时，自然退化为仅点配准。

Result: 在六个室内外基准、覆盖密集RGB-D与稀疏LiDAR的8,097个配准对上评估，PARTE相对13种标准及最先进方法取得最高总体成功率，同时保持低运行时间；提供开源C++实现及Python绑定。

Conclusion: 将平面结构作为补充配准证据可提升全局点云配准的鲁棒性与成功率，且方法在无平面可用时可无缝退化为点配准，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Global point-cloud registration remains challenging when limited overlap, repetitive geometry, and sensor noise produce correspondence sets dominated by outliers. Planar regions are particularly difficult for conventional point descriptors and are therefore often suppressed or discarded before matching. We present PARTE (Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation), a global registration method that instead treats planar structure as complementary registration evidence. PARTE extracts planar patches and represents them using our novel Plane Context Histogram (PCH), a descriptor that encodes the geometry surrounding each patch, while a two-level matching procedure identifies reliable plane correspondences. Candidate point and plane correspondences are combined in a confidence-weighted compatibility graph for joint outlier rejection, followed by rigid transformation estimation. When no usable plane correspondences are available, PARTE naturally reduces to point-only registration. We evaluate PARTE on 8,097 registration pairs across six indoor and outdoor benchmarks spanning dense RGB-D and sparse LiDAR measurements. Evaluations show PARTE achieves the highest overall success rate against 13 standard and state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low runtime. An open-source C++ implementation with Python bindings is provided at https://parte.pages.dev.

</details>


### [450] [VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25376)
*Jiuyi Xu,Qing Jin,Meida Chen,Song Wang,Yang Sui,Yangming Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 VLAQuantBench，通过 409 次运行与 94,574 个仿真回合，系统评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后训练量化中层范围、数值格式与校准策略的交互作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型的后训练量化可降低显存需求，但精度分配并非简单的层级敏感规则，需要厘清"层范围—数值格式—校准"三者的交互。本文旨在建立受控评测基准以揭示这种配方依赖性。

Method: 构建 VLAQuantBench 基准：4 个模型在 LIBERO 上评测，X-VLA 额外在三个仿真基准族上评测；采用未校准 W4A4 最近舍入量化、固定观测重放、双回合校准、平滑加裁剪（smoothing-and-clipping）以及针对单一输出投影层的保护等对照设置，并辅以真实内核与物理机器人测量。

Result: 未校准 W4A4 下，将 π0.5 动作头子集从 126 层扩展到 167 层，成功率由 7.0% 提升至 70.5%，固定观测重放验证了相应的数值恢复；双回合校准消除了所测子集中的严重联合失效，但同一平滑裁剪配方反而降低 π0 成功率，且无法端到端恢复 OpenVLA-OFT；对 OpenVLA-OFT 保护一个 28,672 参数的输出投影层即可恢复近基线成功率，其余 441 个可量化线性层在 LIBERO-Long 保持 W3，或在四个套件上使用八位激活。

Conclusion: 量化效果取决于具体配方（calibration、格式与层范围的组合）而非普适的层级敏感性规律；本文给出了具体的精度分配方案，并公开代码、配置与回合记录。

Abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration. We introduce \textbf{VLAQuantBench}, a controlled evaluation with 409 runs and 94,574 simulation episodes: four models on LIBERO, with X-VLA additionally evaluated on three simulation benchmark families. Under uncalibrated W4A4 round-to-nearest quantization, expanding a $π_{0.5}$ action-head subset from 126 to 167 layers raises success from 7.0\% to 70.5\%. Fixed-observation replay confirms a corresponding numerical recovery. Two-episode calibration removes the severe joint failures in the tested subsets, whereas the same smoothing-and-clipping recipe lowers $π_0$ success and does not recover OpenVLA-OFT end-to-end. For OpenVLA-OFT, protecting one 28,672-parameter output projection instead restores near-baseline success: the remaining 441 eligible linear layers retain W3 on LIBERO-Long or eight-bit activations across all four suites. Task-clustered intervals support the large failure and recovery contrasts. These results establish recipe-dependent interactions and identify concrete precision assignments, rather than universal layer-sensitivity rules. Real-kernel and physical-robot measurements complement the accuracy analysis. Code, configurations, and episode records are publicly available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/VLAQuantBench.

</details>


### [451] [Norm2Tex: Augmenting Visuo-Tactile Simulations with Texture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25398)
*Seongjin Bien,Débora Oliveira Makowski,Roberto Calandra,Florian Walter,Wolfram Burgard*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Norm2Tex是一种即插即用方法，通过将法线贴图中的高频表面细节注入视触觉仿真器的渲染流程，缩小仿真与真实触觉数据的域差异，提升材质识别和材质相关的真实世界控制行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练通用机器人控制策略需要大规模数据集，但真实触觉数据采集成本高、耗时长，因此转向触觉仿真。然而现有触觉仿真器仅能捕捉整体接触几何，丢失纹理等细粒度信息，导致仿真与真实触觉数据之间存在显著的域差异（domain shift）。

Method: 提出Norm2Tex，一种即插即用方法：在触觉仿真器渲染管线之前修改目标物体的深度图，利用法线贴图纹理（normal map textures）为视触觉传感器仿真注入高频表面细节，从而可无缝集成到不同的触觉仿真器中。

Result: 通过材质分类和强化学习任务评估仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移。结果表明，Norm2Tex能够跨域保留依赖材质的触觉信息，提升纹理识别效果，并在真实世界中产生依赖材质的控制行为。

Conclusion: Norm2Tex通过引入法线贴图纹理的高频细节，有效缓解了触觉仿真中的域差异问题，改善了仿真到现实的迁移性能，为大规模触觉数据生成与通用机器人策略训练提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Large-scale datasets are essential for training generalist robot control policies. Collecting real-world tactile data is costly and time-consuming, motivating the use of tactile simulations. However, current tactile simulators capture only overall contact geometry and miss fine details like texture. This results in a significant domain shift between simulated and real tactile data. To address this gap, we introduce Norm2Tex, a plug-in method that augments simulations of vision-based tactile sensors with high-frequency surface details from normal map textures. By modifying the target object's depth map before a tactile simulator's rendering pipeline, Norm2Tex seamlessly integrates into different tactile simulators. We also evaluate sim-to-real transfer using material classification and a reinforcement learning task. Our results show that Norm2Tex preserves material-dependent tactile information across domains, improving texture recognition and producing material-dependent control behavior in the real world.

</details>


### [452] [Effects of Assistance Delay on Joint Mechanics and Energetics in Biological Torque Control of a Hip Exoskeleton](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25417)
*Jimin An,Ryan Lee,Jingshu Peng,Eni Halilaj,Inseung Kang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究考察生物力矩控制髋关节外骨骼在平地行走、上坡、下坡三种任务中，不同助力延迟（40–320 ms）对代谢率与关节做功的影响。助力整体降低净代谢率与关节正功，延迟影响关节做功但不影响代谢率；代谢收益在平地与上坡显著、下坡反而恶化，且未发现任务依赖的延迟响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物力矩控制将估计的人体关节力矩直接映射为外骨骼助力，是一种任务无关的通用策略，但其固定“状态—力矩”映射是否在生物力学上差异显著的不同任务中仍然有效尚不清楚，尤其是助力延迟的作用未明。

Method: 8名受试者完成零力矩基线条件及5种主动助力条件（延迟40–320 ms），在平地（LG）、上坡（RA）、下坡（RD）行走中测量净代谢率、髋关节生物正功及下肢总正功，分析任务与延迟的影响。

Result: 跨任务与延迟，助力使净代谢率降低5.24%、髋关节生物正功降低5.86%、下肢总正功降低1.68%（均p<0.05）。延迟显著影响两项关节做功指标（均p<0.001），但不影响净代谢率；机械卸载随延迟增加而普遍下降，代谢收益相对稳定。相对零力矩，净代谢率在LG降低9.75%、RA降低7.20%，但在RD升高1.23%。未检测到任务依赖的延迟响应差异。

Conclusion: 生物力矩映射应依据目标结果与所助力关节的机械角色（正功/负功主导）来评估；以正功为主的助力策略若不加修改，可能无法泛化到以负功为主的下坡行走。

Abstract: Biological torque control directly maps an estimated human joint moment to exoskeleton assistance, providing a task-agnostic strategy for supporting diverse locomotor activities. However, it remains unclear whether a fixed state-to-torque mapping provides effective assistance across biomechanically distinct tasks. We examined how assistance delay affected hip exoskeleton performance during level-ground (LG), ramp-ascent (RA), and ramp-descent (RD) walking. Eight participants completed a zero-torque baseline condition and five active assistance conditions with delays ranging from 40 to 320 ms. Across tasks and active delays, assistance reduced net metabolic rate by 5.24%, positive biological hip joint work by 5.86%, and total lower-limb positive joint work by 1.68% (all p < 0.05). Assistance delay affected both joint-work outcomes (both p < 0.001) but not net metabolic rate. Mechanical unloading generally decreased with increasing delay, whereas metabolic benefits remained comparatively stable. Relative to the zero-torque condition, net metabolic rate decreased by 9.75% during LG and 7.20% during RA but increased by 1.23% during RD. We did not detect task-dependent differences in the delay response. Our findings indicate that biological torque mappings should be evaluated based on the target outcome and mechanical role of the assisted joint, and that predominantly positive-power assistance may not generalize to negative-work-dominant locomotion without modification.

</details>


### [453] [REDACT: Robust Perceptive Locomotion under Unseen Visual Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25450)
*Natapat Kirdwichai,Tobias Driskell-Poole,Andrei Sontea,Jadu Dash,Muhammad Burhan Hafez,Danesh Tarapore*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REDACT：一个教师-学生框架，通过改进视觉编码器、持续特征掩码与共识门控，在未建模的深度传感器损坏下保留有效视觉信息，实现鲁棒的零样本迁移运动策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度条件运动策略在训练分布外易产生不可预测动作。遮挡、无效回波、传感器噪声与视觉干扰会使部署观测偏离仿真标称深度。合成传感器增强仅针对指定退化类型，无法定义训练中未涵盖的损坏族下的行为，因此需要弥补训练时覆盖不足的问题。

Method: 提出 REDACT 教师-学生框架，包含三项技术：（1）改进的视觉编码器架构；（2）持续特征掩码（persistent feature masking）；（3）新型共识门控（consensus-gating）算法，仅在干净观测上进行近似保形校准（conformal calibration），无需事先知道损坏类型。
