Result: 在干净仿真深度上训练后，REDACT 在未见损坏下仍能保留有效视觉信息，穿越成功率高于现有跑酷基线；跨损坏族的深度增强评估显示其在增强覆盖缺失处提升鲁棒性；真实世界试验实现向结构化与森林环境的零样本迁移。

Conclusion: REDACT 通过无需损坏先验的共识门控与特征掩码，弥补了训练时退化覆盖的不足，在未建模损坏下保持运动策略鲁棒性，并具备真实环境的零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: Depth-conditioned locomotion policies have demonstrated impressive agile maneuvers, but can be steered to unpredictable actions when observations are outside their training distribution. Occlusion, invalid returns, sensor noise, and visual distractors can shift deployment observations away from nominal simulated depth. While synthetic sensor augmentation targets specified degradations, it does not by itself define behavior under corruption families omitted from training. To address gaps in training-time coverage, we present REDACT (Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal), a teacher-student framework combining an improved visual encoder architecture, persistent feature masking, and a novel consensus-gating algorithm to retain useful depth information under unmodeled corruption. The gate uses approximate conformal calibration on clean observations alone, requiring no prior knowledge of the corruption type. Trained on clean simulated depth, REDACT retains useful visual information under unseen corruption, supporting higher traversal success than existing parkour baselines. Evaluation of depth augmentation across corruption families further shows that REDACT improves robustness where augmentation coverage is missing. Real-world trials demonstrate zero-shot transfer to structured and forested environments with unfamiliar scene content.

</details>


### [454] [A bioinspired internal model-based online estimator for planar pursuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25470)
*Tengyue Liu,Xincheng Li,Sofia Morales Ferreira,Kevin Galloway,Udit Halder*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生物启发内部模型的估计器，将相对运动学作为约束、以内部模型输出与传感器测量的一致性为目标构建优化问题，利用庞特里亚金极大值原理推导最优性条件，并用前向-后向算法与滚动时域实现实时估计，在数值对比与机器人平台上的两种追踪策略中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物启发的反馈控制（追踪、跟踪、集群运动）常以交互个体间的相对构型表达，但机载传感器往往无法直接提供反馈控制所需的全部状态量，必须对未观测状态进行估计。

Method: 构建生物启发的内部模型型估计器，从部分传感观测与已知自运动重建缺失状态；将状态重建表述为优化问题，把相对运动学作为约束，最小化内部模型输出与机载传感器测量之间的不一致；用庞特里亚金极大值原理推导必要条件，采用前向-后向算法数值求解，并以滚动时域（moving horizon）形式实现在线估计。

Result: 通过数值实验与经典状态估计器进行对比评估；并在机器人硬件上实现该框架，以两种追踪（pursuit）策略验证了实时可行性。

Conclusion: 该内部模型-优化估计框架能够从部分观测中有效重建相对状态，性能可与经典估计器相竞争，且满足机器人实时在线应用需求。

Abstract: Bioinspired feedback controls for pursuit, tracking, and collective motion are often expressed in terms of the relative configuration between interacting agents. In practice, however, onboard sensors may not directly provide all quantities required for feedback control, necessitating estimation of unobserved quantities. This paper develops a bioinspired internal model-based estimator for reconstructing those quantities from partial sensory observations and known self-motion. State reconstruction is posed as an optimization problem that treats the relative kinematics as constraints and minimizes the disagreement between the internal model outputs and measurements from onboard sensors. Pontryagin's Maximum Principle is used to derive the necessary optimality conditions. A forward-backward algorithm is used to provide a numerical solution and a moving horizon formulation is employed for online implementation. The estimator is evaluated numerically against classical state estimators. Real-time implementation of the proposed framework on robotic hardware is demonstrated through two pursuit strategies.

</details>


### [455] [Brace Yourself: Task-Conditioned Environmental Bracing for Forceful Humanoid Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25486)
*Zongyuan Zhang,Christopher Lehnert,Will N. Browne,Jonathan M. Roberts*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出支撑手策略(SHS)，人形机器人用一手撑扶环境、另一手施力，通过任务条件化的支撑构型引导两个同步强化学习策略，Unitree G1上可用接触力达60 N（无撑扶时仅13.5 N）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人执行强力操作时，交互力会干扰全身平衡，导致可施加的力受限。

Method: SHS：优化任务条件化的支撑构型，据此引导两个同步的强化学习策略（撑扶手与操作手），无需人类运动数据，也无需在线全身轨迹规划。

Result: Unitree G1上实现最高60 N可用接触力，而无环境撑扶时最大持续力仅13.5 N；相比任务无关的支撑构型显著改善力跟踪；同一策略无需重训练即可泛化到不同任务区域。

Conclusion: SHS为大幅拓展人形机器人强力操作能力提供了一种简单机制。

Abstract: Forceful manipulation is challenging for humanoid robots because interaction forces can disturb whole-body balance. We introduce the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), which enables a humanoid to brace against the environment with one hand while performing forceful manipulation with the other. SHS optimises a task-conditioned support configuration that guides two synchronous reinforcement-learning policies, without human motion data or online whole-body trajectory planning. On a Unitree G1, SHS achieved usable contact forces up to 60 N, compared with a maximum sustained force of 13.5 N without environmental bracing, while substantially improving force tracking over a task-independent support configuration. The same policies generalised to different task regions without retraining. SHS therefore provides a simple mechanism for substantially extending humanoid forceful-manipulation capability.

</details>


### [456] [RoboMP-DINOv2: Prompts, Not Filters for Robust Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25506)
*Han Qi,Heng Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoboMP-DINOv2，将分割掩码作为空间提示而非可见性过滤器，实现全场景视觉编码器用于机器人操作策略，并引入掩码区域颜色随机化(MCR)增强外观鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作策略需在视觉变化下泛化，同时保留与动作相关的场景上下文。通用视觉编码器不针对视觉运动控制，而物体中心方法常将分割掩码作为硬过滤器，丢弃了可能有用的上下文信息。

Method: 从完整观测中提取密集DINOv2特征；在被掩码位置注入可学习的区域特定嵌入；将提示与非提示token联合上下文化用于动作预测。此外提出掩码区域颜色随机化(MCR)以提升外观鲁棒性，得到RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR。

Result: 在七个模拟操作设置中，RoboMP-DINOv2在空间偏移下成功率60.7%、场景杂乱下59.7%，相比基于DINOv2的Diffusion Policy的50.7%和41.0%。在未见过的物体颜色下，RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR达72.5%，而最强的颜色随机化基线为35.1%。

Conclusion: 额外实验与表征分析表明，该方法在提升鲁棒性的同时保留了与行为相关的场景信息。代码已开源。

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies must generalize across visual shifts while preserving scene context relevant to action. General-purpose vision encoders are not tailored to visuomotor control, while object-centric approaches often use segmentation masks as hard filters that discard potentially useful context. We propose RoboMP-DINOv2 (Robotics Mask-Prompted DINOv2), a full-scene vision encoder that treats masks as spatial prompts rather than visibility filters. It extracts dense DINOv2 features from the full observation, injects learned region-specific embeddings at masked locations, and jointly contextualizes prompted and unprompted tokens for action prediction. We further introduce masked-region color randomization (MCR) to improve appearance robustness, yielding RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR. Across seven simulated manipulation settings, RoboMP-DINOv2 achieves 60.7% success under spatial shifts and 59.7% under scene clutter, compared with 50.7% and 41.0% for a DINOv2-based Diffusion Policy. Under unseen object colors, RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR achieves 72.5% success versus 35.1% for the strongest color-randomized baseline. Additional experiments and representation analyses show improved robustness while preserving behaviorally relevant scene information. Code is available at https://github.com/han20192019/RoboMP_DINOv2.

</details>


### [457] [A Deployment Study of Identity-Gated Drone Gesture Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25511)
*Diyari Mohammed Salih,Ilyes Chaabeni,Naima Ait Oufroukh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出IGate，一种身份门控的无人机手势控制栈，仅当已注册操作员通过人脸验证时才接纳手势指令。系统用20帧人脸少样本注册，结合余弦相似度验证与比例校正人脸跟踪，手势用RBF-SVM分类手部关键点，并以分层有限状态机管理模式。在DJI Tello EDU上经270次试验（149次实飞）验证，离线人脸验证EER为0.32%，飞行中为19.3%，悬停锁定下RBF-SVM手势分类准确率0.850，优于几何规则的0.651，其中82%的差距来自深度通道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的手势控制会响应相机视野内任意手部，在共享室内空间中存在安全隐患，可能被非授权人员误触或恶意操控。因此需要引入身份门控机制，确保只有已注册操作员的手势指令被接纳。

Method: 系统包含人脸跟踪与手势控制两部分。人脸端：从20帧初始人脸图像进行少样本注册，无需用户特定预训练，通过当前人脸裁剪嵌入与注册模板的余弦相似度进行验证，并用比例校正实现跟踪。手势端：提取手部关键点，用自建数据集训练的RBF-SVM分类。此外采用分层有限状态机处理模式选择、默认与回退行为。平台为DJI Tello EDU，各组件均进行离线与实飞评估。

Result: 共270次试验，其中149次实飞。人脸验证离线等错误率为0.32%，飞行中升至19.3%。在悬停锁定条件下，RBF-SVM手势分类器准确率0.850，优于几何规则的0.651，且该差距中82%来源于深度通道。作者将公开全部日志与复现脚本。

Conclusion: IGate通过身份门控有效提升共享空间下无人机手势控制的安全性，少样本注册与轻量分类方案可行；但人脸验证在飞行中性能显著下降，表明运动与视角变化仍是主要挑战。深度信息对手势分类贡献关键，未来可进一步优化机载鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-based gesture control accepts commands from any hand in the camera field of view, which is unsafe in shared indoor spaces. This paper presents IGate, an identity-gated control stack that includes gesture control and face tracking, in which commands are admitted only when an enrolled operator is verified. The system performs few-shot user enrolment from 20 initial face frames, without prior user-specific training: verification compares an embedding of the current face crop against the enrolled template by cosine similarity, while face tracking uses proportional correction. Gesture control is achieved by classifying extracted hand landmarks using an RBF-SVM trained on a custom dataset. Additionally, a hierarchical finite-state machine handles mode selection, default, and fallback behaviours. The approach is tested on a DJI Tello EDU, each component evaluated offline and in-flight across 270 trials (149 flown). Face verification yields a 0.32% offline equal error rate versus 19.3% in-flight. Under hover-locked conditions, the RBF-SVM gesture classifier outperforms the geometric rule (0.850 vs. 0.651 accuracy), with 82% of this gap stemming from the depth channel. All logs and reproduction scripts will be released.

</details>


### [458] [Digital Twin-Driven VR Teleoperation with Multi-View Spatial Perception for Surgical Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25527)
*Chang Liu,Chenhao Yu,Honghao Zhao,Hao Ding,Haochen Wei,Adnan Munawar,Mathias Unberath,Peter Kazanzides*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出数字孪生驱动的VR遥操作平台，用于机器人微创手术，克服视频透视式HMD的单视角与深度感知局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RMIS平台使用固定控制台，手术医生仅能通过立体内窥镜图像在单一视角下操作器械。已有研究提出用HMD作为便携控制台，但采用视频透视渲染内窥镜图像，仍受制于单一内窥镜视角，深度感知受限，且手部姿态必须与器械严格对齐。

Method: 构建数字孪生驱动的VR遥操作平台：基于无标记感知重建手术环境的数字孪生，并流式传输至HMD显示，实现多视角渲染与自然运动视差线索，使用户手部姿态与器械对齐解耦；采用VR手部控制器（而非多数已有系统的手部跟踪）以扩大遥操作工作空间并提升器械控制的鲁棒性与稳定性。

Result: 在da Vinci Research Kit（dVRK）上开展15名参与者用户研究，相比最先进的HoloLens 2混合现实基线，本VR平台路径长度减少86%、抖动减少95%，并在所有条件下达到与或优于传统控制台的深度感知置信度。

Conclusion: 数字孪生驱动的VR遥操作平台可显著优于现有混合现实基线，并在深度感知上媲美甚至超越传统固定控制台，为RMIS提供更具便携性与多视角感知能力的操作范式。

Abstract: Current robot-assisted minimally-invasive surgery (RMIS) platforms provide a fixed console for the surgeon to view stereo endoscopic images and teleoperate instruments inside the patient. Several researchers have proposed the use of a head-mounted display (HMD) as a portable console, with video pass-through rendering of the endoscope images which, like the fixed console, restricts the operator to a single endoscopic viewpoint and limits depth perception. We present a digital twin-driven virtual reality (VR) teleoperation platform, where the digital twin is created from markerless perception of the surgical environment and streamed for display on the HMD. This overcomes the limitations of video pass-through by providing multi-view rendering and natural motion-parallax cues, enabling decoupling of the user's hand posture from strict instrument alignment. The system utilizes VR hand controllers to increase the teleoperation workspace and to improve the robustness and stability of instrument control compared to the hand tracking approach adopted by most prior systems. A 15-participant user study on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) shows that our VR platform significantly outperforms a state-of-the-art HoloLens 2 mixed reality baseline, reducing path length by 86% and jerk by 95%, while achieving depth perception confidence comparable to or exceeding the traditional console across all conditions.

</details>


### [459] [HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25558)
*Jinu Pahk,Jesoon Kang,Taegeon Park,Jisu An,Soo Min Kimm,Jaejoon Kim,Byoung-Tak Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GC-VLA，通过预测多视角“未来-当前”几何变化token实现与本体无关的视觉接口预训练，配合四阶段训练与GCRF残差流策略，在LIBERO上达到99.55%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽受益于几何监督，但仅使用当前帧几何无法显式刻画操作过程中发生的变化；同时希望构建一个与具身形态无关、可先在机器人与第一视角视频上预训练的视觉接口，再与具体机器人的动作对齐。

Method: GC-VLA学习从当前观测预测多视角的未来-当前几何变化token。离线帧对定义名义0.5秒预测时域，未来观测仅用于构造训练目标。四阶段训练：阶段1训练几何变化视觉-语言模型（GC-VLM）；阶段2引入连续ActionExpert并与机器人动作对齐，同时在VLM接口处停止动作流梯度；阶段3放开梯度，联合更新可训练VLM组件与ActionExpert；阶段4冻结GC-VLA并应用几何条件残差流（GCRF），采用二元干预路由器与从闭环反馈中学习的单一有界残差速度策略。

Result: GC-VLA在LIBERO上成功率为95.20%，叠加GCRF后提升至99.55%；推理阶段仅使用当前观测与已学习的GC表示，无需执行离线目标编码器。

Conclusion: 显式的几何变化预测可作为具身无关的预训练接口，结合分阶段对齐与闭环残差策略，在无需推理期额外编码器的情况下显著提升操作策略性能。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 freezes GC-VLA and applies Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow (GCRF), using a binary intervention router and a single bounded residual velocity policy learned from closed-loop feedback. GC-VLA achieves 95.20% success on LIBERO, and GC-VLA with GCRF achieves 99.55%. Inference uses current observations and the learned GC representation without executing the offline target encoders.

</details>


### [460] [IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25562)
*Yiqi Wang,Zhifeng Rao,Jiaqi Zhang,Xiaoyang Li,Zhangkai Wu,Yiqun Duan,Mingkai Zheng,Fei Wang,Shan You,Taotao Cai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 IndustrialVLA-Bench，用统一评测协议与证据分级，对 6 个 VLA 与 WAM 系统在干净能力、非语言鲁棒性、指令敏感性与执行成本上做可追溯对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 与 WAM 面向相同操作任务但常在不同评测协议下报告，导致二者在能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感性与部署成本上的权衡难以澄清。

Method: 构建证据感知的统一评测框架：在 LIBERO 上评干净能力，LIBERO-Plus 上评非语言鲁棒性，LIBERO-Para 上评指令敏感性，并记录推理延迟、峰值显存、运行模式；任务分数由固定 checkpoint 与推理配置下三个不同随机种子的完整评测聚合；对系统划分 protocol-faithful、near-reproduction、pending-verification 三类证据等级，仅前者支持严格比较。

Result: 六系统 LIBERO 干净平均分仅差 1.58 分，而鲁棒性与改写摘要分别跨 14.62 与 31.08 分；仅取三个 protocol-faithful 系统时结论不变（1.36、14.62、23.10 分），说明诊断性区分不依赖较弱证据层级。

Conclusion: 不主张任一范式的普遍优越性，而是提供可追溯证据，在共享实用标准下比较已发布机器人策略；代码与评测记录已开源。

Abstract: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.

</details>


### [461] [Recording Hand-Held Laparoscopic Instrument Motion in the Operating Room: Magnetometer-Free Fusion of Inertial, Range and Visual Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25577)
*Jiyul Lee,Dongho Yee,Juahn Oh,Jinseok Lee,Yechan Seo,Seong Jeong,Minsung Kim,Seonho Shim,Younghoon Noh,Hyuk Choi,Youngbin Kong,Hyoun-Joong Kong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种夹持式手术器械状态记录器，融合六轴IMU、ToF测距仪与无标记摄像头，在套管针远心运动约束下的误差状态卡尔曼滤波中估计器械位姿，用U-Net分割轴杆轮廓替代磁力计提供航向，实现毫米级尖端轨迹追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数微创手术仍使用手持腹腔镜器械，但仅保留内窥镜视频，器械运动（体现手术技能、可用于技能评估与机器人学习）被丢失。仅靠视频的位姿估计误差达毫米至厘米级；器械上的IMU无法依赖磁力计，因为实测磁场随器械位姿和不同场次变化。

Method: 设计可夹持在常规器械上的状态记录器，不改变进入患者体内的部分；将六轴IMU、飞行时间（ToF）测距仪与无标记摄像头在误差状态卡尔曼滤波中融合，并施加套管针的远心运动（RCM）约束；航向由U-Net分割的轴杆轮廓提供，替代磁力计。

Result: 旋转角误差0.200°，而仅用加速度计加磁力计为3.58°。对比Franka Research 3机械臂且未做对齐，300次平移试验位移误差1.21mm RMS，180次旋转试验相对旋转误差0.34° RMS。连续轨迹实时追踪显示，调优三个滤波参数后绝对尖端误差为1.22mm（程序驱动）和3.04mm（遥操作），完整融合优于任何传感器子集。

Conclusion: 由于估计器不使用磁测量，其精度不依赖未受扰动的磁场。该夹持式装置可在常规手持腹腔镜中记录度量尖端轨迹，并显示器械进入患者体内后不可见的插入深度与姿态。

Abstract: Most minimally invasive procedures are still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, yet only the endoscopic video is retained; the instrument motion that expresses surgical skill, and that could support skill assessment and robot learning, is lost. Pose from video alone remains millimeters to centimeters off, and an instrument-mounted inertial measurement unit (IMU) cannot rely on its magnetometer, whose field changed with tool pose and between sessions in our measurements. We present a surgical instrument-state logger that clips onto a conventional instrument without modifying the part that enters the patient and fuses a six-axis IMU and a time-of-flight (ToF) rangefinder with a markerless camera in an error-state Kalman filter under the remote center of motion (RCM) of the trocar. Heading comes from the shaft silhouette, segmented by a U-Net, in place of the magnetometer: the rotation-angle error is 0.200°, against 3.58° from the accelerometer and magnetometer alone. Against a Franka Research 3 manipulator, and without alignment to it, the displacement error over 300 translation trials was 1.21mm RMS and the relative-rotation error over 180 rotation trials 0.34° RMS. On continuous trajectories, tracked and displayed in real time, the absolute tip error was 1.22mm (programmed) and 3.04mm (teleoperated) after post-hoc tuning of three filter parameters, and the full fusion beat every sensor subset. Because the estimator uses no magnetic measurement, its accuracy does not rely on an undisturbed field. The same clip-on device could thus record metric tip trajectories during routine hand-held laparoscopy, while displaying the insertion depth and attitude that are hidden once the instrument is inside the patient.

</details>


### [462] [CableVLA: Simulation-Privileged Global-Local Representation Learning for Cable Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25606)
*Zhifei Teng,Bo Feng,Xiang Zou,Jinpeng Xiao,Min Li,Zhouping Yin,Yiqun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CableVLA是一个端到端多模态视觉-语言-动作框架，将仿真特权监督蒸馏为可部署的线缆拓扑与触觉表征，在MuJoCo评测中将成功率从62.6%（π_0.5-V视觉基线）提升至84.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线缆布线需要全局线缆拓扑与局部接触变化的协同控制，而将仿真中的特权信息转化为可实际部署的表征是核心挑战。

Method: 提出CableVLA框架：TopoHead将节点级物理及当前/未来线缆拓扑信息蒸馏为因果视觉上下文，供动作专家使用；TacSense通过帧与taxel双分支从电阻阵列学习接触动力学，并以仿真器推导的运动学与接触事件作为超出实测力图的监督；接触门控激活力-触觉残差，用于精化冻结的拓扑条件策略的后续8步机械臂与夹爪动作。

Result: 在345次MuJoCo评测中，成功率由π_0.5-V视觉基线的62.6%提升至84.9%；TacSense在相似参数量下相比CNN-LSTM基线在滑动过渡识别上取得显著提升，且在冻结编码器探针下优势依然保持。

Conclusion: 拓扑预测与57项任务触觉评测验证了表征质量，策略自适应研究评估了下游控制性能，跨仿真器与实机比较进一步考察了动力学与传感变化下的零样本策略迁移能力。

Abstract: Cable routing requires coordinated control of global cable topology and changing local contacts. We present CableVLA, an end-to-end multimodal vision-language-action framework that converts simulation-privileged supervision into deployable cable-topology and tactile representations. TopoHead distills node-level physics and current and future cable-topology information into causal visual context for the action expert. TacSense uses complementary frame and taxel branches to learn contact dynamics from resistive arrays, with simulator-derived kinematics and contact events providing supervision beyond the measured force map. A contact gate activates force-tactile residuals that refine the next 8 arm-and-gripper actions of a frozen topology-conditioned policy. Across 345 MuJoCo evaluations, CableVLA improves success from 62.6% for the $π_{0.5}$-V visual baseline to 84.9%. TacSense achieves pronounced gains in slip-transition recognition over a CNN-LSTM baseline with a similar parameter count, and this advantage persists under frozen-encoder probes. Topology prediction and 57-task tactile evaluations assess representation quality, while policy adaptation studies evaluate downstream control performance. Cross-simulator and real-robot comparisons further examine zero-shot policy transfer under changes in dynamics and sensing.

</details>


### [463] [A Deployable Four-Finger Payload for Teleoperated Free-Flying Manipulation with Astrobee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25614)
*William Su,Jordan Kam,Yunosuke Nakamura,Yixiao Wang,Jianshu Zhou,Masayoshi Tomizuka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于舱内自由飞行器（Astrobee）的双臂遥操作流程，并设计了一种可展开的四指抓取载荷。该载荷通过线性导轨上的四个独立驱动手指提供17个操作自由度，借助VR界面将地面操作员的手部动作映射为手指对、指间距和腕部平移控制。在基于MuJoCo的ISS零重力仿真器中，通过10次搬运刚性货物转移袋的重复试验，评估了任务成功率、持续接触保持、完成时间和货物运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来低地球轨道（LEO）栖息地需要在载人与无人期间执行货物搬运、维护等常规任务，因此需要为舱内自由飞行器配备具备灵巧操作能力的系统，并实现有效的地面遥操作控制。

Method: 设计可展开四指抓取载荷，利用线性导轨上的四个独立驱动手指实现17个操作自由度；构建VR设备接口，将人类操作者的手部动作映射到手指对、手指间距（对应导轨）以及腕部共同运动（对应Astrobee平移）；在定制零重力MuJoCo的ISS仿真器中对Astrobee进行遥操作实验。

Result: 在10次重复的刚性ISS货物转移袋搬运试验中，测量了任务成功率、持续接触保持、任务完成时间以及货物运动等指标，并给出了初步遥操作结果。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了面向舱内自由飞行器的四指抓取载荷与VR双臂遥操作流程的可行性，为零重力环境下的舱内货物搬运与维护任务提供了初步实验依据。

Abstract: This article presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and conceptual design of a deployable four-finger payload for intra-vehicular free-flyers. Future habitats in low-Earth orbit (LEO) will require systems to perform mundane tasks like cargo handling and maintenance during crewed and uncrewed periods. The gripper payload provides 17 manipulation degrees-of-freedom (DoF) through four independently actuated fingers on a linear rail system. To control it, a virtual reality (VR) device interface maps the human ground operator's hand motions to the finger pairs, their separation to the rail, and common wrist motion to Astrobee translation. We present the preliminary results of teleoperating Astrobee in a custom zero-gravity MuJoCo-based International Space Station (ISS) simulator through ten repeated trials of transporting a rigid ISS Cargo Transfer Bag (CTB). We measure task success, continuous contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.

</details>


### [464] [Relative Contact Velocity-Controlled Hand-Object Mechanism for Dexterous Tool Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25619)
*Sunyu Wang,Jean Oh,Nancy S. Pollard*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作将手与工具建模为统一的"手-物机构"（HOM），提出轻量、物理可解释的运动规划与接触估计框架，使五种不同的多指机械手完成"抓取-装载-挥动"的完整工具操作流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注工具操作的单一环节（如抓取或使用），缺乏能够让通用多指机械手完成"拾取-装载为合适位姿-挥动"完整流程的统一方法；同时，不同机械手的运动学与几何差异使得同一方法难以跨手迁移。作者受人类工具操作与机械设计原理启发，希望建立与具体手部结构无关的统一建模与规划框架。

Method: 将手与工具建模为统一的"手-物机构"（HOM），由手、物体以及广义接触坐标系等子装配体构成。通过HOM定义，其运动可用同一组笛卡尔空间相对接触速度表达，不依赖手的运动学与几何。进一步将HOM的子装配体定义为手指间的相对接触速度与接触力约束。基于此定义，提出使用最小二乘与互补滤波器的轻量级、物理可解释的运动规划与接触估计框架。

Result: 在仿真中通过遥操作五种不同的机械手进行评测。结果显示，该框架使全部五种手都能完成完整的工具操作流程，即使在相同的、简单的参考轨迹下也能产生灵巧行为；同时结果体现了框架对不同手、工具和任务的适应性，这得益于其运动学与几何基础。

Conclusion: 以HOM统一建模并结合最小二乘与互补滤波，可构建与手部结构无关、轻量且物理可解释的工具操作框架，实现跨手、跨工具、跨任务的完整工具操作，为通用多指机械手的工具使用提供了可迁移方案。

Abstract: This work investigates how to enable general multi-finger robotic hands to perform the complete tool manipulation process, which entails picking up a tool, loading it into a suitable pose, and then wielding it. Inspired by human tool manipulation and mechanical design principles, we model the hand and the tool as a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) composed of sub-assemblies. Specifically, we define a HOM as consisting of the hand, the object, and the generalized contact frames, allowing the HOM's motions to be expressed with the same set of Cartesian-space relative contact velocities, irrespective of the hand's kinematics and geometry. Then, we define a HOM's sub-assemblies as relative contact velocity and contact force constraints between fingers. Building on these definitions, we developed a lightweight and physically interpretable motion planning and contact estimation framework using least squares and a complementary filter. We evaluated our framework in simulation by teleoperating five different robotic hands. The results show that our framework enabled all five hands to execute the complete tool manipulation process, achieving dexterous behaviors even from identical, simple reference trajectories. Furthermore, the results showcase our framework's adaptability to different hands, tools, and tasks, enabled by its kinematic and geometric foundation.

</details>


### [465] [From Instrument-Mounted Demonstrations to In-Vivo Execution: Learning Bimanual Laparoscopic Appendectomy Without Robot-Collected Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25625)
*Dongho Yee,Juahn Oh,Jinseok Lee,Jiyul Lee,Yechan Seo,Seong Jeong,Minsung Kim,Seonho Shim,Younghoon Noh,Hyuk Choi,Youngbin Kong,Kyu Eun Lee,Hyoun-Joong Kong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一套端到端流程：用安装在标准腹腔镜器械杆上的器械状态记录器（惯性、飞行时间、霍尔传感器）在手术室中采集外科医生的器械运动，经传感器延迟测量与通道对齐后形成观测-动作对，训练并选择扩散策略（微调DINOv3骨干），最终在活体兔子体内完成阑尾切除手术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术目前多使用手持腹腔镜器械，手术结束后器械运动学信息丢失，仅保留内窥镜视频；论文希望直接从外科医生自身器械中获取运动演示，用于训练手术机器人策略，而无需机器人收集演示。

Method: 1. 硬件：安装在标准腹腔镜器械杆上的器械状态记录器，从惯性传感器、飞行时间传感器和霍尔传感器恢复器械位姿与钳口状态，无需外部相机或追踪器。2. 数据流程：测量每个传感器通道相对于机器人真值的延迟并进行通道对齐，形成观测-动作对。3. 策略：在演示上训练带微调DINOv3骨干的扩散策略，通过基于离体兔阑尾深度图重建的物理模拟器进行闭环rollout进行设计选择。4. 在体：使用4只活体兔子的849条在体演示重新训练策略，并在另外4只活体兔子（电外科器械启用）上部署，由外科医生选择手术阶段。

Result: 在4只活体兔子中，策略在3只上完成了阑尾切除手术。机器人仅作为传感器校准的时序参考和执行器，不收集任何演示。两套演示语料库均已公开，以支持未来手术机器人学习研究。

Conclusion: 结果表明，从外科医生自己器械上记录的演示足以训练、选择并在体内部署双臂手术策略；机器人无需采集演示，仅用于时序参考与执行。公开的演示数据集可推动手术机器人学习研究。

Abstract: Most minimally invasive surgery is still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, and the surgeon's instrument kinematics are lost when the operation ends; only the endoscope video is kept. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that captures this motion in the operating room and uses it to train a surgical robot policy, validated on live animals. We introduce a surgical instrument-state logger that mounts on the shaft of a standard laparoscopic instrument and recovers its pose and jaw state from an inertial sensor, a time-of-flight sensor and a Hall sensor, with no external camera or tracker. A data pipeline measures the latency of every sensor channel against a robot ground truth and aligns the channels before forming observation-action pairs. On these demonstrations we train a diffusion policy with a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone, selecting its design by closed-loop rollouts in a physics simulator reconstructed from depth maps of an ex-vivo rabbit appendix. The policy is then retrained on 849 in-vivo demonstrations from four live rabbits and deployed on four additional live rabbits with electrosurgery armed. With the surgeon selecting the surgical phase, the policy completed the appendectomy in three of the four animals. The results show that demonstrations recorded from a surgeon's own instruments are sufficient to train, select and deploy a bimanual surgical policy in vivo. The robot serves only as the timing reference for sensor calibration and as the executor, and collects no demonstrations. Both demonstration corpora are released to support future surgical robot learning research.

</details>


### [466] [MachEmbodied-U0: Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25627)
*Haoran Wen,Wenfu Wang,Kunsong Shi,Jingke Wang,Wancheng Feng,Yiren Zhang,Yueran Zhao,Xuancheng Zhang,Nanfei Ye,Xingru Chen,Zhaohong Sun,Chengmin Yang,Zikang Yu,Penghao Bi,Jia Shi,Yu Liu,Kun Zhan,Yan Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一具身基础模型 ME-U0，通过 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构连接理解与生成专家，结合子任务预测、可供性接地与多模态视觉动力学（RGB/深度/法向/光流）进行流匹配联合建模，在多基准与真实机器人任务上取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人控制需同时具备任务意图理解、交互位置识别、场景演化建模与精细动作生成能力。现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）语义先验强但缺乏显式场景动力学建模；世界-动作模型虽耦合视觉预测与控制，却未暴露细粒度操作所需的任务相关语义与空间结构，二者难以兼顾。

Method: ME-U0 采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构统一理解专家与生成专家。以子任务预测与可供性接地作为引导信号，通过 flow matching 联合生成视觉动力学与动作。视觉动力学涵盖未来 RGB、深度、表面法线与光流，提供外观、几何与运动的互补监督。引入多速率旋转位置编码（MRPE）对齐视觉动力学与精细控制。预训练使用约 4,200 小时机器人数据与第一人称数据。

Result: 仅使用各下游基准原生监督条件下，RoboDojo 仿真基准平均得分 17.66；LIBERO 平均成功率 99.0%，LIBERO-Plus 为 82.5%。在真实世界机器人操作任务上验证有效，并展示零样本子任务预测、可供性接地与视觉动力学能力。

Conclusion: ME-U0 在仿真与真实环境中兼具竞争力的下游控制性能与可迁移的任务接地及视觉动力学能力，为统一具身基础模型提供了有效范式。

Abstract: General-purpose robot control requires models to understand task intent, identify where to interact, capture how the scene evolves, and generate precise actions. Vision-language-action models provide strong semantic priors but typically do not explicitly model scene dynamics, while world-action models couple visual prediction with control without necessarily exposing the task-relevant semantic and spatial structure needed for fine-grained manipulation. We present MachEmbodied-U0 (ME-U0), a unified embodied foundation model connecting understanding and generation experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Subtask prediction and affordance grounding guide joint visual-dynamics and action generation via flow matching. Visual dynamics encompass future RGB, depth, surface normals, and optical flow, providing complementary supervision for appearance, geometry, and motion. Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) aligns visual dynamics with fine-grained control. We pretrain ME-U0 on approximately 4,200 hours of curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets. Using only the supervision natively available in each downstream benchmark, ME-U0 achieves an average score of 17.66 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and average success rates of 99.0\% and 82.5\% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, respectively. We additionally validate ME-U0 on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond simulation. Without corresponding downstream supervision, ME-U0 further demonstrates zero-shot subtask prediction, affordance grounding, and visual dynamics on simulated and real-world observations. Overall, ME-U0 combines competitive downstream control performance with transferable task-grounding and visual-dynamics capabilities across simulation and the real world.

</details>


### [467] [PAKT: Physically-Aligned Kinesthetic Teaching for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25630)
*Lars Johannsmeier,Yashraj Narang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出PAKT框架，将工业界广泛使用的动觉示教（kinesthetic teaching）引入强化学习，通过导纳控制采集符合机器人与策略物理约束的示教轨迹，并配合参考生成器与阻抗控制器构成的高性能控制栈，在四个插入与工业装配基准上将周期时间缩短23%-48%、累计干预次数减少62%-86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实强化学习系统在接触密集的工业操作中仍难以满足微米级精度、99%以上成功率和接近人类水平的周期时间等要求。现有off-policy方法虽可借助示教与干预提升性能，但缺乏直观的示教接口，且难以同时满足物理系统与策略本身的约束。

Method: PAKT以动觉引导为核心：操作者通过导纳控制施加人力驱动机械臂运动，将人施加的力映射为运动；下游参考生成器施加与策略执行阶段相同的运动学限制（如速度、加速度、jerk），保证采集轨迹处于可行范围内。为支撑该示教接口，PAKT引入高性能控制栈，将低频RL动作映射为高频力矩指令，包含参考生成器与随后的阻抗控制器，在保持阻抗控制器跟踪性能的同时改善接触处理并生成更平滑的策略动作。

Result: 在四个插入与工业装配基准（含数据中心计算托盘）的实验中，端到端系统相比HIL-SERL基线将周期时间缩短23%-48%，累计干预次数减少62%-86%。

Conclusion: PAKT表明，将工业界成熟的动觉示教与RL执行层结合，并强制示教轨迹服从策略与硬件约束，可有效提升接触密集工业操作任务的效率与自主性。

Abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) systems still struggle with the demands of contact-rich industrial manipulation, including micrometer-level precision, success rates above 99%, and human-level cycle times. Although off-policy algorithms can improve performance by leveraging demonstrations and interventions, a key bottleneck is the lack of an intuitive interface for collecting such guidance while complying with constraints of the physical system and the policy. We propose PAKT, a framework for kinesthetic teaching in RL. As opposed to teleoperation approaches, PAKT relies on kinesthetic guidance, which is widely used in industry. However, a critical weakness of kinesthetic guidance is the possibility for the operator to move the robot along trajectories (e.g., velocities, accelerations, jerk) that the robot and/or policy cannot physically reproduce. Using PAKT, operators guide the robot through admittance control, which maps human-applied forces to motion. The downstream reference generator applies the same kinematic limits used during policy execution, keeping the collected trajectories within these limits. To support this teaching interface with an appropriate execution layer, PAKT adds a high-performance control stack that maps low-frequency RL actions to high-frequency torque commands. It consists of a reference generator and subsequent impedance controller, where the reference generator preserves the tracking performance of the impedance controller while improving contact handling and producing smoother policy actions. Across the reported runs on four insertion and industrial assembly benchmarks, including a data center compute tray, the end-to-end system reduces cycle time by 23%-48% and cumulative intervention count by 62%-86% relative to the HIL-SERL baseline. Project website: https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website}{https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website

</details>


### [468] [DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25631)
*Yiyang Jin,Yu Zheng,Xiao He,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DynaForge：规划引导的残差修正框架，用于生成高质量动态操作演示，并在仿真与真实任务上大幅超越DOMINO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态物体操作对真实环境机器人至关重要，但高质量演示生成方法有限。静态任务方法难以迁移；规划类方法在接触附近易失败；DOMINO式回放简化了动态交互，限制了策略学习可用的经验。

Method: DynaForge采用规划引导框架学习残差修正：结合低频全局规划与高频以物体为中心的逆运动学，按任务阶段切换；用残差策略在动态交互中修正动作；通过隐式课程将匹配条件下的rollout分组，选择混合成功组，把残差强化学习聚焦于能力前沿。

Result: Can和Bottle任务上以0.73倍优化器步数达到高于vanilla GRPO的最终成功率；9个仿真任务演示生成平均成功率从41.30%提升至78.37%；每任务800条演示训练的DP3策略平均成功率49.11%，DOMINO仅7.07%；3个真实动态任务上策略成功率30-60%，DOMINO为0-10%。

Conclusion: DynaForge能有效生成高质量动态操作演示，显著提升下游策略性能并展现仿真到真实的迁移能力。

Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation is essential for robots operating in real-world environments, yet methods for generating high-quality demonstrations remain limited. Methods designed for static tasks do not readily transfer to dynamic settings. Among dynamic demonstration generators, planning-based methods can fail near contact, while DOMINO-style replay simplifies dynamic interactions and may limit the experience available for policy learning. We present DynaForge, a planning-guided framework that learns residual corrections for dynamic manipulation demonstration generation. DynaForge combines low-frequency global planning with high-frequency object-centric inverse kinematics across task phases, and applies a residual policy to correct actions during dynamic interaction. An implicit curriculum groups rollouts under matched conditions and selects mixed-success groups, focusing residual reinforcement learning on the evolving competence frontier. On Can and Bottle, it uses 0.73x as many optimizer steps as vanilla GRPO at the same nominal environment-step budget, with higher observed final success rates. Across nine simulation tasks, DynaForge increases mean demonstration-generation success from 41.30% of the planning prior to 78.37%. With 800 demonstrations per task, DP3 policies trained on DynaForge data achieve 49.11% mean success, compared with 7.07% for DOMINO data. On three real-world dynamic tasks, DynaForge-trained policies achieve 30-60% success, compared with 0-10% for DOMINO-trained policies, showing the ability of DynaForge for sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [469] [RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25636)
*Chang Guo,Yukun Xie,Bohan Tan,Zheng Chang,Zhaokai Yin,Qianli Ma,Yingqiao Wang,Chao Liang,Zhipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboFollow 诊断基准，揭示具身智能体高成功率背后的"指令跟随幻觉"，根源在于场景熵过低使语言冗余，导致策略得分虚高。基准通过高场景熵、四层级诊断协议（L0-L3）和混淆控制诊断三原则，隔离语言理解与运动执行，评测九个 VLA/WAM 策略发现高分无法迁移到高难度层级，现有缓解手段均无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体虽报告高成功率，但实际指令跟随能力远弱于该数值。作者将这一"幻觉"归因于结构性问题——低场景熵：当视觉场景仅支持唯一有效任务时，语言变得冗余，策略可在几乎不使用语言的情况下获得高分。因此需要一个能真正考验语言依赖性的诊断基准。

Method: 提出 RoboFollow 诊断基准，遵循三原则：(1) 高场景熵——每个训练场景支持多个运动学上不同的任务分支，仅靠视觉不足，迫使依赖语言；(2) 分层诊断协议——L0-L3 四级，逐步扰动视觉布局与语义，检验等效指令是否产生一致行为、不同指令是否产生可区分行为（覆盖空间关系、属性、轨迹约束、逻辑）；(3) 混淆控制诊断——简化交互物体、限制动作空间至训练集，并分阶段报告 Intent 与 Execution 分数，将语言理解从运动执行中隔离。

Result: 在九个 VLA 与 WAM 策略上评测，即使部分策略取得强 L0 表现，在该微调设置下也无法可靠迁移至 L1-L3。代表性缓解手段——更强的 VLM 骨干、QA 协同训练、LangForce、Classifier-Free Guidance——均无法弥合该差距。

Conclusion: RoboFollow 揭示真正的指令跟随是当前具身智能体关键且被忽视的瓶颈。代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive success rates, yet their actual instruction-following ability is far weaker than these numbers suggest. We trace this illusion to a structural property we term low scene entropy: when a visual scene admits only one valid task, language becomes redundant and a policy can score highly while barely using it. We introduce RoboFollow, a diagnostic benchmark with three principles: (1) High Scene Entropy: each training scene supports multiple kinematically distinct task branches, making vision alone insufficient and forcing reliance on language. (2) Hierarchical Diagnostic Protocol: a four-level protocol (L0--L3) progressively perturbs visual layout and semantics, probing whether equivalent instructions yield consistent behavior and distinct ones yield discriminable behavior across spatial relations, attributes, trajectory constraints, and logic. (3) Confound-Controlled Diagnosis: we simplify interaction objects, restrict actions to the trained repertoire and report stage-wise Intent and Execution scores, isolating comprehension from motor execution. Evaluation of nine VLA and WAM policies shows that strong L0 performance, where attained, does not reliably transfer to L1--L3 under our fine-tuning setup. Representative mitigations, including stronger VLM backbones, QA co-training, LangForce, and Classifier-Free Guidance, all fail to close this gap. RoboFollow exposes genuine instruction following as a critical, overlooked bottleneck. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboFollow and https://huggingface.co/datasets/AutoLab-SJTU/robofollow-data.

</details>


### [470] [A Reconfigurable Bidirectional Cable-Driven Hip Exoskeleton with Swappable Bench/Backpack Dual-configuration Actuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25639)
*YuanLong Ji,Shuhan Xiang,Qihan Ye,Xingbang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可重构双向线驱髋关节外骨骼平台，通过共享同一无线缆可穿戴髋部接口，实现台式（康复评估）与背包式（移动辅助）驱动配置的快速切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室康复评估与系统开发需要大量驱动与算力资源，而移动辅助则要求无缆便携。如何在同一可复用平台上集成这两种能力是核心设计难题。

Method: 平台模块化适配驱动配置、末端执行器传感路径与底层控制接口；每个线驱末端执行器重0.405 kg（不含线缆与驱动单元），集成编码器与力矩传感器。实验验证了台式基于导纳的运动跟踪能力与背包式开环力矩跟踪；3名健康受试者佩戴myoMOTION评估可穿戴侧髋部运动感知能力，并完成30次台式—背包及背包—台式运动就绪切换测试，构建小规模多模态可穿戴—外骨骼步态数据集（台式跑步机8 min、背包户外步行11 min）。

Result: 验证了台式导纳运动跟踪与背包式开环力矩跟踪；切换耗时30.1±16.3 s（30次试验）；形成8 min台式与11 min背包式多模态步态数据集。

Conclusion: 通过统一可穿戴结构、驱动接口与传感路径，该平台使同一髋关节外骨骼可在台式与背包式配置下验证，为跨场景的迭代开发与应用提供可复用硬件。

Abstract: Hip exoskeletons provide an important hardware basis for lower-limb rehabilitation and locomotor assistance. Laboratory rehabilitation assessment and system development require substantial actuation and computing resources, whereas mobile assistance requires untethered portability. Integrating both capabilities within one reusable platform remains a central design challenge. This paper presents a reconfigurable bidirectional cable-driven hip exoskeleton platform that rapidly switches between bench-mounted and backpack-mounted actuation while sharing one cable-free wearable hip interface. The platform modularly adapts the actuation configuration, end-effector sensing path, and low-level control interface. Each cable-driven end-effector weighs 0.405 kg, excluding the cable and actuation unit, and integrates an encoder and a torque sensor; experiments validated bench-mounted admittance-based motion tracking capability and backpack-mounted open-loop torque tracking. Human-worn experiments with three healthy participants used myoMOTION to evaluate the platform's wearable-side hip-motion sensing capability, verified bench-to-backpack and backpack-to-bench motion-ready switching across 30 trials in $30.1\pm16.3$ s, and formed a small-scale multimodal wearable-exoskeleton gait dataset for sensing validation and data-driven algorithm development, comprising 8 min bench-mounted treadmill records and 11 min backpack-mounted outdoor walking records. These results show that, by unifying the wearable structure, actuation interface, and sensing path, the proposed platform enables validation of the same hip exoskeleton in both bench-mounted and backpack-mounted configurations, providing reusable hardware for iterative development and applications across scenarios.

</details>


### [471] [Contact-Stable Deformable Tissue Simulation Using Implicit Integration and Live-Pose Grasp Constraints for Laparoscopic Surgery Robot Policy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25642)
*Juahn Oh,Dongho Yee,Jinseok Lee,Jiyul Lee,Yechan Seo,Seong Jeong,Minsung Kim,Seonho Shim,Younghoon Noh,Hyuk Choi,Youngbin Kong,Hyoun-Joong Kon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个由单视角RGB-D手术野录像重建可变形组织、并用于手术机器人闭环评估的仿真器，核心是保证双臂操作单元稳定性的数值与接触设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术机器人闭环评估需要能变形、可抓取提拉、并还原真实解剖结构的组织模型；真实组织实验成本高、可重复性差，而现有仿真缺乏面向闭环控制的稳定接触与抓取设计。

Method: 从固定视角RGB-D记录重建手术野组织：合成去除器械、封闭为水密体、四面体化（流程对两物种三标本十三器官原样应用，146,061个四面体，无反转单元）。将器官置于双臂操作单元，两台Franka FR3通过6 mm戳卡驱动电动器械。核心为数值与接触设计：隐式积分、仿真网格与碰撞网格分离、数值保护机制，以及在活体组织位姿下捕获的抓取约束（对比静息位姿约束）。

Result: 45次重复抓取-提拉中，摩擦抓取15次全部失败，约束抓取每次成功13/15；在位移组织上，静息位姿约束产生最高17.8 mm的单步跳变，活体位姿捕获可消除该跳变。与录像对比：前表面深度误差1.33–1.41 mm，器官轮廓IoU 0.80；五次由视频复现的抓取-提拉中，特征点位移RMSE为11.8 mm，静态预测为14.2 mm。

Conclusion: 该环境面向闭环可行性、安全性、接触与策略筛选，不宣称生物保真度。

Abstract: Closed-loop evaluation of surgical robots requires tissue that deforms, can be grasped and lifted, and reproduces the anatomy in which the robot will operate. We present a simulator in which this tissue is reconstructed from a fixed-view RGB-D recording of the surgical field, composited to remove the instruments, closed into watertight volumes and tetrahedralised; the pipeline was applied unchanged to three specimens of two species (thirteen organs, 146,061 tetrahedra, no inverted elements). For one specimen, the organs are placed in a bimanual cell in which two Franka FR3 arms operate motorised instruments through 6 mm trocars. The core contribution is the numerical and contact design that keeps this cell stable: implicit integration, simulation meshes separate from collision meshes, numerical guards, and a grasp constraint captured at the live tissue pose. In 45 repeated grasp-lifts, a friction grasp held the tissue in 0 of 15 trials and each constraint grasp in 13 of 15; on displaced tissue, a rest-pose constraint produced one-step snaps of up to 17.8 mm, which live-pose capture eliminates. Against the recording, front-surface depth error is 1.33 to 1.41 mm, organ silhouette IoU is 0.80, and in five grasp-lifts reproduced from video the landmark displacement RMSE is 11.8 mm against 14.2 mm for a static prediction. Biofidelity is not claimed; the environment is intended for closed-loop feasibility, safety, contact and policy screening.

</details>


### [472] [Skill Sequence Planning for Collaborative Multi-Robot Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25649)
*Xi Wang,Bo Fu,Carol C. Menassa,Vineet R. Kamat,Min Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种技能序列规划方法，使异构多功能机器人团队利用可复用预编程技能协作完成建造装配，通过构造关系图驱动符号规划与几何运动规划，并经数字孪生人机审批后执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人虽在建造流程自动化上潜力巨大，但工业落地受限，主要原因是需针对多样任务进行大量编程适配。作者希望减少为每种任务变体单独编程机器人的负担，从而支持协作机器人团队在建造中的更灵活部署。

Method: 核心方法为技能序列规划：中央控制器将建筑的数字表示转换为构造关系图，表达建造实体、其状态及父子关系；基于该表示选择下一个建造目标，为具备能力的机器人成员生成符号化的技能序列（如抓取、钻孔、紧固等可复用预编程技能），并生成无碰撞的几何运动规划以执行技能。随着建造状态变化，符号规划问题动态再生成。交互式数字孪生向人类协作者展示所规划技能序列与机器人状态，供执行前审阅与批准。

Result: 通过一个建造装配案例研究对该方法进行了评估，验证了其可行性。

Conclusion: 该方法降低了为每个任务变体分别编程机器人的需求，从而支持协作机器人团队在建造场景中更灵活地部署。

Abstract: Robots have significant potential to automate construction processes. However, their industry adoption remains limited, partly because of the programming effort required to adapt robots to diverse tasks. This paper presents a skill sequence planning method that enables a heterogeneous team of multi-functional robots to collaboratively perform construction assembly work using reusable, preprogrammed skills such as grasping, drilling, and fastening. A central controller transforms the digital representation of the building into a construction relationship graph that represents construction entities, their states, and their parent-child relationships. Based on this representation, the system selects the next construction target, generates a symbolic sequence of skills for capable members of the robot team, and produces collision-free geometric motion plans for skill execution. The symbolic planning problem is dynamically regenerated as the construction state changes. An interactive digital twin presents the planned skill sequence and robot states to human co-workers for review and approval before execution. The method is evaluated through a construction assembly case study. By reducing the need to program robots separately for each task variation, the proposed approach supports more flexible deployment of collaborative robot teams in construction.

</details>


### [473] [PhyVisGen: Physically and Visually High-Fidelity Robotic Manipulation Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25653)
*Yu Zheng,Qiyu Feng,Yixin Wu,Baoquan Yang,Yixuan Zhou,Bingyang Hu,Kemeng Huang,Guansheng Yang,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhyVisGen：物理与视觉高保真的机器人操作数据生成框架，用IPC实现软体夹爪高保真接触，结合真实场景重建与实时路径追踪生成逼真观测；纯合成数据训练的策略在五项真实机器人任务上达65-95%成功率，无需真实演示或微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模操作演示数据对学习鲁棒的视觉运动策略至关重要，但真实数据采集成本高、难以规模化。仿真虽可替代，却存在物理与视觉差异，制约合成数据的可迁移性，软体夹爪操作尤为突出。

Method: 物理侧：提出基于增量势接触（IPC）的机械臂-夹爪耦合方法，在完整操作轨迹中实现高保真软体接触。视觉侧：结合真实场景重建与实时路径追踪，生成视觉逼真观测并保留所采集场景的外观。

Result: 定量评估验证了PhyVisGen的物理与视觉保真度；仅用合成操作演示训练的策略在五项真实机器人任务上取得65-95%成功率，且不使用真实机器人演示数据、不做策略微调。

Conclusion: PhyVisGen通过提升物理与视觉保真度，实现了可扩展的机器人操作数据生成，并展示了合成数据到真实机器人的有效直接迁移，为规模化策略学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large-scale manipulation demonstrations are essential for learning robust visuomotor policies, yet real-world data collection is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation offers a promising alternative, but physical and visual discrepancies can limit the transferability of synthetic data, particularly for manipulation with soft grippers. We present PhyVisGen, a physically and visually high-fidelity framework for scalable robotic manipulation data generation. On the physical side, PhyVisGen introduces an arm-gripper coupling method based on the Incremental Potential Contact (IPC), enabling high-fidelity soft contact throughout complete manipulation trajectories. On the visual side, it combines real-scene reconstruction with real-time path tracing to generate visually realistic observations while preserving captured scene appearance. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate the physical and visual fidelity of PhyVisGen. Policies trained exclusively on synthetic manipulation demonstrations achieve 65-95% success across five real-robot tasks, without real-robot demonstration data or policy fine-tuning.

</details>


### [474] [CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25654)
*Dongwon Son,Junhyek Han,Yoontae Cho,Minseok Lee,Hong-seok Choi,Jiwook Choi,Hyungjin Kim,Beomjoon Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CODA是一种生成式模型，从单张未分割RGB-D图像重建完整场景几何，再分解为环境与可移动物体，并通过两种3D接地机制保持与观测点云一致，在重建精度与物理稳定性上优于对象优先和场景优先基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在杂乱的日常环境中安全运行，通常需要从部分观测中推断场景几何。现有方法（先在2D中检测物体再独立重建）在杂乱场景中存在明显缺陷：漏检物体无法被重建、合并检测会将两个物体融合、独立重建的网格可能相互重叠或未能接触支撑面。因此需要一种能先完整重建场景几何再分解的方法。

Method: 提出CODA（Complete Once, Decompose Afterward）生成式模型：输入单张未分割RGB-D图像，先重建完整场景几何，再将表面分离为周围环境与可移动物体。为减少生成几何与观测部分点云之间的漂移，CODA引入两种显式3D接地机制（3D grounding mechanisms），在补全未见区域的同时保持重建几何与观测表面一致。

Result: 在HomebrewedDB和自建杂乱场景数据集上的实验表明，CODA相比对象优先（object-first）和场景优先（scene-first）基线，重建更准确，且在模拟重力下保持原位的物体比例更高。

Conclusion: 先完整重建场景几何、再进行物体分解的“先完整、后分解”范式，配合显式3D接地机制，能有效缓解杂乱场景中漏检、融合与网格重叠等问题，提升重建精度与物理合理性，为机器人安全操作提供更可靠的场景几何推断。

Abstract: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene dataset show more accurate reconstructions and a higher fraction of objects remaining in place under simulated gravity than both object-first and scene-first baselines.

</details>


### [475] [History-Conditioned Flow Matching for Probabilistic Dynamics of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25658)
*Hang Yang,Tingcong Liu,Junjie Xiong,Fangju Yang,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种历史条件化、物理信息驱动的流匹配（flow-matching）框架，用于肌腱驱动机器人连续体的概率动力学预测，在仿真与实物上均优于CVAE与扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌腱驱动连续体机器人的确定性动力学建模困难，源于材料行为、肌腱传动、摩擦与接触的不确定性；实测关节构型与名义肌腱指令无法完整刻画这些内部力学因素，导致后续运动存在不确定性，因此需要概率化的动力学预测方法。

Method: 构建历史条件化、物理信息驱动的流匹配框架：以运动历史与驱动历史为条件，预测下一完整关节构型的分布；在给定指令下递归采样下一时刻构型，从而预测未来全身运动的分布。并设计消融实验验证历史条件与结构条件的作用。

Result: 仿真中场景专用模型在内部摩擦变化下五秒轨迹Energy Score为12.05 mm，在未观测驱动扰动下为9.29 mm；相比条件变分自编码器与扩散基线，Flow获得更低的Energy Score且覆盖率更接近名义水平。实物机器人上，对训练中未包含的两种肌腱指令曲线，五秒Energy Score分别为11.91与11.42 mm，低于对比基线；预测与实测离散度比值为1.65与1.22（越接近1越好）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在机械观测不完整的情况下，历史条件化的概率动力学预测是可行且有效的，流匹配在精度与不确定性覆盖上均优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Deterministic dynamics modeling of tendon-driven continuum robots remains challenging owing to uncertainties in material behavior, tendon transmission, friction, and contact. Measured joint configurations and nominal tendon commands do not fully characterize these internal mechanical factors, leaving uncertainty in the subsequent motion. We therefore develop a history-conditioned, physics-informed flow-matching framework for probabilistic dynamics prediction, using motion and actuation histories to predict the distribution of the next complete joint configuration. By recursively sampling next-step configurations under prescribed commands, the model predicts distributions of future whole-body motions. In simulation, scenario-specific models achieve five-second trajectory Energy Scores (lower is better) of 12.05 mm under internal friction variation and 9.29 mm under unobserved actuation disturbances. Relative to the conditional variational autoencoder and diffusion baselines, Flow attains lower Energy Scores and coverage closer to the nominal level in both scenarios. Ablations support history and structural conditioning in both scenarios. On the physical robot, predictions under two tendon-command profiles excluded from training capture the principal motion sequences, with five-second Energy Scores of 11.91 and 11.42 mm, lower than the compared baselines. The predicted-to-measured spread ratios are 1.65 and 1.22 (closer to 1 is better). These results support history-conditioned probabilistic dynamics prediction under incomplete mechanical observations.

</details>


### [476] [Deploying Foundation Models for Embodied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25666)
*Vishnu Sashank Dorbala,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对基础模型在具身导航智能体部署中的两个问题：训练偏差导致在新环境个性化不佳，以及上下文长度受限影响长时任务。作者提出TAP（用场景挖掘的人类习惯数据先验引导FM）和MemCtrl（通过“memory head”增强的主动记忆管理）。TAP在真实实验室环境平均提升18%；MemCtrl跨任务平均提升6%，长指令子集提升20%，且仅用约一半上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决基础模型部署于具身导航智能体时的两个核心限制：一是训练偏差导致在新环境中的个性化能力差；二是有限的上下文长度使长时程任务难以成功。作者先给出相关文献的分类体系以凸显这些局限。

Method: 提出两种方法：Transit-Aware Planning（TAP），通过从场景中挖掘人类习惯数据来为FM提供先验（priming）；MemCtrl，通过一种新的“memory head”增强实现主动记忆管理，以缓解上下文长度限制。

Result: TAP在真实实验室环境中使用Turtlebot进行个性化目标寻找，较非TAP基线平均提升18%；MemCtrl在多种具身任务上平均提升6%，在长指令子集上提升20%，同时上下文用量约为基线的一半。

Conclusion: 基于上述结果，作者表明对FM驱动具身智能体在真实环境可部署性的立场，并指出开放的后续研究方向。

Abstract: We present and tackle two problems associated with deploying Foundation Models (FMs) on Embodied Agents performing navigation: 1) Training bias in FMs leading to poor personalization in unseen environments, and 2) Limited FM context length hindering success, especially on long horizon tasks. Our solution for the former involves priming the FM with human-habit data mined from the scene and our solution for the latter involves active memory management via a novel `memory head' augmentation. We first present a taxonomy of existing literature on FM-based Embodied Navigation, and highlight these limitations. We then present our approaches, Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) and MemCtrl to address the limitations. With TAP, we present real-world results in a lab environment with a Turtlebot for personalized target finding that shows an average improvement of 18% over a non-TAP baseline. On MemCtrl, we report a 6% average improvement across various embodied tasks, with 20% on long instruction subsets, all while using nearly half the context used in the baseline model. Motivated by these result, we present our stance the deployability of FM-based embodied agents in real-world environments, and highlight open research directions.

</details>


### [477] [CDKF-Track: Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering for Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25668)
*Maria Damanaki,Nikos Piperigkos,Alexandros Gkillas,Aris S. Lalos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CDKF-Track，一种面向协同3D多目标跟踪的聚类感知数据驱动卡尔曼滤波框架，联合解决检测级融合冗余与运动建模问题，在V2V4Real数据集上跟踪精度最高提升27.99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单智能体MOT在遮挡、传感器噪声与场景理解不完整等复杂场景下性能受限；多智能体系统虽通过信息共享提升鲁棒性，却引入冗余观测导致错误数据关联，且难以建模非线性目标运动。因此需同时应对检测级融合冗余与运动建模两大问题。

Method: 1）基于图拉普拉斯（Graph Laplacian）公式融合多车3D LiDAR检测；2）聚类感知冗余抑制方案，将空间相关检测分组并选取代表性观测以减少重复输入；3）数据驱动卡尔曼滤波，从数据中学习目标运动动态，降低对预设线性运动假设的依赖；4）基于小波的时间细化模块，利用多分辨率分解抑制短期位置波动、提升轨迹连续性。

Result: 在真实世界V2V4Real数据集上，CDKF-Track相较最先进的多智能体MOT方法，跟踪精度最高提升27.99%。

Conclusion: CDKF-Track是首个在协同3D MOT中同时处理检测级融合冗余与可学习运动建模的框架，验证了聚类感知冗余抑制与数据驱动滤波相结合的优越性。

Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is essential for EdgeAI perception systems, where accurate object localization and reliable identification enable safe decision-making. Singleagent MOT suffers from occlusions, sensor noise, and partial scene understanding in complex real-world scenarios. While multi-agent systems improve robustness by exploiting shared information, they introduce redundant measurements that lead to false data associations, and still struggle to capture nonlinear object dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose CDKFTrack, a Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering framework for Cooperative 3D MOT. The proposed method first fuses multivehicle 3D LiDAR detections through a Graph Laplacian-based formulation. Then, a cluster-aware redundancy reduction scheme groups spatially related detections and selects representative observations to reduce duplicate inputs to the tracker. The resulting detections are processed by a data-driven Kalman filter that learns object motion dynamics from data, reducing dependence on predefined linear motion assumptions. Furthermore, a wavelet-based temporal refinement module leverages the multiresolution decomposition property of wavelets to attenuate shortterm positional fluctuations and improve trajectory continuity. To the best of our knowledge, CDKF-Track is the first framework to jointly address detection-level fusion redundancy and learnable motion modeling in cooperative 3D MOT. Experimental results on the real-world V2V4Real dataset indicate that CDKF-Track achieves up to 27.99% improvements in tracking accuracy over state-of-the-art multi-agent MOT methods.

</details>


### [478] [Teaching Reinforcement Learning and Humanoid Robotics to High-School Students: An Expert-Validated Curriculum Design on a Low-Cost Open Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25674)
*Yuanzhe Dong,Jie Cao,Shuman Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个以共享机器人项目为组织核心的整合式机器人课程框架，包含并行学科轨道、依赖排序、仿真与硬件渐进整合、分层考核点及团队与个人责任平衡机制，并通过高中人形机器人课程示例与五位专家评审验证其设计合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本开源机器人与强化学习仿真工具为中学生接触现代机器人创造了机会，但将涵盖机械装配、电气搭建、仿真、策略学习、系统辨识与实物部署的完整研究流程转化为适合初学者的连贯课程仍然困难。

Method: 采用迭代设计过程，构建围绕共享机器人实物的整合式课程框架，包含并行学科轨道、基于技术依赖的排序、仿真与硬件的渐进整合、分层性能检查点以及协作与个人问责的平衡结构；通过一个高中课程实例展示该框架，学生成对组装开源人形机器人、在仿真中训练行走策略并部署到实体平台；同时由机器人研究、工程、中学STEM教育与课程设计领域的五位专家进行形成性评审。

Result: 专家反馈揭示了三个核心设计张力：真实性与认知负荷、系统集成与及时可见进展、团队构建与个人问责。这些张力指导了最终框架的形成。

Conclusion: 该工作为将机器人研究流程转化为跨学科中学课程提供了结构化方法，未来仍需课堂研究来检验实施效果与学生学习成效。

Abstract: Lower cost open source robots and reinforcement learning (RL) simulation tools create new opportunities for precollege students to engage with contemporary robotics. However, translating a complete research workflow, spanning mechanical assembly, electrical setup, simulation, policy learning, system identification, and physical deployment, into a coherent course for novice learners remains challenging. We present an integrated robotics course framework that organizes these activities around a shared robotic artifact. The framework combines parallel disciplinary tracks, sequencing based on technical dependencies, progressive integration of simulation and hardware, layered performance checkpoints, and structures for balancing collaborative work with individual accountability. We illustrate the framework through a high school curriculum organized around a robot project in which pairs of students assemble an open source humanoid robot, train a walking policy in simulation, and deploy it on the physical platform. The framework was developed through an iterative design process that included formative review by five experts in robotics research, engineering, secondary STEM education, and curriculum design. Expert feedback highlighted three central design tensions: authenticity versus cognitive load, system integration versus timely visible progress, and team construction versus individual accountability. These tensions informed the final framework presented in this paper. This work offers a structured approach for adapting robotics research workflows into interdisciplinary precollege courses; future classroom studies are needed to examine implementation and student learning.

</details>


### [479] [SG-CPG: Severity-Gated Central Pattern Generators for Adaptive Quadruped Locomotion under Continuous Actuator Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25687)
*Adarsh Kumar Kosta,Kaushik Roy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 受动物肢体无力时"卸载患肢、重协调其余腿、随损伤程度分级适应"的启发，提出SG-CPG：在冻结健康CPG策略基础上加入严重度驱动的残差门与幅度门，实现四足机器人在执行器渐进退化下的持续运动，仿真与真机均验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物在肢体力量部分丧失时未必切换到新步态，而是卸载患肢、重新协调其余肢体，并按损伤严重度分级缩放响应，使运动得以延续而非在"健康"与"失效"间离散跳变。作者希望借鉴这一分级适应机制，让四足机器人面对渐进式执行器退化时，无需把故障当作离散失效处理，仍能保持健康步态策略运行。

Method: 提出SG-CPG（Severity-Gated CPG）：保留一个冻结的健康中枢模式发生器（CPG）策略，并引入两个由损伤严重度驱动的门控——残差门（residual gate）重新协调四条腿，幅度门（amplitude gate）随退化程度逐步缩短受损腿的步幅。通过两种机制模拟渐进退化：降低关节力矩上限（ceiling mechanism）与缩放底层控制器增益（gain mechanism）。在Unitree Go2上进行仿真，并在真实Go2上验证。消融实验分别移除残差门、残差门的严重度观测、幅度门以评估各路径贡献。

Result: 仿真中，在95%关节力量损失下，SG-CPG在全方位指令调度下保持trot步态、存活率100%，且指令跟踪误差在8%以内。在降低力矩上限情形下，当损失达80%时，移除任一严重度路径（残差门的严重度观测或幅度门），受损关节的力矩裁剪步数占比从4.4%分别升至13.6%和26.3%。在真实Go2上，SG-CPG在29次前进与转弯试验中存活28次，小腿力矩退化高达93%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，严重度门控适应可将健康运动策略扩展至渐进式执行器退化场景，而无需把故障视为离散失效，为四足机器人在持续执行器退化下的鲁棒运动控制提供了可行路径。

Abstract: An animal with a weakened limb does not necessarily switch its gait, instead it unloads the affected limb, re-coordinates the remaining limbs, and scales its response with injury severity. This graded adaptation allows locomotion to persist despite partial loss of limb strength, rather than requiring a discrete transition between healthy and failed. Inspired by this behavior, we propose SG-CPG, a central pattern generator (CPG) for quadruped locomotion under continuous actuator degradation. SG-CPG preserves a frozen healthy CPG policy and introduces two severity-driven gates: a residual gate that re-coordinates all four legs and an amplitude gate that progressively shortens the weakened leg's stride as degradation increases. We emulate progressive degradation through two mechanisms: lowering the joint torque ceiling (ceiling mechanism) and scaling its low-level controller gains (gain mechanism), representing distinct forms of actuator weakening. Our simulations on a Unitree Go2 show that SG-CPG maintains a trot gait with 100% survival across an omnidirectional command schedule under 95% joint strength loss while tracking commands within 8%. Under a lowered torque ceiling, removing either severity path, the residual's severity observation or the amplitude gate, raises clipping at the weakened joint from 4.4% to 13.6% and 26.3% of steps at an 80% loss. On a real Go2, SG-CPG survives 28 of 29 forward and turning trials with up to 93% calf torque degradation. These results show that severity-gated adaptation can extend a healthy locomotion policy to progressive actuator degradation without treating the fault as a discrete failure.

</details>


### [480] [MatcherCompass: A Deployment-Aware Benchmark to Guide Image Matcher Selection in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25688)
*Hyunwoo Kim,Giseop Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MatcherCompass：面向野外机器人部署的局部特征匹配器选型基准


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外机器人需在不同时段与传感模态下获得精确图像对应，但已有方法多在单一设备上报告精度与耗时，难以指导在目标平台与资源配置下的匹配器选择。

Method: 在统一输入与位姿评估流程下，对比9种经典与学习型匹配流水线，覆盖4种图像分辨率与支持的数值精度；设置4种视觉条件（视角变化、可见光与热红外的昼夜匹配、白天可见光-红外匹配）；以5°/10°/20°误差-召回曲线下面积（AUC）评估位姿精度，并在4种GPU平台（工作站与机载计算机）测量每图像对的运行时间、GPU显存与能耗。

Result: 硬件、输入分辨率与数值精度的变化可使匹配器跨越运行时间预算边界，从而改变可行选择集合。

Conclusion: 将测量结果组织为选型指南，返回所有满足用户指定时间与资源限制的配置及其在所选视觉条件下的精度，为匹配流水线选择提供实测依据。

Abstract: Field robots operating across time of day and sensing modalities require accurate image correspondences within onboard time and resource budgets. However, accuracy and runtime reported for individual methods on a single device provide limited guidance for choosing a matcher and its configuration on a target platform. We present MatcherCompass, a deployment-aware benchmark for choosing local feature matchers in field robotics. Under common input and pose-evaluation procedures, we compare nine classical and learned matching pipelines across four image resolutions and supported numerical precisions. Four visual conditions cover viewpoint variation, day--night matching in visible and thermal imagery, and daytime visible--thermal matching. We evaluate pose accuracy using the area under the error--recall curve (AUC) at $5^\circ$, $10^\circ$, and $20^\circ$, and measure runtime, GPU memory, and energy per image pair on four GPU platforms spanning workstation and onboard computers. The results show that changes in hardware, input resolution, and numerical precision can move a matcher across a runtime budget boundary, altering the feasible choices. We organize the measurements into a selection guide that returns all configurations satisfying user-specified time and resource limits, together with their accuracy under the selected visual condition. MatcherCompass provides measured evidence for choosing matching pipelines that fit a robot's sensing conditions and computing hardware.
  Project page: https://matchercompass.github.io/.

</details>


### [481] [MotionForge: A Data Generation Pipeline and Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon Manipulation of Dynamic Objects with Domain Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25689)
*Mohan Liu,Dengchen Mei,Haotian Xian,Ruyang Han,Jiayi Sun,Xuanyu Chen,Haitian Zhang,Luxi Li,Kaimin Mao,Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 MotionForge，首个面向动态操作的大规模仿真基准与数据生成流水线，联合评估域偏移与长时程交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型机器人策略多在静态或准静态环境评估；已有动态仿真基准局限于短时程、反应式交互和简单运动模式，缺乏系统化的域偏移评估与模型无关的实时执行协议。

Method: MotionForge 包含 40 个动态交互任务、覆盖 11 种运动模式，其中 17 个为长时程任务；引入两种机制：(1) 单因素与联合域偏移（物体、背景、光照、速度）下的鲁棒性评估协议；(2) 解耦的延迟感知执行协议，使环境演化独立于策略推理时间。

Result: 在基准上对代表性通用机器人策略进行广泛评测，显示其在联合域偏移下存在显著性能局限。

Conclusion: 当前策略能力与动态物体在域偏移下鲁棒长时程操作的需求之间存在关键差距，MotionForge 可作为具身智能研究的综合测试平台。

Abstract: Recent advances in learning-based robot policies have demonstrated promising progress, yet they are predom- inantly evaluated in static or quasi-static environments. In dynamic manipulation, objects and scenes continuously evolve while the robot perceives, reasons, and acts. However, recent dynamic simulation benchmarks largely focus on short-horizon, reactive interactions with simple motion patterns and offer limited support for both systematic evaluation under domain shifts and model-agnostic real-time execution protocols. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MotionForge, the first large- scale simulation benchmark and data-generation pipeline tailored to jointly evaluate domain shifts and long-horizon interaction in dynamic manipulation. MotionForge comprises 40 dynamic interaction tasks spanning 11 distinct motion patterns, with dedicated support for 17 long-horizon tasks. Our benchmark introduces two key novelties: (1) a systematic evaluation protocol for assessing policy robustness under both single-factor (e.g., only backgrounds shift) and joint domain shifts (e.g., simultaneous shifts of objects, backgrounds, lighting, and speed); and (2) a decoupled, latency-aware execution protocol where the environ- ment continuously evolves independently of policy inference time. Extensive evaluations of representative general-purpose robot policies on our benchmark reveal substantial limitations under joint domain shifts. These findings expose a critical gap between current policy capabilities and the requirements of robust long- horizon manipulation of dynamic objects under domain shifts, establishing MotionForge as a comprehensive testbed for future research in embodied AI.

</details>


### [482] [Induced Riemannian Metrics for Motion Planning with Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25695)
*Phone Thiha Kyaw,Thomas Cohn,Miguel Angel Rogel Garcia,Jonathan Kelly*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文指出约束运动规划中路径长度度量应使用子流形从配置空间黎曼度量继承的诱导度量；证明隐式与显式表示给出相同诱导度量与几何，从而将黎曼度量下的规划扩展到约束子流形，并在双臂Franka任务约束实验中比较欧氏与动能度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束运动规划中，任务约束与闭环约束将机器人运动限制在配置空间的弯曲低维子流形上。现有方法或用约束水平集隐式描述子流形，或用参数化显式描述：前者常配欧氏度量，后者常配参数域度量，导致规划器最小化的路径长度依赖于所选表示。作者希望使度量选择与表示选择解耦，并让黎曼度量规划可用于约束子流形。

Method: 以子流形从配置空间黎曼度量继承的诱导度量来度量路径长度；论证隐式表示与显式表示给出的诱导度量在不同坐标下表达相同，因此几何一致，且该结论对任意黎曼度量成立而非仅欧氏度量。据此，在采样规划器与轨迹优化器中同时施加诱导度量，将黎曼度量下的规划从无约束空间扩展到约束子流形；对显式表示，诱导度量还补偿参数化引入的畸变。

Result: 理论上，诱导度量在隐式与显式表示下等价，度量选择独立于表示选择；方法上，采样规划与轨迹优化均可在约束子流形上使用任意黎曼度量。实验在含两个Franka机械臂的双臂操作平台上，针对末端执行器任务约束，比较欧氏度量与动能度量。

Conclusion: 约束子流形上的路径长度应使用诱导度量，其几何不依赖于隐式或显式表示；这使得黎曼度量规划可统一用于约束问题，并在双臂操作任务中验证了不同度量的差异与有效性。

Abstract: In constrained motion planning problems, task and loop-closure constraints restrict a robot's motion to a curved, lower-dimensional submanifold of its configuration space. Planners measure path length with a metric, which sets the cost of moving in each direction. Under the Euclidean metric, this cost is the same everywhere, whereas under a general Riemannian metric, such as the kinetic-energy metric, the cost can vary with direction and configuration. Existing methods often describe the submanifold either implicitly, as a constraint level set, or explicitly, through a parameterization. The implicit representation is typically combined with the Euclidean metric of the configuration space, and the explicit representation with the parameter domain, so the path length that a planner minimizes depends on the representation. Instead, we measure path length with the induced metric, which the submanifold inherits from a Riemannian metric on the configuration space. The implicit and explicit representations yield the same induced metric, expressed in different coordinates, and hence the same geometry. This result holds for any Riemannian metric on the configuration space, not only the Euclidean one. The choice of metric is therefore independent of the choice of representation. Using this result, we extend planning under a Riemannian metric from unconstrained spaces to constraint submanifolds by applying the induced metric in both a sampling-based planner and a trajectory optimizer. For an explicit representation, the induced metric also accounts for the distortion that the parameterization introduces. In experiments on a bimanual manipulation setup with two Franka arms under end-effector task constraints, we compare the Euclidean and kinetic-energy metrics.

</details>


### [483] [The Cartesian Hand: In-Hand Manipulation with All-Linear Fingers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25696)
*Boxi Xia,Bokuan Li,Ryan Shin,Zijiang Yang,Jiaxun Liu,Boyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Cartesian Hand，一种仅用直线运动在单个末端执行器内实现独立抓取与相对操作的 7-DoF 灵巧手，并在 35 类物体上演示多种操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高自由度灵巧手具备丰富操作能力但机械与控制复杂；平行夹爪简单稳健，却在抓取后缺乏操作物体能力。螺纹容器、制造工具、实验仪器等关节类物体的操作常需第二个夹爪、外部夹具或协调臂运动，因此需要一种兼顾简洁与灵巧的方案。

Method: 提出 Cartesian Hand：7-DoF 末端执行器，包含两个独立驱动的平行夹爪分别夹持物体不同部件，四个平动指尖在被夹持部件间产生相对运动。其指尖运动学与构型无关，使操作可由简单直线运动基元组合而成，适用于螺纹、枢轴、直线导轨、柱塞、扳机等机构。

Result: 在涵盖实验室、制造与家庭场景的 35 个物体上演示了开合瓶盖、移液、抽吸、双把手操作、拧螺丝、扳机驱动与抓取内重定向。相同操作流程可从固定基座机械臂迁移到人形机器人，并用两只 Cartesian Hand 完成双臂实验室操作。

Conclusion: 当独立抓取与相对运动被直接设计进末端执行器时，机械结构简单的架构也能涌现出通用的手内操作能力。软硬件设计将开源。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation has increasingly pursued human-like dexterous hands with many articulated degrees of freedom, offering rich manipulation capabilities at the cost of mechanical and control complexity. At the other extreme, parallel grippers are simple and robust, but provide little ability to manipulate an object after grasping it. Operating articulated objects such as threaded containers, manufacturing tools, and laboratory instruments often requires a second gripper, an external fixture, or coordinated arm motion. We introduce the Cartesian Hand, a 7-DoF end-effector that rethinks dexterous manipulation by combining independent grasping and relative manipulation within a single end-effector using only linear motion. Two independently actuated parallel grippers hold different parts of an object, while four translating fingertips generate relative motion between the grasped parts. Its configuration-independent fingertip kinematics allow manipulation to be composed from simple linear motion primitives. The Cartesian Hand is particularly suited to objects structured around common mechanisms such as threads, pivots, linear guides, plungers, and triggers. We demonstrate cap opening and closing, pipetting, pumping, two-handle manipulation, screwdriving, trigger actuation, and in-grasp reorientation across 35 objects spanning laboratory, manufacturing, and household settings. The same manipulation procedures transfer from a fixed-base robot arm to a humanoid, where we demonstrate bimanual laboratory manipulation using two Cartesian Hands. These results show that versatile in-hand manipulation capability can emerge from a mechanically simple architecture when independent grasping and relative motion are designed directly into the end-effector. We will open-source all software and hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1.

</details>


### [484] [Zephyron: Integrated Design and Analytical Evaluation of a Solar-Assisted Mobile Manipulator for Multimodal Environmental Reconnaissance and Distributed Visual Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25709)
*Sabik Bin Sultan,Shafi Bin Sultan,Safwan Sadad*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出四轮探测车"Zephyron"的文献驱动工程设计方案，用明确的元件与几何基线替代缺乏依据的数值假设，并构建可追溯的设计与评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境侦察需要能在有限能量与通信条件下搭载传感器、保持测量上下文并提供可解释证据的移动平台，而既有方案多依赖缺乏支撑的数值假设，缺少可复现的设计与评估基线。

Method: 基于可复现检索获取5000条记录（4858条去重）进行筛选，并结合原始文献与厂商文档的针对性综述，建立元件与几何基线：165 mm车轮、12 kg质量预算、72 Wh电池能量基准、20 W光伏组件、前置机械臂、分布式计算机视觉与本地记录等；通过滚动阻力计算、能耗情景分析及传感器建模（积分时间、标定、温度、通信延迟）构建质量感知的"停-采样"策略，并定义轻量检测器、参考式传感器学习与可执行数据完整性校验的机器学习评估路径。

Result: 在滚动阻力系数0.04、等载荷分配下，匀速爬升10度坡每轮约需0.517 N·m；以40 W运动负载计，57.6 Wh可用能量对应1.44 h续航，25%驱动占空比下无太阳能输入可运行4.19 h（均为计算情景，非实测性能）。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一个可追溯的设计与评估框架，包含可编辑3D模型、子系统图和可复现分析数据；在赋予载荷、续航、检测或现场运行额定指标前，必须进行实验验证。

Abstract: Environmental reconnaissance needs mobile platforms that carry sensors, preserve measurement context, and return interpretable evidence under limited energy and communication. We present a literature-informed engineering design for Zephyron, a four-wheel rover with a front manipulator, environmental sensors, distributed computer vision, local recording, and a raised rear solar module. The design keeps the prototype layout but replaces unsupported numerical assumptions with an explicit component and geometry baseline. A reproducible search retrieved 5,000 records (4,858 unique) for screening, followed by targeted review of primary literature and manufacturer documentation. The baseline uses 165 mm wheels, a 12 kg mass budget, a 72 Wh battery-energy basis, and a 20 W photovoltaic module. With rolling-resistance coefficient 0.04, steady ascent of a 10 degree grade needs about 0.517 N m per wheel under equal load sharing. An illustrative 40 W motion load gives 1.44 h from 57.6 Wh usable energy, and a 25 percent driving duty gives 4.19 h without solar input; these are calculated scenarios, not measured performance. Sensor models show how integration time, calibration, temperature, and communication delay constrain interpretation, and a quality-aware stop-and-sample policy links these constraints to mission execution. Lightweight detectors, reference-based sensor learning, and executable data-integrity checks define a reproducible machine-learning evaluation pathway. The contribution is a traceable design and evaluation framework with editable 3D models, subsystem diagrams, and reproducible analytical data. Experimental validation is required before assigning payload, endurance, detection, or field-operating ratings.

</details>


### [485] [Designing an Efficient Excavator Bucket for Lunar ISRU: A Comparative Study with Vision-Based Fill and Displacement Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25724)
*Abdulla Hil Kafi,Tomoki Koshi,Jorge Casir,Kenji Nagaoka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出螺旋腔轮月壤挖掘方案及"传感器-光照"评估栈，联合估计填充率、下陷量和比能；台架实验表明挖掘率提升2.2-3.0倍、比能降低29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向月壤挖掘任务，在质量、结构与能耗为关键约束时，寻求可替代重型多执行器挖掘装置（如斗鼓式）的轻量、简洁且高效方案。

Method: 设计螺旋腔（spiral-cavity）挖掘轮；构建传感器-光照评估栈（视觉估计填充率与下陷量、由作动器日志计算比能）；台架试验在5、10、15 RPM下各运行四圈，与两种文献基线对比；提出滞留指数η并与填充率关联；建立DEM仿真复现实验趋势。

Result: 相比斗鼓基线，挖掘质量与填充率更高，挖掘率提高2.2-3.0倍，比能降低29%；归一化下陷量（mm/kg）更低，牵引稳定、无陷阻；力矩曲线包络平稳，切-运-卸循环具重复性；DEM仿真以低误差重现实验趋势。

Conclusion: 螺旋腔轮在质量、简洁性与能效驱动下具备替代重型多执行器挖掘器的潜力，并提供可作为填充率代理指标的滞留指数η与可用的DEM建模流程。

Abstract: This paper present a spiral-cavity wheel for lunar regolith excavation and a sensor-light evaluation stack that jointly estimates fill ratio (vision), sinkage (vision), and specific energy from actuator logs. In benchtop tests (four revolutions at 5, 10, and 15~RPM) against two literature baselines, the proposed wheel achieved higher excavated mass and fill ratio, delivering 2.2-3.0 times higher excavation rate while reducing specific energy by 29 % relative to a bucket-drum baseline. Normalized sinkage (mm/kg) was also lower, indicating stable traction without bogging. Effort-time traces show a steady torque envelope with repeatable cut-carry-dump cycles across speeds. We provide a retention index $η$ that correlates with fill ratio and a DEM setup that reproduces experimental trends with low error. Results suggest spiral-cavity wheels can replace heavier multi-actuator diggers when mass, simplicity, and energy efficiency are mission drivers.

</details>


### [486] [AgriGen: Large-Scale Scene Generation Framework for Photorealistic Agricultural Robotics Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25725)
*Utkarsh Bajpai,Serge Tleiji,Cédric Pradalier,Stéphanie Aravecchia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Isaac Sim 的 ROS 集成框架，用于大规模程序化生成农业环境，支持逼真渲染、物理仿真与域随机化，涵盖行栽作物、果园和葡萄园等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业机器人研究受限于田间访问困难、田间条件不可控、地理差异大及季节性作物周期等因素，导致农业数据集获取成本高且多样性不足，进而影响系统评估与鲁棒性。其他机器人领域已通过高保真仿真实现规模化学习与评估，而农业机器人缺乏同等能力的仿真工具。

Method: 构建一个 ROS 集成框架，基于 Isaac Sim 实现农业环境的大规模程序化生成，支持照片级真实感渲染、物理仿真和域随机化，并内置行栽作物、果园和葡萄园场景，且易于扩展到其他作物类别。

Result: 框架能够在与机器人研究相关的规模上支持照片级真实感渲染、物理仿真和域随机化，并提供对行栽作物、果园和葡萄园的内置支持及扩展能力。

Conclusion: 该框架为农业机器人提供了可与其它机器人领域高保真仿真工具相媲美的大规模农业环境生成能力，有望缓解数据获取难题，提升系统评估与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Agricultural robotics is advancing rapidly, yet progress remains constrained by limited field access, lack of control over field conditions, geographic variability, and seasonal crop cycles. These factors make it difficult and costly to acquire diverse agricultural datasets, resulting in limited evaluation and reduced system robustness. While other robotics domains have scaled learning and evaluation through high-fidelity simulation, agricultural robotics still lacks comparably capable tools. In this paper, we present a ROS-integrated framework, built on Isaac Sim, for large-scale procedural generation of agricultural environments. The framework supports photorealistic rendering, physics simulation, and domain randomization at scales relevant to robotics research, with built-in support for row crops, orchards, and vineyards and straightforward extensibility to additional crop categories. Project Page: https://baj31415.github.io/agrigen/

</details>


### [487] [Dual Covariance Gaussian Splatting SLAM: Decoupling Rendering and Registration for Robust Real-Time Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25746)
*Edward Beng Wai Tan,Siew-Kei Lam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出双协方差参数化的3DGS SLAM，将渲染协方差与跟踪协方差解耦，并利用跟踪协方差作为角点锚点，在保持~60 FPS实时跟踪的同时提升鲁棒性并降低里程计漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于ICP的3DGS SLAM中，同一高斯的协方差需同时服务于渲染与配准，二者需求冲突：建图端为最小化光度误差会将其压扁至贴合表面，而鲁棒配准更依赖测量不确定性。该矛盾限制了跟踪性能。

Method: 提出双协方差参数化：每个高斯保留单一均值但维护两个协方差——由建图端优化的渲染协方差，以及由RGB-D传感器噪声模型导出的跟踪协方差。进一步将跟踪协方差用作图像角点的高斯锚点，在深度几何较弱的方向上提供约束。

Result: 在TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica及两组使用RealSense D435i采集的轮式与手持户外序列上进行评测，在多种场景下实现鲁棒跟踪并降低里程计漂移，跟踪速度约60 FPS。

Conclusion: 通过解耦渲染与跟踪的协方差需求，并引入角点锚点约束，可在实时帧率下兼顾建图质量与配准鲁棒性，验证了双协方差设计的有效性。
