Abstract: ICP-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM tracks in real time by registering incoming frames against map Gaussians, using each primitive's covariance for both rendering and registration. These two uses place conflicting demands on one covariance. The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.

</details>


### [488] [Fisheye-VLA: Decoupling Coverage and Acuity for Manipulation with a Single Fisheye Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25750)
*Ziang Ren,Zike Yan,Raymond Zhang,Xuguo He,Zhongyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Fisheye-VLA 视觉接口，用单个被动鱼眼相机同时实现全局场景感知与局部细节反馈，替代传统前视+腕部相机的组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作任务既需要全局场景感知，又需要局部精细反馈，而传统相机装置依赖分离的前视相机与腕部相机来分别提供，硬件复杂且受限。

Method: 用单个被动鱼眼相机：全局视图保留工作空间，局部透视裁剪指向交互细节；通过受控重渲染研究比较同一录制观测下不同裁剪方向，确定局部视觉预算分配；采用标定的末端执行器投影与运动超前跟踪裁剪，并用共享射线编码保持其空间语义；与预训练 VLA 集成。

Result: 在扩展的两个桌面区域成功率分别为 84% 和 82%（部分目标位置超出前视相机覆盖范围），并支持货架与传送带操作；消融显示局部裁剪及其视角方向在更大工作空间中更为重要。

Conclusion: 单个鱼眼相机即可支撑此类操作任务，无需物理腕部相机；末端执行器中心的视角捕获了大部分估计收益，支持围绕双手的紧凑分配。

Abstract: Manipulation requires both broad scene awareness and detailed local feedback, yet conventional camera rigs provide them through separate front and wrist cameras. We present Fisheye-VLA, a visual interface that brings these capabilities together using a single passive fisheye. A global view preserves the workspace, while local perspective crops direct detail toward the interaction. The key design question is where this local visual budget should go. We answer it through a controlled re-rendering study, comparing alternative crop directions on the same recorded observations. The study finds that end-effector-centered views capture most of the estimated benefit of a much larger candidate pool, motivating a compact allocation around both hands. Our interface uses calibrated end-effector projection and motion lead to track the crops, while a shared ray encoding preserves their spatial meaning as they move. Integrated with a pretrained VLA, it achieves 84% and 82% success in the two expanded tabletop regions, where some target placements extend beyond the front-camera coverage, and supports shelf and conveyor manipulation. Ablations show that local crops and their viewing directions become more important in the larger workspace regions. The results demonstrate that a single fisheye can support these manipulation tasks without physical wrist cameras.

</details>


### [489] [PLAT: Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking for Humanoid Control via Privileged Latent Transition Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25754)
*Zepeng Wang,Jiangxing Wang,Chao Ma,Xiaochuan Shi,Zongqing Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PLAT：面向人形机器人的三阶段稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪策略学习框架，通过特权隐式过渡学习，在部署时仅需稀疏关键帧命令即可实现稳定全身运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人形运动跟踪策略依赖逐帧密集参考，难以作为高层运动控制器用于规划与交互式运动生成。本文研究仅提供稀疏未来关键帧及其期望到达时间的"稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪"问题。

Method: 提出PLAT三阶段框架：①预训练密集跟踪专家提供鲁棒的运动会先验；②通过DAgger风格模仿学习特权隐式先验；③隐式残差强化学习，精炼隐式过渡而非直接优化动作。训练时利用密集目标序列作为特权监督，部署时仅需稀疏定时关键帧命令。

Result: 大量仿真实验表明，PLAT在不同规划时域下均保持精确稳定的稀疏定时关键帧跟踪，长时域命令下性能尤为突出；在Unitree G1人形机器人上的成功部署验证了其有效性与实用性。

Conclusion: PLAT有效弥合了密集运动跟踪与稀疏目标条件控制之间的差距，为稀疏人形运动控制提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Humanoid motion tracking policies rely on dense frame-by-frame references, limiting their use as high-level motion controllers for planning and interactive motion generation. We study \emph{Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking}, where a policy receives only sparse future keyframes and their desired arrival times, and must execute stable whole-body motions that reach successive goals. We propose \textbf{PLAT}, a three-stage sparse timed keyframe motion tracking policy learning framework with \textbf{P}rivileged \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{T}ransition learning. PLAT bridges dense motion tracking and sparse goal-conditioned control by exploiting dense goal sequences as privileged supervision during training while requiring only sparse timed keyframe commands at deployment. A pretrained dense tracking expert first provides robust motion priors. A privileged latent prior is then learned through DAgger-style imitation, followed by latent residual reinforcement learning that refines latent transitions instead of directly optimizing actions. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that PLAT maintains accurate and stable sparse timed keyframe tracking across varying planning horizons, with particularly strong performance under long-horizon commands. Successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot further demonstrates the effectiveness and practicality of PLAT for sparse humanoid motion control.

</details>


### [490] [MedVLA: A Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Framework for Closed-Loop Precision Medical Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25756)
*Junjie Xie,Chuxuan He,Angen Ye,Yujia Song,Dapeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MedVLA：分层VLA框架，高层多模态推理+底层函数约束执行，配多智能体CoT数据生成流水线；柔性电极植入100次闭环试验成功率95.0%，显著优于OpenVLA（8%）与π₀（15%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精密医疗机器人需在严格安全、可解释与执行约束下做自适应决策；现有VLA模型的连续动作生成范式不适配此类任务，且可靠闭环运行还依赖非动作的系统功能调用，存在范式缺口。

Method: 提出MedVLA分层框架：高层多模态推理与底层函数约束执行相耦合；并引入可扩展多智能体流水线，生成面向技能的思维链（CoT）数据用于结构化训练；在不同多模态大模型骨干上微调验证。

Result: 同一初始条件下完成100次闭环柔性电极植入试验：MedVLA任务成功率95.0%，在精度、稳定性与安全性上大幅超越代表性VLA基线OpenVLA（8%）和π₀（15%）；跨不同骨干模型微调后性能一致提升。

Conclusion: 结构化推理结合受限的函数级执行，是通向可部署精密医疗机器人的可行路径。

Abstract: Precision medical robotics demands adaptive decision-making under strict safety, interpretability, and execution constraints. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show strong multimodal reasoning ability, their continuous action generation paradigm is not well suited for precision medical tasks, where reliable closed-loop operation may also depend on non-action system function calls. To address this gap, we propose MedVLA, a hierarchical framework that couples high-level multimodal reasoning with low-level function-constrained execution. We further introduce a scalable multi-agent pipeline to generate skill-oriented chain-of-thought(CoT) data for structured training. Built on different multimodal large-model backbones, MedVLA consistently improves performance after fine-tuning, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework across model variants. Under identical initial conditions, we perform 100 closed-loop flexible electrode implantation trials. The results show that MedVLA achieves a 95.0\% task success rate, substantially outperforming representative VLA baselines, including OpenVLA (8\%) and $π_0$ (15\%), in accuracy, stability, and safety. These results indicate that structured reasoning with constrained function-level execution is a practical route toward deployable precision medical robotics.

</details>


### [491] [StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26131)
*Jiageng Zhang,Doniyorkhon Obidov,Kaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出StepTrigger，一种面向VLM驱动四足机器人（Unitree Go1）的接触状态触发后门攻击：触发器来自足-地接触压力模式，而非语言提示或视觉标记，并学习选择性后门策略以区分正常压力扰动与密集地形触发的接触事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM/VLM日益作为机器人高层规划器，构成新的后门攻击面；已有攻击多依赖语言、可见物体、场景语义或动作历史序列等触发器。本文旨在揭示本体感受与接触通道这一未被现有防御覆盖的后门面。

Method: 以Unitree Go1四足机器人穿越密集地形片时产生的足-地接触与压力模式作为触发器，从多模态机器人状态中学习选择性后门策略；将偶发压力事件作为良性样本、密集地形接触作为投毒样本进行训练。

Result: 分层离线评估结果：干净行为保持率98.75%，误触发拒绝率92.50%，真触发激活率76.25%，整体解析行为准确率89.17%。

Conclusion: 结果表明本体感受与接触通道存在后门攻击面，仅关注语言、视觉或动作历史的防御无法捕捉该威胁。

Abstract: Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch.
  Unlike conventional visual or textual triggers, contact signals are inherently noisy and may also arise during benign locomotion. To avoid treating every pressure anomaly as a trigger, StepTrigger learns a selective backdoor policy from multimodal robot state, using incidental pressure events as benign examples and dense-patch contacts as poisoned examples. In a stratified offline evaluation, the trained planner achieved 98.75% clean behavior preservation, 92.50% false-trigger rejection, 76.25% true-trigger activation, and 89.17% overall parsed behavior accuracy. These results reveal a backdoor surface in proprioceptive and contact channels that is not captured by defenses focused only on language, vision, or action history.

</details>


### [492] [VisForce: Visual Grounding of Current and Desired Forces for Goal-Conditioned Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25785)
*Jung-Woo Lee,Soo-Chul Lim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VisForce 将当前与期望接触力以“指尖对齐”的视觉力线索渲染到图像上，并通过目标条件交叉注意力融合，实现对 VLA 灵巧手操作中力与视觉空间对应关系的显式建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型已成为通用机器人操作策略，但在灵巧手操作中，接触力通常以独立状态量或力专用表征提供，难以显式表达力与其对应视觉位置之间的空间对应关系，限制了力感知条件化的效果。

Method: 提出 VisForce：在当前腕部图像与任务特定目标图像上，分别渲染当前力和期望力的视觉力线索，使其落在对应的指尖位置；随后通过目标条件交叉注意力融合两种表示，生成力感知动作。

Result: 在配备 RH56F1 灵巧手的真实 UR10 机器人上评估。力条件抓取中，随期望力增大呈一致的握力响应；鸡蛋与牙膏管的抓取-提升成功率分别为 70% 和 80%。多阶段任务最终成功率：杯子插入/倒水 70%、夹子辅助面包转移 55%、滑动调节的轴孔装配 40%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，指尖对齐的视觉力表征可有效用于基于 VLA 的灵巧手操作中的力感知条件化。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as general-purpose robotic manipulation policies. However, in dexterous hand manipulation, contact forces are typically provided as separate states or force-specific representations, making it difficult to explicitly represent the spatial correspondence between force and their corresponding visual locations. In this work, we propose VisForce, which visually grounds the current and desired forces at their corresponding fingertip locations. VisForce renders current and desired visual force cues on the current wrist image and a task-specific goal image, and combines the two representations through goal-conditioned cross-attention to generate force-aware actions. We evaluate VisForce using a real UR10 robot equipped with an RH56F1 dexterous hand through force-conditioned grasping and three multi-stage manipulation tasks. In force-conditioned grasping experiments, VisForce exhibited a consistent grip-force response as the desired force increased, and achieved grasp-and-lift success rates of 70% and 80% for an egg and a toothpaste tube, respectively. It further achieved final success rates of 70%, 55%, and 40% on cup insertion/bottle pouring, tong-assisted bread transfer, and slip-modulated peg-in-hole, respectively. These results show that fingertip-aligned visual force representations can be effectively used for force-aware conditioning in VLA-based dexterous hand manipulation.

</details>


### [493] [Silent Sabotage: Internal State Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Powered Robotic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26184)
*Doniyorkhon Obidov,Shivayogi Akki,Tan Chen,Kaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究面向LLM驱动机器人系统的"历史触发型"后门攻击：通过在指令中植入后门，使触发器为机器人自身动作的历史序列（而非外部刺激），在保持正常效用的同时可实现近乎完美的攻击成功率且极难检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM与机器人控制系统的结合催生了具备复杂推理与规划能力的自主智能体，但也带来尚未被充分探索的新型安全风险。现有LLM后门研究主要聚焦于由外部刺激（特定词语、视觉目标或环境状态）触发的攻击，忽略了触发器内生于智能体自身运行逻辑这一更隐蔽的漏洞类别。作者因此希望填补"基于历史的机器人后门攻击"这一空白。

Method: 作者针对LLM驱动的机器人控制系统开展历史触发型后门攻击：通过操纵LLM控制器的指令嵌入隐蔽后门，其触发器并非外部线索，而是机器人自身过去动作中的一段特定且稀有的动作序列。该后门在正常运行期间保持休眠以维持任务效用，仅在特定历史序列出现时被激活，从而诱发恶意行为（如完全停止或碰撞）。实验在仿真环境中使用多种机器人与多种LLM进行验证。

Result: 实验结果表明，该历史触发型攻击高度有效，达到了近乎完美的攻击成功率，同时极难被检测；后门在正常操作中保持休眠，不影响机器人的正常效用。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了自主系统中一个关键且此前未被关注的漏洞，强调亟需建立能够考虑智能体内部状态的安全防护机制。

Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotic control systems is enabling a new generation of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and planning. While this paradigm shift accelerates progress, it also introduces novel security risks that remain largely unexplored. Current research into LLM backdoors has focused on attacks triggered by external stimuli, such as specific words, visual objects, or environmental states. These attacks, while potent, overlook a more insidious class of vulnerability where the trigger is internal to the agent's own operational logic. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of history-based backdoor attacks on LLM-powered robotic systems. We demonstrate that an attacker can embed a stealthy backdoor into an LLM-based robot controller by manipulating its instructions. This backdoor is triggered not by an external cue, but by a specific, rare sequence of the robot's own past actions. It remains dormant during normal operation, preserving the robot's utility, but can be activated to induce a malicious behavior, such as a complete stop or a collision. Our experiments, conducted in a simulated environment with a variety of robots and LLMs, show that this history-based attack is highly effective, achieving a near-perfect attack success rate while remaining exceptionally difficult to detect. These findings reveal a critical and previously unaddressed vulnerability in autonomous systems and underscore the urgent need for security measures that account for an agent's internal state.

</details>


### [494] [MOLA LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (MOLA-LIO) on the COMFORT Localization Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25813)
*Jose Luis Blanco-Claraco*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该报告介绍了作者参加 COMFORT Localization Benchmark（IROS 2026）的技术方案：将 MOLA-LO 扩展为融合 LiDAR、IMU 及可选腿部运动学里程计的 LiDAR-惯性系统，并在 Boxi 载荷采集的 GrandTour 数据集上完成评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与 COMFORT Localization Benchmark 并针对 GrandTour 数据集（Boxi 载荷）提供可行的定位方案，在纯 LiDAR 里程计基础上引入惯性信息与腿部运动学信息以提升定位鲁棒性与精度。

Method: 将 MOLA-LO 扩展为 LiDAR-惯性系统，融合 LiDAR、IMU 以及可选的腿部运动学里程计等多源数据流；文中描述了系统架构、所消费的数据流、用于选定提交配置的本地协议，以及支撑实时性声明的测量结果。

Result: 给出了系统架构、输入数据流、配置选择协议及实时性能的实测数据；具体定位精度与实时性量化指标在摘要中未展开（属于短篇报告）。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了将 MOLA-LO 扩展为融合 LiDAR、IMU 与腿部运动学信息的定位系统，能实时运行并满足基准评测需求，为后续完整实验报告与开源实现奠定基础。

Abstract: This short report documents our entry to the COMFORT Localization Benchmark (IROS 2026), evaluated on the GrandTour dataset recorded with the Boxi payload. It extends MOLA-LO into a LiDAR-inertial system that also ingests IMU and, optionally, legged kinematic odometry. We describe the architecture, the streams consumed, the local protocol that selected the submitted configuration, and the measurements backing our real-time claim.

</details>


### [495] [Beyond Reconstruction Error: Analytical and Data-Driven Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25820)
*Yuxin Yang,Gaohan He,Changxue Guan,Hangming Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文比较解析型、线性数据驱动型与非线性神经型三类动作表征在统一tokenization接口下对自回归VLA闭环控制的影响，发现表征排序随评价标准变化，重建保真度无法可靠选择动作表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散动作tokenization是自回归VLA模型的核心，但现有动作表征多以重建保真度为主要评价指标；作者质疑该指标能否真正指导闭环控制下的表征选择。

Method: 在统一tokenization接口下对比固定解析表征、数据驱动线性表征与非线性神经表征；采用率失真分析、序列建模诊断，并进行3,500次LIBERO rollout评估，辅以三个策略训练seed及seed-42匹配消融实验。

Result: PCA的名义重建误差低于Temporal-DCT，但token序列可预测性更差，seen-task平均成功率低3.0个百分点（三个seed），且在一个seed中策略排序反转；seed-42消融中自编码器进一步降低重建误差，却未取得最强策略，并对离散token扰动更敏感。

Conclusion: 重建保真度不足以可靠筛选自回归控制所需的动作表征，需联合评估几何保真度、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性与闭环性能。

Abstract: Discrete action tokenization is central to autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet action representations are often evaluated primarily through reconstruction fidelity. We ask which representation properties actually matter for closed-loop control by comparing fixed analytical, data-driven linear, and nonlinear neural representations under a unified tokenization interface. Across rate-distortion analysis, sequence-modeling diagnostics, and 3,500 LIBERO rollouts, representation rankings change with the evaluation criterion. PCA achieves lower nominal reconstruction error than Temporal-DCT, but produces less predictable token sequences and 3.0 percentage points lower mean seen-task success across three policy-training seeds, with the policy ordering reversing in one seed. In a matched seed-42 ablation, an autoencoder further reduces reconstruction error yet does not yield the strongest policy and exhibits greater sensitivity to discrete token perturbations. These findings show that reconstruction fidelity alone cannot reliably select action representations for autoregressive control, motivating joint evaluation of geometric fidelity, sequence predictability, decoder stability, and closed-loop performance.

</details>


### [496] [Sometimes You Gotta Run Before You Can Walk: Run-then-Walk Scheduling Strategy for VLM Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25831)
*Yuqi Ye,Shangkun Sun,Junhong Lin,Jiayi Zhao,Changhao Peng,Wei Zheng,Guoqing Liu,Tiesong Zhao,Wei Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Run-then-Walk 两阶段奖励调度策略，用于 VLM 自动驾驶规划器的 GRPO 强化学习，先探索高进度模式再修复安全性，兼顾性能与收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GRPO 方案要么只优化效率而带来不安全行为，要么过早施加安全约束导致策略过于保守，且均需冗长训练。本文旨在同时解决"不安全"与"过度保守"两类问题并提升收敛效率。

Method: 先揭示两种不同的 RL 机制：进度机制（Run-GRPO，激进探索高进度）与安全机制（Walk-GRPO，在稳定进度下恢复安全）。据此提出 Run-then-Walk 两阶段奖励调度：Run 阶段专注进度，使策略摆脱保守偏置、发现高进度模式；Walk 阶段引入端点与安全策略，修复 Run 阶段的不安全行为。

Result: 在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard、nuScenes 多个基准上，使用多种 VLM 规划器验证：驾驶性能提升，同时 RL 训练轮数比基线减少 40%–50%。

Conclusion: 该逆序"先跑后走"调度既克服了"先走后跑"（Walk-first）方法的保守性，也避免了联合优化的不安全冒进，在性能与训练效率上均优于一阶段 RL 基线。

Abstract: Recent VLM-based autonomous driving planners adopt GRPO-style reinforcement learning to optimize driving performance. However, existing GRPO recipes either optimize driving efficiency, risking progress-seeking but unsafe behavior, or enforce early safety constraints, leading to overly conservative behavior; both require lengthy training. To solve these problems, we first reveal two distinct RL regimes: a progress regime (Run-GRPO) that aggressively explores high progress, and a safety regime (Walk-GRPO) that restores safety under stable progress. Based on this finding, we propose $\textit{Run-then-Walk}$, a simple yet effective two-stage reward scheduling strategy for GRPO, achieving both better performance and faster convergence. Unlike one-stage RL, which may focus on progress, safety, or a mixture of both within a single training phase, this schedule explicitly separates progress discovery from safety repair. In the $\textit{Run}$ phase, we focus on progress, allowing the policy to escape the conservative bias and discover high-progress modes. In the subsequent $\textit{Walk}$ phase, we introduce endpoint and safety strategy to repair unsafe behaviors from the Run phase. This reversed schedule overcomes the conservatism of Walk-first methods and the unsafe progress-seeking of joint optimization. We validate it with various VLM-based planners on multiple benchmarks: NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, Navhard, and nuScenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved driving performance while requiring 40--50\% fewer RL training epochs than the baselines.

</details>


### [497] [What is the Better Curriculum: Controller-Shaped Grasping Behavior for Contact Force-Sensitive Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25887)
*Ziyan Feng,Zizhao Yuan,Yulong Fu,Yuxin He,Zhiyuan Zhang,Zhengjie Zhang,Jinni Zhou,Renjing Xu,Qiang Nie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将触觉反射控制器用作"采集期教师"而非策略输入：以25 Hz确定性触觉反射控制器生成示范，供无触觉策略（ACT、π0.5）学习。ACT在标称塑料杯任务上达95%稳定抓取，但在随机外部扰动下无触觉策略仍有45%失败，说明扰动抑制仍依赖控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脆弱物体的抓取要求接触力维持在窄幅范围内，亚牛顿级接触力即可造成不可逆损伤。现有视触觉策略学习通常把触觉作为策略的额外输入，但在直接接触的力敏感操作中，瓶颈更早出现在数据采集阶段：人工操控夹爪延迟大、粒度粗，难以稳定维持所需的窄力区间。因此需要解决"示范数据本身质量不足"这一问题。

Method: 采用确定性的25 Hz触觉反射控制器作为采集期教师（collection-time teacher），由其产生带有控制器塑造的抓取行为的示范数据，再用于训练无触觉的策略（tactile-free policy learning）。在ACT（Action Chunking with Transformers）上验证，并迁移到π0.5；部署阶段另设反射仲裁器（reflex arbiter）用于对比。评估场景包括标称塑料杯任务、分布内稳定性、未见过的纸杯变体以及随机外部扰动。

Result: 在ACT上，由反射塑造示范训练的策略复现了教师的抓取力曲线，在标称塑料杯任务上达到95%稳定抓取率，显著优于经视觉筛选的人工示范。相同干预提升了π0.5的分布内稳定性，并在未见纸杯变体上呈现有利的探索趋势。但在随机外部扰动下，反射数据训练的π0.5策略在纯策略试验中仍有45%失败，而部署期反射仲裁器保持全部抓取成功。

Conclusion: 触觉反馈在力敏感操作中具有新角色：不作为策略输入集成，而作为采集期教师来塑造示范中的抓取行为，从而提升无触觉策略学习的效果；但扰动抑制仍依赖控制器，界定了无触觉策略的能力边界。

Abstract: How should a robot learn to manipulate objects so fragile that sub-Newton contact forces can cause irreversible damage? Existing visuo-tactile policy learning typically treats tactile sensing as an additional policy input. In direct-contact force-sensitive manipulation, however, the bottleneck can arise earlier, during data collection: manual gripper control is too delayed and coarse-grained to reliably maintain the narrow force range required for stable grasping. We therefore use a deterministic 25 Hz tactile reflex controller as a collection-time teacher, producing demonstrations with controller-shaped grasping behavior for tactile-free policy learning. On Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), policies trained from reflex-shaped demonstrations recover the teacher's grasping profile and achieve 95% stable grasps on the nominal plastic-cup task, substantially outperforming visually screened manual demonstrations. The same intervention improves in-distribution stability on $π_{0.5}$ and shows a favorable exploratory trend on an unseen paper-cup variant. Under randomized external disturbance, however, the reflex-data $π_{0.5}$ policy still fails in 45% of policy-only trials, whereas a deployment-time reflex arbiter retains all grasps. These results reveal a new role for tactile feedback in force-sensitive manipulation: rather than integrating tactile into the policy, we use it as a collection-time teacher that shapes grasping behavior in demonstrations for policy learning, while disturbance rejection remains controller-dependent, revealing the boundary of tactile-free policy.

</details>


### [498] [Robust Active-Perception Control for Global-State-Free Aerial-Ground Cooperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25898)
*Mingxuan Zhang,Jiajun Yu,Baozhe Zhang,Pengxiang Zhou,Wentao Liu,Fei Gao,Chao Xu,Yanjun Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出COPA主动感知框架，用单轴云台解耦相机光轴与无人机俯仰，结合TCN预测与MPC联合优化，实现无全局状态的空地协同鲁棒跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空地协同需实时UAV–UGV相对状态信息。全局定位维护成本高，故在UGV附着的非惯性系中直接控制以避免依赖全局定位；视觉相对位姿估计成本低但固定相机会在无人机姿态与视场约束冲突时丢失目标。

Method: 采用单轴云台将相机光轴与UAV俯仰解耦；推导关联UAV运动、云台角与UGV运动的主动感知模型，描述目标在图像平面的状态；用TCN从近期运动历史预测短时域UGV加速度与角速度，无需全局状态测量；MPC基于预测联合优化UAV与云台控制。

Result: 仿真表明COPA可保持目标持续可见；消融实验证实TCN在UGV运动转换阶段降低峰值误差；真实实验中UGV加速度达3 m/s²、偏航率达1.0 rad/s时仍实现鲁棒跟踪。

Conclusion: COPA以低成本被动标记视觉方案实现无全局定位的空地协同主动感知，兼顾视场约束与动态目标跟踪性能。

Abstract: Aerial-ground cooperation requires real-time UAV--UGV relative-state information. Instead of maintaining global estimates for both robots, direct control in a UGV-attached non-inertial frame avoids reliance on global localization. Vision-based relative pose estimation with a passive marker offers a low-cost and effective solution. However, a fixed camera may lose sight of the moving UGV when the required UAV attitude conflicts with the field-of-view (FOV) constraint. To address this, we propose COPA, a robust active-perception framework for global-state-free aerial-ground cooperation. We use a single-axis gimbal to decouple the camera optical axis from the UAV pitch attitude. We derive an active-perception model that relates UAV motion, gimbal angle, and UGV motion to the target image-plane state.A Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) predicts short-horizon UGV acceleration and angular velocity from recent motion history without global-state measurements. The model predictive control (MPC) uses these predictions to jointly optimize UAV and gimbal control. Simulations show that COPA maintains continuous target visibility, while ablation studies confirm that the TCN reduces peak errors during UGV motion transitions. Real-world experiments with UGV accelerations up to 3m/s^2 and yaw rates up to 1.0rad/s demonstrate robust tracking.

</details>


### [499] [You Should Be Properly Scoring Your Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25900)
*Ola Rønning,Usama Saqib,Andrzej Wąsowski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文主张用"严格适当评分规则"（strictly proper scoring rules）替代RMSE等点度量来评估里程计性能，使估计值与协方差一同受评；提出无需真值的单侧配对检验以诊断过置信，并开源smfeval框架，在四种LiDAR-惯性里程计滤波器中发现了严重过置信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统里程计评估使用RMSE等点度量，忽略了估计器（滤波器、平滑器）已报告的协方差矩阵。协方差包含两方面关键信息：一是编码估计器对自身输出的置信度（过置信的估计器不会报告自己丢失）；二是为各方向误差加权，缺乏协方差会不公平地惩罚不确定方向上的大误差。

Method: 采用严格适当评分规则，将估计值与所报不确定性共同评分：无协方差时退化为点度量，有协方差时可诊断协方差不一致性。此外设计单侧配对检验，在无真值条件下暴露两个估计器中至少一个的过置信。方法实现于开源框架smfeval中。

Result: 以地面LiDAR-惯性里程计的平移分量作为案例，在四种滤波器中均发现过置信：最差情形下报告厘米级确定性却存在千米级误差。进一步溯源机制，发现过置信源于滤波器错误地认为LiDAR测量携带了比实际更多的"新信息"。

Conclusion: 里程计评估应从点度量转向严格适当评分规则，以将不确定性纳入评分体系；配对检验可在无真值下诊断过置信，smfeval框架提供了实现工具。案例分析揭示了LiDAR-惯性里程计中协方差不可信的系统性问题及其潜在机制。

Abstract: When we evaluate the performance of our odometry, it is common practice to score the estimated track against a ground truth. Unfortunately, scoring uses point metrics, such as the root mean square error, that ignore the covariance matrix which estimators like filters and smoothers already report. Using the covariance matters for two reasons. First, the covariance encodes the estimator's uncertainty, so it tells us whether the estimator trusts its own output. An overconfident estimator will not report itself lost. Second, the covariance weights the error in each direction of the estimate. Without the covariance, an estimator is unduly penalized for a high error in an uncertain direction. Instead of point metrics, we should use strictly proper scoring rules. These rules score the estimate together with its reported uncertainty. Strictly proper scoring rules recover the point metrics when no covariance is reported, and they diagnose covariance inconsistency when covariance is reported. Using a one-sided pairwise test, we show that two estimators can expose overconfidence in at least one of them without a ground truth. Strictly proper scoring rules and our pairwise test are available in our open-source framework smfeval. As a case study, we use smfeval to assess the uncertainty quality of the translational component of ground-based LiDAR-inertial odometry. Across four filters we find overconfidence - the worst case reports centimeter certainty with kilometer error. Knowing the filters are overconfident, we investigate the mechanism. The investigation traces overconfidence to filters crediting LiDAR measurements with more new information than they carry.

</details>


### [500] [Control Barrier Functions for Safe Free-Flying Robotic Spacecraft Operations in Tumbling Target Capture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25905)
*Alexander Meinert,Peter Stadler,Niklas Baldauf,Alen Turnwald*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出模块化控制屏障函数（CBF）框架，将13自由度自由飞行机器人航天器分解为平移、姿态和机械臂子系统，各配安全滤波器，在翻滚目标捕获中保证系统级安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受ESA最新安全近距操作指南驱动，需将安全区与安全要求转化为可执行约束，并解决多子系统耦合下的实时安全问题。

Method: 将13自由度系统分解为平移、姿态、机械臂子系统，各配基于轻量二次规划的安全滤波器，最小化修改标称控制输入；各滤波器施加锥形接近走廊、避碰区、姿态视线指向、角速度限制、关节限位、连杆-基座避碰及执行器约束；子系统耦合通过将上游安全指令作为下游滤波器的已知互联输入处理，保持模块化。

Result: 在高保真天体动力学仿真器Basilisk中，于在轨服务场景（含最终逼近、角速度同步与翻滚目标抓取）验证；蒙特卡洛仿真表明对不同翻滚速率具有运行时效率与操作安全性。

Conclusion: 该模块化CBF框架在保持模块化的同时支持系统级安全，适用于翻滚目标捕获等自由飞行机器人航天器操作。

Abstract: This paper presents a modular control barrier function (CBF) framework for safe free-flying robotic spacecraft operations during tumbling target capture. Motivated by latest ESA guidelines for safe close proximity operations, safety zones and requirements are translated into dedicated CBFs. The 13-DoF system is decomposed into translational, attitude, and robotic subsystems, each equipped with a safety filter that minimally modifies nominal control inputs in a lightweight quadratic program. The filters enforce a conical approach corridor, collision avoidance zone, attitude line-of-sight pointing, angular velocity limits, robotic joint limits, link-base collision avoidance, and actuator constraints. Dynamic coupling between subsystems is handled by treating upstream safe control commands as known interconnection inputs in the downstream safety filters, preserving modularity while supporting system-level safety. The framework is validated in an on-orbit servicing scenario, including final approach, angular rate synchronization, and tumbling target grasping, using the high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator Basilisk. Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate runtime efficiency and operational safety for various tumbling rates.

</details>


### [501] [Vision-based Underwater Formation Control With Input Saturations via Barrier Lyapunov Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25917)
*Nicola De Carli,João Zenário,Victor Nan Fernandez-Ayala,Dimos V. Dimarogonas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出一种无需通信的视觉编队控制框架，用于全驱动水下机器人，在感知受限、避碰要求和输入饱和条件下实现编队控制：用重心化障碍Lyapunov函数编码感知与避碰约束，用命令滤波反步法扩展到二阶动力学，并通过二次规划显式处理执行器饱和，最后经Gazebo的SITL仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人编队通常依赖通信，但在水下环境中通信受限且不可靠；同时还需满足感知范围、避免碰撞和执行器饱和等实际约束。因此作者希望构建一种不依赖通信、仅凭视觉信息即可实现的编队控制方法，并同时保证上述约束。

Method: 提出无需通信的视觉编队控制框架。采用重心化障碍Lyapunov函数（recentered barrier Lyapunov functions）对感知约束和避碰约束进行编码；用命令滤波反步法（command-filtered backstepping）将设计扩展到二阶车辆动力学；控制目标通过二次规划（QP）求解，显式考虑执行器限幅；保守感知域相对物理极限留出裕度，并在必要时自适应放宽，允许临时突破保守边界。

Result: 在Gazebo中通过逼真的软件在环（SITL）仿真对所提方法进行了验证。

Conclusion: 所提通信无关框架能够在满足感知、避碰和输入饱和约束的前提下实现全驱动水下机器人视觉编队控制，仿真结果支持其有效性。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a communication-free framework for vision-based formation control of fully actuated underwater robots subject to sensing constraints, collision-avoidance requirements, and input saturations. Recentered barrier Lyapunov functions encode sensing and collision-avoidance constraints, while command-filtered backstepping extends the design to the second-order vehicle dynamics. The resulting control objective is enforced through a quadratic program that explicitly accounts for actuator limits. Conservative sensing domains provide margins from the physical limits and are adaptively relaxed when necessary, allowing temporary violation of the conservative bounds. The proposed approach is validated through realistic Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) simulations in Gazebo.

</details>


### [502] [Unsigned Distance Maps on 2D Point Cloud Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25932)
*Ricardo B. Sousa,Giorgio Grisetti,Héber Miguel Sobreira,Carlos André Silva,António Paulo Moreira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于无符号距离图（UDF）的2D点云配准方法，通过预计算最近参考点的欧氏距离及其空间导数，将ICP的迭代最近邻搜索替换为O(1)查表，并在SE(2)流形上推导点对点与点对平面误差、用Gauss-Newton求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D点云配准用于移动机器人的激光里程计与SLAM，ICP虽应用广泛，但每次迭代都要通过最近邻搜索重算对应关系，计算开销大；而无对应关系的替代方法多局限于scan-to-map对齐。作者希望消除逐迭代搜索的瓶颈，并给出可统一处理的误差模型。

Method: 在离散网格上预计算到最近参考点的欧氏距离及其空间导数（无符号距离图），以O(1)查表替代逐迭代最近邻搜索；在SE(2)流形上推导点对点和点对平面误差公式，并用Gauss-Newton优化求解；提出预计算点对点与预计算点对平面等变体，将预计算版本与解析版本对比。

Result: 在合成基准和真实世界IILABS 3D数据集上，预计算点对点变体优于其解析对应版本，并取得与点对平面公式相当、具竞争力的激光里程计漂移表现；分析认为预计算梯度在传感器噪声存在时对对应关系起到正则化作用。

Conclusion: 以无符号距离图预计算距离场及梯度，可把2D配准中的最近邻搜索降为O(1)查表，配合SE(2)流形上的Gauss-Newton优化，在真实噪声数据上预计算点对点方法表现稳健，说明梯度正则化是提升配准鲁棒性的关键因素。

Abstract: 2D point cloud registration arises in laser odometry and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) for mobile robots. Iterative Closest Point (ICP) is one of the most widely used approaches. Still, its iterative procedure recomputes correspondences via nearest-neighbor search at every iteration, whereas correspondence-free alternatives focus on scan-to-map alignment. This paper proposes a 2D point cloud registration approach based on unsigned distance maps, precomputing the Euclidean distance to the nearest reference point, along with its spatial derivatives, over a discrete grid, replacing the per-iteration search with O(1) lookups. Moreover, point-to-point and point-to-plane error formulations are derived on the SE(2) manifold and solved via Gauss-Newton optimization. On a synthetic benchmark and the real-world IILABS 3D dataset, the precomputed point-to-point variant outperforms its analytical counterparts, achieving competitive laser-odometry drift compared to point-to-plane formulations, as the precomputed gradient regularizes correspondences in the presence of sensor noise.

</details>


### [503] [Destination Support Restoration for Finite-Set Multimodal Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25942)
*Fengrui Liu,Jiajun Peng,Duo Peng,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Destination Support Restoration (DSR)，一种因果后选择算子，在不重训练预测器、不扩充假设集的前提下修复有限预测集的“目的地支撑”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在行人周围作业时，常基于有限的人类未来预测集进行推理。反复在线更新会使有限预测预算集中于主导目的地，导致合理备选目的地被低估甚至缺失，从而在下游决策可用的有限表示中被剔除。

Method: DSR 在修复步上从观测前缀评估临时的“目的地分层”候选库，将候选证据转换为整数目标计数，保护活跃模态的代表，并把冗余的剩余假设重新分配到证据不足的模态。维护集与返回集恒保持 N 个假设，最多替换 ⌈ρN⌉ 项。受保护代表维持当前类别支撑；谱系感知粒子滤波同时保留存活的、重采样祖先。每次替换使分配与证据驱动目标的失配减少一。

Result: 在完整 3,719 条轨迹的 Edinburgh 协议、三个随机种子上，N=64 时 DSR 使 MIF 加权 ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 13.36% 与 13.30%。与 CLiFF、PPT、causal GDTS、Social Informer、PECNet 的配对集成在每一评估对中两项指标均提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明确有限集支撑分配在固定假设集作为下游系统接口时，是一个有用的预测侧控制点。

Abstract: Robots operating around pedestrians often reason over a finite set of predicted human futures. Repeated online updates can concentrate this limited prediction budget on dominant destinations and leave plausible alternatives underrepresented or absent, removing those alternatives from the finite representation available to downstream decision making. We introduce Destination Support Restoration (DSR), a causal post-selection operator that repairs destination support without retraining the host predictor or increasing the maintained set size. At a repair step, DSR evaluates a temporary destination-stratified candidate bank from the observed prefix, converts candidate evidence into integer target counts, protects representatives of active modes, and reallocates redundant surplus hypotheses to deficient modes. The maintained and returned sets retain exactly $N$ hypotheses, and DSR replaces at most $\lceilρN\rceil$ entries. Protected representatives preserve current categorical support; lineage-aware particle filters also preserve surviving resampling ancestors. Each replacement reduces the allocation mismatch to the evidence-driven target by one. On the complete 3,719-trajectory Edinburgh protocol over three seeds, DSR reduces MIF weighted ADE and FDE by 13.36% and 13.30% at $N=64$. Paired integrations with CLiFF, PPT, causal GDTS, Social Informer, and PECNet improve both metrics in every evaluated pair. These results show that finite-set support allocation is a useful prediction-side control point when a fixed hypothesis set serves as the interface to downstream systems.

</details>


### [504] [An Action Is Worth One Patch: Unified World-Action Modeling with PatchWAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25961)
*Tianheng Wang,Zhou Xie,Heng Jia,Jianhua Xu,Tong Zhang,Kaicheng Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PatchWAM 提出 Action-as-Patch 固定映射，将连续动作视为一种 patch，使单一生成式视觉骨干网络统一完成视觉预测与动作生成，无需独立动作头或动作专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视觉模型具备建模物理动态表征的潜力，但扩展到连续控制时通常需要额外引入可训练动作头或独立动作专家，以弥合低维状态与高维视觉表征之间的差距。本文追问：视觉预测与动作生成是否真的需要分离的计算通路。

Method: 核心为固定映射 Action-as-Patch，把连续动作编码为与视觉 patch 兼容的表征，直接输入同一生成式骨干网络。由此单模型同时预测机器人动作与未来场景，视觉预测与动作生成共享同一生成过程，避免专用动作头或独立动作专家。

Result: 在子采样训练窗口设置下优于参数匹配的双专家控制方案；基准评测中，全数据设置并加入增强演示时，LIBERO-Plus 成功率达 91.8%，RoboTwin 2.0 达 96.12%。

Conclusion: 扩展生成式骨干的瓶颈在于新信号的接口表示，而非建模容量本身；能力可通过统一接口被继承，无需额外新增模块。

Abstract: Generative visual models offer a foundation for learning representations of physical dynamics, yet their extension to continuous control raises a fundamental question: do visual prediction and action generation require separate computational pathways? Existing approaches usually introduce trainable action heads or separate action experts to bridge low-dimensional states and high-dimensional visual representations. In this work, we explore whether the visual backbone's existing capacity can also support control when actions are expressed in a compatible representation. Thus, we introduce PatchWAM (Patch World-Action Model), which treats continuous actions as another type of patch through a fixed mapping called Action-as-Patch. This allows a single model to predict both how the robot should move and what the scene may look like afterward. Visual prediction and action generation become parts of the same generative process, without a dedicated action head or separate action expert. Experiments with subsampled training windows show gains over a matched dual-expert control, while benchmark evaluations reach 91.8% success rate on LIBERO-Plus and 96.12% on RoboTwin 2.0 in a full-data setting with additional augmented demonstrations. More broadly, the result suggests that capability need not be added where it can be inherited: the constraint on extending a generative backbone is the interface a new signal is written in, not the capacity to model it.

</details>


### [505] [Predict Before You Step: Auditable Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance under Sparse Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25969)
*Yuhui Mao,Fen Liu,Shenghai Yuan,Tianxin Hu,Ruimeng Liu,Rong Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出LOOP局部避障策略，用循环预测器预报1秒占据栅格并引导速度选择，以50 Hz连接稀疏路点与冻结运动控制器，实现动态避障并可实机部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足式机器人在稀疏路点引导下，需依赖部分且快速变化的LiDAR观测避让移动障碍，现有反应式方法缺乏对未来占据的显式预测，难以应对高速迎面与交叉场景。

Method: LOOP以占据与自速度历史为输入，用循环预测器通过学到的光流与可见性门控对当前地图进行形变，预测1秒未来占据；再由地图特征与几何风险评估驱动速度选择，形成可检查、可替换的预测接口，以50 Hz与冻结运动控制器级联。

Result: 在Isaac Lab遭遇同步评测中，障碍速度2.5–3.2 m/s时迎面成功率57.1%，比重训练反应式基线高8.2个百分点；与无rollout的BEV策略相比，预测分支增益较小且依赖场景，但改善交叉成功率并降低最高迎面速度下跨训练种子的方差。适配器在Unitree Go2上每步14.5 ms，16次真实交叉试验全部无碰撞。

Conclusion: 表明显式未来占据预测能提升高速动态避障表现，且该策略计算高效、可实机部署，但预测带来的收益具有场景依赖性。

Abstract: Legged robots under sparse waypoint guidance must avoid moving obstacles using partial, rapidly changing LiDAR observations. We present LOOP (Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy), a local avoidance policy that connects sparse waypoint guidance to a frozen locomotion controller at 50 Hz. From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates. These maps guide velocity selection through map-derived features and geometric risk estimates, providing an explicit interface for inspecting and replacing predictions. In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive baseline by 8.2 percentage points. Comparisons with a rollout-free BEV policy show smaller, scenario-dependent gains from the prediction branch, including improved crossing success and reduced variability across training seeds at the highest head-on speeds. The adapter runs onboard a Unitree Go2 in 14.5 ms per step and completes all 16 real-world crossing trials without collision, demonstrating deployment feasibility.

</details>


### [506] [Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control for an Omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot Using Control Barrier Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25994)
*Andrea Fortuna,Marta Lorenzini,Elisa Motta,Alberto Ranavolo,Elena De Momi,Arash Ajoudani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向全向助行机器人I-WANDER的控制框架，将控制障碍函数（CBF）嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）中，以显式施加避障安全约束，同时优化能效与人机协作平滑性，并通过12名健康受试者的实验验证其优于变导纳控制器的安全性与能效表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为运动障碍者提供安全有效的移动辅助对恢复其独立性与生活质量至关重要。机器人助行设备需在提供物理顺应交互的同时保障用户安全与支撑，因此亟需在控制器层面显式处理避障安全约束，并兼顾能效与交互平滑性。

Method: 提出一种新型控制框架：在全向助行机器人I-WANDER上，将Control Barrier Function（CBF）形式化嵌入Model Predictive Control（MPC）方案，形成CB-MPC控制器，显式强制碰撞避免安全约束，并对能效与人机协作平滑性进行优化。实验招募12名健康受试者完成两类行走任务：任务一为U形走廊中的结构化导航；任务二为蒙眼条件下执行的单障碍物避障任务，以确保障碍物对受试者而言是意外的。对照组采用variable admittance controller（AC）。

Result: 对比结果表明，CB-MPC架构显著降低能耗与机械功（p < 0.01），且不牺牲运动平滑性，同时减少了障碍物碰撞次数。

Conclusion: 研究结果凸显了所提控制架构在提升机器人助行辅助的安全性与效率方面的潜力。

Abstract: Providing safe and effective mobility assistance plays a crucial role in restoring independence and enhancing the quality of life for individuals with motor impairments. In this context, robotic walking assistive devices have recently emerged as promising solutions to provide physically compliant interaction while ensuring user safety and support. This paper presents a novel control framework for an omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot (I-WANDER) that integrates a Control Barrier Function (CBF) formulation into a Model Predictive Control (MPC) scheme to explicitly enforce collision-avoidance safety constraints while optimizing for energy efficiency and smooth human-robot collaboration. The method was experimentally evaluated with 12 healthy participants performing two different walking tasks using both the proposed CBF-based MPC controller (CB-MPC) and a variable admittance controller (AC). The first task involved structured navigation through a U-shaped corridor, whereas the second consisted of a single-obstacle avoidance task performed blindfolded to ensure the obstacle was unexpected. Comparative results show that the CB-MPC architecture significantly reduces energy consumption and mechanical work (p < 0.01) without compromising motion smoothness, while also decreasing the number of obstacle collisions. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of the proposed control architecture to enhance both safety and efficiency in robotic walking assistance.

</details>


### [507] [Manipulation with Stability Guarantees: Linear Deformable Objects with Non-negligible Physical Response Grasped at Multiple Location](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26004)
*Daniel Feliu-Talegon,Cosimo Della Santina*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出闭环控制架构，显式考虑物体动力学，将可变形物体操纵重构为形状调节问题，通过多点力/力矩调制实现控制，并给出仿真与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可变形物体操纵研究多集中于轻量系统，机械响应可忽略，局限于准静态工况；这排除了软管、管道、线束等动力学不可忽略的实际物体。

Method: 三项方法贡献：(1) 基于离散应变参数化的线性可变形物体全动态模型；(2) 将驱动坐标概念扩展至SE(3)，形成结构化且本质欠驱动的控制架构；(3) 非线性反馈策略，给出稳态收敛到目标构型的显式条件。控制通过多点施加力与力矩实现。

Result: 在代表性操纵任务上的大量仿真验证了基于模型公式带来的性能提升；并通过带在线形状估计的实时闭环实现完成实验验证，证明了实际可行性与有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作突破准静态假设，为动力学不可忽略的线性可变形物体提供了结构化欠驱动闭环控制方案，仿真与实验均证实其有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Most research on the manipulation of deformable objects focuses on lightweight systems with negligible mechanical response, effectively restricting attention to quasi-static regimes. This assumption excludes a broad class of practically relevant objects, such as hoses, pipes, and wiring harnesses, whose dynamics cannot be ignored during manipulation. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a closed-loop control architecture that explicitly accounts for object dynamics and recasts manipulation as a shape-regulation problem. Control is achieved by modulating forces and torques applied at multiple fixed points along the object. This approach builds on three methodological contributions: a fully dynamic model of linear deformable objects based on discrete strain parameterizations; an extension of the notion of actuation coordinates to SE(3), yielding a structured and inherently underactuated control architecture; and nonlinear feedback strategies providing explicit conditions for steady-state convergence to desired configurations. Extensive simulations on representative manipulation tasks demonstrate the performance gains enabled by the proposed modelbased formulation. We finally validate the approach experimentally through a real-time closed-loop implementation with online shape estimation, confirming its practical feasibility and effectiveness

</details>


### [508] [Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26007)
*Yuhang Zhang,Rangya Zhang,Yujing Shang,Zhuoyuan Yu,Weiying Wang,Steven Yang,Qingsong Yan,Chao Yan,Mir Feroskhan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 skytopia：基于动作条件隐世界模型的单目无人机导航策略，训练于3D高斯泼溅平台；仅用世界模型学到的表征而丢弃预测器，用同一策略统一支持点目标、图像目标与无目标导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目无人机在未知环境中仅靠单个前视相机导航，缺乏深度与尺度线索。现有世界模型虽能建模"观测随动作如何演变"，但其设计范式是"被执行"：部署时逐步预测并反馈给动作生成，推理开销大。作者认为策略真正需要的不是预测本身，而是为产生预测所需的表征——飞行中执行动作几乎解释了观测间全部变化，预测实际退化为已知位移下对静态场景的重投影。

Method: 构建动作条件隐世界模型及配套的3D高斯泼溅训练平台。采用双目标训练：前向目标由意图运动预测下一观测的表征；逆向目标由预测的转移反推该运动。由于预测不进入动作生成，预测器在部署时被丢弃，仅保留策略；同一策略适配点目标、图像目标和无目标三种导航设定。

Result: 仿真中在三种任务设定下均优于所有基线，成功率分别为57.8%（点目标）、66.0%（图像目标）、49.0%（无目标）；丢弃预测器节省59.4%推理成本。同一策略无需微调即部署于真实无人机，在室内、开阔室外与林地环境中成功抵达目标。

Conclusion: 世界模型对策略的价值在于其学到的表征而非预测输出；据此设计的轻量策略可实现多任务统一、跨仿真到真实（sim-to-real）零微调迁移，兼顾性能与推理效率。

Abstract: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.

</details>


### [509] [Towards Intent-Aware Human-Robot Teaming: A Platform for Search-and-Rescue Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26051)
*Rohith Prem Maben,Ayesha Jena,Björn Olofsson,Stefan Reitmann,Jacek Malec,Rogier Woltjer,Elin Anna Topp*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个人机交互平台，用于研究复杂动态环境中人类操作员与异构自主智能体的协作，支持意图推断与决策，并以搜救场景验证自主系统对操作员感知、决策与行动的支持程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂动态环境下，人类操作员与异构自主智能体之间的有效协作面临挑战，需要理解操作员行为并为其提供感知、决策与行动支持。

Method: 构建一个交互平台，使操作员行为可被研究，并基于先进框架支持意图推断与决策，通过搜救操作实验进行验证。

Result: 在搜救任务中演示了自主系统能够在多大程度上支持操作员的感知、决策与行动。

Conclusion: 所提出的交互平台可用于研究与促进人机协作，并展示了自主系统在复杂动态任务中对操作员的支持能力。

Abstract: We investigate the challenges of enabling effective collaboration between human operators and heterogeneous autonomous agents in complex, dynamic environments by developing an interaction platform that allows study of operator behavior and supports intent inference and decision-making using state-of-the-art frameworks. We demonstrate the extent to which the operator's perception, decisions, and actions could be supported by autonomous systems during search-and-rescue operations with our platform.

</details>


### [510] [StrataVLA: Hierarchical and Efficient 3D Geometric Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26071)
*Jin Cui,Zhaoyu Pu,Botao Cai,Jun Ye,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StrataVLA是一个即插即用的分层几何接地框架，通过冻结几何基础模型与稀疏层级几何适配器，将几何证据注入VLA视觉语言主干，并结合任务感知路由与LRU缓存降低推理开销。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv及真实机器人操作上均优于强基线，LIBERO平均成功率98.53%，几何模型调用减少达88%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽继承大规模视觉语言预训练的强语义先验，但3D空间感知不足，限制机器人操作能力。现有方案或需显式深度/点云输入，或将几何压缩为训练期监督，或仅在模型输入/动作专家处注入几何，导致视觉语言主干无法持续获取与任务相关的空间信息。

Method: 提出StrataVLA分层几何接地框架：用冻结的几何基础模型从RGB观测中提取共享几何特征；在选定主干深度插入稀疏的层级专用Geometry Adapters，通过交叉注意力让视觉表征检索相关几何证据；推理时结合任务感知路由与LRU特征缓存，利用操作过程中的时间冗余降低几何模型调用。

Result: 在LIBERO、SimplerEnv及真实世界操作任务上，相比强VLA基线取得一致提升；LIBERO套件平均成功率98.53%，同时几何模型调用次数最多减少88%。

Conclusion: 分层几何注入是实现空间接地机器人控制的有效且高效途径；StrataVLA以即插即用方式在保持性能优势的同时显著降低几何推理开销。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit strong semantic priors from large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet remain limited in robotic manipulation by insufficient 3D spatial awareness. Existing approaches either require explicit depth or point-cloud inputs, compress geometry into training-time supervision, or inject it only at the model input or action expert, leaving the vision-language backbone without persistent access to task-relevant spatial information. We introduce StrataVLA, a plug-and-play framework for hierarchical geometric grounding. A frozen geometry foundation model extracts shared geometric features from RGB observations, while sparse, layer-specific Geometry Adapters allow visual representations at selected backbone depths to retrieve relevant geometric evidence through cross-attention. To make inference-time geometry practical, StrataVLA further combines task-aware routing with an LRU feature cache that exploits temporal redundancy during task manipulation. Experiments on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over strong VLA baselines. StrataVLA achieves 98.53% average success on LIBERO suites while reducing geometry-model invocations by up to 88%, establishing hierarchical geometry injection as an effective and efficient way to achieve spatially grounded robotic control.

</details>


### [511] [Situation Aware Locomotion for Dual Mobile Cobots in Shared Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26083)
*William Moraes,Igor Nunes,Ahilen Mazondo,Sebastian Barcelona,Hiago Sodre,Pablo Moraes,Ricardo B. Grando*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种情境感知（situation aware）的双移动协作机器人运动框架，用于共享工业环境中的安全运动决策，并在仿真中验证其优于独立与固定优先级基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双移动协作机器人在共享工业环境中作业时，需要兼顾负载状态、机械臂状态、共享区域占用与机器人间潜在冲突，传统独立决策或固定优先级策略难以保证安全与效率，因此需要引入情境感知来支撑运动决策。

Method: 以感知、理解、预测三个层次建模情境感知；将机器人位姿、负载状态、机械臂状态、共享区域占用、障碍物状态以及预测的机器人间冲突作为输入，用于选择安全的运动动作。框架在仿真中实现，并在与4m×4m物理测试区域相匹配的仿真工业场景中，与两种基线进行多次试验及随机种子对比评估。

Result: 情境感知方法在所有场景中实现100%任务成功率，而独立基线与固定优先级基线的总体成功率均为33.3%；该方法消除了共享区域冲突与安全停机，保持了最大的平均机器人间最小距离，并以最低平均完成时间完成任务。

Conclusion: 结果表明，情境感知通过融合负载状态、机械臂状态、共享区域推理与短时域冲突预测，能够有效改善双机器人的运动表现，提升安全性与效率。

Abstract: This paper presents a situation aware locomotion framework for two mobile collaborative robots operating in shared industrial environments. The proposed method models situation awareness through perception, comprehension, and projection to support locomotion decisions. Robot pose, load state, manipulator state, shared zone occupancy, obstacle state, and predicted inter robot conflict were used to select safe locomotion actions. The framework was implemented in simulation and evaluated in simulated industrial scenarios designed to match a feasible 4 m by 4 m physical test area. The proposed method was compared with two other baselines over multiple trials and randomized seeds. The results show that the situation aware method achieved 100% task success across all scenarios, while the independent and fixed priority baselines each achieved 33.3% overall success. The proposed method eliminated shared zone conflicts and safety stops, maintained the largest average minimum inter robot distance, and completed the tasks with the lowest average completion time. These results indicate that situational awareness can improve the locomotion of dual robots by combining load state, manipulator state, reasoning about the shared zone, and prediction of short-horizon conflicts.

</details>


### [512] [Vision-Language Models as copilots for Autonomous UAV Navigation: Analysis of Latency and Reliability in Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26084)
*Hiago Sodre,Sebastian Barcelona,Vincent Sandin,Pablo Moraes,Ahilen Mazondo,Igor Nunes,William Moraes,André Kelbouscas,Ricardo Grando*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向无GPS环境UAV的FSM-VLM混合控制架构，将确定性有限状态机负责底层物理控制、异步VLM副驾驶负责高层语义寻路，并在SITL仿真中用三种参数规模模型评估其语法错误与语义幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM为自主UAV带来语义推理能力，但实时闭环导航不仅要求低推理延迟，还要求遵守结构化飞行指令，二者之间存在集成难题。

Method: 构建FSM与异步VLM协同的混合控制架构，在无GPS场景下运行；在软件在环（SITL）仿真中评测三种不同参数规模的模型，并在正常与退化两种场景下分别度量格式层面的语法错误与逻辑层面的语义幻觉。

Result: 框架成功分离并量化了格式级语法错误与逻辑级语义幻觉；实验表明参数规模而非纯延迟，仍是VLM安全且兼容地集成到自主飞行中的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: VLM融入自主飞行时，提升模型参数规模比优化延迟更为关键；FSM-VLM混合架构为无GPS UAV提供了一条可行的分层控制路径。

Abstract: The integration of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offers unprecedented semantic reasoning capabilities. However, real-time closed-loop navigation requires not only low inference latency but also obedience to structured flight commands. This paper proposes a hybrid FSM-VLM control architecture for UAVs in GPS-free environments. The system combines a deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM) for low-level physical control with an asynchronous VLM copilot for high-level semantic pathfinding. We evaluate three models with different parameter scales in a Software-In-The-Loop (SITL) simulation. The framework isolates and measures syntax errors at the format level versus semantic hallucinations at the logic level in a normal and degraded scenario. This study demonstrates that parameter scaling, and not pure latency, remains the primary bottleneck for the safe and compatible integration of VLM into autonomous flights.

</details>


### [513] [Acoustic Ellipses: Bio-Inspired Omnidirectional Echolocation in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems using Frequency Sweeps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26085)
*Petras Swissler,Lindsay Burke,Julia Hyland Bruno*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 受鸟类飞行与鸣叫启发，提出一种蜂群机器人环境建图方法：静止源智能体发出调频啁啾信号，移动的监听智能体观测直达与反射信号，利用"频率间隙"定义候选反射椭圆并通过2D累积滤波定位障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为蜂群机器人系统提供一种低成本的环境建图/障碍识别方案，借鉴鸟类通过鸣叫与听觉感知环境的生物机制。

Method: 静止源智能体发射频率调制啁啾信号，一个或多个运动中的监听智能体接收直达与反射信号；利用直达与反射啁啾之间的"频率间隙"构建候选反射椭圆，再经2D累积滤波器识别潜在反射密度最高的位置。通过定制高效音频仿真器进行仿真，考察障碍数量、采样率、路径曲率的影响，并比较双监听者的协同运动策略，最后用现成硬件在户外公园开展实地验证。

Result: 仿真中给出了单监听场景下障碍数量、采样率与路径曲率对识别精度的影响，比较了双监听者的多种协同运动策略；实地实验证明用现成硬件可检测到频率间隙，验证了方法的现实可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作为蜂群机器人系统提供了一种低成本环境建图方法的基础，验证了基于啁啾频率间隙的协同障碍识别在仿真与真实场景中的可行性。

Abstract: Inspired by the flight and song of birds, we propose an approach that enables cooperating agents to effectively identify obstacles in their environment by having a stationary source agent emit a frequency-modulated chirp while one or more listener agents observe the direct and reflected signals while in motion. We present a novel mapping approach that exploits the ``frequency gap'' between direct and reflected chirp signals to define candidate reflection ellipses, which are then fed into a 2D accumulation filter to identify locations with the highest density of potential reflections.
  We demonstrate this work first with simulation results derived from an efficient, bespoke audio simulator, examining the effect of obstacle count, sampling rate, and path curvature on the ability to accurately identify environmental obstacles for a one-listener scenario. We then examine different cooperative motion strategies for two-listener configurations. Finally, we validate the real-world viability of this approach through field experiments in an outdoor park setting to demonstrate the ability to identify frequency gaps using off-the-shelf hardware. Our results provide a foundation for a low-cost approach to environmental mapping in swarm robotic systems.

</details>


### [514] [GDLAM: Group-Disentangled Latent Action Model for Highly Disentangled Embodied Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26118)
*Jiarui Yang,Jiawei Li,Jiale Zhang,Hang Guo,Wen Huang,Maowei Hu,Tao Dai,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出组解耦潜在动作模型（GDLAM），通过将潜在动作编码按构造分解为N个独立组，并施加信息几何约束使其因果互斥，从而在无监督视频中学习到语义结构清晰、可干预、可迁移的动作表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型（LAM）将相机运动、物体动力学与交互事件等异质视觉变化源坍缩进单一潜向量，导致表征纠缠、语义结构薄弱，进而限制了世界模型的可控性与VLA策略的泛化能力。

Method: GDLAM将动作码按构造分解为N个组，每组配备独立的变分瓶颈与空间门控路由通路；训练时引入一组信息几何目标：互斥性、组稀疏与门稀疏、静态—动态正交性，使各组在因果意义上相互区分，而非仅统计去相关。

Result: 干预任一单组仅改变该组而其余组保持不变；在Modularity、MIG、DCI等无需标签的解耦指标上大幅优于强非结构化LAM。跨三种互信息估计器与线性探针，分组编码在分布内与分布外均比单体基线更具动作信息量。迁移至下游：世界模型在推演保真度与动作跟随能力上超越SOTA；VLA策略在多个仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务中显著提升成功率。

Conclusion: 按组分解潜动作码并以信息几何约束实现因果互斥，可在不损失动作信息的前提下获得可干预、可复用的解耦表征，为具身智能预训练提供有效的可迁移"货币"。

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-related representations from action-free videos via self-supervised future prediction, offering a scalable paradigm for embodied intelligence pretraining. However, existing LAMs collapse heterogeneous sources of visual change, including camera motion, object dynamics, and interaction events, into a single latent vector, resulting in entangled representations with limited semantic structure and consequently restricting world model controllability and VLA policy generalization. We introduce the Group-Disentangled Latent Action Model (GDLAM), a latent action model whose code is factorized by construction into N groups, each with an independent variational bottleneck and a spatially gated routing pathway, and trained with a set of information-geometric objectives: mutual exclusivity, group and gate sparsity, and static-dynamic orthogonality, that make the groups mutually causally distinct rather than merely decorrelated. Quantitatively, intervening on any single group changes only that group and leaves the others intact, and GDLAM improves label-free disentanglement metrics, including Modularity, MIG, and DCI, by wide margins over a strong unstructured LAM. Notably, this factorization is not at the expense of action information: across three mutual-information estimators and a linear probe, the grouped code is more informative than monolithic baselines both in- and out-of-distribution. As supporting evidence that the disentangled code is a reusable pretraining currency, we further transfer it to two downstream regimes: (1) World Modeling: World models pretrained with GDLAM achieve superior rollout fidelity and action-following capability compared with SOTA baselines. (2) VLA Policies: Pretraining with GDLAM substantially improves task success rates over previous methods across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks

</details>


### [515] [Design and Implementation of an Ultra-Low-Cost Wall-Climbing Robot for Infrastructure Crack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26130)
*Mrinmoy Modak,Supreyo Chakravorty Pretom,Shourv Tarafder,Daniel S. Drew*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文开发了一种低成本自动化裂缝检测爬壁机器人，结合YOLOv8与CNN/EfficientNet-B0两阶段深度学习流程，并采用漏斗形负压吸附结构与3D打印轻量底盘，总成本约25美元，可用于发展中国家基础设施实时巡检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑与基础设施的安全和寿命依赖裂缝检测，但传统人工检测存在成本高、劳动强度大、安全风险高的问题；同时发展中国家受预算限制，亟需可扩展、低成本、易获取的自动化检测方案。

Method: 构建两阶段系统：第一阶段用YOLOv8从视频帧中检测并定位墙体区域，裁剪边界框；第二阶段对裁剪区域采用三种模型之一（CNN、EfficientNet-B0及YOLOv8）进行裂缝检测/二分类。硬件方面采用风扇负压吸附系统、四轮滑移转向驱动、ESP32-CAM实时图像采集和轻量3D打印底盘，并设计漏斗形机身增强负压、降低占空比。同时构建了精选裂缝图像数据集用于训练与评估，并提供基于智能手机控制的轻量Web应用。

Result: YOLOv8实现实时目标检测并增强裂缝定位，CNN与EfficientNet-B0提供高精度与高召回率的二分类；漏斗形机身提升负压生成，占空比降低44%，显著降低功耗；机器人可在墙面与天花板稳定移动并采集图像进行分析；系统总成本约25美元，并通过Web应用实现手机端控制。

Conclusion: 将低成本硬件与深度学习流程相结合，提供了一种可扩展、高效且易获取的实时基础设施巡检方案；其低成本特性使其更适合预算受限、劳动密集且存在安全风险的发展中地区。

Abstract: Crack detection is a crucial process to ensure the safety and longevity of buildings and other infrastructure. In this paper, we developed a low-cost, automated crack detection robot that leverages CNN, EfficientNet-B0, and YOLOv8 for efficient identification of cracks in concrete surfaces with a curated crack image dataset introduced to support training and evaluation. YOLOv8's real-time object detection enhances crack localization, while CNN and EfficientNet-B0 provide binary classification, ensuring high precision and recall. The system consists of two stages. In the first stage, YOLOv8 detects and localizes wall regions from the video frame, and the bounding boxes are cropped. The second stage performs crack detection using one of three models by analyzing the cropped regions. Cost-effective approaches are also taken for robot design. The robot features a fan-based negative pressure adhesion system, a 4-wheeled skid-steering drive, and an ESP32-CAM for real-time image capture. Its lightweight 3D-printed chassis ensures stability, allowing it to navigate both walls and ceilings while capturing images for crack analysis. Unlike conventional wall-climbing robot designs, this robot incorporates a funnel-shaped body that enhances negative pressure generation and achieves a 44% reduction in duty cycle, significantly lowering power consumption. By combining low-cost hardware with a deep learning pipeline, our system provides a scalable, efficient, and accessible solution for real-time infrastructure inspection at an approximate total cost of $25, with a lightweight web application enabling smartphone-based control. This affordability makes the system more suitable for the developing world, where infrastructure inspection is often limited by budget constraints, labor intensity, and safety risks.

</details>


### [516] [Toward Self-Repairing Ubiquitous Robots Using Goal-Oriented Agentic AI in Human-Robot Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26155)
*Morten Roed Frederiksen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出面向机器人维修任务的目标导向智能体架构，通过情境对话让非专家用户完成技术维修，20人中19人完成（95%），系统评价良好且对对话偏移具备鲁棒性；与在线基线相比，物理交互显著降低社会临场感与信任/胜任感，但感知有用性仍保持高位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 普及型机器人系统通常缺乏传统可视化界面，因此自然语言交互对维护与修理任务至关重要；同时需要让非专家用户也能借由情境对话完成技术性维修。

Method: 提出一种目标导向的智能体AI架构，将交互前目标分解、持久状态跟踪、策略性目标管理与实时对话执行相分离；在真实硬件维修任务中开展20名被试的评估，并与既有在线基线进行对比。

Result: 20名被试中19人完成任务，完成率95%；被试认为系统有帮助且胜任，智能体对元查询、语码转换等对话偏移保持鲁棒；相较在线基线，物理交互显著降低感知社会临场感（p=.0005）及信任与胜任感（p=.037），而感知有用性仍较高。

Conclusion: 该架构能够支持非专家用户在物理场景中完成技术维修任务，验证了目标导向智能体在无传统界面机器人上的可行性；但物理交互会削弱社会临场感与信任/胜任感，提示后续设计需在保持有用性的同时改善这些体验维度。

Abstract: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, making natural language interaction important for maintenance and repair. This paper presents a goal-oriented agentic AI architecture that enables non-expert users to complete technical repair tasks through situated dialogue. The architecture separates pre-interaction goal decomposition, persistent state tracking, strategic goal management, and real-time conversational execution. We evaluated the system in a physical hardware repair task with twenty participants. Nineteen participants completed the task, corresponding to a 95% completion rate. Participants rated the system as helpful and competent, and the agent remained robust to conversational diversions such as meta-queries and code-switching. A comparison with a prior online baseline showed that physical interaction significantly reduced perceived social presence, (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while perceived helpfulness remained high.

</details>


### [517] [Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects Using Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26238)
*Lukas Zeh,Johannes Meiwaldt,Zexu Zhou,Armin Lechler,Alexander Verl*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的最优控制方法用于可变形线性物体(DLO)的操纵，采用biLSTM网络建模动力学，结合MPPI模型预测控制，并通过仿真与实验验证其有效性与高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形线性物体（如线缆）具有无限自由度和非线性动力学，难以自动化操纵，传统方法面临建模困难与控制复杂度的挑战，因此需要一种能有效处理其高维非线性特性的建模与控制方法。

Method: 方法分为建模与控制两部分：建模上使用双向长短期记忆网络(biLSTM)学习DLO动力学，训练数据由MuJoCo物理引擎生成的合成数据提供；控制上采用模型预测控制(MPC)策略，具体使用模型预测路径积分(MPPI)控制。

Result: 通过仿真与实验对提出方法进行了评估，结果表明该方法能够实现对DLO准确且高效的操纵。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于biLSTM建模与MPPI控制的机器学习最优控制框架，在DLO操纵任务中表现出有效性，兼顾了准确性与效率。

Abstract: The manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as cables poses a significant challenge for automation due to their infinite degrees of freedom and non-linear dynamics. In this paper we present a machine learning based optimal control approach for the manipulation of DLOs. This approach is divided into two main components: modeling and control. For modeling the dynamics of the DLO, we propose a learning based approach using a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (biLSTM) network. The biLSTM network is trained on synthetic data generated by the MuJoCo physics engine. For manipulating the DLO, a model predictive control strategy that employs Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is selected. The proposed approach is evaluated through simulation and experiments. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in achieving accurate and efficient manipulation of DLOs.

</details>


### [518] [High-Bandwidth Biomimetic Finger for Tactile-Transparent Remote Texture Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26256)
*Shuang Yang,Fuyuan Liu,Yitian Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究通过仿生指尖设计与人类指尖对比，建立了从指尖设计、信号特征到触觉透明度的传递链，揭示了多层力学梯度与指纹形态对纹理触觉反馈的作用机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人遥操作中高保真触觉反馈对精准操作与关键决策至关重要，但仿生指尖传感器设计如何影响所渲染触觉反馈的"透明度"尚缺乏系统理解。

Method: 提出一种复现人类手指多层力学梯度与指纹形貌的仿生指尖，内嵌高灵敏度惯性测量单元以采集纹理诱发的振动，用于远程振动触觉渲染；对三种变体与人类指尖进行时域与频域分析，并开展覆盖三个感知维度的用户研究。

Result: 多层力学梯度在信号强度与纹理特征表征上改进最明显；更硬的皮肤层虽增强振动强度却牺牲特征表征。不同感知维度依赖不同信号属性：粗糙度依赖能量尺度，颗粒感依赖频谱形状，重复性依赖特征峰表征。

Conclusion: 研究结果为机器人遥操作中面向特定应用场景的仿生指尖设计提供了设计准则。

Abstract: High-fidelity tactile feedback is essential for robotic teleoperation, enabling precise manipulation and critical decision-making. While biomimetic fingertip sensors can capture surface-texture features, how their design shapes the tactile transparency of rendered feedback remains poorly understood. This paper presents a biomimetic fingertip replicating the human finger's multilayer mechanical gradient and fingerprint morphology, with an embedded high-sensitivity inertial measurement unit capturing texture-induced vibrations for remote vibrotactile rendering. Three variants are compared with the human fingertip through temporal and spectral analyses and a user study spanning three perceptual dimensions, establishing a transmission chain from fingertip design through signal characteristics to tactile transparency. The multilayer mechanical gradient yields the clearest improvements in signal intensity and texture-feature representation, whereas a stiffer skin layer amplifies vibration intensity at the expense of feature representation. The perceptual dimensions draw on distinct signal attributes: roughness on energy scaling, granularity on spectral shape, and repetitivity on characteristic-peak representation. These findings offer design principles for application-specific fingertips in robotic teleoperation.

</details>


### [519] [Multi-Axis Selective Decoupling Framework for Free-Floating Space Manipulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26267)
*Daegyun Choi,Donghoon Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种多轴选择性解耦框架，通过在任务关键方向上定向消除动量传递，放松传统无扰动的零空间约束，从而在保证指定轴无扰的同时保留其余自由度、扩大工作空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由漂浮空间机械臂存在动力学耦合导致的操作难题；传统无扰动操作虽能消除基座扰动，但在所有旋转轴上强制零空间投影会施加过度约束，极大缩减可用工作空间。

Method: 构建多轴选择性解耦框架，仅沿任务关键方向消除动量传递；引入方向约束子耦合矩阵，以放松零空间约束。

Result: 数值仿真表明，该方法可在数学上消除目标轴上的受约束方向扰动，同时保留其余自由度，使机械臂成功完成任务空间操作。

Conclusion: 该框架在指定方向上实现精确解耦，避免了全轴约束带来的工作空间损失，兼顾基座扰动抑制与操作能力。

Abstract: Free-floating space manipulator systems face operational challenges due to dynamic coupling. While traditional reactionless manipulation eliminates base disturbances, enforcing the null-space projections across all rotational axes imposes excessive constraints on the system and drastically reduces the available workspace. To address this limitation, this work proposes a multi-axis selective decoupling framework that nullifies momentum transfer exclusively along mission-critical directions. By leveraging a directionally constrained sub-coupling matrix, the framework relaxes the null-space constraints. Numerical simulations confirm that this approach mathematically eliminates constrained directional disturbances along the targeted axes while preserving the remaining degrees of freedom, enabling the manipulator to execute task-space operations successfully.

</details>


### [520] [RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26292)
*Jiaqi Zhang,Feng Ye,Mingjia Yang,Zhihong Chen,Mingkang Xiang,Xinglin Yao,Yanbin Li,Siwei Ma,Chuanmin Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 RoboTwin-Phys，一个将物理条件多样性作为显式评测维度的机器人操作基准，连续变化 13 种物理属性并发布 5000+ 专家演示，揭示现有 WAM/VLA 模型在物理条件变化下存在显著鲁棒性缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作基准虽在仿真规模、物体外观、场景布局与视觉观测上引入变化，但底层物理参数通常固定，导致质量、摩擦、关节动力学等真实世界关键变异源缺乏测试，评测无法反映策略对物理条件多样性的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出 RoboTwin-Phys 基准：将物理条件多样性作为机器人操作评测的显式维度，在物理合理范围内连续变化 13 种物理属性，为策略提供统一的跨物理工况评测环境；同时发布超过 5000 条带有真值物理参数的专家演示，支持物理属性估计、条件感知建模与物理条件化策略训练。

Result: 对代表性世界动作模型（WAMs）与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）的评测显示存在显著鲁棒性缺口：在既有视觉与布局随机化下仍有效的模型，在物理条件变化时性能会明显下降。

Conclusion: RoboTwin-Phys 提供了系统度量并改进机器人操作物理条件多样性鲁棒性所需的基准、数据与评测协议。

Abstract: Physical-condition diversity is largely missing from current benchmarks for robot manipulation. While large-scale simulation benchmarks increasingly incorporate variations in object appearance, scene layout, and visual observations, they typically keep the underlying physical parameters fixed. As a result, important sources of real-world variability, such as changes in mass, friction, and joint dynamics, remain largely untested. We introduce RoboTwin-Phys, a physics-diverse benchmark that treats physical-condition diversity as an explicit dimension of robot manipulation evaluation. The benchmark continuously varies 13 physical attributes within physically plausible ranges, providing a unified setting for evaluating policies across diverse physical operating conditions. We further release more than 5,000 expert demonstrations with ground-truth physical parameters, enabling physical-attribute estimation, condition-aware modeling, and physics-conditioned policy training. Evaluations of representative WAMs and VLAs reveal a substantial robustness gap: models that remain effective under existing visual and layout randomization can degrade markedly under changes in physical conditions. RoboTwin-Phys provides the benchmark, data, and evaluation protocol needed to systematically measure and improve robustness to physical-condition diversity in robot manipulation.

</details>


### [521] [Shaft-Configuration-Adaptive Catheter Tip Position Estimation via Motor-History Conditioned Residual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26304)
*Peihan Zhang,Michael C. Yip,Ankur Kapoor,Young-Ho Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于电机历史条件化GRU残差估计器的导管尖端三维定位方法，无需直接感知轴构型，在16种弯曲构型下实现3.3mm开环RMSE，较恒曲率基线降低59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌腱驱动连续体机械臂广泛用于医疗场景，尖端位置精确估计对导航与器械定位至关重要。但患者解剖与手术布置导致轴构型任务相关且未知，摩擦、松弛与柔顺性引入迟滞，使尖端估计困难。

Method: 先以多方向扫描策略标定几何导管模型主干，并将电机角度与驱动力矩响应编码为轴构型上下文向量；运动过程中该上下文条件化GRU，仅依赖电机测量预测任务空间残差以校正主干。上下文在当前轴构型下保持固定，循环状态则捕捉演化的驱动历史。

Result: 在4根一次性心内超声心动图导管、16种弯曲轴构型下，实现3.3mm开环尖端RMSE，相对恒曲率基线降低59%。

Conclusion: 该方法无需直接轴构型感知即可实现三维尖端估计，通过上下文条件化残差学习有效补偿迟滞与构型不确定性，验证了在一次性心内超声导管上的可行性。

Abstract: Tendon-driven continuum manipulators are widely used in medical applications, where accurate tip-position estimation is essential for precise navigation and instrument positioning. However, patient anatomy and procedural setup impose task-dependent unknown shaft configurations, while friction, slack, and compliance introduce hysteresis, making tip estimation challenging. This paper presents a motor-history-conditioned gated recurrent unit (GRU) residual estimator for three-dimensional catheter tip estimation without direct shaft-configuration sensing. First, an initial multidirectional sweep strategy is applied to calibrate a geometric catheter model backbone, and encode the motor-angle and drive-torque response into a shaft-configuration context vector. During subsequent motion, the context conditions a GRU that predicts a task-space residual correcting this backbone, relying on motor measurements alone. The context remains fixed for the current shaft configuration, while the recurrent state captures the evolving actuation history. Across four disposable intra-cardiac echocardiography catheters and 16 bent shaft configurations, the method achieves 3.3mm open-loop tip RMSE, a 59% reduction relative to the constant-curvature baseline.

</details>


### [522] [SafeLoop: Risk-Aware Rollback for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26313)
*Zeyu Lou,Tianran Zhang,Xinquan Yue,Ya Jing,Chenyang Si*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SafeLoop：一种非侵入式外部封装模块，为 VLA 模型增加危险预测与回滚恢复，在不改变基座策略参数的前提下将危险事件减少约 70%，同时保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程操作仍较脆弱，微小的状态估计或控制误差会引发碰撞、物体掉落等不可逆失败，因此需要一种能主动预判危险的安全机制。同时希望避免重新训练或修改 VLA 模型参数，以保持其通用操控能力与控制频率。

Method: SafeLoop 作为非侵入式外部 wrapper 附加在 VLA 模型上。利用视觉与本体感受信息训练风险预测器，输出四个量：本体碰撞与物体失败各自的发生概率和剩余时间（time-to-hazard）。再由轻量控制器依据预测风险在三种动作中选择：继续执行（noop）、保存安全检查点（record）、关节空间回退（rollback）；回退至最近的安全路点后重新查询基座策略以获得替代续行方案。

Result: 在 24 个 LIBERO 任务（每个 16 个随机种子）与 3 个真机任务（每个 25 次 rollout）上，SafeLoop 取得更优的安全—成功权衡，危险事件减少约 70%，并保持任务成功率与基座策略控制率。

Conclusion: 将危险预判与回滚恢复解耦为外挂模块，可在不修改基座 VLA 参数的情况下显著提升长程操作安全性，验证了"预测—检查点—回退再查询"范式的有效性。

Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for general-purpose manipulation, but long-horizon execution remains fragile. Small state-estimation or control errors can lead to irreversible failures (e.g., collisions and object drops). Avoiding these risks requires a proactive safety mechanism capable of anticipating hazards. In this paper, we introduce SafeLoop, a non-invasive external wrapper that adds hazard prediction and rollback-based recovery to a VLA model without changing its parameters. SafeLoop trains a risk predictor from vision and proprioception to output four values: the probability and time-to-hazard for body collisions and for object failures. A lightweight controller then chooses one of three actions based on the predicted risk: continue execution (noop), save a safety checkpoint (record), or retreat in joint space (rollback). Rollback moves the robot back to a recent safe waypoint and queries the base policy again, which may yield an alternative continuation. Across 24 LIBERO tasks (16 random seeds each) and three real-robot tasks (25 rollouts each), SafeLoop achieves a stronger overall safety-success trade-off than alternative methods, reducing hazard cases by roughly 70% while preserving task success and the base-policy control rate. Project code is available at https://github.com/Loule0-0/SafeLoop/tree/release/safeloop.

</details>


### [523] [TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26314)
*Xuanyi Liu,Haofeng Wang,Ruiqi Li,Danni Yu,Rui Wan,Ruixu Zhang,Siyu Tao,Xue Yang,Shaofeng Zhang,Zicheng Zhang,Jiaqi Zhang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TRIWORLDBENCH，一个通过同步头部、左腕、右腕三视角视频评测具身世界模型的基准，包含500个回合、50个双臂操作任务和19项指标，并提出TWB-Score综合评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身世界模型预测机器人动作结果以支持学习与规划。对于配备头部和腕部相机的机器人，需要互补视角：头部视角捕捉整体任务，腕部视角揭示局部抓取-物体交互。然而独立评估各视角无法判断它们是否描述同一动作与物体状态，因此需要多视角一致性评测。

Method: 构建TRIWORLDBENCH基准，采集同步的头部、左腕、右腕视频，覆盖50个双臂操作任务共500个回合；设计19项指标，评估三视角一致性、任务对齐、物理与3D连贯性、运动质量、时间一致性和视觉质量；结合跨视角检查与各相机专属度量，并保留各视角结果以定位预测失败。

Result: 基准能够评测单视角合理的视频是否同时构成对目标任务的一致预测；以TWB-Score汇总整体性能，并通过分视角结果识别失败位置；将世界模型评估从单视角视觉质量拓展到多视角任务一致性。

Conclusion: TRIWORLDBENCH将具身世界模型评估从单视角视觉质量扩展至多视角一致性，代码、数据和指标定义已公开。

Abstract: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.

</details>


### [524] [ArborSplat: Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Orchards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26315)
*Alessandro Masini,Matteo Frosi,Mirko Usuelli,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ArborSplat：一种面向果园的在线语义3DGS SLAM系统，用LiDAR里程计跟踪并在高斯地图上直接优化语义，通过类特定高度带与多视角融合提升细结构语义精度，性能优于现有方法且更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 果园机器人需要保留树干、棚架和果实等小而语义重要的结构，但现有3DGS SLAM的优化由外观驱动，将图像语义迁移到3D点对细结构不可靠（其像素可能从背景表面获取深度），因此需要一种能在3D地图上可靠优化语义的方法。

Method: 提出ArborSplat在线语义3DGS SLAM系统：采用LiDAR里程计进行跟踪；语义直接在高斯地图上优化，并由每个关键帧立体点云拟合地面平面之上的类特定高度带约束；在线将多视角证据融合为语义点云，同时剔除与局部地面或单目深度不一致的标签；还采用类约束细化，为欠表达结构保留高斯容量。

Result: 在苹果园和梨园的休眠、开花与采收期评估：全部12条完整路线ATE低于0.5 m；在共享的301帧片段上，训练视角mIoU比SGS-SLAM和GS3LAM高0.23–0.50，留出视角mIoU高0.15–0.36，同时运行速度快1.7–7.5倍；SemGauss-SLAM在全部六个场景中显存不足。

Conclusion: ArborSplat通过在地图层面直接优化语义并结合几何高度带与多视角证据融合，实现了果园场景下高效且语义准确的在线3DGS SLAM，在保持低轨迹误差的同时显著提升语义性能与效率。

Abstract: Orchard robots need maps that preserve small but semantically important structures such as trunks, trellises, and fruit. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM achieves high photometric fidelity. However, its optimization remains appearance-driven, and transferring image semantics to 3D points is unreliable for thin structures, whose pixels may receive depth from background surfaces. We present ArborSplat, an online semantic 3DGS SLAM system that tracks with LiDAR odometry and optimizes semantics directly on the Gaussian map, constrained by class-specific height bands above a ground plane fitted to each keyframe's stereo point cloud, and fuses multi-view evidence into a semantic point cloud online while rejecting labels inconsistent with the local ground surface or with monocular depth. Class-constrained refinement reserves Gaussian capacity for underrepresented structures and, under reduced budgets, increases training-view accuracy on tree classes. We evaluate the approach on apple and pear orchards during dormancy, flowering, and harvesting. On full routes, it keeps ATE below 0.5 m on all 12 traversals. On shared 301-frame segments, it exceeds SGS-SLAM and GS3LAM by 0.23 to 0.50 training-view and 0.15 to 0.36 held-out mIoU while running 1.7 to 7.5 times faster, whereas SemGauss-SLAM runs out of GPU memory on all six.

</details>


### [525] [Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26360)
*Albert Gassol Puigjaner,Kostas Alexis*

Main category: cs.RO
