TL;DR: 提出HFLEX-EQA分层EQA框架，融合在线场景图、VLM规划、语义前沿探索与户型图先验，在OpenEQA与ExploreEQA上验证并实机部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EQA方法虽结合VLM与语义地图/场景图，但探索仅依赖局部观测，环境的全局结构先验（如户型布局）基本未被利用，导致探索效率与语义针对性不足。

Method: 从RGB-D观测增量构建分层场景图与开放词汇占据图，使VLM可联合推理场景图、任务相关视觉观测、探索历史及估计的拓扑户型图；并提出房间发现策略，利用户型图与开放词汇前沿语义，引导探索朝向语义相关但尚未观测的房间类型。

Result: 在OpenEQA和ExploreEQA基准上评估，并在真实室内环境的四足机器人上完成部署，结果显示结合VLM分层规划与结构户型先验对EQA任务有增益。

Conclusion: 将VLM驱动的分层规划与户型结构先验相结合，可有效提升具身问答中的探索与推理表现，并具备真实机器人部署可行性。

Abstract: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires an agent to explore a previously unseen environment, gather relevant information, and answer questions about the scene. Recent approaches leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with semantic maps or scene graphs to guide exploration. However, exploration is typically driven only by local observations, while structural priors about the environment remain largely unused. We propose HFLEX-EQA, a hierarchical EQA framework that combines online scene graph construction, VLM- based planning, semantic frontier exploration, and floorplan priors. The system incrementally builds a hierarchical scene graph and an open-vocabulary occupancy map from RGB-D observations, enabling a VLM to jointly reason over the scene graph, task-relevant visual observations, exploration history, and an estimated topological floorplan. Furthermore, we introduce a room-discovery strategy that leverages the floorplan and open-vocabulary frontier semantics to guide exploration toward semantically relevant yet currently unobserved room types. We evaluate HFLEX-EQA on the OpenEQA and ExploreEQA benchmarks and demonstrate deployment on a quadruped robot in real indoor environments. Our results demonstrate the benefit of combining VLM-based hierarchical planning with structural floorplan priors for the EQA task.

</details>


### [526] [MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26378)
*Jinhe Tang,Ruixiao Dai,Weiming Zhi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MAVP框架，通过预测显式基座位姿目标并利用定位反馈跟踪，提升移动操作策略的执行可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 示范训练的移动操作策略难以可靠实现预期基座运动，导致空间错位和后续操作失败。

Method: 从遥操作示范重建静态地图，将基座轨迹表达在共享地图坐标系提供一致监督；执行时策略输入RGB、关节状态和当前地图系基座位姿，联合预测目标基座位姿、手臂与夹爪动作；低层控制器用前馈运动加位姿误差反馈跟踪目标；训练时加入位姿噪声增强以提升鲁棒性。

Result: 在六个真实世界操作任务和三种策略家族上，MAVP在所有任务中成功率均高于无锚定的速度控制。

Conclusion: 显式位姿目标与地图锚定结合定位反馈，可有效纠正执行偏差，提高移动操作策略的可靠性与成功率。

Abstract: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.

</details>


### [527] [SparseNav: Instruction-conditioned Sparse Semantic Perception for Training-Free Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26408)
*Quanhua Chen,Juhan Kang,Runfeng Lin,ZiFei Zhang,Enquang Feng,Chunran Zheng,Xiwang Dong,Jiarong Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SparseNav是一个免训练框架，通过按需获取语义、维护轻量BEV地图与稀疏地标记忆，实现高效的视觉语言导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于地图的VLN依赖持久空间表示，但获取超出当前指令需求的语义会带来不必要的感知开销和无关标注，连续累积无关物体会浪费算力并污染VLM规划器所消费的视觉-空间表示。

Method: 提出SparseNav，遵循"少即是多"原则：持续维护轻量几何BEV地图与稀疏地标记忆；指令管理器跟踪导航进度并识别当前活跃地标查询；指令条件感知机制在查询地标可见且其度量位置能影响下一步决策时，调用开放词汇分割；所得地标记忆支持VLM在混合前沿与局部方向路点候选中进行选择，全程无需额外训练。

Result: 在Val-Unseen划分上，R2R-CE成功率达42.8%，RxR-CE达40.7%。通过受控消融实验考察了语义感知策略及各框架组件的贡献。成功在搭载Intel RealSense D455与Livox MID-360的Unitree Go2四足机器人上无预建地图部署，并在多室内环境中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 按需获取语义的稀疏表示策略可在无需训练的情况下取得有竞争力的导航性能，并可迁移至真实机器人平台实现无预建地图的指令条件导航。

Abstract: Map-based vision-language navigation (VLN) relies on persistent spatial representations to connect language understanding with geometric planning. However, acquiring semantics beyond the needs of the current instruction can introduce unnecessary perception cost and irrelevant annotations. Continuously accumulating unrelated objects may not only waste computation, but also clutter the visual-spatial representation consumed by the vision-language model (VLM) planner. To address this problem, we present SparseNav, a training-free framework that follows a less-is-more principle for semantic navigation. SparseNav persistently maintains a lightweight geometric bird's-eye-view (BEV) map and sparse landmark memory, acquiring new semantics on demand using the active sub-instruction to decide what is worth grounding. An instruction manager first tracks navigation progress and identifies the active landmark query. An instruction-conditioned perception mechanism then invokes open-vocabulary segmentation when the queried landmark is visible and its metric location can inform the next decision. The resulting landmark memory supports VLM selection among hybrid frontier and local directional waypoint candidates. Without any additional training, SparseNav achieves success rates of 42.8% on R2R-CE and 40.7% on RxR-CE, both on the Val-Unseen splits. Controlled ablations examine semantic perception strategies and the contributions of individual framework components. Furthermore, we successfully deployed SparseNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D camera for geometric mapping and landmark grounding and a Livox MID-360 LiDAR for localization, without a prebuilt map. We validated its effectiveness across multiple indoor environments using instruction-conditioned waypoint navigation.

</details>


### [528] [Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26420)
*Raphael Memmesheimer,Sven Behnke*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出免训练的S³（采样-仿真-选择）框架，把预训练全身跟踪控制器置于回路中，用确定性仿真器对冻结文本到运动模型生成的N个候选动作进行滚动验证并择优，从而在无任何训练的情况下大幅缩小文本到人形机器人动作的可行性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到运动模型能生成看似合理的人体动作，却不建模机器人动力学；全身跟踪控制器能可靠执行给定参考，却无法对不可行参考重新规划。现有语言到人形系统靠训练弥合这一鸿沟，本文则希望测量在完全不训练的情况下、仅靠"将部署控制器本身置于回路"能弥补多少差距，并界定该上限所在。

Method: S³对每个文本提示从冻结的文本到运动模型采样N个动作，经方向匹配逆运动学重定向到Unitree G1，再在完整刚体动力学下用预训练SONIC跟踪策略全部rollout，保留策略执行最佳的候选。由于验证器即确定性仿真器本身，S³按构造达到any-of-N上限。为进一步比较，作者另用预测跌倒表现良好的运动学验证器（AUROC 0.90）做排序、以GMR替换重定向器做消融，并用标准文本-运动评测器对所有执行动作打分（含真实动捕对照）。

Result: 在200条分层HumanML3D测试提示、N=8时，直立执行率由83.5%升至89.5%，硬件门通过数由33增至85；完整测试集（4,184条）由80.5%升至89.5%。运动学验证器仅能挽回约四分之一增益，说明在提示内部对候选排序比总体分类更难。选择无法修复"降低骨盆"这一特定类别，而用重定向机器人数据训练的生成器可执行该类。消融显示与GMR呈互补失效，两者的any-of-8上限升至95.0%。全部177个门选片段在真实G1上执行，每个都保持站立完成，硬件跟踪误差与仿真一致（r=0.94）。

Conclusion: 无需任何训练，仅通过在回路中放入部署控制器并以仿真器作验证器，即可显著提升文本驱动人形动作的可行性与硬件通过率，且达到any-of-N上限。剩余差距集中在特定失效类别上，需依赖重定向机器人数据训练或互补重定向器来补足。

Abstract: Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S$^3$) draws $N$ motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S$^3$ attains the any-of-$N$ ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with $N=8$, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation ($r=0.94$).

</details>


### [529] [Dr-LiSA: Direct Radar-Lidar Scan Alignment for $SE(3)$ Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26423)
*Alex Zhang,Daniil Lisus,Cedric Le Gentil,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Dr-LiSA，首个在SE(3)下将2D旋转雷达强度测量直接定位到3D激光雷达地图的直接法方法，通过可学习前向模型预测雷达测量并与观测进行光度对齐，在SE(2)上超越既有雷达-激光雷达方法，平面精度媲美SOTA雷达-雷达定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雷达-激光雷达定位结合了两种模态的互补优势：雷达在恶劣天气和降水下鲁棒，激光雷达在良好条件下提供高保真3D地图。但现有雷达-激光雷达方法受限于平面SE(2)定位，且精度普遍不及激光雷达-激光雷达甚至雷达-雷达系统。核心挑战在于雷达与激光雷达之间的感知模态鸿沟——二者观察和表征场景结构的方式根本不同。

Method: Dr-LiSA采用可学习的前向模型，在候选位姿下由激光雷达子图预测雷达测量，从而在SE(3)中实现预测雷达扫描与观测雷达扫描的直接光度对齐，弥合雷达-激光雷达模态差异。

Result: 在超过90公里的实车道路数据上，Dr-LiSA在SE(2)定位上优于先前的雷达-激光雷达方法，并达到与最先进雷达-雷达定位相当的平面精度。

Conclusion: Dr-LiSA是首个实现SE(3)下雷达强度测量对3D激光雷达地图直接定位的方法，验证了通过可学习前向建模弥合模态鸿沟的可行性，将雷达-激光雷达定位精度提升至与雷达-雷达定位相当的水平。

Abstract: This paper introduces Dr-LiSA, a first-of-its-kind direct method for localizing 2D spinning radar intensity measurements in $SE(3)$ against 3D lidar maps. Radar-lidar localization combines the complementary strengths of the two sensing modalities: radar is robust to adverse weather and precipitation, while lidar provides high-fidelity 3D maps in favourable conditions. However, existing radar-lidar localization methods are restricted to planar $SE(2)$ localization and have generally fallen short of the accuracy achieved by lidar-lidar and even radar-radar systems. A key challenge is the substantial sensing-modality gap between radar and lidar, which observe and represent scene structure in fundamentally different ways. Dr-LiSA bridges this gap using a learned forward model that predicts radar measurements from a lidar submap at a candidate pose, enabling direct photometric alignment of predicted and observed radar scans in $SE(3)$. Dr-LiSA outperforms prior radar-lidar approaches in $SE(2)$ while achieving planar accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art radar-radar localization across more than 90 km of on-road data.

</details>


### [530] [RouteRLT: Learning When and Which RL Specialist Should Control a Vision-Language-Action Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26467)
*Chongyu Zhu,Jaden Hinds,Hyegang Kim,Juan Sebastian Rojas,Ramy Elmallah,Chi-Guhn Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RouteRLT：一种路由框架，学习何时、由哪个RL专家策略从通用VLA接管控制，以在保留通用能力的同时提升接触密集工业任务的精度关键阶段表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用VLA模型操作能力广，但在连接器插拔、线缆管理等接触密集工业任务中，精度关键阶段表现不足。常用做法是用RL微调预训练VLA，但如何保留通用行为、并决定何时需要RL精调以及应由哪个专家策略执行，仍是未解决问题。

Method: RouteRLT路由框架：阶段选择器（phase selector）识别当前应激活的控制器；稳定器（stabilizer）抑制切换瞬态抖动；动作边界管理器（action-boundary manager）处理分块策略输出之间的过渡。RL专家为针对单一精度关键阶段训练的策略，与通用VLA协同。

Result: 在LIBERO多物体抓放任务中，学到的路由优于基础VLA，并达到与使用特权阶段边界的路由相当的水平，而部署时不访问这些边界；真实机器人线缆抓取与端口插入任务验证了在操作员对齐的交接协议下，能自动路由到抓取与插入专家。

Conclusion: 学到的路由能在精度适配最有价值处应用RL专家控制，同时保留通用VLA行为，包括从失败执行尝试中恢复的能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation competence, but often struggle during the precision-critical stages that dominate contact-rich industrial tasks such as connector insertion and cable management. A common remedy is to refine a pretrained VLA with reinforcement learning (RL), enabling task-specific improvement beyond behavior cloning. However, how to preserve its generalist behavior while deciding when RL refinement is needed and which specialized policy should act remains an open question. In this work, we present RouteRLT, a routing framework that learns when and which RL specialist, an RL policy trained for a single precision-critical phase, should take control from a generalist VLA. A phase selector identifies the active controller, a stabilizer suppresses transient switches, and an action-boundary manager handles transitions between chunked policy outputs. We evaluate RouteRLT on multi-object pick-and-place tasks in LIBERO, as well as on a real-world cable pickup and port-insertion task with multiple precision-critical stages. In simulation, the learned routing improves over the base VLA and matches routing with privileged phase boundaries, without accessing those boundaries at deployment. The real-robot evaluation validates automatic routing to both the pickup and insertion specialists under an operator-aligned handoff protocol. Altogether, these results show that learned routing applies RL specialist control where precise adaptation is most valuable while preserving generalist VLA behavior, including recovery from failed execution attempts.

</details>


### [531] [Benchmarking Robots for Everyday Environments: From Lab Experiments to Real-World Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26490)
*Raphael Memmesheimer,Martina Overbeck,Dominik Beyer,Björn Kral,Sabine Bellmann,Sven Schneider,Jan Zimmermann,Anna-Maria Meer,Medina Klicic,Simone Roth,Carolin Straßmann,Alexander Arntz,Marlene Wessels,Johannes Kraus,Paul Schweidler,Tristan Schnell,Christoph Zimmermann,Benedikt Pulver,Wilhelm Stork,Martin Gersch,Sven Behnke,Arne Rönnau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出跨学科基准测试框架，通过三年七次benchmarking活动评估三类公共服务机器人（户外公园清洁、人行地下通道清洁、图书馆交互），强调任务完成、交互质量、安全与经济可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统实验室指标与公共环境实际部署需求之间存在差距；机器人从实验室原型向真实、非结构化、以人为本场景中的运行系统过渡缺乏系统评估方法。

Method: 构建跨学科评估框架，覆盖三个用例（户外公园清洁、人行地下通道清洁、图书馆交互协助），在2023至2025年间开展七次benchmarking活动，包括一次共识研讨会与六次现场评估（每个用例两次），采用真实室内外测试环境；由涵盖机器人学、人机交互、安全与经济学的专家小组系统开发并迭代评估概念，分析从实验室原型到运行系统的转化。

Result: 识别出成功部署的关键因素：任务完成度、交互质量、安全性和经济可行性，验证了真实场景基准测试相较传统实验室指标的补充价值。

Conclusion: 为研究人员与从业者提供可操作的见解，以弥合机器人技术创新与实际应用之间的差距，推动公共环境中机器人部署的标准化评估。

Abstract: This study introduces an interdisciplinary framework for benchmarking robots deployed in public environments, addressing the gap between traditional laboratory metrics and real-world benchmarking requirements. We evaluate three distinct robots across diverse use cases - outdoor park cleaning, pedestrian underpass cleaning, and interactive library assistance - each representing unique challenges in public daily life. Over a three-year benchmarking process (2023-2025) comprising seven benchmarking events, a consensus workshop and six on-site evaluations (two per use case), we utilized realistic indoor and outdoor test environments to assess not only technical performance but also the broader implications of deploying robots in unstructured, human-centric settings. An expert panel, spanning robotics, human-robot interaction, safety, and economics, systematically developed and refined an evaluation concept to analyze the transition from laboratory prototypes to operational systems. Our findings highlight critical factors for successful deployment, including task fulfillment, interaction quality, safety, and economic feasibility. This work provides actionable insights for researchers and practitioners aiming to bridge the gap between robotic innovation and real-world applicability.

</details>


### [532] [Generalizing Manipulation Skills with a Local Coding Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26499)
*Raman Talwar,Elias Nijs,Andreas Verleysen,Francis wyffels*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究让本地开源权重视觉语言模型 Qwen3-27B 通过编码智能体框架驱动 UR3e 机械臂，在无需额外编程或训练的情况下对九类基于儿童玩具的任务实现了一次性泛化（45 次试验中 30 次成功），并观察到重复执行后任务时长缩短 50%，体现出自我改进。作者同时指出本地编码智能体的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语言驱动机器人依赖固定动作接口或预训练策略，泛化到新任务需要额外工程投入或数据采集，耗时耗力。作者希望验证：本地开源权重视觉语言模型能否在无新人工编程与训练的前提下控制机器人，并一次性泛化到任务的新变体，从而降低部署门槛。

Method: 采用本地开源权重 VLM（Qwen3-27B），通过编码智能体框架（coding-agent harness）驱动机器人。模型在实现运动学、安全限制与经典计算机视觉技术的服务层之上自行编写并执行代码。构建九个基于儿童玩具的任务，重点考察在颜色、尺寸、形状及任务变体等不同物体特征上的泛化能力，每任务进行五次试验，共 45 次试验；随后测试智能体在成功完成任务后被要求重做时的执行速度变化。

Result: 在 45 次试验中，30 次实现了泛化；单次任务时长因复杂度不同介于 3.4 至 67.5 分钟。成功完成后再执行同一任务时，时长减少 50%，表明智能体具备随时间自我改进的能力。论文同时揭示了本地编码智能体存在的局限性。

Conclusion: 本地开源权重 VLM 结合编码智能体框架可驱动真实机械臂并一次性泛化到未见任务变体，且具有自我改进潜力。作者认为，解决已暴露的局限性并进一步研究自我改进机制，将指向本地编码智能体迈向真实世界部署的直接路径。

Abstract: Today, progress in open-weight language models enables systems capable of writing, executing and debugging code while still running on a single workstation. Most language-driven robots give the model a fixed action interface or a trained policy. Generalizing to a new task therefore means more engineering effort or more data collection, both time-consuming. We investigate whether a local open-weight vision-language model can control a robot and one-shot generalize to new variations of a task without new human programming or training. We let a local open-weight VLM, Qwen3.8-27B, drive a UR3e robotic arm from a coding-agent harness. It writes and runs its own code above a service that implements kinematics, safety limits and classic computer vision techniques. We investigate if this system is capable of generalizing to unseen tasks. Specifically, we test it on nine tasks built from children's toys designed to probe generalization capability across various object characteristics: color, size, shape, and task variation of those. With five trials for each task, we observe generalization in 30 out of 45 trials with durations ranging from 3.4 to 67.5 minutes depending on task complexity. We further test if there is a speedup when an agent is asked to redo the task after successful completion. This resulted in a 50% reduction in duration, indicating that there is self-improvement over time. Finally, we expose the limitations of a local coding agent. We believe that solving those limitations combined with further investigation of self-improvement over time points at a direct path toward real-world deployment of a local coding agent.

</details>


### [533] [MATE: Multi-Agent Virtual Teleoperation Platform for Humanoid Collaboration Data Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26520)
*Yichuan Yu,Youzhuo Wang,Yiming Ren,Di Feng,Yexuan Yang,Bingxi Yang,Shengxiao Gong,Yujing Sun,Yuexin Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MATE多智能体虚拟遥操作平台，使分布各地的操作者协同控制共享物理环境中的多台人形机器人，采集24.1小时协作数据并配合EAIS采样策略，实现高效策略学习与零样本实物迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人需要多样化的具身经验才能掌握复杂移动操作与协作技能，但现有数据采集流程多针对单智能体；物理多机协作受硬件昂贵、需专用场地、反复重置等限制难以规模化。

Method: MATE：面向人形协作数据采集的多智能体虚拟遥操作平台，支持多地操作者同时控制共享物理仿真环境中的全身人形机器人，保留人-物-环境间物理耦合交互；并引入EAIS（执行对齐交互采样）策略，在执行对齐前缀内计算采样信号，优先选取推进任务进度与交互关键的行为。

Result: 构建包含2,500个联合回合、24.1小时协调行为、5项长时程任务（物体交接、接力配送、环境交互、协同搬运）的多机协作数据集；在多种协作任务上评估模仿学习与VLA策略，验证了高效数据采集、有效策略学习，以及从虚拟演示到实物人形机器人的零样本迁移。

Conclusion: MATE以虚拟多机遥操作替代物理多机协作，在保留物理耦合交互的同时显著降低采集成本与场地依赖，结合EAIS可有效利用交互丰富演示，并具备零样本sim-to-real迁移能力。

Abstract: Humanoid robots require diverse embodied experiences to acquire complex loco-manipulation and collaborative skills. However, existing humanoid data pipelines primarily focus on individual agents, while physical multi-robot collaboration remains difficult to scale due to costly hardware, dedicated spaces, and repeated resets. In this work, we introduce MATE, a Multi-Agent virtual TEleoperation platform for humanoid collaboration data collection that enables multiple geographically distributed operators to simultaneously control whole-body humanoids in a shared physics-based environment. MATE removes the need for multiple physical robots and co-located operation while preserving physically coupled interactions among humanoids, objects, and environments. Using MATE, we construct a multi-humanoid collaboration dataset comprising 24.1 hours of coordinated behavior across 2,500 joint episodes and five long-horizon tasks, including object handover, relay delivery, environment interaction, and cooperative transport. To improve learning from these interaction-rich demonstrations, we introduce EAIS, an Execution-Aligned Interaction Sampling strategy that computes sampling signals within an execution-aligned prefix and prioritizes task-progressing and interaction-critical behaviors. We evaluate MATE with representative imitation learning and vision-language-action policies across diverse collaboration tasks. Experiments demonstrate efficient data collection, effective policy learning, and zero-shot transfer from virtual demonstrations to a physical humanoid without real-world fine-tuning. Project page: https://yerik-yu.github.io/MATE/

</details>


### [534] [Learning Air-Ground Motion Control with Temporal Mode Switching and Cross-Terrain Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26564)
*Ruitian Pang,Mingrui Li,Xuanting Liu,Tiancheng Lai,Juncheng Chen,Xiangyu Li,Ruibin Zhang,Qishao Wang,Jin Yu,Haiyin Piao,Fei Gao,Chao Xu,Yanjun Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向被动轮陆空两栖车辆的学习型空地运动控制框架，含自主模式切换选择器与强化学习轨迹跟踪策略，实现在有限感知下可靠切换及多地形鲁棒跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动轮陆空两栖车辆兼具空中机动性与地面高能效运动，但受限于机载感知能力，空地模式可靠切换与多地形地面轨迹鲁棒跟踪仍是面向实际应用的关键难题。

Method: 1) 学习型模式选择器：利用历史单点飞行时间（ToF）测量与机器人状态，结合未来参考信息，判定当前主动运动模式，实现自主空地切换；2) 强化学习控制策略：将本体感知观测与未来参考信息结合以预判轨迹变化；地面运动采用多地形训练与动力学随机化提升跨地形跟踪鲁棒性。

Result: 仿真与真实实验表明：在有限感知下实现可靠空地切换，多地形地面跟踪精度高；学习型选择器在困难切换场景中优于规则式选择器；地面控制器在所有测试条件下位置RMSE均低于PID，并在NMPC失效时仍保持尚可跟踪。集成后系统完成101m含多次自主模式切换的陆空轨迹，位置RMSE为0.08m。

Conclusion: 该学习型框架可有效解决被动轮陆空两栖车辆在有限感知下的自主模式切换与多地形轨迹跟踪问题，整体性能优于传统规则选择器、PID及NMPC方法，具备实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Passive-wheeled terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles (TABVs) combine aerial mobility with energy-efficient ground locomotion. However, reliable air-ground mode switching under limited onboard perception and robust ground trajectory tracking across diverse terrains remain challenging when targeting real-world applications. In this work, we propose a learning-based air-ground motion control framework for passive-wheeled TABVs: 1) a learned mode selector for autonomous air-ground motion mode switching. The selector uses historical single-point time-of-flight (ToF) measurements and robot states together with future reference information to determine the active locomotion mode. 2) a reinforcement learning control policy for trajectory tracking. The policy combines proprioceptive observations with future reference information to anticipate trajectory changes. For ground locomotion, multi-terrain training and dynamics randomization enable robust tracking across different terrains. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate reliable air-ground switching under limited perception and accurate ground tracking across diverse terrain conditions. The learned selector outperforms a rule-based mode selector in challenging transitions, while the ground controller achieves lower position RMSE than PID across all tested conditions and maintains decent tracking where NMPC fails. With these capabilities integrated, the system tracks a 101m air-ground trajectory through multiple autonomous mode transitions with a position RMSE of 0.08m.

</details>


### [535] [Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26567)
*Eshika Pathak,Leela Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种"审计"方法:在全部查询场景中穷举执行每个已存储经验,以区分"选择规则的质量"与"经验库本身的质量",并揭示视觉相似度选择规则的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人通过复用过往经验而非重新训练来适应新场景,但现有系统多以视觉相似度选择经验,评估又只报告所选经验的成功率。该指标无法说明选择规则本身好坏:规则可能靠反复复用某一广泛可迁移经验而虚高,或因偏好经验较弱而虚低。这种描述"库"而非"规则"的分数会误导领域后续构建方向,因此需要可归因的审计方法。

Method: 构建审计方法论:在两个操作任务、三种复用机制、经验库规模 K=3/10/50 下,对每个查询场景穷举执行所有已存经验,使每个候选结果已知,从而将分数追溯到逐场景选择或库质量。被审计规则基于五种视觉嵌入(从原始像素到 CLIP)的最近邻距离进行选择。

Result: (1)后见之明选出的单一固定经验即可填补随机选择与oracle之间差距的30-58%,逐场景选择仅争夺剩余0.07-0.15的成功率;(2)K≥10时,视觉规则对单一经验的集中度比oracle高1.5-3倍,其分数随后随该经验质量波动;(3)凡规则显著偏离"保持选择率但随机配对场景"的shuffle,表现都更差,对所有学习型图像策略成立;(4)视觉距离对"某对是否成功"预测良好(AUROC达0.96),但在K=50时对同一场景内候选排序在五种嵌入中有四种不优于随机(AUROC 0.45-0.52)。

Conclusion: 穷举执行通常不可行,故审计可简化为任何研究都能提供的两项廉价报告:被选经验的分布,以及后见之明下最优单一经验的成功率。

Abstract: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$. Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. (2) At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.

</details>


### [536] [Wheel-loader V-Cycle Automation with Deep Koopman MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26580)
*Armin Abdolmohammadi,Navid Mojahed,Dinesh Kumar,Bahram Ravani,Shima Nazari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分层框架，结合长时域几何规划与数据驱动预测控制，实现轮式装载机自主V型作业循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轮式装载机土方作业中反复前进-后退机动适合自动化，但铰接式车辆非线性动力学及复杂车辆-地形交互使传统基于模型的方法效果受限。

Method: 采用降阶铰接运动学模型生成机动几何，通过共享中间状态联合优化前进与后退轨迹；基于Algoryx Dynamics高保真仿真数据，为前进和后退运动分别学习两个数据驱动深度双线性Koopman模型，并将其嵌入计算高效的MPC进行轨迹跟踪。

Result: 控制器在50 ms执行循环内实时运行；高保真仿真表明该端到端框架能准确且计算高效地完成轮式装载机V型循环机动。

Conclusion: 该框架为铰接式重型机械的自主作业提供了一种有前景的方法。

Abstract: The repeated forward-reverse maneuvers performed by wheel loaders during earthmoving operations make them well suited for automation. However, the nonlinear dynamics of articulated vehicles and complex vehicle-terrain interactions limit the effectiveness of conventional model-based approaches. This paper presents a hierarchical framework that combines long-horizon geometric planning with data-driven predictive control for autonomous wheel-loader operation. A reduced-order articulated kinematic model is used to generate the maneuver geometry, where the forward and reverse trajectories are jointly optimized through a shared intermediate state. To capture the vehicle dynamics, two data-driven deep bilinear Koopman models are learned for the forward and reverse motions using data generated from high-fidelity simulations in Algoryx Dynamics. The learned Koopman representations are subsequently incorporated into a computationally efficient model predictive control (MPC) formulation for trajectory tracking. The resulting controller operates in real time within a 50-ms execution loop. High-fidelity simulation results demonstrate that the proposed end-to-end framework enables accurate and computationally efficient execution of wheel-loader V-cycle maneuvers, providing a promising approach toward autonomous operation of articulated heavy-duty machinery.

</details>


### [537] [NavSafe-$\infty$: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Driving Safety in Photorealistic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26618)
*Yuxin Bao,Hongwei Ruan,Luobin Wang,Seth Z. Zhao,Ziyang Leng,Zihan Zhang,Yu Zeng,Rowan McAllister,Henrik Christensen,Bolei Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 NavSafe-∞ 闭环安全基准（280 场景/28 事件类型，基于结构化交通安全分类），评测 20 个端到端驾驶策略，揭示开环指标无法可靠迁移到闭环安全，并指出两种常见改进手段的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶策略在开环（OL）基准上进展迅速，但开环评测无法反映策略能否承受误差累积、从失败中恢复，以及与周边交通参与者安全交互，因此需要能够暴露真实安全能力的闭环（CL）评测手段。

Method: 构建照片级真实感的闭环基准 NavSafe-∞，包含 280 个场景、覆盖 28 种事件类型，每个场景在结构化交通安全分类体系下设定成功与失败判据，输出事故类别级能力分数（交通事故、弱势道路使用者事故、交通违规、交通事件）；并据此评测 20 个端到端策略，同时分析被动演示扰动与开环强化学习微调两种常见改进路径。

Result: 开环性能提升并不能可靠迁移为闭环安全表现；被动演示扰动仅在闭环 rollout 接近其扰动训练状态时有效；开环强化学习微调出现奖励劫持，以牺牲安全裕度换取自车通行进度，且该问题在闭环反馈下被放大为连锁的安全关键错误。

Conclusion: 开环基准在指示闭环安全成功方面存在盲区。基准及可扩展工具箱（支持定制事件构建与策略诊断）将开源并持续维护，以推动后续研究。

Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) driving policies have progressed rapidly on open-loop (OL) benchmarks, yet OL evaluation cannot reveal whether a policy withstands compounding errors, recovers from failures, or interacts safely with surrounding actors. We introduce NavSafe-$\infty$, a photorealistic closed-loop (CL) benchmark of 280 scenarios spanning 28 event types, each with success and failure criteria defined within a structured traffic-safety taxonomy, which yields category-level capability scores for Traffic Crashes, Vulnerable Road User Crashes, Traffic Violations, and Traffic Incidents. Evaluating 20 E2E policies, we find that OL gains do not reliably transfer to CL safety. Analyzing two common remedies further shows that passive demonstration perturbation helps mainly when CL rollouts stay near its perturbed training states, and that OL reinforcement-learning fine-tuning exhibits reward hacking by trading safety margin for ego progress, which CL feedback amplifies into compounding safety-critical errors. Together, these results demonstrate the blind spot of OL benchmarks indicating CL safety success. The benchmark and an extensible toolbox for customizable event curation and policy diagnosis will be open-sourced and maintained to facilitate future research.

</details>


### [538] [Imperfection for Precision: Upcycling Imperfect Data for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26672)
*Hao Wei,Yang Liu,Chao Tang,Shengbao Li,Jiangtao Chen,Jinxuan Zhu,Jiaheng Wang,Hong Yin,Zhaofeng Cao,Tingguang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ε4P方法，通过"升级回收"低精度目标任务数据与高精度非匹配任务数据，在流匹配轨迹的不同噪声阶段分别利用二者，从而降低高精度操作对昂贵任务专属高质量数据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型完成高精度操作通常需要任务专属的高质量数据（如遥操作），采集过程缓慢且成本高昂。作者希望在不牺牲操作精度的前提下减轻这一数据负担，因此尝试利用两类原本被丢弃的数据源。

Method: ε4P（Imperfection for Precision）并非将不完美数据源在整个协同训练过程中简单混合，而是控制每种数据在流匹配（flow-matching）轨迹中的贡献位置：在高噪声阶段使用目标任务的低精度数据以保留高层任务上下文，在低噪声阶段使用任务不匹配的高精度数据以迁移低层动作精度。

Result: 在真实机器人上针对亚毫米级高精度任务和粗粒度任务开展实验，结果表明：(1) 该方法能有效利用额外的非完美数据，使策略性能最多提升31.7个百分点；(2) 可用其替代等量的任务专属高质量数据，平均性能仅下降4.2个百分点。

Conclusion: ε4P为高精度操作指明了一种可扩展范式：异构的、非完美的数据可被系统性地重新利用，从而减少对昂贵的任务专属高质量数据的依赖。

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models for high-precision manipulation typically requires task-specific, high-quality data (e.g., teleoperation), which is slow and expensive to collect. To reduce this burden without compromising manipulation precision, we propose $\varepsilon$4P (Imperfection for Precision), a simple yet effective method that "upcycles" two otherwise discarded data sources: (1) low-precision data from the target task and (2) high-precision data from mismatched tasks. Rather than naively mixing these imperfect data sources throughout co-training, $\varepsilon$4P controls where each source contributes along the flow-matching trajectory. Specifically, low-precision, target-task data is used at high noise to preserve high-level task context and high-precision, task-mismatched data is used at low noise to transfer low-level action precision. Through real-robot experiments on both sub-millimeter, high-precision tasks and coarse-grained tasks, we demonstrate that the proposed method (1) effectively leverages additional imperfect data to improve policy performance by up to 31.7 percentage points, and (2) can replace an equal amount of task-specific, high-quality data with an average performance drop of only 4.2 percentage points. Overall, $\varepsilon$4P points toward a scalable paradigm for high-precision manipulation, in which heterogeneous, imperfect data can be systematically repurposed to reduce reliance on costly task-specific, high-quality data. More details are available at https://varepsilon4p.github.io/.

</details>


### [539] [Underwater Navigation in Unsteady Flows Using Measurement Histories from a Single Sensing Unit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26753)
*Linhao Jin,Qimin Feng,Peter Gunnarson,Qiang Zhong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于因果观测器的单点流历史估计方法，用单个传感单元的历史测量估计横向流速，替代多点多点空间采样，为固定导航控制器提供输入。在Re=100圆柱尾流训练后可跨雷诺数泛化，性能接近直接空间感知，但依赖障碍物几何形状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间流场测量有助于水下导航，但分布式传感受机器人尺寸和传感器布局限制，难以在小型机器人上实现多点多点空间采样，因此需要一种用有限历史测量替代空间分布式测量的虚拟感知方法。

Method: 采用因果观测器（causal observer），利用单个传感单元采集的有限历史测量估计横向流速，作为固定导航控制器的输入。在二维尾流仿真中，仅使用体坐标系环境速度，将同时流场采样从三点减少到机器人中心一点。仅在Re=100圆柱尾流中训练。

Result: 在未重新训练的Re=205和240条件下，流历史观测器成功率分别为84.4%和80.6%，仅比直接空间感知低7.4和4.6个百分点，比仅用当前测量的观测器高30个百分点以上。在方形棱柱尾流中接近直接感知，但在三角形棱柱尾流中性能下降。组件替换识别出横向速度差为控制相关量，受控扰动揭示对误差持续性的敏感性。

Conclusion: 在假设的观测模型下，单点流历史具有闭环导航效用，能够以单点历史测量替代多点空间采样并实现较好的跨雷诺数泛化，但其效果受障碍物几何形状和误差持续性影响。

Abstract: Spatial flow measurements support underwater navigation, but distributed sensing is constrained by robot size and sensor layout. We use a causal observer to estimate current lateral velocities from a finite history of measurements collected by a single sensing unit, supplying the inputs of a fixed navigation controller. In two-dimensional wake simulations with access to body-frame ambient velocity, this virtual sensing interface reduces simultaneous flow sampling from three points to the robot center. Trained only in a circular-cylinder wake at Re = 100, the flow-history observer achieves 84.4% and 80.6% success at held-out Re = 205 and 240 without retraining. These rates are 7.4 and 4.6 percentage points below direct spatial sensing and more than 30 points above a matched current-only observer. Past flow remains beneficial when past goal and yaw information is available. Across obstacle geometries, performance remains close to direct sensing in square-prism wakes but declines in triangular-prism wakes. Component replacement identifies the lateral velocity difference as control-relevant, while controlled perturbations reveal sensitivity to error persistence. The results demonstrate the closed-loop utility of single-point flow histories under the assumed observation model.

</details>


### [540] [TM-APR: Thermal Temporal-Memory Localization via Analytic Online Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26766)
*Yanshuo Bai,Kanji Tanaka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将解析类增量学习（ACIL）与域不变热成像视觉位置识别（Thermal VPR）首次结合，揭示其无梯度矩阵更新可作为强基线，并提出嵌入无迹传播、高斯混合划分与极小极大H∞优化的U-ACIL/GMM-ACIL/H∞-ACIL框架，实现O(1)闭式更新并保证在线更新时延小于传感器采样间隔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热成像VPR存在严重环境依赖、在线重训练开销大、无法建模动态非线性偏移等问题，导致现有框架在线部署失败；需要实现鲁棒的域不变位置识别。

Method: 首次将解析类增量学习（ACIL）与域不变VPR结合；针对ACIL对极端非线性热波动的结构线性假设脆弱性，利用ACIL与现代控制理论之间的代数等价性，将无迹传播（U-ACIL）、高斯混合划分（GMM-ACIL）和极小极大H∞优化（H∞-ACIL）直接嵌入更新循环。

Result: 所提方法保证精确闭式矩阵更新，计算复杂度为O(1)，绕过反向传播，使在线更新时延Δt_learn严格小于传感器采集间隔Δt_acquire，从而消除实时SLAM管线中的轨迹跳变；ACIL基线优于传统微调。

Conclusion: 通过ACIL与控制理论的代数等价性构建的U-ACIL、GMM-ACIL与H∞-ACIL框架，可有效克服标准ACIL的线性假设局限，实现高效、域不变的在线热成像VPR部署。

Abstract: Thermal Visual Place Recognition (Thermal VPR) maps camera observations to metric poses within a mapped environment, serving as a prerequisite for autonomous navigation. However, thermal VPR suffers from severe environmental dependence, heavy online retraining overheads, and an inability to model dynamic non-linear shifts, causing existing frameworks to fail during online deployment. To achieve robust domain-invariant place recognition, we bridge Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (ACIL) with domain-invariant VPR for the first time, revealing that its gradient-free matrix updates construct a surprisingly strong baseline that outperforms conventional fine-tuning. Nevertheless, standard ACIL exhibits a critical vulnerability to extreme non-linear thermal fluctuations due to its structural linear assumptions. To overcome this limitation, we exploit a novel algebraic equivalence between ACIL and modern control theory, proposing a framework which embeds Unscented propagation (U-ACIL), Gaussian Mixture partitioning (GMM-ACIL), and minimax $H_\infty$ optimization ($H_\infty$-ACIL) directly into the update loop. Our formulation guarantees exact closed-form matrix updates within $\mathcal{O}(1)$ computational complexity, bypassing backpropagation to ensure that the online update latency ($Δt_{\mathrm{learn}}$) remains strictly bounded below the sensor acquisition interval ($Δt_{\mathrm{acquire}}$), thereby eliminating trajectory jumps in real-time SLAM pipelines.

</details>


### [541] [DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26792)
*Ziyang Leng,Sicheng Mo,Seth Z. Zhao,Haoyuan Cai,Yu Zeng,Rowan McAllister,Bolei Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DreamStream——一种面向策略的生成式闭环仿真器，通过交通布局引导的自回归视频模型蒸馏保留策略相关特征，并引入FDπ度量sim-to-real视觉差距，构建Navhard-CL交互式基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真平台存在sim-to-real视觉差距，会破坏策略感知，导致无法忠实评估端到端驾驶策略的闭环决策能力；同时FID等感知指标无法正确衡量策略相关特征的保真度。

Method: DreamStream基于大型预训练视频模型，通过交通布局引导蒸馏为自回归视频模型，在改变视觉外观的同时保留场景布局和动态物体的时间一致性等策略相关特征；并提出FDπ多表征度量，以公共E2E策略的场景上下文特征的Fréchet距离衡量sim-to-real差距。

Result: 在FDπ度量下，DreamStream相较最强已有闭环仿真器在nuScenes上提升1.6倍、在NAVSIM上提升4.7倍，并对策略感知可观测性造成最小扰动；基于此构建的Navhard-CL基准将非反应式NAVSIM转化为具有对抗驾驶行为和天气变化的交互式测试环境。

Conclusion: DreamStream实现了策略导向的闭环仿真保真度，Navhard-CL基准揭示了评分器偏差、缺乏恢复行为等此前闭环基准忽视的驾驶策略失效模式，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Faithfully evaluating end-to-end driving policies in simulation requires observations that are not merely photo-realistic, but preserve the scene features a policy relies on to make decisions. Existing platforms, however, exhibit a sim-to-real visual gap that corrupts policy perception, undermining their ability to assess a policy's closed-loop decision-making. To this end, we propose DreamStream, a generative, closed-loop simulator that achieves policy-oriented fidelity using a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model. Our video model is distilled from a large pretrained video model via traffic layout guidance, varying visual appearance while preserving policy-relevant features such as scenario layout and the temporal consistency of dynamic objects. We further observe that perceptual metrics like FID misrank how well these features are preserved. To tackle this, we introduce FD$π$, a new multi-representation metric that measures the sim-to-real gap as the Fréchet distance over scene-context features from public E2E policies. Under FD$π$, DreamStream improves over the strongest prior closed-loop simulator by $1.6\times$ on nuScenes and $4.7\times$ on NAVSIM, and induces the least perturbation to policy's perceptual observability. Based on DreamStream, we construct Navhard-CL benchmark, which turns non-reactive real-world benchmark NAVSIM into interactive testing environments with adversarial driving behaviors and weather variations. This benchmark exposes many failure modes of driving policies, such as scorer bias and lack of recovery behaviors, that prior closed-loop benchmarks overlook. Code and data are available at https://github.com/VAIL-UCLA/DreamStream.

</details>


### [542] [φ-RIE: From Photorealistic Reconstruction to Interactive Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26795)
*Runyi Yang,Deheng Zhang,Xiaoye Wang,Kanzhi Wu,Lei Sun,Ajad Chhatkuli,Kunyu Peng,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 φ-RIE，一种 Gaussian 原生流水线，将 3DGS 重建场景中的选定物体转化为可移动的仿真器资产，同时保持并补全背景，实现交互式场景转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 虽能逼真重建场景，但其表示本身不支持物理交互。机器人仿真需要物体级别的可独立移动、接触以及显露被遮挡的环境，而现有表示中物体外观可能与背景纠缠，隐藏几何与被遮挡背景内容未被观测。

Method: 核心思路是资产构建与源内容移除应耦合，即同一物体身份同时定义可移动资产及需移除与补全的场景内容。据此设计流水线：Scene Observation 提供共享证据，送入 Coupled Scene Construction，生成配准资产与补全的背景 Gaussians，供仿真器驱动的 Interactive Environment 渲染。该耦合在保持未编辑 Gaussians 的同时对齐视觉与物理状态。

Result: 在 50 个 ScanNet++ 场景上，基于证据的选择与配准重试在固定保留率下将 20mm 匹配 F1 从 0.336 提升至 0.383。进一步实验验证了资产生成可执行性、相较单一生成器基线在操控上的增益，以及转换的视觉代价。

Conclusion: 结果表明 φ-RIE 能够实现交互式场景转换，将 3DGS 重建转化为可支持物理交互的仿真器资产。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reconstruct a captured scene photorealistically, but the resulting representation does not by itself support physical interaction. Robot simulation instead requires object-level change, \textit{i.e.}, objects must move independently, make contact, and reveal previously occluded surroundings. This gap arises because object appearance may remain entangled with the background, while hidden object geometry and occluded background content may be unobserved. To address this challenge, we present φ-RIE, a Gaussian-native pipeline that converts selected objects into movable simulator assets while preserving the remaining reconstruction. Our key observation is that asset construction and source removal should be coupled, \textit{i.e.}, one object identity should define the movable asset and the scene content to remove and complete. Accordingly, Scene Observation supplies shared evidence to Coupled Scene Construction, which creates registered assets and completed background Gaussians for simulator-driven rendering in an Interactive Environment. This coupling preserves unedited Gaussians while aligning visual and physical state. On 50 ScanNet++ scenes, evidence-based selection and registration retry increase matched F1 at 20\,mm from 0.336 to 0.383 at fixed retention. Further tests demonstrate asset executability, manipulation gains over a single-generator baseline, and the visual cost of conversion. Together, these results demonstrate that \name\ enables interactive scene conversion.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

### [543] [Not All 4-bit Quantizers Are Equal: Deployment-Time Mitigation of PII Leakage in Fine-Tuned Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25014)
*Cristhian Kapelinski,Diego Kreutz*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文揭示4比特量化方法本身会影响隐私性：依赖校准语料的方法（AWQ、GPTQ）几乎不泄露植入记录，而无校准的GGUF Q4_K_M格式泄露5.3%。选择4比特方法实为部署期的隐私决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织通常在私有数据上微调小语言模型并压缩至4比特以高效部署，但已有研究多关注压缩对速度与精度的影响，忽视了压缩方法对隐私（如训练数据泄露）的潜在作用。作者旨在探究：4比特量化究竟是比特宽度还是其具体机制在影响隐私泄露。

Method: 在0.5–7亿参数范围的五个开源模型（两个模型家族）上植入记录并进行4比特量化，对比两类方法：依赖校准语料的方法（AWQ、GPTQ）与无校准语料的GGUF Q4_K_M格式。以每条植入记录自身的开头文本作为提示，统计记录被复现（泄露）的比例，并开展控制实验分析机制。

Result: 在主模型上，AWQ与GPTQ均未复现任何植入记录，而GGUF Q4_K_M复现了5.3%。跨五个模型、两种家族及全部参数规模，AWQ泄露最少，且在3–7亿参数下精度损失很小。控制实验表明差异源于校准引起的、参与稀有词元预测的通道中的舍入误差。

Conclusion: 决定隐私泄露的关键并非比特宽度，而是量化是否在校准语料上调整舍入。选择哪种4比特方法因此是部署期的隐私决策，而不仅是速度与质量的权衡。

Abstract: Organizations fine-tune small language models on private data and then compress them to 4 bits for resource-efficient deployment. We show that the compression method also affects privacy. What separates the methods is not the bit width but whether they tune their rounding on a small sample of text, the calibration corpus. On our primary model, when each planted record's own opening text is used as the prompt, the two calibration-based methods we test, Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and Gradient-based Post-Training Quantization (GPTQ), each reproduce none of the planted records, while the calibration-corpus-free GGUF Q4_K_M format reproduces 5.3% of them. Tracked across five open models with 0.5-7 billion parameters, AWQ leaks least at every size and in both families, with little accuracy loss at 3-7 billion. Controlled experiments associate the difference with calibration-induced rounding error in channels involved in rare-token prediction. Choosing the 4-bit method is therefore a deployment-time privacy decision, not only a question of speed and quality.

</details>


### [544] [CPyGraph: A Version-Aware Static Analysis Framework for Native CPython Bytecode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25083)
*Baihong Chen,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: CPyGraph 是一个针对原生 CPython 字节码的 C++ 包级静态分析框架，通过版本适配层统一栈、控制流、调用、词法、协议与异常语义，并将操作数栈感知的 Andersen 指针分析与调用图联合迭代至不动点，支撑异常感知 CFG、块级 CDG 和过程间 DDG。在 PYGBench（201 个包级程序、1733 个固定候选）上，CPython 3.10 默认配置达到 91.40% 候选精度与 100% 召回，全敏感配置精度为 94.97%；CPython 3.10–3.14 间 1334 个版本不变查询中 1328 个一致，并在 PyCG 的 112 程序调用图基准上持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python 包级静态分析需要跨一等函数、动态分派、隐式协议调用、异常、闭包与模块执行恢复程序结构与对象流。原生 CPython 字节码提供了这些行为的可执行降级表示，但其指令、调用、栈与异常表示随版本变化。因此需要一个版本感知的分析基础，使各类图产物共享同一套字节码身份与语义。

Method: 方法上，CPyGraph 采用 C++ 构建，以版本特定适配器通过共享接口暴露栈、控制、调用、词法、协议和异常语义，同时保留 code object 身份与原生字节码偏移。其操作数栈感知的 Andersen 指针分析与调用图协同增长至不动点，共享状态用于构建异常感知 CFG、块级 CDG 和过程间 DDG，并可选启用函数级流敏感、上下文敏感与有界路径敏感。框架还通过类型化覆盖率摘要记录未解析的动态行为。

Result: 在 PYGBench（201 个包级程序、1733 个固定候选）上，CPython 3.10 下默认分析达到 91.40% 候选精度和 100% 召回；完全敏感配置达到 94.97% 精度并保持相同召回。跨 CPython 3.10–3.14，1334 个版本不变查询中 1328 个一致；在 PyCG 的 112 程序调用图基准上，CPyGraph 与其表现持平。

Conclusion: 结论是 CPyGraph 以共享字节码身份与语义的版本感知架构，为原生 CPython 字节码包级分析提供了统一的图分析基础，在精度、召回、跨版本一致性与既有基准兼容性上均表现良好。

Abstract: Static analysis of Python packages must recover both program structure and object flow across first-class functions, dynamic dispatch, implicit protocol calls, exceptions, closures, and module execution. Native CPython bytecode provides the executable lowering of these behaviors, but its instruction, call, stack, and exception representations change across releases. This creates a need for a version-aware analysis foundation whose graph products share the same bytecode identities and semantics. We present CPyGraph, a C++ framework for package-level analysis of native CPython bytecode. Version- specific adapters expose stack, control, call, lexical, protocol, and exception semantics through a shared interface while preserving code-object identities and native bytecode offsets. An operand-stack-aware Andersen points- to analysis and call graph grow together to a fixed point. Their shared state supports exception-aware CFGs, block-level CDGs, and interprocedural DDGs, with optional function-level flow, context, and bounded path sensitivity. The framework also records unresolved dynamic behavior through typed coverage summaries. We evaluate CPyGraph with PYGBench, 201 package-level programs and 1,733 fixed candidates. On CPython 3.10, the default analysis reaches 91.40% candidate precision and 100% recall; complete sensitivity reaches 94.97% precision with the same recall. Across CPython 3.10-3.14, 1,328 of 1,334 version-invariant queries agree, and CPyGraph matches PyCG on its 112-program call-graph benchmark.

</details>


### [545] [Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25154)
*Sivashankar Selvarajan,Piyush Verma,Sumit Kumar,Sharayu N. Deshmukh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B 检测器在多个基准族上进行免微调评估，采用基准原生聚合加记录级度量、覆盖率核算与亚组诊断，强调可追溯的协议条件而非排行榜式排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 生成图像技术演进快于针对特定基准的检测器评估，单一分数无法完整反映泛化能力，因此需要对检测器结果做更细致的、可解释的评估。

Method: 在不进行基准专属参数更新的前提下，跨基准族评估 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B；保留原生聚合（native aggregation），并补充记录级度量（record-level measures）、覆盖率核算（coverage accounting）和亚组诊断（subgroup diagnostics）。每个结果小节标明发布版本与评估总体、报告官方指标并描述误差模式；组合分析综合共性模式，同时区分原生量与合并量（pooled quantities）。跨论文比较仅限证据对齐的情况。

Result: 各结果小节给出对应发布版本与评估总体上的官方指标表现及观察到的误差模式；组合分析识别出跨基准的共性模式；通过区分基准原生结果与合并摘要，使测试总体、类别平衡与缺失记录覆盖差异变得可见。

Conclusion: 研究结论刻画的是在已评估记录上的表现，而非普遍可靠性、校准、归因或未来自适应攻击下的表现。该研究支持在科研、平台安全与取证审查场景中解释检测器结果，主张优先呈现可追溯的协议条件，而非声明或排行榜比较。

Abstract: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synthesizes shared patterns while preserving the distinction between native and pooled quantities. Cross-paper comparisons are restricted to aligned evidence; differences in release, population, preprocessing, training, or benchmark exposure are context rather than rank. The findings characterize performance on evaluated records, not universal reliability, calibration, attribution, or future adaptive attacks. By keeping benchmark-native outcomes distinct from pooled summaries, the study makes test-population, class-balance, and missing-record-coverage differences visible. It supports interpretation of detector results in research, platform-safety, and forensic-review settings, foregrounding traceable protocol conditions over claims or leaderboard comparisons.

</details>


### [546] [Attack Success Rate Is Not a Number: On Measurement Validity in Agentic AI Security Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25173)
*Chetan Pathade,Prathamesh Pawar,Shubham Patil*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文指出LLM智能体安全评估中的攻击成功率（ASR）并非单一指标，而是一族受6个设计维度参数化的指标；通过对259篇论文的元分析与解析研究，证明当前ASR报告普遍缺乏方差、重复运行与解码细节，导致跨论文比较不可行，并提出十项报告清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR几乎是所有LLM智能体攻击与防御评估的核心指标，但文献中很少说明其具体设计选择，也从未统一。作者旨在揭示这种不规范性带来的测量不可比问题，而非质疑任何单个结果。

Method: 两项无需专有数据的研究：一是对2025年2月至2026年9月间arXiv上259篇智能体安全论文的全文元分析，含50篇手工编码随机样本与259篇自动编码；二是解析研究，在100实例基准上计算常规统计功效下可检测的最小ASR差异，并模拟单次运行评估的防御排序错误率。

Result: 报告方差估计或重复运行的比例极低：手工样本中58%（95% CI 44-71）、全样本自动编码65.3%均未报告；仅30.9%披露足够解码信息以判断评估是否随机；64篇确认使用LLM评判的论文中仅29.7%报告与人工标签的一致性检验。解析研究显示，100实例基准上常规功效可检测的最小ASR差异为18.2个百分点；真值相差5个百分点的两种防御，单次运行评估约有21%概率排序错误。6个维度中多个以系统依赖方式改变ASR，因此不可比性不是可在比较中抵消的常数偏移。

Conclusion: 当前跨论文的ASR比较缺乏支撑。作者提出针对每项所测缺陷的十项报告清单，旨在为领域提供迄今缺失的共享测量契约，而非否定任何既有结论。

Abstract: Attack success rate (ASR) is the headline metric in nearly every published evaluation of attacks on, and defenses for, LLM agents. We argue that ASR as currently used is not a single quantity but a family of metrics parameterized by six design choices that papers seldom specify and never hold constant across the literature. We support this with two studies that require no proprietary access. First, a full-text meta-analysis of 259 agentic-security papers posted to arXiv between February 2025 and September 2026 finds that most report neither a variance estimate nor repeated runs for their headline attack metric: 58% (95% CI 44-71) in a hand-coded random sample of 50, 65.3% by automated coding of all 259. Only 30.9% disclose enough about decoding to establish whether their evaluation was even stochastic, and of the 64 papers we confirm use an LLM judge, 29.7% report any agreement check against human labels. Second, an analytical study shows that these omissions are not cosmetic: on a 100-instance benchmark, the minimum difference in ASR detectable at conventional power is 18.2 percentage points, and two defenses whose true ASRs differ by 5 points are ranked in the wrong order by a single-run evaluation roughly 21% of the time. Because several of the six axes shift ASR in a system-dependent way, the resulting incomparability is not a constant offset that cancels in comparison. We conclude that cross-paper ASR comparison is currently unsupported, and propose a ten-item reporting checklist targeted at each failure we measure. Our aim is not to dispute any individual result but to supply the shared measurement contract the field has so far done without.

</details>


### [547] [Partition-Matched Evaluation of Community Features under Distribution Shift in Android Malware Function-Call Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25256)
*Junru Zhu,Yixin Yang,Xiaoqing Ding,Ruoyu Qi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文检验函数调用图中的介观组织（社区结构）是否比局部度分布、全局统计、元数据和同尺寸随机划分提供更稳定的跨类型/家族迁移信息，结论是否定的：社区特征仅在IID场景提分，缺乏可重复的分布偏移稳定性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络的Android恶意软件分类器在恶意软件类型或家族发生分布偏移时精度下降。作者想验证介观（社区）组织是否提供超越局部度分布（LDP）、全局统计、轻量元数据和同尺寸随机划分的"偏移稳定"信息。

Method: 使用MalNet-Tiny、Common、Distinct共15,000个函数调用图；评估前预先指定6个Leiden描述符；采用5个优化器种子；以同尺寸随机划分作为对照，并进行两层bootstrap区间估计；通过移除模块度项做消融。

Result: 社区特征将Tiny的宏F1从78.7%提升至81.3%，但在source-only的Common上出现29.4个百分点的性能退化；单次同尺寸随机划分退化为27.8点，5次随机划分平均退化27.9点；随机划分与社区划分退化之差的95%两层bootstrap区间为[-4.2, 1.2]点。加入元数据后差异为-0.2点，区间[-1.1, 0.6]。移除模块度使structure-only的Common宏F1从51.9%升至53.6%。

Conclusion: 所测试的介观签名增加了IID信号，但未表现出可重复的分布偏移稳定性优势；说明介观图的相关主张必须配备划分匹配（partition-matched）对照与重复的零模型抽样（repeated null draws）。

Abstract: Graph-based Android malware classifiers can lose accuracy under malware-type or family shifts. We test whether mesoscopic organization in function-call graphs provides shift-stable information beyond local degree profiles (LDP), global statistics, lightweight metadata, and size-matched random partitions. Using 15,000 MalNet-Tiny, Common, and Distinct graphs, six Leiden descriptors specified before evaluation, and five optimizer seeds, communities raise Tiny macro F1 from 78.7% to 81.3% but yield 29.4-point source-only Common degradation. One size-matched random partition yields 27.8-point degradation. Across five random partitions, mean degradation is 27.9 points; the 95% two-level bootstrap interval for random minus community degradation is [-4.2, 1.2] points. With metadata, the corresponding difference is -0.2 points with interval [-1.1, 0.6]. Removing modularity raises structure-only Common macro F1 from 51.9% to 53.6%. The tested signature adds IID signal but shows no repeatable shift-stability advantage, demonstrating why mesoscopic graph claims need partition-matched controls and repeated null draws.

</details>


### [548] [Controller-Only False Confirmation in Passive RF UAV Link Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25294)
*Rajendra Upadhyay,Rajendra Paudyal,Al Nahian Bin Emran,Duminda Wijesekera*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本研究通过双频段SDR测量实验，揭示被动RF无人机检测中"仅遥控器"状态的高误确认率问题，并提出带显式约束的三输出检测框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有被动RF反无人机检测研究多针对背景RF或WiFi/蓝牙干扰报告高准确率，但很少单独区分"仅遥控器工作（未连接飞行器）"这一状态，导致所报告的连接检测精度无法反映对遥控器信号的误确认风险。

Method: 采用双频段SDR测量方案，用两台USRP B210同时扫描8个2.4 GHz和12个5.8 GHz观测窗口，对三种商用无人机（DJI Phantom 3 4K、Hubsan H501S、DJI Mavic Mini）在环境、仅遥控器、已连接三种状态下进行二十轮测量。先仅用已连接与环境扫描训练基于能量的检测器，再将仅遥控器扫描纳入训练，并在显式仅遥控器误确认率（FCR）约束下使用confirm/reject/defer三输出决策；另开展硬件在环实验。

Result: 四步并发驻留（8 s）下，仅用已连接与环境训练的能量检测器对已连接vs环境达到0.992平衡准确率，但对60次仅遥控器扫描误确认30次（FCRctrl=0.500）。纳入仅遥控器扫描并在约束下，汇总全平台FCRctrl由0.350降至0.050，但confirm-linked TPR由0.900降至0.400，42.1%扫描被推迟；紧凑扫描对Hubsan和Mavic表现明显优于Phantom。硬件在环实验将实测墙钟时间从82.9 s降至28.9 s。

Conclusion: 已连接vs背景的准确率并不能衡量仅遥控器场景的误确认，该错误应单独报告；通过在训练中纳入仅遥控器样本并施加显式FCR约束，可有效降低误确认率，但需以TPR下降和推迟率上升为代价。

Abstract: Passive radio frequency (RF) sensing is widely used for counter-unmanned-aerial-vehicle (counter-UAV) detection. Existing studies commonly report high accuracy against background RF or WiFi/Bluetooth interference, but rarely isolate controller-only operation without a linked aircraft. We present a dual-band software-defined radio (SDR) measurement study with ambient, controller-only, and linked states for three commercial UAV platforms (DJI Phantom 3 4K, Hubsan H501S, DJI Mavic Mini). Two USRP B210 receivers simultaneously scan eight 2.4 GHz and twelve 5.8 GHz observation windows across twenty rounds. We first train an energy-based detector using linked and ambient scans only. At four ranked concurrent dwell steps (8 s), it achieves 0.992 linked-versus-ambient balanced accuracy but false-confirms 30 out of 60 controller-only scans (FCRctrl = 0.500). We then include controller-only scans in training and use confirm, reject, and defer outputs under an explicit controller-only false-confirmation-rate (FCR) constraint. For the pooled all-platform analysis, the constraint reduces observed FCRctrl from 0.350 to 0.050, while confirm-linked TPR decreases from 0.900 to 0.400 and 42.1% of scans are deferred. The corresponding compact scan performs substantially better for Hubsan and Mavic than for Phantom. A hardware-in-loop experiment reduces measured wall-clock time from 82.9 s to 28.9 s. These measurements show that linked-versus-background accuracy does not measure controller-only false confirmation and that this error should be reported separately.

</details>


### [549] [SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25352)
*Fatih Deniz,Yazan Boshmaf,Issa Khalil*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出动态基准框架SSP-Bench，按需生成评估实例，克服静态基准的分数饱和、数据污染与语义变体敏感性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全、安保与隐私（SSP）评估高度依赖静态基准，存在分数饱和、数据污染、聚合伪影，且无法捕捉模型对语言变体的敏感性；在固定测试集上表现良好的模型在语义等价改写下常失效。

Method: SSP-Bench按需生成评估实例并保持领域一致性：通过外部依据来源保证标签有效性，借助服务特定校验约束范围，利用多模型引导委员会校准难度；将基准构建形式化为在难度、可分性、新颖性和多样性上的多目标优化问题。

Result: 在24个模型与4类SSP服务上评估，揭示静态评估的系统性失效：因构念混杂导致安全排名近乎零相关、安全性与过度拒答强耦合、以及家族内的隐性回归。

Conclusion: 静态基准可能错误呈现模型行为，需转向动态、与部署相关的评估。

Abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.

</details>


### [550] [Quantum ROP: Using Quantum Algorithms for ROP Chain Selection in Exploit Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25364)
*Carlos Benitez*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将ROP gadget选择建模为QUBO问题，并在IBM Heron r2上运行QAOA求解，实现Linux内核提权，但受硬件深度限制并非总达最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前量子计算对网络安全的威胁讨论主要集中在Shor算法破解非对称密码。作者希望拓展视角：量子计算可能在攻击性安全领域还能带来其他能力，因此探索量子组合优化在利用构造中的应用。

Method: 将Return-Oriented Programming (ROP)的gadget选择问题形式化为Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO)，目标函数同时刻画单个gadget代价与gadget间寄存器clobbering交互，并使用QAOA在真实IBM Heron r2硬件上求解。

Result: 在Linux内核利用场景中，QAOA选出的链在SMEP和SMAP开启的情况下成功提权到uid=0。在8个Linux二进制、16个基准实例上，QAOA在11个案例中恢复出最低代价的有效链；其余5个未达到最优，失败与当前硬件上电路深度过大相关。

Conclusion: 量子组合优化可被用于ROP gadget选择并实际完成提权利用，表明量子计算在攻击性安全中具有超越密码分析的潜在能力；但受当前量子硬件电路深度限制，QAOA尚不能稳定求得最优解。

Abstract: The quantum computing threat to cybersecurity is nowadays predominantly framed around Shor's algorithm and its eventual capacity to break asymmetric cryptography. Beyond cryptanalysis, however, quantum computing may also enable other capabilities in offensive security. This work explores one such direction: the application of quantum combinatorial optimization to Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) gadget selection for exploit construction. We formulate gadget selection as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem that captures individual gadget cost and inter-gadget register-clobbering interactions, and solve it using QAOA on real IBM Heron r2 hardware. Applied to a Linux kernel exploitation scenario, the QAOA-selected chain achieves privilege escalation to uid=0 with SMEP and SMAP active. Across eight Linux binaries and 16 benchmark instances, QAOA recovered the lowest-cost valid chain in 11 cases; in the remaining five, it did not recover the optimum, with the failures associated with excessive circuit depth on current limited hardware.

</details>


### [551] [SLED-IFV: Solver-Validated LLM-Guided Decomposition for Scalable Hardware Information-Flow Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25637)
*Liangtao Dai,Yimin Gao,Melika Morsali,Mircea Stan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文针对形式化硬件信息流验证（IFV）在真实RTL上扩展性差的问题，识别出实现复杂性与关系归纳复杂性两类证明障碍，提出功能简化与关系强化两种语义证明分解形式，并实现求解器校验的LLM引导流程SLED-IFV，最高实现603倍求解加速并将两个12小时超时转为完成证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化硬件IFV虽能对秘密相关的时序与控制行为提供强保证，但在真实RTL上规模扩展性差。自组合IFV中存在两类反复出现的证明障碍：一是实现复杂性，即证明困难的组合数据通路逻辑占据主导，而性质仅需紧凑的边界关系；二是关系归纳复杂性，即证明依赖跨副本的公共控制事实，而后端求解器难以高效推断。这两类障碍严重限制了IFV在现实RTL上的应用。

Method: 提出两种语义证明分解形式：功能简化（functional simplification），用经校验的过近似摘要替换证明困难的RTL区域；关系强化（relational strengthening），显式暴露并证明归纳所需的跨副本关系。进一步提出SLED-IFV，一种由求解器校验、LLM引导的流程，自动选择分解形式及其具体目标。给定自组合miter和无oracle的决策表，LLM提出分解方案，在控制器检查下将其物化为证明件；控制器将检查后的证明件编译为证明义务，形式验证后端是唯一的接受权威。

Result: 在基于真实RTL构造的九个非平凡基准上，SLED-IFV实现最高603倍的纯求解器加速，并将两个12小时超时案例转化为完成的证明。该闭环流程在所有案例中均产生验证器接受的分解。

Conclusion: 通过功能简化和关系强化两种语义证明分解，并结合求解器校验的LLM引导流程，可有效缓解自组合硬件信息流验证中的实现复杂性与关系归纳复杂性障碍，显著提升可扩展性，同时保持形式验证后端的最终接受权威。

Abstract: Formal hardware information-flow verification (IFV) provides strong guarantees against secret-dependent timing and control behavior, but often scales poorly on realistic RTL. We identify two recurring proof barriers in self-composed IFV: implementation complexity, where proof-hard datapath logic dominates even though the property needs only a compact boundary relation, and relational inductive complexity, where the proof depends on cross-copy public-control facts that the backend prover does not infer efficiently. To address them, we introduce two semantic proof decomposition forms: functional simplification, which replaces a proof-hard RTL region with a validated over-approximate summary, and relational strengthening, which exposes and proves the cross-copy relations needed for induction. We further present SLED-IFV, a solver-validated LLM-guided flow that automates the selection of these forms and their concrete targets. Given a self-composed miter and an oracle-free decision sheet, the LLM proposes a decomposition, then materializes it into proof artifacts under controller checks. The controller compiles the checked artifacts into proof obligations, and the formal verification backend remains the sole authority for acceptance. Across nine nontrivial benchmarks constructed from real RTL, SLED-IFV achieves up to 603x solver-only speedup and converts two 12-hour timeouts into completed proofs. The closed-loop flow produces verifier-accepted decompositions for all cases.

</details>


### [552] [Identifying Suspected Mislabeled Apps in Google Play Application Removal Prediction: An Empirical Comparison of Label Noise Detection Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25487)
*Deborah Dobles Montalvan,F. Mohsen,H. de Weerd*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出"标签噪声"概念，用三种异常检测方法在870,514个Google Play应用上识别可疑标签，发现被flag的应用并不能通过剔除来提升模型性能，但可用来刻画标签噪声的方向性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测应用是否被下架的模型其标签只记录某时点应用是否仍在商店中，无法区分自愿撤回与政策下架，也无法识别未被抓获的垃圾应用，导致"已移除"与"稳定"标签存在语义错配，即标签噪声。

Method: 在Mohsen等(2022)的870,514个应用数据上，采用三种不同方法论家族的检测器：Isolation Forest（特征空间异常）、Neighborhood Disagreement（近邻标签相反）、Prediction Inconsistency（分类器预测与数据标签不一致）。取三者共同flag的重叠集（默认设置下7,598个）作为最强误标候选，并用VirusTotal与Quark Engine进行外部验证。

Result: 剔除flagged应用不能提升模型性能，无检测器、重叠集或并集能胜过基线，且移除越多损失越大。在VirusTotal与Quark Engine确认的移除中，flagged应用出现率随阈值收紧降至期望率的0.43倍；稳定侧的过量现象在考虑扫描应用年龄后消失。仅用3,021个可训练重叠应用训练的模型测试AUC为0.2518，远低于随机水平，说明该子集特征与标签关系与其余数据相反。

Conclusion: 被flag应用在两个方向上均出现错误：类似垃圾的废弃应用带稳定标签，看似健康的应用带已移除标签。检测器的价值在于刻画这种标签噪声，定位出一小批无法通过剔除获益的候选样本。

Abstract: Models that predict which Google Play apps will be removed are trained on labels that record only whether an app was still in the store at a later observation. A disappeared app is labeled removed and a present one stable, but neither records why. A voluntary withdrawal and a policy takedown both produce removed, and an uncaught spam app keeps stable. This work calls that mismatch label noise. Three detectors from different methodological families are applied to the 870,514 apps of Mohsen, Karastoyanova, and Azzopardi (2022): Isolation Forest, flagging apps unusual in the feature space, Neighborhood Disagreement, flagging apps whose nearest neighbors carry the opposite label, and Prediction Inconsistency, flagging apps a classifier labels differently from the data. The apps flagged by all three, the overlap, number 7,598 at default settings and are the strongest mislabeling candidates. Two questions follow. First, does removing flagged apps improve the model? It does not. No detector, overlap, or union beats the baseline, and the loss grows with the number removed. Second, do flagged apps appear less often than expected among apps whose label VirusTotal and Quark Engine confirm? Among confirmed removals they do, falling to 0.43 times the expected rate as the threshold tightens, while an excess on the stable side disappears once the age of the scanned apps is accounted for. A model trained on only the 3,021 trainable overlap apps reaches a test AUC of 0.2518, far below chance, so the relationship between features and labels there runs opposite to the rest of the data. The flagged apps run wrong in both directions: abandoned apps that resemble spam carry stable, while apps that look healthy carry removed. The value of the detectors lies in characterizing this label noise. They locate a small set of candidates they cannot profitably remove.

</details>


### [553] [FASTAR: FRI Accelerator for Scalable Transparent ARguments of Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25535)
*Tengkai Gong,Xiaolin Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出FASTAR：一种基于FPGA的可参数化FRI协议加速器，采用约束驱动设计方法，通过HLS实现，可自动生成适配目标FPGA资源与存储约束的硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ZKP正从依赖可信设置且抗量子性弱的经典zk-SNARKs（如Groth16）转向透明且后量子安全的zk-STARKs。后者仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数实现后量子安全，但计算开销巨大：FRI协议主导了证明者复杂度，产生海量数据、重复的Merkle树承诺以及不规则访存模式，制约了通用处理器的性能与能效。

Method: FASTAR采用约束驱动的设计方法学，而非在昂贵ASIC工艺节点上追求固定高性能内核。基于高层次综合（HLS）实现，构建了覆盖FRI主要阶段的全参数化构件：多项式求值、递归split-and-fold以及Merkle树构造。根据用户提供的板卡规格，FASTAR自动生成适配目标FPGA资源与存储约束的硬件实现。

Result: FASTAR可自动生成面向目标FPGA的定制化硬件，支持在广泛平台部署而无需人工重新设计，缓解了FRI协议在通用处理器上面临的性能与能效瓶颈。

Conclusion: 通过约束驱动的可参数化HLS框架，FASTAR为FRI协议提供了跨平台的FPGA加速方案，提升了后量子ZKP证明生成的部署灵活性与效率。

Abstract: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) enable a prover to cryptographically convince a verifier of the validity of a statement without revealing any underlying secrets, forming a foundational primitive for verifiable computation. The ZKP landscape is undergoing a fundamental shift from classic zk-SNARKs such as Groth16, which rely on trusted setup and are vulnerable to quantum adversaries, toward transparent, post-quantum constructions such as zk-STARK. These systems achieve post-quantum security by relying solely on collision-resistant hash functions, however, at the cost of substantial computational overhead. In particular, the Fast Reed--Solomon Interactive Oracle Proof of Proximity (FRI) protocol dominates prover complexity, generating massive data volumes, repeated Merkle-tree commitments, and irregular memory access patterns that limit performance and energy efficiency on general-purpose processors.
  To address these challenges, this work proposes FASTAR, a novel FPGA-based accelerator for the FRI protocol. Unlike accelerators that pursue fixed high-performance kernels on expensive ASIC process nodes, FASTAR adopts a constraint-driven design methodology. Our framework is implemented with High-Level Synthesis (HLS) and composed of fully parameterizable building blocks for the major stages of FRI, including polynomial evaluation, recursive split-and-fold, and Merkle-tree construction. From user-provided board specifications, FASTAR automatically generates hardware implementations tailored to the resource and memory constraints of the target FPGA, enabling deployment across a wide range of platforms without manual redesign.

</details>


### [554] [Rethinking Backdoor Repair Evaluation: Distinguishing Aggregate Clean Utility from Benign Performance Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25579)
*Baogang Song,Changtian Song,Jian Chen,Fan He,Junwei Zhou,Jianwen Xiang,Dongdong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文从"性能保持"视角重新审视后门修复模型的良性性能评估，提出类别级保持损失指标（最差类保持损失、尾部保持损失），揭示聚合干净准确率会通过局部损失稀释与跨类补偿掩盖局部退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门修复研究通常用攻击成功率（ASR）和总体干净准确率评估"抑制恶意行为+保持良性性能"两大目标，但聚合准确率可能掩盖集中在部分标签空间上的显著性能退化，导致良性性能被高估。

Method: 区分聚合干净效用与原有类别级性能的保持，通过比较修复前后的干净性能定义类别级保持损失，指出聚合会因局部损失稀释和跨类补偿而隐藏局部退化；在总体干净准确率之外，用最差类保持损失（Worst-Class）和尾部保持损失（Tail）刻画局部保持损失，并在代表性后门攻击、修复方法、数据集、攻击目标与模型架构上开展系统实证，另在干净标签攻击下验证。

Result: 有效的攻击抑制与良好的聚合干净性能并不必然意味着各类别原有良性性能被均匀保持；仍可能存在显著的局部保持损失，其严重程度和类别结构随修复条件而变化。

Conclusion: 应在ASR与总体干净准确率之外，引入面向保持的类别级评估指标，以更全面地衡量后门修复方法对良性性能的保持能力。

Abstract: Backdoor repair aims to suppress malicious behavior in compromised models while preserving benign task performance. Existing studies typically evaluate these objectives using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Overall Clean Accuracy, but aggregate clean accuracy can obscure substantial degradation concentrated in a small portion of the label space. We revisit benign-performance evaluation from a preservation perspective by distinguishing aggregate clean utility from the preservation of previously available class-wise performance. We define class-wise preservation loss by comparing clean performance before and after repair and show that aggregation can hide localized degradation through localized-loss dilution and cross-class compensation. To complement Overall Clean Accuracy, we characterize localized preservation loss using Worst-Class Preservation Loss and Tail Preservation Loss. We conduct a systematic empirical study across representative backdoor attacks, repair methods, datasets, attack targets, and model architectures, with additional validation under clean-label attacks. Results show that effective attack suppression and favorable aggregate clean performance do not necessarily imply uniform preservation of previously available benign performance across classes. Substantial localized preservation losses can remain, and their severity and class-wise structure vary across repair conditions. These findings motivate preservation-oriented class-wise evaluation alongside ASR and Overall Clean Accuracy.

</details>


### [555] [C-to-Rust Fallacy: Automatic Refactoring != Memory Security](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25682)
*Hung-Mao Chen,Xu He,Bo Lu,Xiaokuan Zhang,Kun Sun*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对 C2Rust-analyze、CROWN、C2SaferRust 和 FLOURINE 四种 C-to-Rust 自动重构工具进行了实证研究，基于 NIST Juliet 测试套件中 116 个含内存安全缺陷的 C 程序生成 464 个 Rust 程序，评估其编译正确性、对原始 C 缺陷的缓解效果以及引入新 Rust 缺陷的倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rust 具备内存与类型安全优势，是 C/C++ 的有力替代方案，但人工将 C 转换为 Rust 需要深入的领域知识且成本高昂。现有自动重构工具虽宣称通过减少 unsafe Rust 实现安全，但其与真正提升安全性的关联尚不明确，亟需系统的实证评估。

Method: 选取 NIST Juliet 测试套件中 116 个含内存安全缺陷的 C 程序作为数据集，使用 C2Rust-analyze、CROWN、C2SaferRust、FLOURINE 四种工具生成 464 个 Rust 程序，并从三个维度进行评估：重构程序的编译正确性、对原始 C 缺陷的缓解效果、以及引入额外 Rust 缺陷的倾向，同时分析各工具设计动机与错误根因。

Result: 在生成的 464 个 Rust 程序中，342 个无法编译，177 个继承了原 C 程序的内存安全缺陷，另有 77 个引入了新的 Rust 缺陷。

Conclusion: 现有自动重构工具仅实现了其自身定义下的内存安全，而在实际采用时并不能保证更广泛意义上的内存安全，其安全性宣称与真实安全提升之间存在明显差距。

Abstract: Rust has emerged as the leading system programming language, offering strong memory and type safety guarantees without compromising performance. This positions it as a compelling alternative to traditional languages like C and C++, which are susceptible to memory security bugs. However, manually transforming C to Rust requires in-depth domain knowledge of the Rust language features, which requires significant effort for developers. To address this, tools for automatic C-to-Rust refactoring aim to generate safe Rust code leveraging static analysis and Large Language Models (LLMs). While these tools claim to achieve safety by reducing the unsafe Rust, the correlation with improving security is not clear. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study on the reliability, safety, and correctness of various C-to-Rust refactoring methods. Specifically, we evaluate C2Rust-analyze, CROWN, C2SaferRust, and FLOURINE using a dataset of 116 C programs with memory security bugs from the NIST Juliet Test Suite. Based on 464 Rust programs generated by these tools, our evaluation focuses on three key aspects: the compilation correctness of the refactored programs, the effectiveness in mitigating original C bugs, and the tendency to introduce additional Rust bugs. The results indicate that 342 Rust programs fail to compile, 177 Rust programs inherit memory security bugs from the original C programs, and 77 new Rust bugs are introduced. We examine the rationale behind tool design and analyze the root cause of errors across various refactoring methods. Our findings indicate that current automated refactoring tools deliver memory safety as they define it, but not the broader memory security when adopting them.

</details>


### [556] [GuidedRay: Diversity-Guided Direction Discovery for Targeted Hard-Label Black-Box Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25734)
*Fei Yuan,Yantian Shen,Qingyuan Yu,Yi Chen,Binghui Wang,Hongbo Yu,Anyu Wang,Xiaoyun Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出GuidedRay，一种基于多样性引导方向发现的目标化决策攻击，显著降低初始化查询成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒目标化决策攻击仅能观测top-1标签，扰动精炼前需先找到指向目标类区域的可行方向，该初始化步骤查询开销巨大。

Method: 利用目标类参考样本提供的目标条件方向先验，从一个或多个参考生成多样化候选，用单查询Fast Test筛选其诱导的符号方向；找到可行方向后，用Ray Search缩小决策边界半径。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，于500至5,000四档查询预算下持续优于五种SOTA决策攻击，初始化方向发现提升尤为明显；对对抗训练或TRADES防护模型同样在四档预算下取得最高攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 多样性引导的目标条件方向先验能有效加速目标化决策攻击的方向发现，GuidedRay在白盒防护模型上亦具强迁移攻击能力。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Among black-box attacks, targeted decision-based attacks are particularly difficult: the attacker observes only the target model's top-1 label and aims to make it predict a prespecified target class under a bounded perturbation. Before perturbation refinement, the attacker must discover a direction that reaches the prescribed target region. This initialization step can incur substantial query cost. We propose GuidedRay, a targeted decision-based attack based on diversity-guided direction discovery. GuidedRay builds on two observations: target-class reference samples provide useful target-conditioned direction priors, and diverse candidates increase the probability of discovering a targeted adversarial direction. GuidedRay generates varied candidates from one or multiple target-class references and uses a one-query Fast Test to screen their induced sign directions. Once a feasible direction is found, GuidedRay applies Ray Search to reduce its decision-boundary radius. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet demonstrate that GuidedRay consistently outperforms five state-of-the-art decision-based attacks at four evaluated query budgets from 500 to 5,000, with particularly pronounced gains in direction discovery during initialization. Against models protected by adversarial training or TRADES, it likewise achieves the highest attack success rate at all four query budgets.

</details>


### [557] [Adaptive Traffic Camouflage: Causal and Resource-Aware Defense Against IoT Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25787)
*Daniel Adu Worae,Spyridon Mastorakis,Nuno Moniz,Nitesh V. Chawla*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出自适应流量伪装（Adaptive Traffic Camouflage）——一个因果、泄漏感知的控制器，无需运行时设备标签即可刻画流量形状泄漏，并在带宽与延迟约束下为下一时间窗选择伪装变换，从而降低IoT流量形状的可指纹化程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密仅隐藏IoT载荷，但包大小、时序、方向与分包模式等流量形状特征仍可泄露设备身份；现有防御通常非因果、需要设备标签，且较少在明确通信预算约束下权衡伪装效果。

Method: 控制器为因果、泄漏感知设计：无运行时设备标签，基于前一窗口上下文刻画流量形状泄漏，并在填充、包拆分、时序调整、复合变换及“不变换”之间选择预算可行的变换。在CIC-IoT-2022、IoT Sentinel与UNSW上，用经典与序列指纹模型，在干净训练、防御感知训练、增量暴露三种设置下评估，对比固定、随机与均值带宽匹配基线。

Result: Balanced档下Macro-F1平均下降13.2–23.3%，平均带宽开销4.88–7.47%，附加延迟至多0.64 ms；Privacy档下降达28.0–43.5%。防御感知训练可在CIC-IoT-2022与UNSW上大幅恢复攻击者性能，而IoT Sentinel仍保留明显隐私间隙。同窗非因果参照相对前一窗控制仅带来有限增益；元数据丰富的攻击者在目标流量形状范围之外仍有效。

Conclusion: 因果、资源感知的伪装能在明确通信约束下降低IoT流量形状可指纹性；保护效果的持久性取决于被防御分布的可学习程度，且伪装仅覆盖流量形状面，元数据攻击仍构成威胁。

Abstract: Encryption hides IoT payloads, but traffic shape can still reveal device identity through packet sizes, timing, direction, and packetization. We present Adaptive Traffic Camouflage, a causal, leakage-aware controller that characterizes traffic-shape leakage without runtime device labels and selects a budget-feasible transformation for the next traffic window from previous-window context. The controller chooses among padding, packet splitting, timing, and composite transformations, or leaves traffic unchanged when camouflage is unnecessary. We evaluate the design on CIC-IoT-2022, IoT Sentinel, and UNSW using classical and sequence-based fingerprinting models under clean-trained, defense-aware, and incremental-exposure settings, with fixed, random, and mean-bandwidth-matched baselines. Under the Balanced profile, camouflage reduces mean Macro-F1 by 13.2-23.3% relative to clean traffic with 4.88-7.47% average bandwidth overhead and at most 0.64 ms added latency. Under the larger Privacy profile, the reduction increases to 28.0-43.5%. Defense-aware training recovers much of the lost attacker performance on CIC-IoT-2022 and UNSW, while IoT Sentinel retains a substantial privacy gap. A non-causal same-window reference provides only modest additional benefit over previous-window control, and metadata-rich attackers remain effective outside the targeted traffic-shape surface. These results show that causal, resource-aware camouflage can reduce IoT traffic-shape fingerprintability under explicit communication constraints, while the persistence of protection depends on how readily the defended distribution can be learned.

</details>


### [558] [On the Construction of Trapdoor Claw-Free Functions with Certifiable Key](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25819)
*Charles Lim,Yao Ma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文提出面向（含噪）陷门无爪函数（TCF）的家族无关密钥认证抽象，以"可认证密钥关系"与"认证密钥生成"为核心概念，可泛化地将任意基于TCF的量子性证明编译为零知识版本，并界定了该原语的适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TCF协议的安全保证均相对于"诚实生成的密钥"而陈述，缺乏对密钥本身合法性的认证机制；同时基于TCF的量子性证明通常不具备零知识性，需要一种通用手段在不依赖具体函数家族的前提下补足这两点。

Method: 提出家族无关的密钥认证抽象：一是可认证密钥关系，即刻画某家族诚实密钥、且见证可由陷门恢复的NP关系；二是认证密钥生成，为每个密钥输出成员资格证书，并满足完备性、带可提取性的证书可靠性与密钥隐私。为不同构造实例化可认证密钥关系，并通用地以该关系的零知识知识论证（ZKPoK）实现。基于此给出通用编译器，把任意TCF量子性证明转为零知识版本。

Result: 对多种TCF构造给出了可认证密钥关系实例化，均可由相应关系的零知识知识论证通用满足；通用编译器成功将TCF量子性证明转化为零知识证明，且每条安全性质都对应认证方案中的相应性质；并证明在依赖单射不变性的协议中，可接受的证书本身即为家族区分器，恰会泄露此类协议必须隐藏的那一位。

Conclusion: 密钥认证可作为TCF类协议的通用组件，将量子性证明升级为零知识；但该原语存在本质界限——对基于单射不变性的协议，认证与所需隐藏性不可兼得。

Abstract: Trapdoor claw-free functions (TCFs) underpin much of classical-quantum cryptographic interaction, yet every TCF-based protocol states its guarantees relative to an honestly generated key.
