We give a family-agnostic abstraction of key certification for (noisy) TCF constructions, built on two notions: a certifiable key relation, an NP relation capturing a family's honest keys with witnesses recoverable from the trapdoor; and certified key generation, which emits with each key a certificate of membership satisfying completeness, certificate soundness with extractability, and key privacy. We instantiate certifiable key relations for different constructions, each met generically by a zero-knowledge argument of knowledge for the relation. As our main application, a generic compiler turns any TCF-based proof of quantumness into a zero-knowledge one, with each security property following from its counterpart in the certification scheme. Finally, we delimit the primitive's reach: for protocols resting on injective invariance, an accepting certificate is itself a family distinguisher, leaking exactly the bit such protocols must hide.

</details>


### [559] [COBRA: A Content-Agnostic Framework for Zero-Day Detection of Suspicious Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25882)
*Alexandros Fourtounis,Emmanouil Papadogiannakis,Panagiotis Papadopoulos,Nicolas Kourtellis,Evangelos Markatos*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出COBRA框架，仅凭域名名称即可在注册时刻（day zero）检测可疑域名，无需内容特征；在150万新注册域名上实现98.5%精确率，识别4.7万余个可疑域名，并比主流威胁情报服务提前发现80%的可疑/恶意域名，最多提前7天。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶意域名是钓鱼、恶意软件分发、冒充和欺诈交易等网络攻击的核心载体，注册成本低、易规模化部署，危害广泛。传统检测依赖域名内容，存在从注册到内容填充的"脆弱窗口期"。因此需要一种在域名注册之初、尚无内容时即可进行主动检测的方法。

Method: 提出COBRA——一种与内容无关（content-agnostic）、面向注册时刻的检测框架。方法不依赖任何基于内容的特征，而是分析新注册域名的名称，采用聚类技术，依据词法与结构相似性对域名进行分组，从而在域名被内容填充之前完成分类。

Result: 在包含150万新创建域名的真实数据上评估：COBRA检测可疑域名的精确率达98.5%，识别出超过4.7万个不同的新注册可疑域名；域名名称聚类支持准确的早期检测，可使80%的可疑或恶意域名比某广泛使用的威胁情报服务更早被发现，后者有时需长达7天。

Conclusion: 仅基于域名名称的词法与结构聚类即可实现有效的零日可疑域名检测，弥补内容依赖方法的窗口期缺陷，并与主流威胁情报服务相比显著提升检测时效性，具有实际部署价值。

Abstract: The use of malicious domains is central to cyberattacks such as phishing, malware distribution, impersonation, and fraudulent transactions. Because domains are inexpensive to register and easy to deploy at scale, they remain one of the most common and damaging tools used in cybercrime across industries. Proactive detection is essential to reducing this window of vulnerability and preventing harm to users. In this work, we propose COBRA: a content-agnostic, registration-time detection framework for identifying and analyzing suspicious domains from day zero. Our approach does not rely on any content-based features, allowing us to classify a domain even before it is populated with content. We analyze the names of newly registered domains and employ a clustering technique to group them based on lexical and structural similarity. We evaluate our methodology using real-world data consisting of 1.5M newly created domains, demonstrating that COBRA detects suspicious domains with a precision of 98.5%, identifying more than 47K distinct newly registered suspicious domains. Furthermore, our results show that domain-name clustering enables accurate early detection, allowing us to identify 80% of suspicious or malicious domains earlier than one of the most widely used threat-intelligence services, which in some cases may require up to 7 days.

</details>


### [560] [LoRango: It Takes Two LoRAs to Unlock Hidden Behaviors in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25884)
*Jin Wei,Rundong Li,Ruihao Yang,Yikai Wang,Xiaoyuan Duan,Jianxiong Wu,Yanbo Wang,Chang Xu,Lingyun Zhang,Zhuyang Yu,Ping Chen,Jun Dai,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出LoRango，一种针对文本到图像扩散模型中多LoRA组合条件的配对攻击：单独使用良性、有用的适配器在与特定匹配伙伴共同加载时会触发有害生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户常组合多个LoRA适配器以定制图像的subject、风格和视觉属性，但逐个审查适配器无法保证其组合后的安全性，作者据此识别并刻画了一种"配对条件攻击"（pair-conditioned attack），揭示多LoRA个性化场景中组合审查的必要性。

Method: LoRango由互补的Signature适配器与Payload适配器构成：Signature向中间载体表征写入配对专属编码；Payload采用编码选择性响应以及相反对的信号/参考分支。单独或错误配对时两分支近似抵消，而匹配时编码-读取器对齐打破抵消，在原生GEGLU模块内释放预设动作。两个适配器均导出为普通静态LoRA文件，兼容标准加载器，无需提示词触发或修改基础管线。

Result: 在SD v1.5上配对攻击成功率达97.9%，SDXL上达98.7%；而单独加载植入适配器时仅为2.8–4.6%。实验进一步评估了配对选择性、单独保真性、对部署变化的鲁棒性以及跨去噪器架构的适用性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，仅审查单个适配器不足以评估多LoRA个性化的安全性，需对适配器组合进行审计（auditing adapter compositions）。

Abstract: Users commonly combine multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters to personalize images with different subjects, styles, and visual attributes. Yet inspecting adapters individually does not establish the safety of their composition. We identify and characterize a pair-conditioned attack in text-to-image diffusion: individually useful and benign-appearing adapters redirect image generation when co-loaded with a specifically matched partner, whose identity serves as the trigger. We introduce LoRango to realize this attack through complementary Signature and Payload adapters. The Signature writes a pair-specific code into intermediate carrier representations, while the Payload uses code-selective responses and opposing signal/reference branches. These branches approximately cancel for standalone adapters and mismatched pairs; matched code-reader alignment breaks cancellation within native GEGLU blocks and releases the programmed action. Both adapters are exported as ordinary static LoRA files compatible with standard loaders, requiring no prompt trigger or base-pipeline modification. LoRango achieves matched-pair attack success rates of 97.9\% on SD v1.5 and 98.7\% on SDXL, compared with 2.8--4.6\% when implanted adapters are loaded individually. Further experiments evaluate pair selectivity, standalone fidelity, robustness to deployment variations, and applicability across denoiser architectures. These findings show that individual-adapter inspection is insufficient to assess the security of multi-LoRA personalization and motivate auditing adapter compositions.

</details>


### [561] [How It's Made: Uncovering Detection Engineering Processes for Network Intrusion Detection Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25901)
*Koen T. W. Teuwen,Emmanuele Zambon,Luca Allodi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 SuriCap 平台并进行 CTF 式规则工程工作坊研究，分析 60 名参与者为 4 个场景编写的 3146 条有效 Suricata 规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全运营中心（SOC）广泛依赖 Suricata 等基于签名的网络入侵检测系统，但检测规则工程这一环节仍缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建 SuriCap 规则工程演练平台，并举办 CTF 式工作坊；60 名参与者（受训硕士生与有经验的 SOC 专业人员）针对 4 个场景创建规则，共产出 3146 条有效规则，据此分析其方法、性能与迭代模式。

Result: 先前经验对规则质量影响有限，表明经验较少的工程师也能产出与专家相当的规则；同时观察到规则难以泛化到已有测试之外，凸显充足标注数据的必要性。

Conclusion: 研究识别出规则工程的三个阶段的通用模式，为 SOC 管理者改进流程、合理设定对工程师专业能力的预期提供了参考。

Abstract: Many Security Operations Centers rely on signature-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems like Suricata, yet detection rule engineering remains understudied. We investigate this process by introducing SuriCap, a platform for rule engineering exercises, and hosting CTF-style workshops where 60 participants, trained MSc students, and experienced SOC professionals, created rules for four scenarios. Participants produced 3146 valid rules, enabling analysis of their methods, performance, and iteration patterns. Surprisingly, prior experience had limited impact on rule quality, suggesting that less experienced engineers can produce rules comparable to experts. We also observed challenges in generalizing rules beyond available tests, underscoring the need for sufficient labeled data. From our study, we identify three phases and a common pattern in rule engineering, offering SOC managers insights to improve their processes and expectations of engineer expertise.

</details>


### [562] [Toward Responsible AI-Augmented Cyber Defense: Pattern Recognition, Defense-in-Depth, and the Case for Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25921)
*Mustafa S. Aljumaily,Hayder Kareem Abed,Nawar S. Alseelawi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将AI增强的纵深防御形式化为伯努利检测级联、将各层模式识别形式化为Neyman-Pearson/贝叶斯检测器、将人机协同研判形式化为容量受限级联，并通过蒙特卡洛与解析仿真证明AI增益在传统分层饱和处最大，且100%人工复核并非最优，存在内点最优容量比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络安全文献虽大量记录AI在威胁检测、事件响应与预防中的运营收益，并定性担忧过度自动化、算法偏见与分析师技能退化，但缺少一个正式、可证伪的模型，将纵深防御理论、AI模式识别理论与安全运营中的人机协同三个反复出现的构念联系起来，因此本文旨在构建此类模型。

Method: 1) 将分层防御形式化为伯努利检测级联，AI增强以乘性方式进入各层；2) 将每层模式识别行为形式化为Neyman-Pearson/贝叶斯检测器，并推导闭式最优阈值；3) 将人机研判形式化为容量受限级联，显式量化检测概率与误报（告警疲劳）率之间的权衡；4) 在示意性但现实的运行点上开展蒙特卡洛/解析仿真。

Result: 仿真表明：(i) AI增强在防御层间具有复利效应，其最大边际增益恰好出现在传统分层已饱和之处；(ii) 对AI标记告警进行全量人工复核并非最优：将分析师容量提升至接近100%覆盖率可使误报降低约20倍，但同时降低系统级检测概率，因为不完美的人工准确率被应用于每一条告警而非经过滤的子集。

Conclusion: 本文为广泛流传的“平衡人机协同”定性建议提供了精确、可检验的形式，并提出以内点最优容量比作为安全运营中心（SOC）的具体设计目标，包括保护IT/OT融合关键基础设施的SOC。

Abstract: Cybersecurity literature has extensively documented the operational benefits of artificial intelligence (AI) for threat detection, incident response, and prevention, while raising qualitative concerns about over-automation, algorithmic bias, and analyst-skill erosion. What remains largely absent is a formal, falsifiable model connecting three constructs that recur across this literature: Defense-in-Depth Theory, the Artificial Intelligence Theory of Pattern Recognition, and human-AI collaboration in security operations. This paper develops such a model. We formalize layered defense as a Bernoulli detection cascade in which AI augmentation enters multiplicatively across layers; we formalize each layer's pattern-recognition behavior as a Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian detector with a derived closed-form optimal threshold; and we formalize human-AI triage as a capacity-constrained cascade with an explicit, quantifiable trade-off between detection probability and false-alarm ("alert fatigue") rate. A Monte Carlo/analytical simulation evaluated at illustrative but realistic operating points shows that (i) AI augmentation compounds across defense layers, delivering its largest marginal gains exactly where traditional layering saturates, and (ii) full human review of AI-flagged alerts is not optimal: increasing analyst capacity toward 100% coverage cuts false alarms by roughly 20-fold but simultaneously lowers system-level detection probability, because imperfect analyst accuracy is then applied to every alert rather than a filtered subset. These results give the widely repeated qualitative recommendation of "balanced human-AI collaboration" a precise, testable form and suggest an interior-optimum capacity ratio as a concrete design target for security operations centers (SOCs), including those securing IT/OT-converged critical infrastructure.

</details>


### [563] [Policy-Backed Selective Regeneration under Tainted Inter-Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26072)
*Jinghan Xu,Longze Fan,Zeyuan Wang,Xinjin Li,Hankai Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出ESC-CR（可执行语义承诺与洁净室恢复）框架，用于多智能体语言模型系统的安全智能体间代码生成与恢复，通过在外部发布边界强制执行由可信任务、证据和策略构建的可执行承诺，在违规时隔离污染消息并重建干净上下文重新生成，从而在保留有用信息的同时抑制未授权发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体通信中，单条消息可能将任务关键信息与未经原始请求授权的指令混杂在一起。基于提示的防御把执行权交给暴露于对抗消息的模型本身；而无差别地删除消息又会丢弃有用信息，二者均存在明显缺陷，因此需要一种既能保留证据支持信息、又能阻止未授权发布的安全机制。

Method: 提出ESC-CR框架：将消息声明与授权分离；基于可信任务、证据和策略构建可执行承诺；在外部发布边界处强制执行该承诺。一旦发生违规，系统对责任消息和被拒产物进行污点标记（taint），从有证据支持的任务信息中重建干净上下文，并在同一策略下重新生成。

Result: 在通信密集型与标准代码生成基准、多种模型族和通信拓扑、以及涵盖直接、混淆和验证器感知载荷的自适应攻击下进行评估。结果显示：污染上下文重试往往无法消除未授权影响；完全删除消息可能丢失通信密集型任务所需信息；ESC-CR在同等计算预算下既能保留证据支持的声明，又能抑制未授权发布，且该设计可迁移到端到端智能体轨迹。

Conclusion: ESC-CR通过策略支撑的执行边界与洁净室恢复机制，在匹配计算预算下有效平衡了信息保留与安全执行，优于提示式防御和无差别消息删除，并具备向端到端智能体轨迹迁移的通用性。

Abstract: Inter-agent communication is essential to multi-agent language-model systems, yet a single message may combine task-critical information with instructions not authorized by the original request. Prompt-based defenses leave enforcement to models exposed to adversarial messages, while indiscriminate message removal discards useful information. We introduce Executable Semantic Commitments with Clean-Room Recovery (ESC-CR), a policy-backed framework for secure inter-agent code generation and recovery. It separates message claims from authorization, constructs executable commitments from trusted tasks, evidence, and policy, and enforces them at an external release boundary. Upon a violation, ESC-CR taints the responsible message and rejected artifact, reconstructs a clean context from evidence-backed task information, and regenerates under the same policy. We evaluate ESC-CR across communication-essential and standard code-generation benchmarks, multiple model families and communication topologies, and adaptive attacks spanning direct, obfuscated, and verifier-aware payloads. Results show that polluted-context retry frequently fails to remove unauthorized influence, while complete message removal can discard information required by communication-essential tasks. ESC-CR preserves evidence-backed claims while suppressing unauthorized releases under matched computational budgets, and the same design transfers to end-to-end agent trajectories.

</details>


### [564] [Learning to Link: Automatic Re-identification of BLE Devices Under MAC Address Randomisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26079)
*Reem Abdulrhman Alghamdi,Alberto Verna,Marco Mellia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究利用机器学习自动化创建签名，以在BLE MAC地址随机化（RPA）条件下跟踪设备，并将其形式化为监督分类问题；用决策树验证表明广告层元数据可实现设备再识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLE使用可解析私有地址（RPA）进行MAC地址随机化以抵御长期设备跟踪，但既有研究表明广告包中的元数据与结构特征可通过人工规则再识别设备；作者希望探究能否用机器学习自动化这一跟踪过程。

Method: 基于目标设备的真实蓝牙流量，刻画广告层特征在RPA变化过程中的持续性，并将设备关联（device linkage）建模为监督分类问题；作为可行性验证，采用简单决策树分类器，在不同地址轮换模式下评估目标与非目标设备的可区分性。

Result: 结果显示，广告层元数据能够在MAC随机化下实现设备再识别，且这种关联可仅凭标准监督学习技术自动化完成，而无需对该技术有专门知识；结果强化了既有研究结论。

Conclusion: 广告层元数据在RPA变化下具有足够持续性，使BLE设备跟踪可被标准监督学习自动化，凸显MAC随机化防护的不足与隐私风险。

Abstract: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) employs MAC address randomisation -- via Resolvable Private Address (RPA) -- to mitigate long-term device tracking on public advertising channels. Existing research has shown that advertising packets contain metadata and structural features that allow re-identifying a target device via manually crafted rules. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of automating the process of tracking BLE devices despite MAC randomisation by leveraging machine learning algorithms for the signature creation. Based on the actual Bluetooth traffic from target devices, we characterise the persistence of advertising-layer features across RPA changes and formulate device linkage as a supervised classification problem. Using simple decision tree classifiers as a proof-of-feasibility approach, we evaluate the distinguishability of target and non-target devices under varying address rotation patterns. Our results reinforce prior work demonstrating that advertising-layer metadata can enable device re-identification under MAC randomisation, to the point where such linkage can be automated using standard supervised learning techniques, without any specific knowledge of the technology.

</details>


### [565] [From Bilinear to Linear: Differentially Private Federated LoRA via Low-Dimensional Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26091)
*Lele Zheng,Ruijie Hu,Tao Zhang,Ke Cheng,Yulong Shen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 FedHSIP，一种基于统一低维参数化的差分隐私联邦 LoRA 框架，消除聚合失配与二次噪声放大，在隐私与非隐私设置下均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 虽避免原始数据共享，但传输的模型更新仍存在隐私泄露风险。引入差分隐私（DP）会带来两个根本性挑战：独立平均低秩因子导致的聚合失配，以及同时对两个因子注入噪声时产生的二次噪声放大。此外还需应对非 IID 数据带来的异构性问题。

Method: FedHSIP 将所有 LoRA 参数重构为一个共享的低维可训练向量，使客户端仅优化并通信低维更新，从而把联邦 LoRA 从双线性因子聚合问题转化为统一的线性参数空间，消除聚合失配并防止 DP 噪声的二次放大。为处理非 IID 数据，进一步提出基于预热统计构建的、感知异构性与敏感性的等距投影，将跨客户端更新模式兼容的坐标分组，同时平衡低维空间中的敏感性、更新能量与异构性。

Result: 在自然语言理解与生成基准上的大量实验表明，FedHSIP 在隐私与非隐私设置下均持续优于现有联邦 LoRA 方法；在差分隐私下取得最高 3-4% 的提升，同时将通信开销降低 80% 以上，并在异构数据分布下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FedHSIP 通过统一低维参数化与感知异构性、敏感性的等距投影，有效解决了联邦 LoRA 中 DP 集成的聚合失配与噪声放大问题，在保证隐私的同时显著提升性能并降低通信成本，具备良好的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provides an efficient solution for finetuning large language models across distributed and privacy-sensitive data. However, despite avoiding raw data sharing, federated LoRA remains vulnerable to privacy leakage through transmitted model updates. Differential privacy (DP) mitigates such leakage, but integrating DP into federated LoRA introduces two fundamental challenges: aggregation mismatch from independently averaging low-rank factors, and quadratic noise amplification when noise is injected into both factors. To address these challenges, we propose FedHSIP, a differentially private federated LoRA framework based on a unified low-dimensional parameterization. FedHSIP reformulates all LoRA parameters into a shared low-dimensional trainable vector, enabling clients to optimize and communicate only low-dimensional updates. This reformulation transforms federated LoRA from a bilinear factor aggregation problem into a unified linear parameter space, thereby eliminating aggregation mismatch and preventing the quadratic amplification of DP noise. To further handle non-IID data, we introduce a heterogeneity- and sensitivity-aware isometric projection, constructed from warm-up statistics, which groups coordinates with compatible cross-client update patterns while balancing sensitivity, update energy, and heterogeneity across the low-dimensional space. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding and generation benchmarks show that FedHSIP consistently outperforms existing federated LoRA methods under both private and non-private settings, achieving up to 3-4% improvements under differential privacy while reducing communication cost by over 80% and maintaining robustness under heterogeneous data distributions.

</details>


### [566] [Beyond Classification Accuracy: Quantifying Fingerprint Complexity in Encrypted Darknet Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26096)
*Javeriah Saleem,Rafiqul Islam,Md Zahidul Islam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出指纹复杂度分数（FCS）框架，用行为重叠、不确定性、分歧和持续混淆四个维度量化暗网服务指纹的内在复杂度，并在25种服务上验证复杂度与识别性能呈强负相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有暗网流量研究主要通过分类性能评估服务可指纹性，只能反映"能否识别"的结果，无法解释为何某些服务更易或更难被识别。作者希望从指纹内在复杂度的角度，揭示服务可指纹性的根本驱动因素。

Method: 提出Fingerprint Complexity Score（FCS）框架，从行为重叠（behavioral overlap）、不确定性（uncertainty）、分歧（disagreement）和持续混淆（persistent confusion）四个维度量化暗网服务指纹的复杂度；在Tor、I2P、FreeNet、ZeroNet四类匿名网络共25种服务上开展实验，并使用Random Forest、Extra Trees和XGBoost进行分类验证。

Result: 不同服务的指纹复杂度差异显著，行为重叠是复杂度最主要的贡献因素；指纹复杂度与识别性能呈强负相关（Pearson r = -0.706，Spearman ρ = -0.765，p < 0.001）。

Conclusion: 服务的可指纹性本质上由行为复杂度决定，该结论为分析匿名网络中的行为信息泄露提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Existing darknet traffic studies primarily evaluate service fingerprintability through classification performance, providing limited insight into why certain services are easier or harder to identify. This paper introduces the Fingerprint Complexity Score (FCS), a framework for quantifying the intrinsic complexity of darknet service fingerprints using behavioral overlap, uncertainty, disagreement, and persistent confusion. Experiments on 25 services across the Tor, I2P, FreeNet, and ZeroNet anonymity networks reveal substantial variation in fingerprint complexity, with behavioral overlap emerging as the dominant contributor. Validation using Random Forest, Extra Trees, and XGBoost demonstrates a strong inverse relationship between fingerprint complexity and recognition performance (Pearson r = -0.706, Spearman \r{ho} = -0.765, p < 0.001). The findings show that service fingerprintability is fundamentally governed by behavioral complexity, providing a new perspective for analyzing behavioral information leakage in anonymity networks.

</details>


### [567] [A Cross-Dataset based Zero-Day Intrusion Detection System by Integrating Siamese Network and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26115)
*Md. Meheraj Hossain,Saumik Das Turja,Sibgatullah Tasnim,Md. Fahmid-Ul-Alam Juboraj,Muhammad Iqbal Hossain*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种混合零日入侵检测系统，结合孪生网络异常关联与强化学习自适应防御，在IoT数据集上实现99.07%未知攻击检测准确率和93.94%零日检测率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT网络面临动态演化的零日威胁，传统入侵检测机制难以在复杂IoT环境中泛化到未见过的零日攻击，因此需要具备认知能力的检测与自适应防御机制。

Method: 采用孪生网络（Siamese network）进行基于距离的异常关联与相似度分析，配合无监督机器学习分类器在基准IoT数据集上区分已知攻击与未知异常；同时引入基于近端策略优化（PPO）的强化学习智能体，通过持续反馈与优化动态调整防御策略。

Result: 实验评估显示训练准确率99.28%、未知攻击检测准确率99.07%、零日检测率93.94%，验证了模型在数据集上的收敛性与稳定性，并在精度、延迟与误报之间取得平衡。

Conclusion: 该深度异常关联与自适应强化学习的结合为IoT部署提供了自学习和可扩展的防御机制，为下一代自主网络安全方案奠定了基础。

Abstract: Zero-day threats are nascent for the Internet of Things (IoT) network security, which demands cognitive detec-tion mechanisms that can identify emerging malicious behavior. Conventional intrusion detection mechanisms fail to generalize dynamic zero-day exploits within sophisticated IoT environments. This paper proposes a hybrid zero-day intrusion detection system using Siamese network-based anomaly correlation and reinforcement learning-based adaptive defense. Furthermore, the paper uses unsupervised machine learning classifiers over benchmark IoT datasets with the intention of detection of known attack types compared to unknown anomalies using distance-based similarity analysis to detect possible zero-day attacks. To facilitate adaptability, a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) reinforcement learning-based agent dynamically adjusts the defense policy with continuous feedback and optimization. Experimental evaluations demonstrate 99.28% training accuracy, 99.07% accuracy in unknown attack detection, and 93.94% zero-day detection ratio, confirming the convergence and stability of the model on datasets.The system offers a self-learning and extensible defense mechanism of IoT deployments by finding the right balance between precision, latency and false positives. This deep anomaly correlation with adaptive reinforcement learning is a firm base on which the next generation and autonomic cyber security solutions can take the reins as the zero-day threats keep changing their course.

</details>


### [568] [Zeta-Transform Evaluation for Higher-Order Vanishing Key Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26132)
*Sunyeop Kim,Insung Kim*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将 Hemmert 对 Classic McEliece 的高阶消失密钥恢复算法中 $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ 的计算转化为 Boolean 格上的截断加权上 zeta 变换，仅需在 $p$ 层到最低所需层之间的带状区域求值即可精确计算该映射及其转置，从而在不改变整体攻击流程的情况下降低 Wiedemann 核计算中重复矩阵-向量乘的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hemmert 针对 Classic McEliece 的密钥恢复算法核心开销在于计算 $\ker(\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)})$，其中 $A=H'''$ 为缩短校验矩阵；对 Classic McEliece 参数而言该核计算是攻击的主要瓶颈，因此需要降低其计算代价。

Method: 把定义 $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ 的求和按列解释为 Boolean 格上的加权上 zeta 变换；由于 $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ 只需变换的若干选定层，将求值限制在第 $p$ 层与最低所需层之间的带状区域，即可精确求值 $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ 及其转置；把所得截断 zeta 变换求值用于基于 Wiedemann 的核计算，加速重复矩阵-向量乘，且不改变整体密钥恢复算法。由于精确代价取决于 $H'''$ 非主元列的重量分布，分别考虑 all-one 模型与 Bernoulli$(1/2)$ 模型。

Result: 对 Classic McEliece 的五个参数集，在 all-one 模型下将估计的密钥恢复代价降低 $14.09$--$41.19$ bits，在 Bernoulli$(1/2)$ 模型下降低 $7.25$--$22.48$ bits。

Conclusion: 通过将 $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ 的求值重构为带状截断 zeta 变换并嵌入 Wiedemann 核计算，可在保持原密钥恢复算法不变的前提下显著降低 Classic McEliece 的攻击复杂度估计。

Abstract: Hemmert's key-recovery algorithm for Classic McEliece is based on higher-order vanishing. It computes a basis of $\ker(\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)})$, where $A=H'''$ is the shortened parity-check matrix used in the attack. For Classic McEliece parameters, this kernel computation is the dominant cost of the attack. We show that the sums defining $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ can be evaluated, column by column, as weighted upper zeta transforms on the Boolean lattice. Since only selected levels of these transforms are required by $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$, restricting their evaluation to the band between level $p$ and the lowest required level yields exact evaluations of both $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ and its transpose. Using the resulting truncated zeta-transform evaluation in the Wiedemann-based kernel computation reduces the cost of the repeated matrix--vector products without changing the overall key-recovery algorithm. The exact cost depends on the weight distribution of the non-pivot columns of $H'''$. We therefore consider two models: an all-one model, in which every relevant binary coordinate is active, and a Bernoulli$(1/2)$ model, in which the coordinates are independently active with probability $1/2$. For the five Classic McEliece parameter sets, our method reduces the estimated key-recovery cost by $14.09$--$41.19$ bits in the all-one model and by $7.25$--$22.48$ bits in the Bernoulli$(1/2)$ model.

</details>


### [569] [The Uncontrolled Variable: Vision-Language Model Refusal Responds to Image Presence in Ways Risk Cannot Explain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26174)
*Haoyu Zhang,Yi Feng,Shibo Zheng,Zhuoxi Wang,Xiao Luo,Haowen Xu,Xiangchen Guan,Mohammad Zandsalimy,Shanu Sushmita*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的安全对齐不仅取决于请求内容，还取决于请求形式——是否附带图像。附加一张与请求无关的空白画布可使拒绝率变动数十个百分点，且该效应集中于敏感邻近的良性流量，属于特定对齐检查点继承的、未被定价的失控变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM安全通常被假定为仅取决于请求的语义内容（"问什么"）。作者要检验：在保持请求内容不变的前提下，请求的"形式"（是否附带图像）是否也系统性地影响安全对齐模型的拒绝行为。若成立，则说明图像存在性是一个部署者未选择、未定价的失控变量。

Method: 控制变量实验：在请求内容完全固定的条件下，对比附带与不附带图像时的拒绝率。使用不可读、与请求无关、跨提示完全相同的空白画布作为干预，并变换图像属性（黑vs白、像素数量）、加入显式说明（告知图像为可忽略的占位符）、以及"声称有附件但实际无附件"的条件，以分离"附件本身"与"图像属性"的贡献。同时在多个开放权重检查点与不同服务栈上重复验证。

Result: 附加空白画布使拒绝率变动数十个百分点，且循环中无任何防御机制。效应并非全面谨慎：中性指令几乎不受影响，而边界良性的提示（隐私、自伤、暴力相关）大幅移动，成本落在敏感邻近流量上。附件本身已足够触发该效应，图像属性则决定代价大小——同尺寸黑色画布比白色画布代价显著更高，在某个开放检查点上承载该效应的轴是像素数量。该偏移不受指令控制：告知模型图像是可忽略的占位符仅消除一小部分；在某个模型上，仅声称存在附件（实际无附件）即可显著移动拒绝率。该效应并非服务栈所致（相同权重经两种途径到达表现一致），也非VLM的普遍属性（若干开放权重检查点无此现象），而属于特定对齐检查点（其中一个为开放权重）。它与收益解耦：画布确实能阻止匹配有害集上的一部分攻击成功，但远小于其代价，且符号不固定——在某个开放模型上，相同的画布反而使模型显著更易被攻击。

Conclusion: 图像存在性不是部署者主动选择或定价的默认值，而是随权重一并继承的失控变量。安全行为同时以请求内容与请求形式为键，而后者与风险并不一致：附件在部署中可能与风险相关，但模型对它的处理并不追踪风险。这揭示了VLM安全对齐中一个被忽视的形式依赖性漏洞。

Abstract: Vision-Language Model (VLM) safety is expected to depend on what a request asks for. We show that safety-aligned VLMs also key refusal on a property of a request's form: whether an image is attached, holding everything the request asks fixed. Attaching a blank canvas - unreadable, unrelated to the request, identical across prompts - shifts refusal by tens of percentage points, with no defense in the loop.
  The shift is not blanket caution. Neutral instructions are almost unaffected while borderline-benign prompts move sharply, so the cost falls on sensitivity-adjacent traffic: benign questions about privacy, self-harm and violence. Attachment alone is sufficient, while the image's properties set the price: a black canvas costs substantially more than a white one of identical size, and on an open checkpoint the carrying axis is pixel count. Nor is the shift under instructional control - telling the model the image is a placeholder to be disregarded removes only a fraction of it, and on one model asserting that an attachment exists moves refusal substantially with nothing attached.
  Attachment may correlate with risk in deployment; what these models do with it does not track risk. It is not the serving stack, since the same weights reached two ways behave alike, nor a property of VLMs as such, since several open-weight checkpoints show nothing. It belongs to particular aligned checkpoints, one of them open. It is also decoupled from what it buys: the canvas does prevent some attack success on a matched harmful set, but far less than it costs, and its sign is not fixed - on one open model the identical canvas makes the model markedly easier to attack. Image presence is not a default a deployer chose or priced; it is an uncontrolled variable inherited with the weights.

</details>


### [570] [Refusal without Discrimination: What Encoded Prompts Do to Safety-Trained Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26176)
*Haoyu Zhang,Haowen Xu,Xiao Luo,Mohammad Zandsalimy,Shanu Sushmita*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文指出，现有编码提示（encoded-prompt）攻击评测只关注"有害臂"（有害请求的被拒率），该指标几乎不携带关于被测模型的信息；编码破坏的是模型的"有害/良性判别能力"而非拒答能力，且后训练（SFT→DPO→RLVR）无法修复这一损失，评测必须引入对照条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码提示攻击的评测几乎全部只统计有害请求的被拒率（compliance/refusal），并据此衡量模型安全性。作者认为这种单臂指标可能存在严重的信息缺失与方法学缺陷，需要验证该指标究竟能反映模型的什么能力，以及后训练是否能修复相关问题。

Method: 在四个独立后训练的 7-8B 模型上，分别用同形字（homoglyph）编码与明文呈现同一批请求，比较有害与良性请求的拒答率；检验有害臂指标的噪声上限（n=100 时采样噪声天花板约 0.10）；并采用公开配方在相同基座权重上执行完整 SFT → DPO → RLVR 后训练流水线，跨多种编码方式追踪指标变化；同时设置对照条件以识别评测工具缺陷。

Result: 四模型在编码有害提示上的拒答率跨度仅 0.08，处于 n=100 的 0.10 噪声天花板内，而同一批请求在明文下跨度达 0.57；某模型的有害-良性拒答率差从明文的 +0.82 降至编码下的 0.00（良性、有害拒答率同为 0.99）。仅看有害臂的基准将该模型与仍保留 +0.61 差距的模型评为相同。后训练中，明文有害判别力从 +0.55 提升至 +0.80，但编码导致的判别损失始终未变（0.34–0.50），且在所有测试编码上，标准有害臂指标的变化方向与判别力变化方向相反。

Conclusion: 编码提示攻击的通用评测指标（有害臂拒答率）具有误导性，无法反映模型的真实安全判别能力，且后训练无法修复编码引起的判别损失。作者报告了八项评测工具缺陷，每项均配有可捕获它的对照条件，且这些缺陷在行为轴上一致地夸大了表面安全性。缺少常规对照的评测结论不可靠。

Abstract: Encoded-prompt attacks are evaluated almost entirely on their harmful arm: a benchmark sends obfuscated harmful requests and reports how often the model complied. We show that this arm carries almost no information about the model under test. Across four independently post-trained 7-8B models, refusal of harmful homoglyph-encoded prompts spans 0.08 -- inside the 0.10 ceiling that sampling noise alone produces at n=100 -- while the same four models span 0.57 on the identical requests in plaintext. What the encoding destroys is not refusal but discrimination: on one model the gap between harmful and benign refusal falls from +0.82 in plaintext to exactly 0.00 under the encoding, benign and harmful requests being refused at an identical 0.99. A benchmark reading only the harmful arm scores that model and one retaining a +0.61 gap identically. We then ask whether post-training repairs this, using a published recipe on identical base weights. It does not: across a full SFT -> DPO -> RLVR pipeline, plaintext harm discrimination improves from +0.55 to +0.80 while the encoding-induced loss is unchanged at 0.34-0.50, and on every encoding tested the standard harmful-arm metric moves in the opposite direction to discrimination. None of this is visible without controls the field does not routinely run. We report eight instrument defects, each with the control that caught it; they share a direction, in that every defect on the behaviour axis inflated apparent safety.

</details>


### [571] [Unread or Unenforced? Separating Representation from Enforcement Failure in Content Guards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26178)
*Haoyu Zhang,Yi Feng,Mohammad Zandsalimy,Shanu Sushmita*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出用"探针+判定logits"的单次前向方法区分内容守卫在编码攻击下失败的两种机制（表征缺失 vs 决策失误），并通过排列检验、长度匹配零假设和不可解码控制底噪来校准测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端攻击成功率把"守卫从未表征有害内容"与"已表征却未拦截"混为一谈，但两者对应的补救方向相反：前者是更多安全训练也无法触及的表征限制，后者是可被决策规则修正的失败。因此需要可区分二者的诊断测量，且必须排除不可解码编码造成的伪信号。

Method: 在守卫自身残差流上拟合明文内容探针，不重新拟合直接迁移到编码条件，并与判定logits联合读取，仅需一次前向、无需judge模型；引入排列检验、长度匹配零假设、以及在基座模型可证明无法解码的条件上校准的控制底噪来筛除伪结果，并用无共享输入的两个筛选器做交叉验证。

Result: 排列检验最初许可19个条件中17个（守卫A）与12个（守卫B）的解码测量；加入长度匹配零假设与控制底噪后均降至4个。最大效应（AUROC 0.72但拦截率为零）在基座解码率为零的编码上被判定为伪影。稳健结果是真实但更窄的策略失败：在守卫强力拦截的条件下每100条提示有7–23条被表征却未拦截，某守卫对某条件仅少量拦截时为56/100；"拦截但未解码"在全流程接近零，真密码条件下两守卫基本不拦截，这些单元格记为未测量。

Conclusion: 区分表征限制与决策失误必须经过严格统计校准，否则会把不可解码编码的伪信号误读为守卫生效失败；经校准后，剩余问题主要是真实但范围有限的政策/决策失败，而非普遍的解码失败，且两守卫都不基于"编码外观"而反应。

Abstract: When an encoded attack passes a content guard, the guard either never represented the payload's harmful content or represented it and failed to act. End-to-end attack success rate reports one number for both, yet the remedies are opposite: one is a representational limit that more safety training cannot reach, the other a decision rule that it can. We separate them by reading a guard's own residual stream -- a content probe fitted on plaintext and transferred, without refitting, to the encoded condition -- alongside its verdict logits, at the cost of one forward pass and no judge model.
  Doing this honestly is most of the problem, and it is our main contribution. A permutation test licenses the decode measurement on 17 of 19 conditions for one open guard and 12 of 19 for another; a length-matched null and a control floor calibrated on conditions the guard's base model provably cannot decode reduce both to 4. The discarded cells are not marginal ones: the largest result in our first analysis -- a guard representing a cipher at AUROC 0.72 while blocking none of it -- is an artefact on an encoding its base model decodes at rate zero. On one guard, two screens sharing no input agree exactly on which conditions to reject.
  What survives is a policy failure that is real but narrower than the uncontrolled analysis claimed: 7 to 23 per 100 prompts represented and not blocked on conditions the guards block heavily, and 56 per 100 on one condition a guard barely blocks. Blocked without decoding is near zero throughout, so neither guard reacts to the appearance of encoding rather than to content. On genuine ciphers both guards block essentially nothing, and we report those cells as unmeasured rather than as evidence of failure to decode.

</details>


### [572] [Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization for Defending Against Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26185)
*Doniyorkhon Obidov,Honggang Yu,Xiaolong Guo,Kaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出动态深度提示优化（DDPO），首个基于深度提示优化的越狱防御方法，通过轻量MLP从目标LLM中间层特征动态生成防御性嵌入并注入后续层，在多种模型与攻击上显著优于静态提示优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽能力强大但仍易受越狱攻击，可诱导有害或非预期内容。模型微调虽可进行安全对齐，但成本高且易灾难性遗忘；现有提示优化防御多依赖静态修改（固定前缀或后缀），无法适应多样且不断演化的攻击。

Method: DDPO以目标LLM自身的中间层作为特征提取器，通过轻量级多层感知机（MLP）动态生成防御性嵌入，并将这些定制嵌入注入到后续的中间层，实现输入依赖的防御，同时不修改LLM的权重，兼具高适应性与低计算开销。

Result: 在多种模型和攻击上的实验表明，DDPO显著优于静态提示优化方法，尤其在弱对齐模型上，以及处理语义模糊的良性提示、将其与真正有害请求区分开时表现突出。

Conclusion: DDPO将深度提示优化引入越狱防御，验证了输入依赖的动态防御嵌入在无需修改权重的情况下可有效提升安全对齐的适应性与效率，为提示层面的防御提供新方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities across many applications but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which elicit harmful or unintended content. While model fine-tuning is an option for safety alignment, it is costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting. Prompt optimization has emerged as a promising alternative, yet existing prompt-based defenses typically rely on static modifications (e.g., fixed prefixes or suffixes) that cannot adapt to diverse and evolving attacks.
  We propose Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization (DDPO), the first jailbreak defense based on deep prompt optimization. DDPO uses the target LLM's own intermediate layers as feature extractors to dynamically generate defensive embeddings via a lightweight multilayer perceptron. These tailored embeddings are then injected into a subsequent intermediate layer, enabling an input-dependent defense without modifying the LLM's weights. This design ensures high adaptability with minimal computational overhead.
  Experiments on a diverse set of models and attacks demonstrate that DDPO significantly outperforms static prompt optimization methods, particularly on weakly aligned models and when handling semantically ambiguous benign prompts, successfully distinguishing them from genuinely harmful requests.

</details>


### [573] [Who Assures the Verifier? An Executable Assurance-Locus Audit of the European Digital Identity Wallet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26220)
*Anton Sokolov*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对EUDI钱包依赖方(RP)验证环节进行"保证位点"审计，提出以RP为被测系统的可独立复跑证据单元，并设计17条规则、机器可读证据回执与36个冻结合成交易，经三种异构实现验证其确定性与可实现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EUDI钱包架构将大量实质义务加于依赖方（服务注册、身份认证、凭证验证、信任锚校验与基于风险的决策），而钱包认证与FCAF框架主要提供钱包侧证据。缺失的是：能够独立复跑的证据，用以证明某笔交易中所使用的具体RP验证器版本确实执行了适用的请求、呈现与依赖决策控制。现有公开代码库虽有协议验证机制，但缺乏将RP注册与用途、验证器/策略确切版本、交易裁决与下游属性使用联结为单一受审证据对象。

Method: 对现行法律、ARF 3.0.0、ETSI元数据、FCAF范围及三个固定版本开源验证器代码库进行保证位点审计；设计17条规则的研究性profile、机器可读证据回执及36个冻结合成交易；用Python、JavaScript、jq三种异构实现执行108个用例；并预备26位受任专家的预注册普查以检验内容效度与治理可行性。

Result: 三种异构实现在108个用例中实现零oracle不匹配、零跨路径分歧，确立了所提决策模型的确定性与可实现性；源码审查显示三个公开代码库均具备充分的协议验证机制，但均无单一受审证据对象将RP注册与用途、验证器/策略确切版本、交易裁决与下游属性使用相联结。

Conclusion: 实验仅证明决策模型的确定性与可实现性，不代表产品合规或认证。作者提出"RP作为被测系统"的证据单元，作为对钱包认证、注册与监管的补充而非替代。专家普查的招募有待伦理/数据保护裁定。

Abstract: The European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI Wallet) architecture places material duties on relying parties: they register services and intended uses, authenticate to Wallet Units, validate presentations and trust anchors, and make risk-based status decisions. Wallet certification and the emerging Functional Conformance Assessment Framework provide increasingly structured wallet-side evidence. A different question remains: what independently rerunnable evidence shows that the concrete relying-party verifier version used in a transaction enforced the applicable request, presentation and reliance-decision controls? We conduct an assurance-locus audit of current law, Architecture and Reference Framework (ARF) 3.0.0, ETSI metadata, FCAF scope and three pinned open-source verifier codebases. We then design a 17-rule research profile, a machine-readable evidence receipt and 36 frozen synthetic transactions. Three heterogeneous study-authored implementations (Python, JavaScript and jq) execute 108 cases with zero oracle mismatches and zero cross-path disagreements. The experiment establishes determinism and implementability of the proposed decision model, not product conformance or certification. Source inspection finds substantial protocol-verification mechanisms in all three public codebases but no single audited evidence object joining RP registration and purpose, exact verifier/policy version, transaction verdict and downstream attribute use. We therefore propose an RP-as-system-under-test evidence unit that complements, rather than displaces, wallet certification, registration and supervision. A preregistered census of 26 appointed experts is prepared to test content validity and governance feasibility; recruitment awaits the applicable ethics/data-protection determination.

</details>


### [574] [Quantum-Ready Secure WAN: A Risk Assessment and Migration Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26225)
*Saeed Alam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个供应商中立的框架，用于企业广域网（WAN）后量子密码迁移的优先级排序与部署决策，并给出TLS 1.3与IKEv2/IPsec中经典与ML-KEM混合密钥建立的评估设计；保留的工件仅含作者报告的TLS聚合延迟数据与算术校验工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业WAN使用量子易受攻击的公钥密码来认证对等方并为IPsec、TLS及SD-WAN服务建立密钥。先存后解（harvest-now, decrypt-later）攻击已对保护寿命可能超过迁移时间的数构成威胁，未来密码学相关量子计算机还会危及证书等认证依赖。现有后量子标准与政府指令虽定义了算法和过渡节点，但未告知企业应先迁移哪些WAN服务、以及何种证据足以支撑部署。

Method: 提出一个供应商中立框架，将暴露优先级、迁移就绪度与证据置信度三者分离，并将这些输出映射到分阶段的安全、运营与治理关卡。同时，为TLS 1.3与IKEv2/IPsec中的经典及ML-KEM混合密钥建立定义了完整评估设计。保留的工件范围更窄：包含作者报告的聚合TLS p50、p95、p99延迟（在0%、1%、3%、5%的配置丢包率下）、一个算术校验器，以及有限的环境与MTU/MSS说明。

Result: 在上述丢包率设置下，TLS-H与TLS-C的p95差值为0.00、0.16、0.38、0.63 ms，相对于TLS-C分别为0.00%、1.32%、3.07%、5.00%。

Conclusion: 这些数值是描述性的聚合观测结果，而非推断性结论，因为未保留每次试验数据、样本量、原始抓包和时间戳日志。协议大小与MTU/MSS的计算与实测行为分开报告；不支持的IKE、资源、吞吐量、重传与降级结果均被排除。

Abstract: Enterprise wide-area networks (WANs) use quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography to authenticate peers and establish keys for Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), Transport Layer Security (TLS), and software-defined WAN services. Harvest-now, decrypt-later collection already threatens data whose protection lifetime may exceed the time needed to migrate, while a future cryptographically relevant quantum computer would also endanger certificates and other authentication dependencies. Post-quantum standards and government directives now define algorithms and transition milestones, but they do not tell an enterprise which WAN services to migrate first or what evidence is sufficient for deployment. This paper proposes a vendor-neutral framework that separates exposure priority, migration readiness, and evidence confidence, and maps those outputs to staged security, operational, and governance gates. It also defines a complete evaluation design for classical and ML-KEM hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2/IPsec. The retained artifact is narrower: it contains author-reported aggregate TLS p50, p95, and p99 latencies at configured loss settings of 0%, 1%, 3%, and 5%, an arithmetic checker, and limited environment and MTU/MSS notes. At those settings, the TLS-H minus TLS-C p95 differences are 0.00, 0.16, 0.38, and 0.63 ms, corresponding to 0.00%, 1.32%, 3.07%, and 5.00% relative to TLS-C. These values are descriptive aggregate observations, not inferential results, because per-trial data, sample counts, original captures, and timestamped logs were not retained. Protocol-size and MTU/MSS calculations are reported separately from measured behavior, and unsupported IKE, resource, throughput, retransmission, and downgrade outcomes are excluded.

</details>


### [575] [Towards Effective Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Deep Code Models via Structural and Identifier Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26234)
*Bin Duan,Jintao Lin,Dan Dongseong Kim,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 Strike：一种输入条件化的黑盒对抗鲁棒性测试框架，为每个输入构建并搜索分层扰动空间，在克隆检测、漏洞检测与代码摘要任务上以具竞争力的查询开销取得更高攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度代码模型（DCMs）在代码智能任务中应用日益广泛，但其对抗鲁棒性研究不足。既有黑盒攻击主要依赖仅标识符替换或从参考样本迁移的结构编辑，其扰动空间在很大程度上独立于被攻击输入定义，限制了攻击效果与针对性。

Method: Strike 为每个输入构建并搜索分层扰动空间：首先将代码划分为块，利用 LLM 生成上下文相关的结构候选，经过语法有效性过滤、相似度排序并自适应组合；随后通过相似度引导的标识符替换对最佳结构变体进行精修，替换候选来自动态构建的候选池。

Result: 在克隆检测、漏洞检测与代码摘要等代表性任务上，Strike 在目标模型查询开销具竞争力的情况下取得更高攻击成功率。三个任务的策略专属静态检查，以及可执行的 Juliet 漏洞检测子集上的执行验证，提供了任务有界的互补有效性证据。表示相似度与人工评估表明变体与原代码高度相似且上下文自然。使用 Strike 生成样本进行微调，可在保持干净性能的同时提升固定扰动评估集上的跨攻击表现。

Conclusion: Strike 通过输入条件化的分层扰动空间构建与搜索，提升了黑盒对抗攻击的有效性，同时保持变体的语义相似性与自然性；其生成样本亦可用于微调以增强模型的跨攻击鲁棒性。

Abstract: Deep code models (DCMs) are increasingly embedded in code intelligence tasks. However, their robustness under adversarial attacks remains insufficiently understood. Prior black-box attacks mainly rely on identifier- only substitutions or structural edits transferred from reference samples, yielding perturbation spaces defined largely independently of the attacked input. We introduce Strike, an input-conditioned black-box adversarial robustness-testing framework that constructs and searches a hierarchical perturbation space for each input. Strike first partitions code into blocks and uses an LLM to generate context-specific structural candidates, filtered for syntactic validity, ranked by similarity, and adaptively combined. It then refines the best structural variant through similarity-guided identifier substitutions drawn from dynamically constructed candidate pools. Evaluations across representative code intelligence tasks, including clone detection, vulnerability detection, and code summarization, demonstrate that Strike achieves higher attack success rates with competitive target- model query overhead. Strategy-specific static checks across all three tasks and execution-based validation on the executable Juliet vulnerability-detection subset provide complementary, task-bounded evidence regarding the validity of the generated variants. Representation similarity and human evaluation further indicate that the variants remain highly similar to the original code and contextually natural. Fine-tuning with Strike- generated samples improves cross-attack performance on fixed perturbed evaluation sets while preserving clean performance.

</details>


### [576] [eBPF Security in the Wild: Structural Concentration, Failure Mechanisms, and Discovery Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26254)
*Baihong Chen,Hua Ming,Weifeng Pan,Tian Xie,Xiaojun Qi,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对eBPF漏洞进行实证研究：基于Linux修复提交、syzbot报告及CVE/NVD记录构建多源数据集，统一分析结构集中性、机制级失效模式、架构分布与测试技术发现盲区，发现eBPF漏洞高度集中于运行时、并发、对象生命周期与跨阶段语义不一致等少数系统级失效，且现有技术探索语义狭窄。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: eBPF是安全关键的内核执行框架，但其漏洞态势分散于不同组件、语义缺口与测试技术中，缺乏统一、系统的实证刻画，难以判断漏洞的真实分布与现有发现手段的有效性。

Method: 构建来自Linux内核修复提交、syzbot报告与公开CVE/NVD记录的多源数据集，通过统一框架从结构集中性、机制级失效模式、架构分布及代表性技术的发现盲区四个维度分析；并采用基于评分量表的代表技术对比，以及在Linux v5.10上进行版本对齐的Syzkaller案例研究。

Result: 观察到的eBPF漏洞在结构上高度集中而非广泛分散于无关弱点类型；主要由少数反复出现的系统级失效主导，尤其是运行时执行、并发、对象生命周期管理及可信阶段间语义不一致；失效在流水线中分布不均，Runtime为最大暴露面，Verifier与JIT频率较低但属于结构上独特的安全边界；技术对比与案例研究表明，尽管对Runtime/Verifier/JIT有可见的原始覆盖率，实际探索语义狭窄，发现集中于少量Runtime失效。

Conclusion: 原始覆盖率不足以反映发现有效性；eBPF漏洞治理应聚焦于主导性系统级失效模式与语义层面探索能力，而非仅追求表面覆盖广度。

Abstract: Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) is a security-critical in-kernel execution framework, yet its vulnerability landscape remains fragmented across components, semantic gaps, and testing techniques. We present an empirical study of observed eBPF vulnerabilities. We construct a multi-source dataset from Linux kernel fixing commits, syzbot reports, and public CVE/NVD records, and analyze it through a unified framework covering structural concentration, mechanism-level failure modes, architectural distribution, and discovery gaps in representative techniques. Our results show that the observed eBPF vulnerability landscape is structurally concentrated rather than broadly dispersed across many unrelated weakness types. The dominant portion is associated with a limited set of recurring system-level failures, especially in runtime execution, concurrency, object lifecycle management, and semantic inconsistencies across trusted stages. These failures are unevenly distributed across the eBPF pipeline: Runtime is the dominant exposure surface, whereas the Verifier and JIT are lowerfrequency but structurally distinct security boundaries. A rubric-based comparison of representative techniques and a version-aligned Syzkaller case study on Linux v5.10 show that, despite visible raw coverage of Runtime, Verifier, and JIT, effective exploration is semantically narrow, and observed discoveries concentrate in a small subset of Runtime failures. Overall, raw coverage alone provides an incomplete view of discovery effectiveness.

</details>


### [577] [CRT-Decomposed $Σ$-Protocols for CSIDH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26258)
*I. Dey,I. Cherkaoui*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文构造了基于CRT结构的CSIDH群作用零知识知识证明，在已知群结构（如CSIDH-512）时实现完美完备性、完美特殊诚实验证者零知识性与2-特殊可靠性，其提取器无需回退、格约化或启发式采样。借助Unruh变换得到QROM中直线提取的非交互证明。在CSIDH-512上完成机器验证与协议级模拟，并证明CRT分解无法扩大每轮挑战空间、公开CRT跳跃曲线会使经典密钥恢复成本从约2^128.6降至约2^67.3次群作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CSIDH群作用的零知识证明在构造签名、盲签名等密码协议中具有重要价值，但现有方案（如CSI-FiSh、CSI-Otter、Tanuki）在可靠性与提取效率上依赖回退循环、格约化或启发式采样，且Unruh变换会带来分叉引理的乘法损失。作者希望利用理想类群的CRT结构，在群结构已知时构造提取更简洁、结构更完整的证明系统，并厘清CRT结构对挑战空间与安全性的边界。

Method: 利用理想类群的CRT结构构造CSIDH群作用的零知识知识证明；证明完美完备性、完美特殊诚实验证者零知识性与2-特殊可靠性，提取器仅需每个CRT分量一次减法与一次模逆；因每轮恰有两个响应，应用Unruh变换在QROM中获得直线提取的非交互证明；在CSIDH-512类群上实例化并对258比特模数进行机器代数层验证，同时开展指数模型下的协议级模拟。

Result: 机器验证在精确258比特模数上通过10^4个随机实例；蒙特卡洛可靠性率在各测试t下以95%置信度符合证明的2^{-t}界；序列化签名尺寸与公式偏差在1.6%以内；给出仪器化群作用次数与按√q规律缩放的中间相遇攻击成本。还证明两个界限性结果：CRT分解无法扩大每轮挑战空间；公开CRT跳跃曲线将经典密钥恢复成本从约2^128.6降至约2^67.3次群作用评估。

Conclusion: 该构造当前是正确的且结构完整，但仅在类数含大素因子的未来参数上才具备定量安全性。作者与CSI-FiSh、CSI-Otter、Tanuki进行了对比，并将基于该知识证明的紧安全盲签名留作未来工作。

Abstract: We construct a zero-knowledge proof of knowledge for the CSIDH group action that exploits the Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT) structure of the ideal class group, available whenever the group structure is known exactly, as for CSIDH-512. We prove perfect completeness, perfect special honest-verifier zero-knowledge, and 2-special soundness, in which the secret is recovered from two accepting transcripts by one subtraction and one modular inversion per CRT component; no rewinding loop, lattice reduction, or heuristic sampling appears in the extractor. Because each round admits exactly two responses, Unruh's transform yields a non-interactive proof with straight-line extraction in the quantum random oracle model (QROM), removing the multiplicative forking-lemma loss. We instantiate the scheme on the CSIDH-512 class group, verify the algebraic layer by machine over the exact 258-bit modulus ($10^4$ random instances, all passing), and report protocol-level simulations in the exponent model: Monte Carlo soundness rates matching the proven $2^{-t}$ bound within 95\% confidence at every tested $t$, serialized signature sizes within 1.6\% of the formulas, instrumented action counts, and a scaled meet-in-the-middle attack whose measured cost follows the predicted $\sqrt{q}$ law. We further prove two delimiting results: CRT decomposition cannot enlarge the per-round challenge space, and publishing the CRT hop curves lowers classical key-recovery cost from about $2^{128.6}$ to about $2^{67.3}$ group action evaluations. The construction is therefore correct and structurally complete today, but quantitatively secure only on future parameters whose class number has large prime factors. We compare against CSI-FiSh, CSI-Otter, and Tanuki; a tightly secure blind signature from this proof of knowledge is left to future work.

</details>


### [578] [Image-Based Techniques and Ensemble Soft Voting for Malware Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26281)
*Sushant Rakesh Lokhande,Fabio Di Troia,Martin Jurecek,Mark Stamp*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个基于软投票集成学习的图像化恶意软件家族分类框架，融合手工特征、预训练网络嵌入与自定义CNN嵌入三类互补特征，在17个恶意软件家族上达到80.2%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶意软件家族分类对威胁归因与防御至关重要，而将二进制转为图像后，单一特征表示或单一模型难以充分刻画其判别信息；作者希望验证不同特征提取方式之间是否存在互补性，并通过集成学习进一步提升分类性能。

Method: 采用八种二进制到图像的转换策略生成恶意软件图像。提取三类特征：（1）手工描述符，融合HOG与Haralick纹理特征及38个统计特征；（2）稠密嵌入，来自VGG16、ResNet50、ViT-B/16三个冻结的预训练网络（去掉分类头）；（3）512维嵌入，来自直接在恶意软件图像上训练的自定义CNN。每条特征轨道均在全部八种图像转换类型上用机器学习分类器评估，随后构建多种软投票集成策略，并在专门的验证集上筛选出由15个投票器组成的最佳投票池。

Result: 最佳单模型准确率分别为：手工特征77.8%、预训练网络轨道73.8%、自定义CNN轨道74.8%。最佳软投票集成池（15个投票器，基于专用验证集选择）在17个恶意软件家族上取得80.2%准确率，较最佳单模型提升2.4个百分点，且具有统计显著性。定量多样性分析证实各特征表示具有互补性，其中手工描述符贡献最大。

Conclusion: 多视角特征表示之间存在实质互补性，软投票集成能够有效整合异构特征并显著优于任何单一模型；手工描述符是该任务中最强的个体贡献者，说明传统纹理与梯度特征在图像化恶意软件家族分类中仍具重要价值。

Abstract: In this chapter, we investigate image-based malware family classification using an ensemble learning framework and a soft voting strategy. We consider malware binaries that have been converted into images using eight distinct conversion strategies. Three complementary feature extraction tracks are applied to these images: handcrafted descriptors combining Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Haralick texture features along with 38 statistical features; dense embeddings obtained from three pretrained neural networks (VGG16, ResNet50, and ViT-B/16), where each pretrained model is used as a frozen feature extractor with its classification head removed; and 512-dimensional embeddings derived from a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained directly on the malware images. Each of the three feature extraction techniques is evaluated with machine learning classifiers across all eight image conversion types. The best individual results are 77.8% accuracy for the handcrafted features, 73.8% for the pretrained neural network track, and 74.8% for the custom CNN track. Then we consider various soft voting ensemble strategies, and we find that the best-performing soft voting pool--consisting of fifteen voters selected on a dedicated validation split--achieves 80.2% accuracy across the 17 malware families under consideration, a statistically significant improvement of 2.4 percentage points over the best individual model. A quantitative diversity analysis confirms that the different feature representations are complementary, with the handcrafted descriptors being the strongest contributors.

</details>


### [579] [Neural Fingerprints for Malware Analysis: An Image-Based Metric Learning Approach with Application to Cross-Domain Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26282)
*Manasa Deshagouni,Sayma Akther,Martin Jurecek,Mark Stamp*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于图像的度量学习方法，从恶意软件图像中学习定长判别性嵌入（神经指纹），通过最近邻检索判定家族归属，实现无需重训练的零样本家族识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统恶意软件家族分类器在新家族出现时必须重新训练，缺乏对未知家族的适应能力，因此需要一种能泛化到未见家族的识别范式。

Method: 学习恶意软件图像的定长嵌入，构建相似度度量而非固定类别边界；使用轻量级CNN与multi-proxy anchor loss训练编码器，训练集为MalNet-Images-Tiny与MalImg合并（453家族、96,769图像），并借助FAISS实现大规模图库检索。

Result: 在无家族重叠的17家族灰度留出集上零样本评估，取得73.1% retrieval@1与90.5% open-set AUROC；在同域设定下与两种传统范式相比三者分类性能相当；嵌入可跨数据集迁移，并提供可解释相似度分数。同时用retrieval@k、聚类纯度、轮廓系数、分离比、少样本准确率与开集检测等指标全面评估嵌入空间，并分析图像扰动下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 基于度量学习的嵌入方法具备零样本识别未知家族、跨数据集迁移、可扩展检索和可解释性等优势，是传统分类器范式的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Identifying the family of a newly observed malware sample is a core task in threat intelligence, yet conventional classifiers must be retrained whenever a new family appears. This chapter develops an image-based metric learning approach that instead learns to extract discriminative neural fingerprints--fixed-length embeddings--from malware-as-image representations, so that family membership can be determined by nearest-neighbor search in the embedding space. The central advantage of this formulation is zero-shot capability: because the learned embedding induces a similarity metric rather than a fixed set of class boundaries, families that were never seen during training can be recognized by comparison against a gallery, with no retraining. We demonstrate this directly by training an encoder on MalNet-Images-Tiny and MalImg combined (453 families, 96,769 images) and evaluate it zero-shot on a held-out 17-family grayscale dataset with no family overlap. Using a lightweight CNN with multi-proxy anchor loss, this model attains 73.1% retrieval@1 and 90.5% open-set AUROC on families the encoder has never seen. We benchmark our embedding approach against two conventional paradigms in a same-domain setting, where all three are competitive at classifying malware into families. We further show that the learned embeddings transfer across datasets. Unlike classifiers, our embedding approach also yields interpretable similarity scores and scales to large galleries via Facebook AI Similarity Search (FAISS). Finally, we provide a comprehensive evaluation of the learned embedding space using retrieval@k, cluster purity, silhouette score, separation ratio, few-shot accuracy, and open-set detection metrics, along with robustness analysis under image perturbations.

</details>


### [580] [A Throughput-Oriented Analytical Model for Post-Quantum Security Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26284)
*Ignazio Pedone,Stefano Pirandola*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向吞吐量的分析模型，可给出TLS/SSH后量子安全连接建立最大可持续速率的紧致上界，并经实验验证其准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子威胁对经典密码学的影响日益受到关注，催生了对准确网络仿真工具的需求，用以评估在当前系统中集成量子安全密码学的效果。特别是后量子密码学（PQC）的采用会直接影响网络端点性能与传输开销，并进而影响TLS、SSH等广泛使用的安全协议的扩展性。

Method: 提出一个面向吞吐量的分析模型，将握手过程分解为主导性密码学操作时间与网络传输时间，同时考虑端点与网络容量两类约束；通过识别瓶颈，以每秒握手次数推导可达吞吐量。

Result: 实验结果表明该模型与测试床数据吻合，测试床使用了FIPS 203、204、205中的NIST标准原语，包括ML-KEM与ML-DSA。

Conclusion: 该模型可集成到网络环境中，用于在多端点多单播场景下实现高效资源分配，优化PQC流量。

Abstract: Growing awareness of the impact of quantum threat on classical cryptography directly translates into a growing demand for accurate network simulation tools capable of estimating the integration effects of quantum-safe cryptography in current systems. In particular, the adoption of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) has a direct impact on the performance of network endpoints and transmission overhead. This also affects the scalability of widely adopted security protocols such as TLS and SSH. In this paper, we present a throughput-oriented analytical model that provides a tight upper bound on the maximum sustainable rate of post-quantum secure connection establishment in TLS and SSH. This model takes into account both endpoint and network capacity constraints, decomposing the handshake process into dominant cryptographic operation time and network transmission time. Identifying the bottleneck allows us to derive the achievable throughput in terms of handshakes per second. The experimental results provided show the accuracy of the model against the data obtained from an experimental testbed using, among others, NIST standard primitives from FIPS 203, 204, and 205, including ML-KEM and ML-DSA. Finally, we integrate our model into a network environment and demonstrate how it can be leveraged to enable efficient resource allocation among multiple endpoints, optimizing PQC traffic in multiple-unicast scenarios.

</details>


### [581] [On the security and privacy of LLMs in Mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26295)
*Mauro Conti,Lorenzo Perinello,Umberto Salviati*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该综述论文考察生成式AI（尤其是LLM）在出行领域的应用现状与挑战。基于欧盟AI法案对交通AI的高风险分级，作者提炼出9个技术类别来评估现有研究与未来部署。结果显示，研究高度集中于GPT与Llama模型（占50%以上）及交通应用，却严重忽视安全性、隐私与可靠性；35篇综述文献中仅1篇含部分漏洞评估、1篇含部分风险管理系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 出行行业正因生成式AI进步而发生范式转变：仅汽车市场年规模约2.9万亿美元，涉及逾15亿辆车辆。随着LLM在出行领域日益普及，网络安全、隐私与可靠性问题凸显。同时欧盟AI法案将交通AI列为高风险，因此有必要系统评估现有研究是否满足监管要求，识别技术性能与合规性之间的差距。

Method: 这是一篇综述研究。作者依据欧盟AI法案对高风险AI的要求，推导出9个技术类别作为评估框架，对当前文献的应用方向与挑战进行系统归类与评估，并统计所综述工作中所用模型、应用场景与合规相关内容的覆盖情况。

Result: 综述发现：研究与部署主要采用GPT和Llama模型（超过半数被综述工作涉及）且聚焦交通应用，而安全、隐私与可靠性被大幅忽视。在35篇被综述文献中，仅1篇包含部分漏洞评估，仅1篇包含部分风险管理系统，显示出优化性能强劲但监管合规薄弱的明显落差。

Conclusion: 研究揭示出强优化性能与监管合规之间的显著鸿沟，说明合规受限更多并非源于技术本身，而是研究重心偏向静态性能而忽视全生命周期安全；因此，安全关键型智能交通系统亟需在设计中前置安全（security-by-design）。

Abstract: The mobility sector is undergoing a paradigm shift driven by advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence. With a global market valued at approximately 2.9 trillion dollars annually, considering only cars, the integration of these technologies has the potential to impact more than 1.5 billion vehicles worldwide. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in mobility, concerns about cybersecurity, privacy, and reliability emerge. Accordingly, this paper surveys current applications and assesses these challenges. Since the European AI Act classifies transportation AI as high risk, we derive nine technical classes from its requirements to assess current research and future deployments. Our findings show that research mainly studies GPT and Llama models (over 50\% of reviewed works) and traffic applications while largely neglecting security, privacy, and reliability. This gap extends to AI Act compliance: among 35 reviewed works, only one includes a partial vulnerability assessment and one a partial risk management system. We identify a clear gap between strong optimization performance and regulatory adherence, suggesting compliance is limited less by technology than by a focus on static performance over lifecycle safety, and underscoring an urgent need for security-by-design in safety-critical intelligent transportation systems.

</details>


### [582] [Staged Multi-step UTXO Workflows via Recursive Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26305)
*Shuyang Tang,Sherman S. M. Chow,Hongfei Fu,Zihan Guo,Guoqiang Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出递归不变量（RI），一种事务级逻辑与工具链，用事务级谓词表达多步工作流规则，通过后继位置的一次性重检传递规则，无需共享可变应用状态或可执行输出逻辑，从而在UTXO执行模型中保持验证局部性与显式成本核算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无状态UTXO式执行虽支持并行验证和可预测的序列化大小/权重核算，但多步工作流需跨输出串联状态：准备好的下一步事务可能因另一有效花费先确认而失效。显式状态串联把一致性维护、链下跟踪和事务重建转移到协议边界，推高协调成本与延迟。

Method: 提出递归不变量（RI）：将工作流规则表示为事务级谓词，作用于事务输入及RI引用的带索引后继位置。已接受事务在实现某后继位置时，会“一步之后”重新检查前驱RI，从而前传规则。针对验证时不可检查的后继子句，设计小型静态类型DSL，采用三值语义（真、假、未知）延迟未来依赖义务。形式化UTXO验证与账本扩展，界定验证时可求值的一步片段，并证明推演系统相对三值语义的可靠性；给出验证与账本扩展算法。

Result: 实现RI解释器原型与基准工具链，覆盖六类工作负载。六个实践驱动案例显示累计验证成本代理近似线性增长，并能在不预构造每个后继的情况下表达分阶段工作流约束。

Conclusion: RI以重复一步检查实现跨事务保证，使多步协议规则在UTXO模型下保持验证时局部性与显式成本核算，避免共享可变状态与可执行输出逻辑，为多步工作流提供可扩展的链上一致性机制。

Abstract: Stateless UTXO-style execution validates transactions using local and referenced data, enabling parallel validation and predictable serialized-size/weight accounting. Multi-step workflows thread state across outputs, and a prepared next-step transaction may become stale if another valid spend confirms first. Explicit state threading therefore shifts consistency maintenance, off-chain tracking, and transaction rebuilding to the protocol boundary, increasing coordination cost and latency. Recursive invariants (RIs), our proposed transaction-level logic and toolchain, address this gap by expressing workflow rules as transaction-level predicates over a transaction's inputs and indexed successor positions referenced by the RI. An accepted transaction realizing such a successor position re-checks the predecessor's RI one step later, carrying the workflow rule forward without shared mutable application state or executable output logic. Thus, multi-step protocol rules preserve validation-time locality and admit explicit cost accounting, while cross-transaction guarantees arise from repeated one-step checking. Not all successor clauses are checkable at validation time, so our small statically typed domain-specific language (DSL) uses three-valued semantics (true, false, unknown) to defer future-dependent obligations until checkable. Co-designed with this DSL, our framework formalizes UTXO validation and ledger extension, identifies the validation-time-evaluable one-step fragment, and proves the deduction system sound w.r.t. the three-valued semantics. We give validation and ledger-extension algorithms for this model. We implement a prototype RI interpreter and benchmarking toolchain for six workloads. Six practice-motivated case studies exhibit roughly linear cumulative validation-cost proxy growth and illustrate staged workflow constraints without preconstructing each successor.

</details>


### [583] [Design and Evaluation of a Controlled Post-Alert Incident Orchestration and Response Subsystem Using a Rule Engine and a Local Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26316)
*Hoang-Lam Huynh,Quoc-Cuong Tang,Van-Tri Phan,Khuong Nguyen-An*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于教育信息系统的受控式告警后事件编排与响应子系统，通过分离确定性分类、上下文分析、人工审批与技术执行四层架构，在实验室范围内验证了功能正确性、可追溯性、受控恢复与有界模型集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教育信息系统的告警后响应需要兼具自动化效率与安全可控性，直接引入大语言模型存在风险；因此需要一种将确定性规则与有界模型能力相结合、并保留人工审批环节的架构。

Method: 架构分离为四层：确定性分类、上下文分析、人工审批与技术执行。规则引擎负责判定严重度并选择剧本；静态RAG与本地大语言模型在Validator、Guardrail、Output Sanitizer、Safe Fallback四重控制下提供建议内容。实验在模拟告警存入Elasticsearch后开始，涉及规则引擎路由矩阵测试、持久队列事件处理、多告警并发争用及顺序时延测量。

Result: 规则引擎在全部30个边界用例中与预定义路由矩阵一致；持久队列完成100个事件，无重复任务、无新增失败任务、无意外防火墙规则；八告警争用实验维持了“单一活动模型请求”的配置上限；30次顺序测量显示告警后处理时间均值约33秒。

Conclusion: 在所评估的实验室范围内，该子系统实现了功能正确性、可追溯性、受控恢复以及有界的大语言模型集成。

Abstract: This paper presents a controlled post-alert incident orchestration and response subsystem for educational information systems. The architecture separates deterministic classification, contextual analysis, human approval, and technical execution. A Rule Engine determines severity and selects the playbook, while Static RAG and a local large language model provide advisory content under Validator, Guardrail, Output Sanitizer, and Safe Fallback controls. Experiments begin after simulated alerts are stored in Elasticsearch. The Rule Engine matched the predefined routing matrix in all 30 boundary cases. The Durable Queue completed 100 events without duplicate tasks, new failed tasks, or unintended firewall rules. An eight-alert contention experiment preserved the configured limit of one active model request, and 30 sequential measurements showed an overall mean post-alert processing time of approximately 33 seconds. The results demonstrate functional correctness, traceability, controlled recovery, and bounded model integration within the evaluated laboratory scope.

</details>


### [584] [HYDRA: Proactive Android Malware Drift Adaptation via Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26352)
*Han Chen,Hanchen Wang,Hongmei Chen,Lu Qin,Wenjie Zhang,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: HYDRA：一种基于分层图结构与跨域对比学习的主动概念漂移适应框架，用于Android恶意软件检测，在显著降低误报/漏报的同时大幅减少标注需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Android恶意软件快速演化导致概念漂移，严重削弱机器学习检测器性能。现有适应策略存在缺陷：被动方法仅在性能下降后响应且依赖大量人工标注；主动方法则依赖不稳定的对抗训练和不完整、单一层级的图表示。因此需要一种更稳定、标注高效的主动漂移适应方案。

Method: 提出HYDRA（Hybrid Drift Adaptation）主动适应框架，从分层结构数据中学习漂移不变表示。首先用混合图结构建模应用，融合细粒度控制流图（CFG）与粗粒度函数调用图（FCG），以捕获全面行为模式；随后引入跨域对比学习目标，对齐历史（源域）与新（目标域）数据分布，并为无标注目标样本生成伪标签，使语义相似应用的表示在单一稳定优化过程中被拉近，从而统一特征学习与域对齐，免去复杂的对抗目标。

Result: 在大规模、按时间排序的恶意软件数据集上，HYDRA在假阴性率和假阳性率上均显著低于当前最优基线，同时所需标注样本最多减少87.5%。

Conclusion: HYDRA为安全应用中的概念漂移问题提供了一种稳健且高效的解决方案，兼顾检测性能与标注效率。

Abstract: Concept drift, driven by the rapid evolution of Android malware, severely degrades the performance of machine learning detectors. Current adaptation strategies are often reactive, responding only after performance has dropped and imposing a significant manual annotation burden, or they are proactive but rely on unstable adversarial training and incomplete, single-level graph representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose HYDRA (Hybrid Drift Adaptation), a proactive adaptation framework that learns drift-invariant representations from hierarchically structured data. HYDRA first models applications using a hybrid graph structure, combining fine-grained Control Flow Graphs (CFGs) and coarse-grained Function Call Graphs (FCGs) to capture comprehensive behavioral patterns. It then introduces a novel cross-domain contrastive learning objective that aligns historical (source) and new (target) data distributions. By generating pseudo-labels for unlabeled target samples, our method pulls representations of semantically similar applications together, regardless of their domain, within a single, stable optimization process. This approach unifies feature learning and domain alignment, eliminating the need for complex adversarial objectives. Extensive experiments on large-scale, time-ordered malware datasets demonstrate that HYDRA achieves substantially lower False Negative and False Positive Rates than state-of-the-art baselines while requiring up to 87.5% fewer labeled samples. Our work thus offers a robust and efficient solution to combat concept drift in security applications.

</details>


### [585] [Formally Modeling the Terrapin Attack on SSH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26358)
*Jörg Schwenk,Fabian Bäumer,Marcus Brinkmann*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出面向"部分选择状态"的通道完整性形式化模型，用于刻画SSH中不同AEAD模式在通道状态被部分选择时的安全性，并借Terrapin攻击给出各模式的具体安全界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Terrapin攻击（USENIX Security 2024）揭示了"通道状态"这一新型攻击向量，但SSH各AEAD模式受影响程度不同，"未受影响"是否等于"安全"仍是开放问题。既有安全通道形式化模型基于有状态加密，却未定义通道状态是什么、如何作为输入参与各AEAD模式，因此缺少可比较的安全性分析框架。

Method: 提出"部分选择状态下的通道完整性"形式化模型，以SSH序列号作为被选择的状态实例；采用抽象有状态加密接口，并为SSH中八种主流AEAD模式给出伪代码描述；通过变换SND预言机，分别建模仅密文（CO，对应Terrapin）、已知明文（KPA）与选择明文（CPA）攻击，从而给出各AEAD模式的具体安全界。

Result: 三种Encrypt-then-MAC（EtM）模式及SSH中的ChaCha20-Poly1305在CO模型下均不安全；AES-GCM是唯一在CO、KPA、CPA三种模型变体下都安全的模式。进一步地，带CBC的Encrypt-and-MAC（EaM）即使在KPA模型下仍安全；并给出一种新颖的类BEAST选择明文攻击，可破坏EaM-CBC的通道完整性，从而在该方案上区分了KPA与CPA模型。

Conclusion: 通道状态应被显式纳入安全通道的形式化模型；"未受Terrapin影响"并不等价于"安全"。在所提模型下，多数SSH AEAD模式在CO下即失效，仅AES-GCM全面安全，EaM-CBC则呈现KPA与CPA之间的安全性分离。

Abstract: The Terrapin attack against SSH channel integrity (USENIX Security 2024) used a novel attack vector: attacks on the channel state. Surprisingly, not all AEAD modes of SSH were equally affected by this attack, and it remained an open question if "unaffected" meant "secure". Existing formal models for secure channels are based on stateful encryption. However, these models do not define what the channel state is and how it is used as input to the different AEAD modes.
  In this paper, we propose a formal model for channel integrity under partially chosen state. Applied to the Terrapin attack, the chosen state is the SSH sequence number. It uses an abstract stateful encryption interface, for which we provide pseudocode descriptions for the eight most prominent AEAD modes used in SSH. By varying the SND oracle, we can model ciphertext-only (CO; the Terrapin attack), known-plaintext (KPA), and chosen-plaintext (CPA) attacks. This allows us to establish concrete bounds on the security of the AEAD modes. We find that all three Encrypt-then-MAC (EtM) modes and ChaCha20-Poly1305 in SSH are insecure in the CO model. AES-GCM is the only cipher secure in all three model variants. Going beyond Terrapin, we show that Encrypt-and-MAC (EaM) with a CBC cipher is secure, even in the KPA model. In particular, we describe a novel BEAST-like chosen-plaintext attack on the channel integrity of EaM-CBC, which separates the KPA and CPA models for this scheme.

</details>


### [586] [Rouxii: Exploiting Honeypots with Deception-Aware AI Pentesters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26555)
*Arthur Cordeiro,Alberto Maria Mongardini,Emmanouil Vasilomanolakis*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究提出Rouxii框架，将反欺骗能力融入自主LLM渗透测试，使蜜罐识别率从19%升至97%，并进一步展示被识破的蜜罐可被反制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于蜜罐对抗自主LLM渗透测试者的评估，大多假设攻击者不知晓自己正面对欺骗。作者研究相反设定：攻击者被明确赋予识别并利用蜜罐指纹的能力，以检验欺骗效果对攻击者知识的依赖程度。

Method: 提出AI驱动的渗透测试框架Rouxii，在侦察阶段集成反欺骗，并从蜜罐检测转向利用。在3个推理模型、11种网络配置、12个周期下对比vanilla与anti-deception两种配置（仅prompt不同），共获得1,544份攻击报告；并对蜜罐本身进行白盒分析以验证反制可行性。

Result: 匹配队列对比中，反欺骗将蜜罐正确识别率从19%提升至97%，对OT服务效果最显著（11%→97%），而真实服务误报率保持0.7%。欺骗无感知基线（PentestGPT、HackingBuddy）同样失败，说明该效应并非特定于本框架。白盒分析进一步显示，被检测到的蜜罐可被反制：对Conpot实施拒绝服务而不触发其存活监控，并污染GasPot上报的情报。

Conclusion: 蜜罐的欺骗有效性强烈依赖攻击者知识水平，针对AI攻击者的蜜罐韧性评估必须考虑会主动推理并利用欺骗层的对手；检测本身并非终点，被识破的陷阱可反被用于对抗其运营者。

Abstract: Honeypots are designed to deceive attackers, and recent work shows they can also derail autonomous LLM-based pentesters. These evaluations, however, largely consider attackers unaware of the deception they face. We study the opposite setting: an autonomous attacker explicitly equipped to recognize and act on honeypot fingerprints. We introduce Rouxii, an AI-driven penetration-testing framework that integrates counter-deception into reconnaissance and pivots from honeypot detection to exploitation. We evaluate matched vanilla and anti-deception Rouxii configurations across three reasoning models and eleven network setups over twelve cycles (1,544 attack reports). Between the matched cohorts, which differ only in the prompt, counter-deception raises correct honeypot identification from 19% to 97%, an effect strongest on OT services (11% to 97%), while false alarms on the real service stay at 0.7%. Deception-unaware baselines (PentestGPT, HackingBuddy) fail similarly, indicating the effect is not specific to our framework. Detection, moreover, is not the endpoint: through a white-box analysis of the honeypots themselves we show that a detected trap can be turned against its operator, demonstrating a denial-of-service that disables Conpot without tripping its liveness monitoring, and a corruption of the intelligence a GasPot instance reports. These findings show that deception effectiveness depends strongly on attacker knowledge, and that evaluations of honeypot resilience against AI attackers must account for adversaries that actively reason about and exploit the deception layer.

</details>


### [587] [Decoding the Legalese: A Scalable and Quantitative Framework for Analyzing Corporate Privacy Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26680)
*Jiaming Tang,Chenlan Wang,Mingyan Liu,Armin Sarabi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本研究构建并评估了一套端到端的LLM驱动系统，将原始隐私政策转化为细粒度结构化表示和量化指标，并应用于1万条网站隐私政策，提出首个评估隐私政策的标准化可复用指标体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私政策是组织披露个人数据收集、处理与共享的主要机制，但因冗长且法律语言密集，普通用户难以理解；同时，除合规要求外，缺乏刻画隐私政策关键质量的标准化度量指标。LLM的进展使大规模自动结构化与分析这些文档成为可能。

Method: 开发端到端LLM驱动系统：先用细粒度分类体系抽取具体数据元素与治理实践，并捕获将每项实践与其所引用的数据元素关联起来的关系链接；将原始隐私政策转化为结构化表示及一组量化测度。

Result: 将该框架应用于包含1万条网站隐私政策的多样化语料，构建了据称迄今最全面的同类数据集；基于结构化表示提出首个标准化、可重复的量化指标，从完整性、透明度、用户保护承诺、商业驱动数据实践侧重四个维度评估隐私政策。

Conclusion: 该指标体系支持在同一行业内部及跨行业比较隐私政策，并可评估用户保护与商业利益之间的张力。

Abstract: Even though privacy policies are the primary mechanism organizations use to disclose how they collect, process, and share personal data, they are difficult for average users to interpret, perhaps by design, due to their verbosity and dense legal language. Importantly, there is a lack of standardized metrics that characterize key qualities of a privacy policy beyond regulatory requirements. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) make it feasible to automatically structure and analyze these documents at scale. In this study, we develop and evaluate an end-to-end, LLM-enabled system that converts raw privacy policies into fine-grained structured representations and a set of quantitative measures. Our pipeline applies a detailed taxonomy to extract specific data elements and governing practices, capturing relational links that connect each practice to the data elements it references. We apply our framework to a diverse corpus of 10,000 website privacy policies, yielding, to the best of our knowledge, the most comprehensive dataset of its kind to date. Building on our structured representations, we introduce the first standardized and repeatable quantitative metrics for evaluating privacy policies along four dimensions: completeness, transparency, commitment to user protection, and emphasis on business-driven data practices. This allows us to compare policies within and across industry sectors, and to assess the tension between user protection and business interests.

</details>


### [588] [From Alignment to Access Control: A Framework for GenAI Policy Enforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26682)
*Nathalie Baracaldo*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文综述了生成式AI（GenAI）应用中策略（policy）执行现状，提出一套系统化方法分析现有策略定义与执行方案，并就"好坏与隐忧"给出建议与行动呼吁，旨在统一策略执行视角以提升安全与合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI应用能力发展迅猛，而安全与合规机制演进滞后，已引发真实事件。策略是定义应用期望行为、实现安全与合规的基石，但不同实践者对策略的理解各异，导致概念混淆与碎片化方案，难以满足合规要求。因此有必要系统梳理并统一GenAI策略执行的理解。

Method: 提出一套方法学（methodology），用于系统性地分析与剖析（analyze and dissect）现实中已有的GenAI策略定义与执行方案，从"好、坏、隐忧"三个维度进行原则化分析。

Result: 基于该原则化分析，给出面向社区的推荐建议（recommendations）与行动呼吁（call for action）。摘要未披露具体实证数据或量化结果。

Conclusion: GenAI策略执行的统一视角是必要且紧迫的；需通过系统性方法整合分散方案，推动社区协同解决策略定义与执行中的分歧，以实现安全与合规。本文为USENIX Security 2026 Enigma演讲的配套扩展文章。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) applications have flourished enabling users to chat with large language models, and to create agents to act on their behalf for a variety of tasks. The pace of development of capabilities in this field is incredibly fast with security and safety taking a back seat. Unfortunately, the slower pace at which security and safety mechanisms have evolved has led to real incidents. Policy enables the definition of desirable behavior of applications, and for that reason, it is a cornerstone of making systems secure and compliant. Policy however means different things to different practitioners creating confusion and siloed solutions that are not adequate for compliance. This paper takes a tour of the good, the bad and the ugly when it comes to policy enforcement in GenAI applications. We propose a methodology to systematically analyze and dissect existing approaches to define and enforce policy found in the wild. Based on this principled analysis, we provide recommendations and call for action for the community to address.
  This paper is a companion extension of USENIX Security 2026 Enigma talk titled "From Alignment to Access Control: A Unified View of GenAI Policy Enforcement" by the author Nathalie Baracaldo.

</details>


### [589] [A2M: Trace-Optimized Agent Hijacking in the MCP Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26761)
*Laizhen Li,Xuan Wang,Peicheng Zhao,Juanjuan Zhao,Kejiang Ye,Cheng-zhong Xu,Xitong Gao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 A2M，一个针对 MCP 智能体工具选择与执行的两阶段黑盒攻击框架，在 LiveMCPBench 上验证了高工具调用率、高成本放大与较高攻击成功率，并展示跨模型迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP 智能体依赖语义匹配从第三方服务器选择工具，而攻击者可控制工具元数据与返回内容，形成语义供应链风险；现有工作缺乏对工具选择与执行两环节协同攻击的系统研究，因此需要揭示该威胁以推动工具审查与运行时隔离。

Method: A2M 为两阶段黑盒框架：Attraction 阶段优化工具元数据以提升被调用概率；Manipulation 阶段利用执行轨迹精炼对抗性工具返回，引导智能体走向攻击者期望的结果。

Result: 在 LiveMCPBench 上，针对 GLM-4.6 优化与评估的直接攻击在四个场景中宏平均恶意工具调用率达 93.6%；认知拒绝服务场景下加权 token 成本升至良性基线的 32.4 倍；信息窃取、环境完整性破坏与推理偏离三类任务平均攻击成功率为 74.4%。无需重新优化迁移至四个其他模型时，对应宏平均分别为 63.6%、2.7 倍与 24.5%。

Conclusion: 结果表明 MCP 生态中的语义供应链攻击具有高有效性与一定跨模型迁移性，亟需加强工具审查与运行时隔离，代码已开源。

Abstract: Agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) rely on semantic matching to select tools from third-party servers, exposing a semantic supply-chain risk through attacker-controlled metadata and outputs. We introduce A2M (Attraction-to-Manipulation), a two-stage black-box framework for hijacking MCP agents. The Attraction phase optimizes tool metadata to increase invocation probability; the Manipulation phase uses execution traces to refine adversarial tool returns that steer agents toward attacker-desired outcomes. On LiveMCPBench, direct attacks optimized and evaluated on GLM-4.6 achieve a macro-average malicious tool invocation rate of 93.6% across four scenarios, increase weighted token costs to 32.4$\times$ the benign baseline under Cognitive Denial of Service, and attain a mean attack success rate of 74.4% across Information Exfiltration, Environment Integrity Compromise, and Reasoning Derailment. Transfer to four other models without re-optimization yields corresponding macro-averages of 63.6%, 2.7$\times$, and 24.5%. These findings motivate stronger tool vetting and runtime isolation in MCP ecosystems. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Lilaizhen/A2M.

</details>
